Rushing past a few lush trees and bushes, Jason suddenly halted his steps, before he turned around in order to squeeze himself through a particular bush as his mana eyes perceived something.
It was extremely risky because it could either save him or cause his death, as he saw a large hole behind the bush which he entered without hesitating anymore.
With his mana eyes, he perceived faint mana fluctuations radiating from something he estimated to be a hole, while further below he sensed weak fluctuations that came most likely from awakened beasts.
However, even though the mana radiating from them was extremely weak, the radiating color Jason perceived was a thick green indicating the potential of a magical ranked beast, which was the reason for him to jump into the hole.
Even though the fire elemental crystal horned python was a magical ranked beast, it barely reached this rank thanks to it undergoing a mutation and it would never challenge other magical ranked beasts if it was not necessary because it was suicidal.
After jumping into the hole he identified as a den, Jason felt his shoulder burning even more than before, while Artemis was forcefully woken up from her slumber.
Looking around, he suddenly saw three small dark-green furred wolf cubs in front of him, gazing at him confused, as they expected their parents to come back.
Smiling lightly, Jason used all his remaining mana to supply his golden eyes with it while trying to show that he didn't want to harm them.
Bewitched by his golden eyes the dark green-furred wolf cubs, he identified as tornado wolf cubs didn't make a single sound as they approached him quietly.
'Thank you!!' He told himself, as he exerted the concealment technique, he barely knew in order to suppress his mana fluctuations even more.
Seeing the magical-ranked python halting in its track, his heart thumped loudly as he stopped to breathe.
'Just go!' Jason shouted in his mind as the crystal horned python slowly slithered away from the bush he squeezed through.
Sighing in relief, he didn't even notice the three furballs sniffing at him in interest.
Stroking them subconsciously, Jason was still looking through the soil with his mana eyes in order to figure out when to leave the Wolf den he jumped in a few seconds ago.
Suddenly he heard Artemis screeching out, which surprised him.
Turning around to her worriedly, he saw her quarreling with the tornado wolf cubs, which were currently at the awakened rank because she also wanted to be stroked.
Averting his gaze towards his left hand, Jason noticed that he stroked one of the wolf cubs, while the others also wanted to be cuddled causing them to approach his other hand.
Trying to lift it, Jason felt extremely uncomfortable and it was almost impossible to do without him feeling an almost unbearable aching coming from his broken shoulder, which caused him to inspect his current situation closer.
Scanning through his own body, he sighed in relief, as he took out a handful of glimmering potions.
Gulped down the potions after a short moment, Jason immediately felt the effect, invigorating his body while at the same time supplementing him with necessary nutrition.
Because of the tornado wolf cubs' gentle behavior, Jason forgot that they would be magical ranked beasts once they reached maturity, and even more important was that they had parents that would come back soon.
However, Jason seemed to be completely oblivious to this fact.
After gulping down the potions, Jason took out a few dishes to eat because he felt extremely hungry, almost as if he were to starve any moment if he wouldn't eat immediately.
Unfortunately, he was interrupted by three dark green bodies and a pure white Artemis jumping towards the food he took out from his storage device, as the four beasts landed on his chest, throwing him on the back.
Shouting out in pain, his heavy chest was immediately freed from the four beasts' weight, as Jason glared at all of them.
'Are all of you my soul bonds now or what?! Can't your parents feed you?? Artemis is already a glutton and too much for me to handle.' Sighing deeply, Jason couldn't help but feel slightly regretful, that he even entered the Wolf den.
Nevertheless, he had to acknowledge that surviving the crystal horned python's wrath would have been much more of a hassle.
Nodding his head, he took out a few dishes because the puppy eyes of the tornado wolf cubs made him weak.
"You three helped me to survive… let me give you a reward, okay?" Jason said as he took out a few raw steaks he purchased in Cyro-City in order to make a BBQ on their journey through the four-star rift when they had time and the opportunity to do so.
Unfortunately, the whole expedition was now somewhat chaotic, and instead of grilling and eating the steaks by himself, he could also feed them to the wolf cubs, who saved his life, even if they weren't aware of the effect the cubs and their parents' smell had.
Feeding the three tornado wolf cubs, Artemis stared daggers at him, causing him to chuckle lightly, as he took out another steak and a magical ranked mana core at the same time to let her decide what she wanted to eat.
Taking the steak with her beak, Jason stored the magical ranked mana core away, as he took out convenience food which he heated up slightly with his black origin flame before he scarfed down one plate after another.
After a few plates, he took out a few more steaks to give them the wolf cubs and Artemis, and when Jason was done eating, he felt full of energy thanks to the food he ate and the potions' effects.
The pain in his shoulder already lessened slightly, even though it was still extremely painful.
Trying to stand up, Jason suddenly noticed four furballs laying on his lap and legs.
"Am I a bed or something like that?!" he mumbled as his body stiffened when killing intent enveloped his whole body.
Turning his head, he saw two, three-meter tall dark-green furred wolves entering the Wolf den, only to bare their teeth at the sight of him, while both released their killing intent towards him.
"Oh..F**K...Greetings mother wolf…."

chapters.title: Chapter 209 - Escaped
chapters.content:
Seeing the two adult Tornado wolves at the magical rank in front of him, cold sweat poured down his back, while their killing intent tried to inflict fear within Jason.
Gulping down his saliva, he took a glance at the sleeping cubs and Artemis as an idea appeared in his mind!
'Should I....No...I can't...Even if I do so it would be useless' Shaking his head, Jason immediately disregarded the idea of kidnapping one of the tornado wolf cubs in order to survive, because it would end up in bad blood with each other, which was not what both of them most likely wanted, and it was unsure if he would even survive his current dilemma like this.
Thinking about all kinds of solutions, Jason′s head seemed to smoke and in the end, there was no perfect solution for his current situation.
He was too slow to flee from two magical ranked beasts and not strong enough to fight them.
Abducting the sleeping tornado cubs would only worsen the situation long-term while he would maybe survive for a short time.
However, the worst was that Artemis just continued to sleep, as if the killing intent around them was nothing, while his back was completely drenched in cold sweat.
Within a second, Jason used his newly established fortified soul conjunction with Artemis to forcefully wake her up, which was retorted with an annoying screeching from her, as she opened her eyes.
Standing up, she looked around, only to see the adult Tornado wolves radiating a dense killing-intent in front of them, which shocked her, as she stepped back, only to bump into Jason.
"Now your awake, hmm?" Jason said as a joke, trying to ease up the tension around them while staring at the adult Tornado wolves that didn't move a single inch.
They were equally shocked to see two low-ranked beings infiltrating their den, which not a single beast around them ever dared to do because they wouldn't be able to endure the wrath of two magical ranked beasts at the same time.
As such the current situation was uncommon while the mother tornado wolf was only glad that nothing happened to her cubs, who seemed to sleep next to the bipedal being, without being on guard against possible attacks.
From the Tornado wolf's perspective, this could only have a few certain reasons… either her cubs were manipulated, tricked by an illusion, sedated from poison or there was no threat from the beings that infiltrated the den.
After scanning through her cubs' mana cores, she couldn't detect any poison, while the first two reasons were quite difficult to figure out.
But even so, the wolf mother felt relieved, causing her to decrease the killing intent she released by a large margin, allowing Jason to take a deep breath.
'They won't attack me with the cubs next to me, right?' Jason figured out and this was most likely the only positive aspect in his current position.
Suddenly an idea formed in his mind, as he remembered something important about mother-beast instincts and that they knew if their cub was in danger.
As such, Jason tried to go all in.
Slowly grabbing one of the wolf cubs with his hand, he could only hear two loud growls in front of him, as the killing intent increased once again.
However, Jason couldn't care less at the moment, because his shoulder burned like fire, as he picked one of the tornado wolf cubs up from his leg in order to lay it next to his leg to free it.
The other two cubs laid across his other leg and he did the same with the two of them.
Yawning, one of the tornado wolf cubs seemed to wake up, only to fall back into a deep slumber, which caused Jason to smile lightly.
'They don't even know that I'm about to die huh? At least some emotional support would be nice.' He lamented while maintaining his smile until both legs were finally freed.
Meanwhile, Artemis couldn't really do anything to help because her talons were too sharp to grab the tornado wolf, which would hurt them and wake them up, even if she dulled them.
As such, Jason had to do everything by himself, and after his legs were free, he changed his current position, only to hear the growling next to him becoming louder.
The adult Tornado wolf approached him, causing goosebumps to spread all over his body, while he tried to be as genuine as possible.
He didn't want to hear the tornado cubs and picking them up once again to lay them carefully in front of him, he caressed them one after another which caused them to turn on their back, revealing their belly towards him.
Caressing it, Jason suddenly sensed Artemis' jealousy, as she approached him from behind, demanding carcasses.
Frowning, Jason couldn't help but mumble "Are you a diva or something like that? We might be torn apart any moment and you want to be caressed?", before he noticed that he could freely breathe, without any killing intent enveloping him and Artemis.
'Huh?' Looking at the two matured Tornado wolves, he noticed that their gaze turned less hostile and Jason stepped back from the three cubs in order to give their parents time to inspect them to figure out if there were any injuries.
If his knowledge was not completely wrong, the intelligence of beasts at the magical rank was not worse than that of average adults and Jason relied on this information in order to survive.
Furthermore showing too much fear would worsen his situation, even if he couldn't help himself in the beginning, because he was too flustered.
As such, he thought about multiple magical ranked beasts' habits, and only a minority hunted for fun, while most of them only killed beasts in order to protect their children, territory, or eat something.
Before he utilized his plan, he saw the male tornado wolf dragging a large beast corpse into the den, while the thick scent of blood permeated the air, telling Jason that they had more than enough food for the time being.
Slowly retreating, Artemis finally noticed how serious their situation was, as she similarly stepped back.
After inspecting their cubs, the mother tornado wolf's gaze averted back to Jason and Artemis, before she picked up two cubs with her maw before the other tornado wolf took the remaining cub.
'Can we go?' Jason thought, as Artemis suddenly flapped with her wings, landing on his right shoulder, causing him to almost shout out in pain.
"YOU!!" Gnashing his teeth, he held out his left arm for Artemis to step it, before she slowly paddled towards his left shoulder while expressing her being sorry through the fortified soul conjunction.
Stepping slowly back, he wanted to prevent doing any sound, and only when the two of them left the Wolf den for good, Jason sighed in relief, before looking around if anything dangerous was nearby them.
To Artemis, he instructed
"Stay with me for now...I don't know if there are any flying beasts around us...We lost our team and are without anyone who is capable enough to defeat unblemished beasts…"
Thinking about all kinds of possibilities, Jason′s shoulder that still hurt like hell with each step he took was the only thing that forcefully held him back from being lost in thought because he had to find a good hideout in order to recuperate.
The forest was too dangerous because he could see high mana fluctuations from everywhere and was as such not a good place for him to recuperate from his injury.
Suddenly he remembered something
'Wasn't there something with low mana fluctuation far behind the flower, nearby the hillside where our assassination failed?'
Jason wondered and if his memory was not completely wrong, he couldn't see any high-graded mana fluctuations from there.
He didn't feel comfortable about the place, but Jason felt that it was the only area that was remotely safe if anything within the four-star rift could be called like this.

chapters.title: Chapter 210 - Cave
chapters.content:
Looking around, he tried to find similar areas like the one he previously saw nearby the mutated crystal horned pythons habitat because he wanted to avoid being too close with other high-ranked beasts.
Scanning everything with his mana eyes, he could perceive many mana fluctuations from unblemished beasts and even magical ranked beasts around him, which caused Jason to feel overwhelmed by the sensation of being extremely weak.
He hadn't felt this for quite some time because he became one of the strongest in his school, but now his whole existence was on the line.
A single mistake and everything was over.
Jason knew that and he decided to search for the best path back to the mutated crystal horned python′s habitat, because of two important facts.
First, the wind elemental python was dead, blown into smithereens, while the second reason was that not a single high-ranked beast should be there because the fire elemental crystal horned python was still searching for him, and he hadn't seen any other beasts in the surrounding.
He saw the crystal horned python slithering past the Wolf den without coming back and it would most likely take some time before it would give up its pursuit, which caused Jason to feel like a ray of hope emerged within him.
As long as he found a safe area to recuperate and increase his soul energy in order to store Artemis, everything would become much easier for him.
With the fortified soul conjunction, his survival rate would increase further and the ray of hope within Jason widened slightly.
While finding his way back to the crystal python habitat, he looked out for other hideouts that might be even safer than the one he presumed to find but there was nothing, which soured Jason′s mood slightly.
'At least it will be better than sleeping inside the forest without anyone on night duty, right?' He thought as he noticed the sun descending slowly.
Hastening up his steps, Jason′s mana eyes were working at full speed, trying to maintain a perfect observance, while giving his best to avoid any kinds of high-ranked beasts.
Half an hour later, he finally reached the large stone that protrudes out of the ground, with a smile emerging on his face, as he noticed that the ripen plant was still there without any signs of other beasts or even the fire elemental crystal horned python in his surrounding.
For a short moment, he felt his greed emerging from deep within him, as he looked at the almost ripen plant in front of him, which he immediately suppressed.
Even if he wanted to, it would be suicidal to take the ripen plant with him now, because the python would be able to detect his scent once he picked up the herb, which would additionally release spores, attaching to his clothes.
As such, Jason disregarded this opportunity, because he didn't want to provoke the crystal horned python needlessly, as he walked towards the uncountable number of colors he saw thanks to his mana eyes.
'They have to be ores, materials, or something like that, right?' He asked himself because these colors radiating around pointy-shaped things hadn't moved for the time he fled from the python pair, which was already some time ago.
As such it had to be inanimate objects, which enlightened him, causing his steps to hasten up even more.
The closer he came, the more colors he perceived, while the mana fluctuations around there seemed to be high and low at the same time.
However, this wasn't the main point, because almost all of these mana fluctuations contained elemental transmuted mana, which made him curious.
Even though his shoulder hurt like hell while walking, Jason increased his speed even further, while Artemis decided to fly a few meters above him due to the uncomfortable sensation she had to endure with Jason′s fast strides, as she was forced to remain squeezed on his shoulder.
But even Artemis was attracted to some of these mana fluctuations, causing her to subconsciously fly towards them, only for her to see something she hated the most.
When Jason squeezed himself through the last bush that obstructed his view, he saw a huge hillside with a large cavern entrance in front of him, which was Artemis' reason to look so frustrated.
As a flying beast, the thing she hated the most was having her freedom restricted.
She didn't mind staying within Jason's soul world for weeks, which was already boring, but when she was outside she wanted to soar through the sky.
Even the Wolf den was already too much for her and now Jason had to enter a cavern?
Artemis didn't like it, which she transmitted to Jason, who could only smile apologetically.
"Well.. either come with me or stay outside. You know I can′t order you, but please know that everything outside the cavern is extremely dangerous." He only said, trying to put on a disguise as if he didn't care about Artemis' choice while entering the cavern entrance with careful steps.
His mana eyes distracted him extremely, with colors ranging from black to dark-green and all kinds of mana fluctuations from thin to thick, low- to high-quality, and so on.
It was almost painful and if he wasn't proficient with enduring pain through his eyes, Jason would have already deactivated his mana eyes, which could end up devastating, once he missed something dangerous.
He was in a four-star rift and everything could kill him and he was aware of this fact.
A little bit pain was nothing if he wanted to survive here and he only noticed Artemis following him, as she intentionally landed on his right shoulder, which caused Jason to grit his teeth in pain in order to prevent crying out loudly.
After she was satisfied, she immediately changed towards his left shoulder, where she stayed as if nothing happened.
'She really became a diva?' Jason thought, suppressing the desire to lecture her because his full attention was required somewhere else.
Walking deeper into the cave, he noticed tunnels at the end of the entrance, leading in four different directions.
Two tunnels were extremely large with a height of more than ten meters while the remaining outer tunnels had a height of three meters at most.
This difference might be important for him to decide which path to choose because most high-ranked beasts were rather large.
But this didn't apply for all of them and the mutated crystal horned python was one example, while he already saw more than enough smaller magical ranked beasts within the valley.
As such it didn't really matter which tunnel he took.
All of them radiated dense mana, with hundreds of colored pointy-shaped things further down the tunnels.
The only advantageous fact Jason made overjoyed was that he couldn't see a single moving beast further below with his mana eyes, while he saw many rare colors through the soil, shocking him.
'Where the hell did I land?' He wondered, as his sight was obstructed due to the absence of a light source.
Holding out his left hand, Artemis immediately figured out what he wanted to do, causing her to screech out in anger, as a black flame appeared in it, lightening up the surrounding.
Clearly seeing his surroundings it was the first time for Jason to see something like this, as he saw one of the objects that radiated a color protruding out of the soil.
'Is that a crystal?'

chapters.title: Chapter 211 - Elemental Crystal Cave
chapters.content:
Jason clearly saw a red crystal protruding out of the ground, which radiated a faint light-gray color, and at the same time, fire elemental transmuted mana which astonished him a little bit.
'Why does this crystal look soo familiar?' He wondered, and approaching the red crystal radiating faint fire transmuted. mana, Jason remembered something he read and saw in many different books from Shane and Dalia.
They were mostly about the three basic lifestyle occupations but also in Beast creations and in even more theses Dalia handed him out.
"Is that a fire elemental crystal?" Jason mumbled as he squatted down in order to touch the red crystal.
Once his left hand touched the crystal, he immediately felt a vigorous wave of fire elemental mana invading him, causing slight pain when it entered his mana veins.
Releasing his black origin flame within himself, the pain substituted before he released the crystal from his hand.
'Interesting!... If all the things with colors I see within the cave are elemental crystals, I′m within an elemental crystal cave, huh?'
He thought while smiling silly…
If Jason was really within an elemental crystal cave, his financial issue would immediately vanish as long as he excavated a decent amount of them.
Now the only question tormenting him, how he should mine them...
Taking a look inside his storage device, Jason was sure that he purchased quite a lot of things, but he couldn′t remember having bought a pickaxe.
Upon sensing a bunch of tools thrown into the corner of his storage device, Jason took them out one after another with a small ray of hope emerging within him.
'That′s a sickle, an ax…..a shovel!....a hoe? Why did I buy a hoe? Oh!! I really bought a pickaxe!!'
Taking out a pickaxe, Jason′s smile radiated the surrounding, as Artemis jumped from his shoulder in order to give him some space, while Jason tried to move his shoulder in order to test out his current capabilities
His shoulder hurt like hell, but he wanted to extract at least this one crystal in front of him because he was curious about it.
If he could satiate his curiosity by enduring a little bit of pain, he would definitely accept it.
Furthermore, it wouldn't take long, because the crystal had only the size of his fist.
As such after two to three painful swings with his low-grade-1 pickaxe the crystal was already in his left hand, while he sealed it in order to prevent it from releasing transmuted mana into his body.
Looking at the red gleaming crystal, Jason tried to remember the advantages elemental crystals had, and the first fact that jumped into his mind, was their capability to strengthen affinities.
With pure elemental crystals, beasts and even humans could increase their affinity to a certain extent, while it was mostly used for beasts to strengthen their affinity because they would innately share it with their contractor.
The extent for elemental crystals to strengthen affinities was restricted to the amount of mana and its purity.
If the purity within was less than the innate purity of the beast's transmuted mana which wanted to enhance its affinity, it wouldn't work, while comprehending a higher-ranked affinity by solely absorbing a purer transmuted mana was extremely difficult with some theorists even saying that it might be dangerous.
It was said that there was even the possibility to deteriorate the affinity by comprehending something innately wrong, even though the possibility was extremely low.
'Ah!!' Suddenly Jason remembered the main reason for the elemental crystals' price which was not low, to begin with.
The reason was that one could even concoct potions with them, while it was also possible to forge weapons with elemental crystals, and inscribe runes with a certain ratio of crushed elemental crystals within the inscribing mixture would allow one to use a foreign affinity to a certain extent.
Like this one could disguise runes within the ground, by using crushed earth elemental crystals or create traps with a variety of elemental runes.
But more importantly, were the concocted potions and Jason faintly remembered a certain Beast creation book, stating that some potions to evolve beasts had to be concocted with elemental transmuted mana.
Thinking about this statement, Jason tried to remember more paragraphs like this and after a short while, he could already faintly remember a few theses, paragraphs, and even potions stating the same.
'Aren't some wands also made out of elemental crystals...or was it a similar material?' Jason wondered as he remembered a special perk of some wands, allowing someone without a single affinity, to use weak affinities.
Even one of the stated perks, he remembered about the elemental crystals would be worth a fortune, while the elemental crystals in front of him had all these advantages.
Jason′s mood immediately skyrocketed and he decided to strive deeper into the elemental crystal cave, while his mana eyes observed everything in order to figure out where the supposed elemental crystals were and at the same time to see if any beast approached him.
Weirdly enough, he couldn't see any beast at all, and the further he went into the cave, the more elemental crystals he found, protruding out of the ground, ceiling, and walls.
'Is it finally my time?' Jason thought overjoyed, as he turned around to figure out if something from above entered, only for his eyes to widen in extreme shock.
"What the hell is that?" He exclaimed, which resounded throughout the cave, as he saw hundreds of beasts flooding the cavern entrance, he walked in a few hours ago.
However what wondered him was, that presumed prey and predator charged into the cavern at the same time seemingly without caring about each other′s existence at all.
'What did I enter?!' Yet, even after asking himself the same question multiple times there was no answer and Jason went deeper into the cave to further increase the distance to the beast at the entrance.
Every few painful steps he took, Jason turned around without halting his steps for a single second in order to check what happened above.
'They stopped?' he wondered, as he noticed something even weirder.
'These beasts excavate the crystals?!?' With a shocked expression, Jason saw hundreds of beasts occupying the cavern entrance and even the four different tunnels in order to dig out the elemental crystals, without going deeper into the cave.
'Why don't they come down?' He wondered as the walls around him began to shake violently, startling him, Artemis, and the beasts from above.
Noticing that the beasts from above charged out of the cave, Jason had a bad premonition, however, even after a few seconds passed, there was not a single beast that accidentally entered the depths of the cave as he did, and he finally figured out what was going on, as two of the four the tunnels above him collapsed.
'Is that an earthquake?! Why now?' Jason lamented as he remembered Shane lecturing him that he should always know his surroundings which included the landscape with its perks.
Cursing in his mind, Jason exclaimed angrily "How the hell should I know where exactly tectonic plates are situated?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 212 - Calming Pain
chapters.content:
Everything around him shook violently, and there was nothing to grip in order to stay firmly, causing him to fall on the ground, where searing pain spread out from his shoulder.
Shouting out in pain, Jason cursed his decision to venture into the four-star rift more than ever.
'Why am I so uselessly stubborn?!'
But in the end, there was no use in lamenting about his choice, because it already happened and lamenting about the past was useless.
In order to enhance his body, he ordered Scorpio to enter his mana core once again, causing him to reach the physique of an 8th Adept rank.
With this, he could endure a little bit more force as a few rocks loosened up from the ceiling, falling onto him and Artemis.
Enveloping himself in a tattered exoskeleton out of his coccyx grew a 60-centimeter long stinger, piercing straight towards the rock falling onto him.
Shattering the rock, Jason sighed in relief as dirt fell straight into his eyes, forcing him to close them.
'F**k' Cursing out, Jason used his senses to perceive stones, rocks, and loose soil falling onto him, while he unsheathed his Viridi-Starstream daggers.
Even if there were no beasts around him, large rocks and exploding elemental crystals could still harm or even kill him if he was not careful.
The presumed earthquake took still a long time and the pain in his shoulder increased further, while Jason decided to let his eyes closed in order to prevent more fine dust, dirt, or whatsoever from entering them.
His mana senses were still able to perceive everything around him clearly because he was already accustomed to it since he was young.
When he couldn't see anything at all, he relied on himself to survive in a city without much support for orphans or rather disabled children like him at all.
After his mother died, he forcefully used his 1st Novice rank mana in order to perceive his surrounding as far as possible, which was extremely taxing
Thinking about his mother, Jason felt melancholic, sad, and angry at the same time, because he neither knew who killed his mother, how she looked like, other than her photo and her voice began to slowly disappear from his memories.
Being reminded about that, his mana fluctuations became unstable and filled with anger, causing his perception to become unclear.
'Why did she have to die?!.. Cerus-family...I'll be coming soon. If you don't answe...r!!' He thought in anger, as a large rock fell on his shoulder, causing the already unbearable pain to increase further.
"ARGHH!" Jason shouted out, as he calmed down..'I can think of that later…Let's survive first'
Telling this to himself, an eternity or rather one minute passed until the presumed earthquake stopped.
'That was a long one....?' Jason thought while cold sweat drenched his already completely wet clothes, thanks to the pain and complete focus he overcame.
Opening his eyes, he noticed Artemis next to him looking at him accusingly while her whole plumage was dirtied, which annoyed her.
Jason didn't care about his soulbond being dirty at the moment, as he took out a few potions which he emptied without wasting any time, which caused his aching shoulder to feel slightly better.
Taking out a small bowl and water, he placed it in front of Artemis saying "Drink first and then you can wash up, alright?"
Which she answered by turning away from him like she was about to say "Hmpff!"
Sighing, Jason decided to ignore her for the time being, as he looked around if something important changed in his current situation.
One of the most important issues was the question of the cave collapsed completely, locking him inside or if he could venture out once he wanted.
If he was imprisoned, it wouldn't be that much of a problem, because it would prevent other beasts from invading his current position, but there would be only one extremely terrifying issue.
Once he was completely sealed within the cave without any oxygen supply, his chances to survive would be limited.
However, this issue could be relatively easily solved, because he could either use his physique to clear a path outside thanks to the tools he had, use fireballs to make a crude path, or use a few grenades within his storage device.
As such, Jason was still rather calm, as he activated his mana eyes in order to figure out the situation above.
Fortunately, even the soil radiated faint traces of mana, allowing him to see where less mana was which showed the tunnels.
Upon observing everything carefully, Jason noticed that he could even see the paths leading everywhere which shocked him because it was as if he used an X-ray vision.
It somehow creeped him out, but he was still glad as he noticed that more than enough paths that lead to his current position were free, even though they were partially spilled by rubble.
With an intact oxygen supply, Jason decided to take a good rest, because he was already too exhausted to either eat something or look around for a more comfortable position to rest.
Leaning at the wall, he closed his dead-tired eyes and fell asleep, while Artemis cleaned her plumage not without forgetting to glare at Jason.
**
Waking up, Jason wasn't sure how many hours passed, as he cleaned himself within a basin he took out with the water he stored in his storage device.
Taking out a clean set of clothes, Jason exhausted himself by changing them, without hurting his shoulder too much, and gritting his teeth was barely helpful.
He changed into a completely new set of clothes with the exception being his mana grade-2 leather armor which was important for him to survive.
Without it, Jason felt naked and unguarded and somehow he somehow survived the whole incident the day before, thanks to it.
Checking his soul world, Scorpio seemed to have entered it once again and upon looking closer, his exoskeleton seemed to repair itself slowly, which wondered him.
'Is that an effect from the soul world or is that normal?' Either way Jason was unsure what the reason was, but it was definitely advantageous and made him happy.
His soul energy was already completely replenished and without being able to take a look at his quantum bracelet, Jason was unable to tell the time.
As such, he wanted to practice the Heaven's Hell technique in order to improve his soul energy and at the same time to keep the track of time, because his soul energy was fully replenished every five to six hours.
In the end, Jason wanted to stay longer within the cave, because it was the only safe place he found and it could even benefit him extremely, due to the high quantity of qualitative good elemental crystals.
He was not sure how vast the elemental crystal cave was but from what his mana eyes perceived, it was shocking.
To add on, Jason had to recuperate his broken shoulder which still hurt like hell.
'One step after another!' He told himself while approaching the soul world core within himself.
Practicing the Heaven's Hell technique, Jason felt his tension loosening slowly, while the familiar pain spread through his body, calming him down.
The last 24 hours were just too much for him to handle, and the calming pain released everything at once, while Artemis eyed him weird, because Jason smiled while she felt the pain searing through his body.
'Is he broken?''

chapters.title: Chapter 213 - Breathtaking Speed
chapters.content:
After practicing the Heaven's Hell technique, Jason felt much better, and standing up, his shoulder seemed to hurt less compared to before.
'Is it because of the tension?' He wondered, but moving the shoulder slightly reminded him of the pain.
'Maybe 6 days?' Jason predicted and thinking about the remaining time their expedition team planned to remain within the four-star rift, he estimated that he had between 19 to 24 days left until the rift would close.
'No time to stress myself, right? I shouldn't be that far from the highland plateau.' Thinking about the remaining time, Jason calmed himself down and the most important thing, for now, was to heal his broken shoulder with all kinds of potions, nutrition, and mana supplying the recuperation process.
Pondering what he should do first, he decided to eat something, because his stomach was already revolting against the emptiness inside it.
It was only fortunate for him that he purchased so much food and taking out one plate after another, Artemis approached him in order to receive a mana core.
Handing out an incomplete unblemished beast core, she stared daggers at him, which Jason ignored knowingly, by focusing on his own food.
Screeching out, she revolted but there was no need for Artemis to digest complete mana cores from beasts, because the digestion time was roughly the same, while she would only have to eat more incomplete unblemished ranked cores at once in order to balance the mana scarcity out.
Jason knew why Artemis wanted a magical ranked mana core and it was most likely because liquefied mana was extremely helpful for her, however, he forgot to purchase a large number of such cores, while a bulk of unblemished ranked beast cores waited for Artemis to devour them.
He obtained the unblemished ranked beast cores from Cheng when he sold the pseudo-mana grade-3 anvil and Artemis had to eat them, either now or later.
As such he could only act ignorant and once he finished his large breakfast, Jason decided to actively absorb mana, as a faint smile emerged on his face.
The surrounding mana was extremely dense and somehow even more so after the earthquake which most likely dug out some crystals which laid around him.
Initially, Jason wanted to collect all mana- and elemental crystals before starting to absorb mana, but he wanted to recuperate a little bit more before straining his broken shoulder even more than he already did.
He was already scared that the burden his broken shoulder had to endure the day before was too large to handle and permanent injuries would be the worst-case scenario, for now, which Jason didn't even want to imagine.
Still smiling with the dense mana streams around him, Jason opened his pores without hesitation, as he created a large suction force within him, greedily accepting everything in his surrounding, without differentiating between transmuted mana or neutral mana.
This could be seen as foolish, but from his previous experience, Jason was sure that the black origin flame within him, could cleanse the harmful transmuted mana, expelling it if necessary.
There was no secured proof to this, but his strengthened soul connection with the origin flame told him so subconsciously.
If he couldn't even trust his own soulbonds, who could he trust?
Trusting his gut feeling, he just began to do as he thought, without considering that it might be a mistake.
With time passing, Jason felt all kinds of transmuted mana infiltrating his mana veins, while his whole body was heated up by the black origin flame, cleansing everything instinctively.
Meanwhile, the pain in his shoulder soothed with him circulating mana through his shoulder's mana veins.
**
Five whole days passed and Jason sat on the ground with a thick mana cocoon stripped in different colors enveloping him.
Absorbing mana greedily, his mana core creaked loudly, as Artemis looked curious towards his direction.
Circulating the mana through his mana veins, his mana core enlarged slightly, while his physique toughened.
Expelling a black reeking liquid, Jason slowly opened his golden eyes which flickered vigorously.
The colored cocoon slowly dissipated with Jason stopping his absorption and he stood up, only to notice that his shoulder was already completely recuperated from his previous injury.
"Faster than I expected" he mumbled joyously, while slowly moving his shoulder around to test if anything felt uncomfortable.
Figuring out that everything was fine, he looked at Artemis with a smile emerging on his face as he said
"I finally did it!"
Not only did he break into the 4th Adept rank after painstakingly absorbing mana over five days, but he also practiced the Heaven's Hell technique three times a day, which increased his soul energy by a large margin.
Before breaking through, Jason's soul energy reached 239,74 units, while Artemis' requirement increased to 165 units as her strength increased once again, while Scorpio's soul energy demand increased to 75 units.
With this and his black origin flame's negligible 0.01 soul energy demand, Jason required 240.01 units in order to take Artemis into his soul world.
After breaking through, his soul energy increased by one unit and with him reaching 240.74 soul energy units, he could finally take Artemis back into his soul world once again.
It had been a long time and finally, it was done, which made both Jason and Artemis happy, as they smiled foolishly, at least Jason felt like Artemis smiled.
Artemis was happy because she could flee from the narrow cave she loathed, while Jason was expectant to figure out more about the fortified soul conjunction and how much his strength would increase by taking her into his mana core instead of Scorpio.
With a large, white magic circle appearing below Artemis, she screeched out one more time before vanishing from his sight only to emerge within his soul world.
Feeling Artemis within him, Jason smiled lightly and he similarly entered the soul world to take a look at his three soulbonds.
Scorpio grew slightly in size while his exoskeleton was already fully healed from the previous torn state, Jason caused.
The black origin flame was still below his soul world core, purifying and toughening everything, while its demand for soul energy increased even more with time passing.
Now that Artemis was finally back within the soul world, Jason feared his black origin flame's demand, because he wasn't sure how greedy it would become with time passing.
But before he would give his black Origin flame a single soul energy unit, he would save some for safety matters, because Scorpio's evolution might happen a short time after he leaves the four-star rift, while there was also the possibility of him finding a high potential beast.
If that was the case, the worst thing that could happen was the lack of soul energy, which was not something Jason wanted to experience ever.
Soaring through his soul world, Artemis screeched out in joy, as Jason noticed something weird.
'Was my soul world always so large?' He never really estimated the size of his soul world but weirdly enough it felt larger than before, causing him to look around confused.
'And why does everything here seem so vibrant and full of energy?'

chapters.title: Chapter 214 - Limitations
chapters.content:
Seizing up his own soul world felt weird because Jason wasn't even aware of what his soul world really looked like.
Everything was enveloped in a golden hue and an uncountable number of elements floated around the world, which he was already aware of while he didn't even know what some of them meant.
Jason knew that elemental variations and so on existed, but he never heard of someone having a few rarer elements in their soul world.
Maybe it was confidential or a private matter that nobody reveleat this, but it was the first time for him to feel weird looking at his own soul world.
'What the hell is this? Or what am I?' Jason asked… He was curious about himself, Not only did he possess special eyes but also an extremely unique soul world which was definitely not normal.
He wasn't scared of himself, but he was aware that some classmates feared him and his abilities, even though he did nothing to hurt them intentionally.
Even if his soul world made him curious, there was nothing for him to do at the moment, because he could neither ask his masters or anyone else.
And he was unsure if they could even help him, as his gaze followed a mana flow that looked similar to magma, causing him to shake his head.
'One step after another!' He told himself, as he left his soul world, to tell Artemis when she should enter his mana core through the gigantic golden gate that was the connection between the soul world and his mana core.
Standing up within the cave, Jason scanned through his body to take a look, only for him to notice that his physique and mana core size almost reached the peak of the 8th Adept rank, which was more than he expected.
The baptism he received was only extremely powerful when he was at the early Adept ranks, increasing his mana core and physique by three levels, while the effect lessened the higher levels and ranks he reached.
But even if that was the case, achieving a mana core size and physical amplification of four levels was extremely large, which Jason would never achieve solely from Scorpio and the black Origin flame's baptism.
'Did I finally receive Artemis' whole amplification?' Jason wondered.
Before Artemis' amplification was drastically reduced, because he couldn't take her inside his soul world while the soul energy he possessed was too shallow, but this small problem was fortunately not there anymore.
Smiling, Jason wondered how much his strength would increase if Scorpio were to enter his mana core in order to fuse with him.
But even more interesting would be Artemis' fortified soul conjunction, because Jason was now fully connected to both Artemis and Scorpio, even though Scorpio's fortified soul conjunction was thinner compared to Artemis'.
Waiting for Artemis to fly through the gigantic golden gate, he expected a sudden change within himself any moment.
However, even after five minutes passed nothing happened and Jason was about to enter the soul world, as Artemis transmitted him a teasing laugh, causing Jason to frown deeply.
'Hahahah...fuu-nn..y' He thought, before his sight blurred for a short moment, as Artemis finally entered his mana core, causing a tidal wave of energy to spread through his whole body, shaking him violently.
"S**t" Jason shouted out through his gritted teeth, as his legs gave in, by the overwhelmingly large amount of mana that entered his body unhindered.
Around his mana core, appeared an illusionary enlarged mana core, which indicated Artemis' increase he could receive from her, while his physique was forcefully amplified by 100% instead of her normal ? strengthening which astonished him.
He never thought that Artemis amplification would be so tough to endure, but thinking that she was roughly at the 2nd Evolved rank explained everything.
Receiving a 100% amplification meant that her whole strength was converted to him, increasing his mana core and physique immediately to the 2nd Expert rank, before it began to slow down at the 3rd Expert rank.
Artemis 100% amplification could be compared to a power boost, but Jason couldn't feel any happiness as his pores involuntarily opened, with blood oozing out of his orifices and pores, without stopping.
Taking a look within his mana core, Jason only saw Artemis jumping around happily, curiously looking at everything, while he tried to find a way to decrease her amplification which burdened his body too much.
'Sweety….can you somehow decrease your amplification? My body can't take your full strength!' Transmitting the thought to Artemis, she halted her steps before trying to restrict her amplification, as she felt his pain.
However, it seemed as if she couldn't do it and Jason entered the soul world in order to take a look at the golden gate.
Maybe there was something to restrict Artemis amplification.
Looking at the gaze, his eyes widened, as a faint smile appeared on his face.
'Jackpot!'
The gigantic golden was fully opened once a beast entered his mana core and with Scorpio fully converting its strength to Jason, there was no problem, while Artemis was in a completely different league.
Maybe this would also change, but Scorpio was barely at the late-awakened rank which was somewhat close to his current strength, while Artemis was almost several levels above him.
Increasing his physique from the 8th Adept rank to the 3rd Expert rank, suddenly without any warning was not something his body could handle, and Jason began to close the gigantic golden gate, leaving only a small opening.
Leaving the soul world, Jason immediately noticed that his body was freed from the heavy pressure, as he could move around freely once again.
Artemis amplification was restricted to roughly 34% which was barely more than he would initially receive, causing him to wonder what exactly this golden gate within his soul world was.
Subconsciously opening the golden gate further, Jason felt his physique and the illusionary mana core around his own increasing.
Testing it for more than ten minutes, he already felt exhausted, but a bright smile appeared on his face.
"So the 1st Expert is my limit, huh?" Mumbling, while he averted his attention back to Artemis, connection.
With a smile on his face, he transmitted Artemis his thoughts, as he himself imagined her wings to manifest on his back, as his shoulder blades began to itch, with 1.5 meter long wings slowly developing.
'Fortunately, I took off my leather armor' Jason thought sweating heavily due to the focused mana circulation in addition to the fast decreasing nutrition he had to use up to develop them.
Once Artemis' wings were manifested on his back, Jason felt extremely exhausted, but he didn't want to end it here, as he tried to flap with them, only to notice that they were completely asynchronous.
Losing balance, he fell on the ground with his face first.
'It's even harder than controlling Scorpion's stinger!' Jason noticed and controlling Scorpio's exoskeleton and stinger took him already some time, while his small scorpion soulbond supported him for the whole time, helping him out.
Without Scorpio helping him out to control everything, Jason would already be dead by now, because even manifesting the stinger within an extremely short amount of time was impossible for him alone.
With enough practice it would be possible, but not now!
Sighing, Jason noticed that he had too many things to take care of while increasing the proficiency with his affinities and fortified soul conjunction were definitely one of the most important things.
There was only one disadvantage he noticed about the fortified soul conjunction and he wasn't sure what exactly the reason for this was.
'My mana core is limited to a single beast with a fortified soul conjunction?'

chapters.title: Chapter 215 - Everything Is MINE!
chapters.content:
It was impossible for Scorpio to walk through the golden gate, while Artemis occupied his mana core, which was somewhat regretful because he was excited to fuse with all of them in order to become a mutant-like existence.
The only thing that wondered him was that his gut feeling told him that the whole limitations of his gigantic golden gate were neither difficult to understand nor complex at once, leading him to become even more confused than he initially was.
But even if his gut feeling gave him such a feeling, there was nothing for him to do which would change the current situation and he couldn't fuse with both Scorpio and Artemis at the same.
Considering his combat prowess, it would be the best to let Scorpio occupy his mana core while fighting with Artemis next to him, but if he were to fight alone in the 'Big-Three tournament', he might as well use his fortified soul conjunction.
'But if I use it, everything will be exposed, huh?' Jason thought but thinking that he didn't have to summon his soulbonds body parts, it could also stay hidden under the disguise that his soulbonds became stronger.
Nodding his head lightly, Jason decided to focus on the present, while trying to flap with the white wings at the same time.
In the end, it didn't work as planned and Artemis within his mana core had to guide him slowly in order for Jason to understand everything.
But even after the explanations, it was hardly possible for him to flap synchronized with his wings, as he sighed in frustration.
Suddenly he felt his wings flapping vigorously, as Artemis controlled them inside the mana core, only for Jason to notice that he was too heavy to even ascend a single centimeter.
'In the worst-case scenario, Artemis might as well fly while I fight in the sky, huh?' Jason thought before he began to chuckle lightly while visualizing a magnificent fight in the sky against some vicious beasts.
Shaking his head, Jason knew that Artemis had to become larger and more powerful in order for him to manifest stronger wings, while his own strength was not enough for him to handle it.
Maybe he could already float if Artemis were to amplify him with her complete strength which instead of a smaller part, which he had to restrict in order to barely endure her being inside his mana core.
Experimenting many different things with Artemis and Scorpio, like the time they needed to switch their position within the mana core and to manifest smaller or larger body parts.
The biggest difference for Jason was the time he required to manifest a foreign body part was much higher compared to his soulbonds supporting him within the mana core, as they obviously knew how their own body worked.
While testing out many things with his soulbonds, he never neglected to replenish the high demand of nutrition and mana in order to manifest everything and after two hours passed, his whole body revolted against taking another bite of the dishes he stored within his spatial ring inside the preservation segment.
As such, Jason was forcefully interrupted to experiment and he could only sigh and store the dishes away once again.
'Aren't there any high-nutrition dishes in my storage device?' He wondered but Jason couldn't remember to have bought either high-nutrition dishes or supplements.
Regretting this decision, he would have to force himself to continue to eat the preserved dishes for the next two weeks, if he were to remain within the elemental crystal cave before venturing out.
Jason already made a rough plan of what to do and his plan involved staying within the elemental crystal cave for another week at the bare minimum.
His demand for star notes was frustratingly high and with his own expenditures added to his soulbonds' expensive demands, Jason could only make a rough plan to achieve the best outcome, without being locked within the four-star rift, or whatever would happen if he were to remain within the rift after it closed.
He already collected lots of elemental crystals and if his memories and perception were not completely in disarray, the elemental crystal cave should have all four types of elemental crystals.
Elemental crystals were classified into four sections also called, Basic, Intermediate, Advanced, and Unique!
Basic elemental crystals were crystals with wind, fire, water, and earth transmuted mana
Intermediate element crystals had ice, metal, lightning, and many more elemental transmutations, while Advanced elemental crystals transmutations like wood, darkness, and light.
Unique elements weren't necessarily better and valuable like the poison element, but other crystals had an astronomical price because of their blood, nature, fiendish, holy, and other unique elements.
The nature element was similar to the wood element but much superior. While the wood element barely controlled woods, nature controlled plants, wood, sentient plants, and if strong enough even beasts with a strong bond to nature.
To think that all four different crystal sections ranging from a rather cheap price to an astronomical height could be found within the elemental crystal cave made Jason curious about the origin of it, while his greed and joy overlapped.
Over the last few days, not a single beast dared to venture into the cave because the memories about the earthquake were still apparent in their mind, while Jason also didn't perceive a single human being coming closer to them.
At least that was what his eyes perceived but he might as well miss something, while he absorbed mana.
It was not like he observed everything consistently but he was still relatively careful because almost everything within the four-star rift might kill him.
As such, Jason stood up in order to start his journey through the cave, collecting the protruding and loosened crystals he could even see without his mana eyes activated.
Gathering one crystal after another, he sealed them in order to prevent the elemental crystals from leaking mana, while at the same time scanning through their complex mana veins in order to figure out how they were composed.
Since he began to forge, Jason was interested in all kinds of materials and how they were composed, while it was even more interesting to see how ores acted when they were heated up, because the mana veins seemed to come alive.
Even if he was interested in testing it out right now, Jason didn't want to waste any precious crystal until he amassed a large enough fortune.
Without him noticing, he already went deeper into the cave, while the crystals occurrences around him increased.
Not only increased the number of elemental crystals around him, but they also released denser mana fluctuation, which caused Jason to smile brightly.
If he had to estimate the cave's value, Jason's brain would most likely melt because what he saw within the tunnel was barely the tip of the iceberg, while the crystals his mana eyes perceived through the ground were much more in number and mana density.
But there were still a few that wondered him.
'Why is there not a single beast excavating these crystals? It doesn't seem to be dangerous and the earthquake as the sole reason sounds somewhat unreasonable…Furthermore, I can't believe the government doesn't know anything about the elemental crystal cave? It's barely a one to a two-day trip away from the highland plateau... Is there something wrong with the cave, which I haven't noticed?
It's really weird to see all four elemental crystal classifications at once because it is said to be rare to find an elemental crystal cave with a single attribute forming crystals over the course of hundreds of years with the surrounding transmuted mana, even less multiple types of elemental crystals at once with all kinds of elements.'

chapters.title: Chapter 216 - Hidden Dangers
chapters.content:
Without being able to answer the questions in his mind, Jason averted his attention to more important things.
Collecting the elemental crystals while excavating some with his grade-1 pickaxe, Jason quickly noticed that the common pickaxe was quite useless which forced him to envelop it with a thin mana membrane in order to prevent it from breaking.
Fortunately, his passive mana absorption balanced out his consumption and he could calmly mine the surrounding elemental crystals.
Time passed without him realizing, while Jason's soul energy was once again replenished.
Practicing the Heaven's Hell technique, he couldn't help but smile joyously, as he noticed that his soul energy increased by almost three units with a single practice.
An increase of 1.2% for a single practice was not much for someone with barely 1 soul energy unit, but for Jason whose soul energy increased to 240.7, 1.2% was a huge advantage.
Even more so, because he could practice the Heaven's Hell technique three times a day.
Considering that his soul energy reached barely 1 unit slightly more than four months ago, Jason couldn't help but laugh.
'I came pretty far already, huh?' He thought while continuing to mine the elemental crystals.
The further the cave went, the more crystals occurrences appeared in the tunnel around him but there was a weird sensation enveloping him, that caused his body to itch.
However, his mana eyes couldn't detect anything at all, as he let his guard down.
Without wasting time, Jason forced himself to eat enough food in order to supplement his body with nutrition, while the Heaven's Hell practice in addition to the labor drained his energy quite a lot.
Taking a look into his storage device, he smiled but it was somewhat weird.
'Has already so much time passed? Where are all the crystals from?' Jason asked himself, as his sight blurred for a second before he entered his soul world.
'My soul energy has already replenished?' He wondered…' Hasn't it been an hour at most?'
Unbeknownst to Jason more than six hours passed and it was already late at night, while his soul energy was fully replenished.
Shaking his head, the blurry sensation disappeared before he decided to practice the Heaven's Hell technique once again.
Leaving his soul world once again, Jason opened his eyes, as he noticed that his sight dimmed while his senses were restricted.
"Huh?!" without knowing what happened, he felt his body becoming slower, while he couldn't even feel the ground below him.
'What is going on?!' Jason was about to panic, as he forcefully tried to circulate his mana through his veins in order to release the tension, only for him to notice that his senses turned even more sluggish while circulating mana within him.
"F**K!" Exclaiming quietly, he had to figure out what was going on.
Trying to remember what changed during the last few hours, he raked his mind while visualizing the last few hours.
'My mana eyes couldn't detect anything at all, but my senses are suppressed while circulating mana through my body makes everything worse...'
Unsure what to do, he suddenly remembered something his masters always told him!
'Don't rely on your mana eyes too much! The world is vast and you can't think that your eyes will always be the answer!'
With this in mind, he thought 'Does this mean that there has to be something around here without mana fluctuations and that it even reacts with mana and hastens the suppressing process….'
Thinking about all kinds of possibilities, it had to be something poisonous that invaded his body, and Jason couldn't expel it by circulating mana through the mana veins because it turned the situation even worse.
Trying to find a solution, Jason could only remember his black origin flame cleansing the transmuted poison and ice mana from his soulbonds, as he summoned it from his soul world.
Before, his black origin flame did everything by itself, but now it didn't seem to act, which wondered Jason.
'Is the black origin flame only instinctively acting because it sensed transmuted mana?' Jason wondered as he decided to take the risk when he manifested the flame within his body.
In order to not kill himself or even damage anything within him, the flame couldn't be too hot otherwise he could destroy his own cells which would be counterproductive.
Without knowing what exactly invaded him, Jason could only hope as he spread the black origin flame throughout his whole body, which caused him to start sweating immediately, as his whole body heated up.
Even if the sensation of his whole body burning from the inside was uncomfortable, Jason noticed his sight clearing slightly, while his other senses became more distinct.
Sighing deeply, Jason was still unsure what caused his suppressed senses or where it came from, as he perceived something particular within his sweat thanks to his eyesight.
Within his sweat was an almost invisible yellow-greenish liquid, and Jason began to wonder what exactly it was.
'Is that poison?...but where does this come from?' Jason asked himself as he couldn't remember to have ever seen something like that and looking at the ceiling, he couldn't see any liquid dropping down, which caused him to wonder what else it could be.
"OH!?" Jason exclaimed with a sudden Idea 'It couldn't be solid, but what if the liquefied poisonous substance was gaseous before?'
After this though, he focused on his eyesight, without his mana eyes activated on the surrounding, only for him to find nothing at all.
Averting his gaze, he suddenly noticed a blue shining crystal, that was different from the other he saw above.
However, upon closer inspection, Jason noticed that it was exactly the same crystal…
'Wasn't there a faint yellow-greenish hue within the crystal?'
Turning around he decided to focus on the crystals and suddenly as if a lightning strike hit him, he exclaimed overjoyed
"FOUND YA!" But suddenly his mood plummeted, as he shut his mouth, sealing it completely when he noticed what he was doing.
Concluding the facts he gathered, Jason figured out that the whole deeper layers seemed to be filled with an extremely faint yellow-greenish hue which was hardly noticeable by looking at the soil around him.
Fortunately, the elemental crystals around him shone brightly in all kinds of colors, helping him to figure out the main issue.
'If even I could hardly perceive it with my exceptional eyesight, how can others see it?' Jason wondered and it was the second time for him that his mana eyes were completely useless.
The first time was his mana eyes missing the existence of the black origin flame and the second time could have killed him as his mana eyes couldn't perceive the poisonous air around him.
Suddenly Jason panicked slightly, causing the black origin flame within him to fluctuate lightly, as he noticed that he was deep inside an elemental crystal cave that was filled with poisonous gas.
'Is that the reason most beasts don't dare to venture deeper into the elemental cave?' He asked himself, trying to remain calm, after acknowledging that his black origin flame saved his life once again.
'I really have to nurture it later!!' Jason swore to himself, as he slowly circulated the black origin flame through his body, without leaving any cell out.
Jason didn't know the area of effect the mysterious poison had which was the reason for him to act so over cautiously by cleansing everything within his body.
It wouldn't purify his body but only cleanse his body from poison, disadvantageous transmuted mana, and most likely drugs, which could be labeled as poison.
Trying to stay rational, Jason began to smile lightly, once he estimated his current situation.
'Because I only began to feel slightly blurry when I entered the deeper layers of the cave, the poison can only be further down. With the current density of poison, I can easily handle it passively, without wasting too much focus on it!.'
'As long as my black origin flame can handle it, the whole cave will be mine, because there is no other living being except me!!'

chapters.title: Chapter 217 - Jinx
chapters.content:
With the black origin flame manifested within him, Jason could easily endure the mysterious poisonous fog, whose origin was still unknown, while his journey through the elemental crystal cave continued.
He didn't venture much deeper into the cave's depths because the poison's density increased, while the mountain of elemental crystals within his storage device amassed.
Jason was sure that he had more than enough funds for Scorpio's evolution and probably even a surplus, which caused him to feel extremely great, while he could barely estimate the current date, without knowing what time it is.
'Has it already been six days?' Jason wondered when he entered his soul world in order to practice the Heaven's Hell technique once again.
He wasn't sure why, but he couldn't comfortably sleep in the cave, leading him to barely sleep only one time after he practiced the Heaven's Hell technique, and he woke up with his soul energy fully replenished.
Thanks to the dense mana around him he didn't really feel tired and instead of solely mining elemental crystals, Jason also absorbed mana actively not missing a single time to practice the Heaven's Hell technique three to four times a day.
Because he only slept a short amount of time and in order to have a rough track of time, Jason was forced to use up his soul energy as soon as it was replenished.
With his soul world's soul energy replenishing speed of slightly less than 6 hours, he could practice the Heaven's Hell technique three to four times a day.
The most time-consuming in this case was, however, that his practice required a whole hour until it was completed, while he had to eat a huge feast every time.
Regretting that he forgot to buy high-nutrition food, Jason could only force himself to eat low-nutrition food on mass, even if his stomach and mind revolted against him eating one dish after another, seemingly without stopping.
In the end, everything was worth the effort, with his soul energy increasing to 316.2 units, while Artemis' demand increased by another 10 units.
With this, Jason was overjoyed to have a surplus of soul energy, which would most likely be used up once Scorpio finished his evolution.
But even if that was the case, he was sure that the same scenario as it happened with Artemis wouldn't happen because he learned out of his prior mistakes.
Having Artemis around him for more than a month was not necessarily bad, but it had its disadvantages.
The last six days were quite boring for Jason and he couldn't do much, except absorbing mana, mining crystals, practicing the Heaven's Hell technique, or doing a full-body workout and everything he did brought him benefits.
His mana core was already filled by a quarter and if he were to focus on absorbing the mana within the elemental crystal cave for the remaining 8 days, Jason was confident to breakthrough.
But that was not necessary, because he was already confident in his current strength and even if he were to use the next week to breakthrough, it was more important for him to find his way towards the highland plateau.
Initially, he only wanted to recuperate his broken shoulder, but the cave's value convinced him to stay here for the last six days.
However, what he saw at the cavern entrance told him that other humans entered the cave a few hours ago, searching for ways towards the deeper layer, which frustrated Jason quite a bit.
He wanted everything for himself, but being greedy would only bring him more problems than benefits.
As such, Jason had to find a path towards the surface, without being found, otherwise, he wasn't sure what the small group that entered the cave would do with him.
He was sure that they would question him if he already mined something and demand him to hand it over, which was not something Jason would ever want to do.
Humans were innately self-centered, at least since the mana breakout and only a few wouldn't care about Jason's fortune, without eying him with greed.
Because of that, he had to remain unseen.
Jason's big advantage was his mana eyes that could see all tunnels and where they lead to, while it was hardly possible for anything to remain unnoticed, as long as it released mana.
One such unnoticed, manaless thing was the mysterious poison at the deeper parts of the case, while Jason was unsure if anyone concealing their mana core could remain hidden from him.
Thinking back on the time, he saw through Max Drake's concealed mana core, Jason was sure that it would be hard for any living being to remain hidden from him, as long as he focused on anything around him.
Nevertheless, his previous confidence about the superiority of his mana eyes diminished with the existence of the mana-less poisonous fog and he couldn't trust them fully anymore as he also looked through everything with his normal eyes.
Without concentrating on the mana flow, Jason could see everything normally and extremely clear and he searched for a path towards the surface without being found out.
Suddenly, he heard something behind him, and thinking that neither Scorpio nor Artemis were outside the soul world, Jason turned around as fast as he could.
With his mana eyes still activated, Jason couldn't perceive any fluctuations at all, as soil crumbled down the wall his attention was fixated on.
His eyes widened in shock, as he thought that another earthquake might happen, only to see that not a single pebble crumbled from other walls, except the one he stared at in the beginning.
Suddenly a grey lizard head pierced through the wall he looked at, shoving away the earth thanks to its flat head.
Jason's eyes widened with a sudden thought filling his whole mind 'I can't see its mana fluctuations!! Did I jinx it?!'
Looking shocked at the Lizard showing through the wall, he immediately began to gather multiple pieces of information.
'I can't see its mana fluctuation but without the earth wall between the lizard...no is that a Drake?...Nevermind… without the wall, I can barely perceive a dark-green color, which means this Drake might be at the unblemished rank, right??'
Circulating more mana into his eyes, Jason tried everything to see through the Drake in front of it, which was hardly possible.
From its appearance, the drake looked like a lizard with long, scaled limbs, while its spine was filled with protrusions.
The drake's color was a plain grey, while its protrusions and claws were pitch-black, but Jason didn't care about its look at all.
'Why can't I see your mana rank and fluctuations?! What is special about you???' He almost shouted, because the jinx he inclined to himself shattered his whole confidence over his mana eyes.
But what was even worse, was that even more Drakes without any mana fluctuations emerged out of the crumbling wall in front of Jason, causing him to step back, while subconsciously concealing his mana core as well as possible.
Retreating as far as possible without making a sound, Jason could barely see the grey untraceable Drakes anymore and he had never heard of any Drake with a flat skull, allowing it to excavate tunnels underground, while it can conceal its mana core completely.
Seeing that every single one of the untraceable Drakes had the same ability, even the smaller ones in the back, Jason concluded that it was an innate ability, they received when they were born, which was not less shocking.
There was no need for Jason to remain at the lower layers of the cave and he slowly retreated further towards the surface.
Without his mana eyes being able to ensure him that he was not pursued by someone, he felt naked and insecure...
Upon noticing this, he felt weird
'To what extent did I rely on my mana eyes?!?'

chapters.title: Chapter 218 - Death
chapters.content:
Without his mana eyes ensuring his safety, Jason ascended the elemental crystal cave slowly, while trying to understand what happened.
'For instance...My mana eyes are not perfect, even though I can see quite a lot, they're not capable of perceiving everything...In the end, it's pretty rare to see something without any mana fluctuations at all but that doesn't mean I can rely on my mana eyes to 100%...F*ck!! What am I even doing?!
This untraceable Drake seems to be a beast underground and they're most likely unable to find me.
Without mana fluctuations, their senses should be worse than other beasts…I think?'
Thinking about all of this, Jason couldn't help but sigh inwardly, not without forgetting to activate his mana eyes in order to know where the small human group from above would be, even if he couldn't trust them fully anymore, they still helped him.
Their small group was far away from his and Jason took only tunnels that wouldn't overlap with the others, as he perceived something particular, causing goosebumps to spread all over his skin.
'Why now?' Jason wondered as he saw a mass of humans at the Master rank entering the elemental crystals cavern entrance.
Without knowing if any of these groups came from the government or if they're all hunters venturing into the four-star rift in order to gain something, Jason had to acknowledge that he was in a tricky situation.
But what was even worse, was that the large human group stayed at the entrance, without doing much.
At least that was what Jason could perceive and he estimated that they established a small camp in order to stay at the cavern entrance for the time being, which caused him a great headache.
'Walking past them like a passerby won't work, huh?' he asked himself, and even without anyone answering, Jason knew the answer.
With his current mana core rank, he could be considered as a pushover at most, which wasn't really how Jason imagined his trip inside the elemental crystal cave to end.
If at least Malia was with him, he wouldn't feel so powerless.
Suddenly Jason recalled Lin and Lux who shot at the magical ranked python without caring about his life at all.
'Or did Lux aim at me?' Jason wondered while Lux's smile appeared in his memory once again.
'I hope Malia is fine….' He thought....feeling guilty that he convinced Malia to enter the four-star rift.
Malia and the Fler's were the only humans he could trust the most while Shane and Dalia were ranked immediately after them.
Even if Jason trusted his masters to a certain extent, he wasn't sure if they only used him for their goals or not.
It was unlikely, but he would probably need some more time to figure out everything for himself.
As such, he couldn't give his full trust to them, at least for now.
If something happened to Malia, Jason wouldn't be able to face the Fler's and even less Greg, as a small trace of guilt filled his mind.
However, even if he felt slightly guilty, it was not as if he forced anyone of the expedition team to enter the materialized four-star rift within Cyro-City.
In the end, everyone decided for themselves and nobody was forced, which relieved Jason's sense of guilt a tiny bit.
Jason still sincerely hoped that she was fine and healthy, but he was likely to face more threatening situations than her, alone from the vast gap of strength between the two of them.
Looking back every now and then in order to figure out if an Untraceable Drake, Jason called them, followed him, he could only be glad that this was not the case.
Meanwhile, Jason continued to approach the cave's upper layers, while he became slightly nervous.
After two hours, the presumed human camp was fully established and smaller groups ventured into the four tunnels, only to find a few collapsed paths.
As such, they were forced to free them, without worsening the situation within the cave.
This would most likely take some time and was the only thing Jason found slightly advantageous.
Due to the construction work, these groups had to do, the number of groups venturing deeper into the cave decreased by a large margin.
'Oh!' After another hour passed, Jason was already quite close to the other groups, when he noticed that the first group that arrived inside the cave, met one of the many small groups that had to split up.
But only, now, upon looking closer, Jason noticed something important, his mana eyes couldn't perceive before when he was deep within the cave, as his eyes widened involuntarily.
'The first small group included only one human, with three….undead human-like beings?!! Is that LUX??' Previously his mana eyes couldn't perceive the transmuted mana, because he was too far away from them while his mana eyes' accuracy was altered by the surrounding mana.
There were thousands of tons of soil between them and each grain, pebble, crystal, and so on released mana fluctuations.
As such, it was only normal for his mana eyes to see not everything through soil far away.
But sensing that Lux was nearby him, caused him to frown, while his eyes turned slightly red in anger.
However, even if Jason was extremely angry and Lux, there was something important he couldn't deny at all.
'How did his strength increase this much in such a short time?' Jason wondered, as his eyes widened in shock, and he rubbed them subconsciously.
Even after rubbing them several times, Jason thought he was in a dream, as he saw ten undead unblemished ranked beasts with dozens of undead evolved ranked beasts emerging next to him.
