chapters.title: Chapter 380 - Tension
chapters.content:
Jason was aware that it wouldn't be best if he were to approach the small group of young prodigies right now because the tension around them was enormous.
They had to pay attention to the golden-horned lion after all!
Not only were they supposed to prevent injuring it too seriously but it was also important that it wasn't allowed to injure their own soulbonds or comrades!
Other than that, the surrounding area was dangerous and stronger beasts could arrive at any moment too.
Yet, until now, nothing happened and everything went according to their plan.
But who could reassure them that it would stay like this?
Even after Jason was aware of all of that, he did not bother to hide his existence and the fact that he approached them.
He was still wearing the pitch-black mask and his mana core was concealed which were alarming factors to the person in charge of paying attention to the surroundings.
The young man In charge of that task issued a warning to their group whose tension intensified visibly.
However, before anyone in their group could do something, Jason had already halted in his tracks.
He was around 100 meters away from the group of young prodigies and would wait until they finished their current hunt before doing anything else.
This worsened the group's tension further as they assumed Jason was going to attack them once they were off-guard or finished their hunt, which would allow the unknown, mysterious masked prodigy which they assumed Jason to be, to attack them.
Their group might be large but their combat prowess was not the highest if one were to compare them to real prodigies from big clans.
In the end, their family owed the Jual clan a big favor to give them the opportunity to enter the Mythic Garden.
They entered the Mythic Garden overconfident only to notice that their strength was shallow which was devastating.
From their dream to contract Mid-Magical ranked beasts with strong blessings, the only beast they caught was the golden-horned lion they were currently surrounding.
After more than four months, this was the first and probably also the last blessed beast they were to catch.
It was embarrassing, considering that they were a group of 10 young prodigies that wanted to get one blessed beast for each of them, but there was nothing they could do about it.
This was also one reason which caused their tension to increase by a large margin!
They wanted to increase their talents and combat prowess during their whole six-month-long journey through the Mythic Garden, which was even more devastating than they had been told.
Jason's strength was unknown to them and their vigilance was the cause for the entire catching process to be postponed by more than two hours.
The whole process looked like a charade to Jason but on the other side, he was able to perceive the small group's tension.
'Aren't they too much? They have several beasts that entered the Lowest Lique stage not long ago! Shouldn't they be more confident? How could I be able to fight against more than 20 opponents with a higher mana core rank than me..at once at that? Did they forget the rift's age restriction?'
Considering that someone above the age of 20 was unable to venture through the rift, there shouldn't be such tension because of a single individual.
Under normal circumstances, someone at this age should have 2 soulbonds at most! Adding the fact that beasts at a certain cultivation rank are prevented from being inside the Mythic Garden, they shouldn't be too afraid.
The strongest beast Jason could have was a Low Lique stage beast.
However, even he hadn't seen such a soulbond from any of the young prodigies he fought next to.
Maybe some descendants of influential clans were hiding their soulbonds but that was not something Jason could say for sure!
Because Jason was aware of the group's tension, he decided to wait until one of them contracted the golden-horned lion that laid unconscious and tied up next to them.
From the beginning, he couldn't help but expect a large discussion to break out when the group caught the golden-horned lion to decide who the blessed beast should belong to.
However, on the contrary, Jason witnessed how everyone stepped back to give a young woman some space.
Approaching the unconscious golden-horned lion she led a tread of her soul towards her hand which she had cut.
Around 20 minutes later the golden-horned lion was bound by the young woman as a magic circle appeared below it.
The lion entered the woman's soul world which was the signal Jason waited for.
Walking towards the group that was still tensed up, Jason couldn't help but suppress laughing out.
It was fortunate that he wore a mask, otherwise, he would enrage the group of young prodigies.
Nevertheless, in order to prevent a misunderstanding or accident to occur, Jason said out loud
"Don't bother too much about me, I just wanted to ask one or two questions, if that's fine with all of you! The golden-horned lion is not a beast I'm interested in either!"
The tension substituted by a small margin after the small group heard what Jason said.
They were unsure whether his words were trustworthy or not.
However, that was not something that concerned Jason when one young man in their group stepped forward to speak for his group.
"Hello, I apologize if this sounds rude but we wouldn't feel comfortable if you were to come closer. You are a stranger and we have seen many betrayals during the last few months. We will listen to your questions but I hope that you can understand our cautiousness!"
Jason nodded his head, fully understanding why the young men and women were so vigilant against him.
He was a stranger with a concealed mana core and wore a mask to disguise his identity too.
As such he just asked straightforwardly
"I ventured through the flatlands and noticed that there were only a few beasts. According to my information, the flatlands should be the most populated area within the Mythic Garden. Do any of you know why that is the case?"
'You waited several hours to ask us that?' Was what everyone in the small group of young men and women asked themselves.
Yet, they didn't voice out their question as to the young man who spoke to Jason earlier
"We are not sure about the reason for that, but it should have had something to do with the amount of mana in the adjacent areas that is slowly but consistently increasing. Furthermore, we heard lots of loud sounds of different beasts during the last few days...That means there could be a few stronger beasts slaughtering a few groups of beasts!"
Nodding his head, Jason already estimated that to be the case before he asked the second question
"Ok, thanks. How about one-eyed rats? Did you guys encounter such beasts in the surrounding areas?"
This question caused the young prodigies to tense up as the young man hesitantly said
"Yeah...we encountered them...but they were pursued by the Demonic Three-eyed wolf not long ago...Its destructive curse killed three friends of ours…"
"The Demonic Three-eyed Wolf hunted the one-eyed rats too?" Jason mumbled subconsciously which caused the young man to unintentionally blurt out as he had a bad premonition
"What does that mean...too?"
Lifting his head to look at the young man, Jason couldn't help but sigh as he said
"I encountered the Demonic Three-eyed Wolf today...probably a few hours before I found you guys...It hunted the Debilitation Centaur horde"
"Doesn't that mean it is close to us???" Everyone exclaimed loudly as thunderous roars echoed through the surrounding landscapes.
"Looks like it…"

chapters.title: Chapter 381 - Nullified
chapters.content:
Jason was still able to remain calm, knowing that there was no other strong beast around thanks to his mana eyes.
However, that wasn't the case for the other young prodigies whose tension was already high from hunting the golden-horned lion and Jason's sudden appearance.
It was even worse after they had heard that the Demonic Three-eyed wolf could be nearby as they had already witnessed its terrifying strength.
As such they panicked a little bit until the young man, that had stepped forward to talk to Jason before, announced.
"Let's depart, right now! There is no time to waste!!"
When Jason saw this he couldn't help but suppress chuckling, thinking that they didn't even know where he saw the Demonic Three-eyed wolf.
Only half a minute later he had still not received a question where exactly the beast was sighted before which caused him to frown as he saw that the young prodigies ignored him, departing straight into the direction he came from.
Clearing his throat he said
"I would head the opposite way if I were you guys. At least if you don't feel like being killed by a destructive curse"
After he said so, Jason exerted the weightless steps technique before he rushed towards a completely different direction, on his way to search for the possible survivors of the Demonic Three-eyed wolf's massacre.
However, instead of looking for the Debilitation Centaurs', Jason wanted to find the one-eyed rats that seemed to have faced the same fate as the Debilitation Centaurs.
It was unfortunate for those races and also Jason as he had planned to find out more about their curses in order to pick the most suitable soulbond for him.
Nevertheless, there was nothing he could change about the past.
This thought allowed him to retain his calmness as he ignored the young men and women's gaze that followed him.
**
More than a month had passed and one could see Jason fighting against a Lowest Lique stage Thunderstrike bull which he had encountered on his way towards the rift.
During the last month, Jason had found himself in several dozen life-threatening situations one after another, all caused by the aftermaths of the exposed mana vein that seemed to turn every beast into a ferocious and mana-greedy being.
After he sustained several dozen injuries, he couldn't help himself but allow Scorpio to liquefy his first drop of mana.
Jason was sure that he could take Scorpio's amplification without much issues as his mana absorption was slower and the fact that Scorpio had a potential limit at the Lowest Lique stage.
He could only liquefy around 20 drops of mana which was a rough estimation Jason did.
However, this made it possible for Jason to allow Scorpio's advancement into the Lique stage, which Artemis didn't want to accept.
Yet, after Jason explained that it was only because Scorpio would reach his potential limit soon, which meant that Jason wouldn't have any problems giving Scorpio the opportunity to become stronger, Artemis accepted it.
Her mana absorption and potential were unparalleled according to her own 'words' and Jason could just nod his head, accepting everything she tried to implement with the things she said.
After he encountered the group of young prodigies, everything went downhill and the only upside was that his mana core rank had reached the 2nd Master rank, while his mana core size should be comparable to that of a Lowest Lique stage!
This was not important to Jason, who just wanted to increase his defensive capabilities by allowing Scorpio to break into the Lique stage.
By manifesting his exoskeleton Jason's defense would become much stronger, while the stinger could be utilized to attack an unguarded opponent.
Unfortunately, even after he had received the 2nd baptism, Jason could tell that his vessel was still not strong enough. He was confident in taking on Scorpio's whole soul world amplification, which indicated that his vessel was strong enough for the time being, however, this was only for the time being.
The worst opponent of his soul world amplification had yet to come.
Artemis was something he couldn't take lightly and her advancement was rapid as long as she received enough high-quality food!
Even if that was not the case, allowing her to absorb as much mana from the surrounding area as she wanted was already enough, allowing her to reach a mana absorption rate that was higher than Scorpio's by a few times.
Jason couldn't take this lightly and he knew that allowing her to advance into the Lique stage would slow his own progress drastically.
That was because his mana core size would be enlarged every single time, any of his soulbonds became stronger, increasing the demanded mana Jason had to accumulate to break to a new level!!
This was annoying and if possible, he wouldn't have allowed Scorpio to advance to the Lique stage.
Unfortunately, the Mythic Garden had become more dangerous with each day passing and he had yet to pick the cursed beast he wanted to take as soulbond.
There were three cursed beasts that had a suitable soul amplification curse, which Jason was confident to catch and bind to himself.
Both the one-eyed rat and Debilitation Centaurs' survived, even if their population was decimated.
This was however not tragic to Jason who only needed one of those to bind to his soul.
While the one-eyed rat's curse was stronger, its curse didn't vary and was straight at 20% decrease, while the Debilitation Centaur's curse was inconsistent between 3%-10% which made Jason curious about it.
The third suitable cursed beast he found was a small three-tailed panther that seemed to be a variation evolution from the weakening curse panther which he encountered on his first day, immediately after he arrived in the Mythic Garden.
Almost 6 months had passed since then and Jason had become more powerful which allowed him to be able to catch the variation evolution of the weakening cursed panther.
To Jason's bad fortune was the small three-tailed panther's curse not up to the one-eyed rat's 20% weakening or the interesting inconsistent weakening curse of the Debilitation Centaurs.
In the end, it was just the best looking and most powerful, thanks to it being at the Lowest Lique stage with a purple-colored hue enveloping it
This was the potential of a beast, Jason was able to see and it indicated that the three-tailed panther was able to reach the Low Liques stage which was the best among all three.
Adding its darkness affinity and the fact that it is harboring a 10% soul world amplification curse, he would probably pick this beast as his next soulbond.
There was also a fourth cursed beast that was considered the best out of the three he named prior.
In the end, Jason would love to catch and bind the fourth one...
Unfortunately, it was too strong and not something Jason could fight against, yet.
Because of that, Jason couldn't help himself and thought that he should have the Debilitation Centaur as his next soulbond, use its curse for the time being to lighten the burden on his vessel to a certain extent before coming back to the Mythic Garden a year later.
However, this was just a dream which Jason shattered before it infested his mind.
It was unlikely for him to come back to the Mythic Garden in a year due to multiple factors.
One of them was the fact that his strength might be out of the Mythic Garden's restrictions threshold while another one was the fact that the woman that was at the sovereign rank and probably the matriarch from the Jual clan
In that case, the three-tailed panther would be the best choice, if he wanted to retain a high soul world amplification. Around 20% would be a large soul world amplification but not something the most terrifying human prodigies didn't have.
Otherwise, he would have to take the one-eyed rat whose curse would reduce his soul amplification to 13%. This would be comparable to that of above-average prodigies from big families, yet still in their normal range.
While Jason pondered about what he should choose, he didn't even realize the alarming amount of mana that was suddenly unleashed several kilometers away from him.
It was not only extremely dense and pure but enveloped by complex emotions and the desire for blood. This bloodlust infested every living being which caused them to go riot, attacking everything in their surrounding.
Only minutes later did Jason hear the stamping of several hundred beasts and numerous voices echoing through the surrounding area.
Distracted from his thoughts he turned around, only to see several hundred humans riding on Lowest Lique stage beasts, that had varying mana drops ranging from one to several dozen within them, towards him.
The strongest beast Jason was able to identify in this short moment had around 40 drops of mana within its mana core
In mankind's terms, one to 40 mana drops meant that a beast's strength ranged from the 1st Magical rank up to the 4th Magical rank.
A beast would enter the 5th Magical rank from the 50th drops of mana.
As such every 10 drops of mana, a beast would have an increase of one level in the Magical rank. This was the same for the Magus rank and it would only change from the Grandmagus and Guardian rank as the number of liquefied mana drops required to advance a level would increase by a large margin!
They ignored Jason's entire existence and rushed past him while only a few gave him an apologetic smile at most.
There were two things Jason perceived after he had instinctively inserted mana into his eyes, enhancing their sight.
Not only was he able to see the horrific mana fluctuations intertwined with bloodlust, but Jasn could tell from which beast the bloodlust intertwined mana fluctuations radiated from.
The color enveloping this beast was rare to see and from the outlines he perceived, Jason couldn't help curse out.
Only a moment later he had already manifested Artemis' wing before he used a large margin of mana to circulate through his wings.
Turning around he flew towards the huge group of young prodigies whose speed was much slower than his due to the second thing he perceived.
'Nobody has an enlarged mana core which means that their soul world amplification is nullified...and even their soulbonds strength has been reduced by a quarter...how terrifying!
Taking a deep breath he utilized the mana he inserted into Artemis' wings perfectly. Additionally he user the whole amplification of 100% from her due to the fact that she was currently inside his mana core to use his fastest speed.
This was enough to rush past every human prodigy riding on their soulbond until he reached the front.
Suddenly, his attention was drawn to the young man, who was the master of the beast with 40 drops of mana.
"What are you d---..."
However, before he could even finish his sentence, Jason felt as if his whole body was overwhelmed by a sudden tiredness, as his soul amplification had been completely nullified!!

chapters.title: Chapter 382 - Fate Changing Fruit
chapters.content:
Scorpio's amplification of 33% hit suddenly rock bottom with a big 0% while Artemis' amplification that has been raised to 100% due to the fact that she resided in his mana core was halved.
This shocked Jason greatly and his speed was barely comparable to an average 8th Master rank thanks to the fact that his mana core rank was at the 2nd Master rank and enlarged by a small margin from both baptisms he had received from Solaris.
'Urgh…what the hell is going on. Why is the petrification serpent in a berserk state and how is its curse so strong???' Jason lamented, not knowing how he should keep with the pace everyone else was rushing past him!
Suddenly he felt a huge hand grasping his waist as he was lifted on top of a large, fiery sabertooth tiger where two men were already seated.
"You are always good for a surprise Jason! I didn't expect to see you here, with a fortified soul conjunction at that"
Turning around, the young man who grasped him said.
"ISGA?" Jason exclaimed, both shocked and happy to see his friend while the person in front of Isga just lifted his hand saying
"You're welcome"
Artemis' wings dissipated in order to make himself more space as he made himself comfortable on the mount after taking a few deep breaths.
He couldn't even say 'thank you' yet, but the young man, that had to be the master of the fiery sabertooth tiger, didn't bother about that.
Nevertheless, Jason couldn't help but say thank you, knowing that he would die any moment if he were to be rejected from staying on the sabertooth tiger.
The petrification serpent's body shot out of the forest revealing its bloodshot eyes that began to glow in a faint brown-goldish light as the weakest Lowest Lique stage beasts had begun to slow down.
They had been paralyzed and Jason couldn't help but sigh, knowing that they would die any moment as he averted his gaze.
Looking forward his attention was drawn to the young man that was mounted on a beast called? Hurricane Carnosauria. Carnosaurias belonged to one of the extinct races that reappeared after the mana outbreak. This Dinosaur had been long since extinct and reappeared so suddenly.
However, this was not important to Jason or anyone around because the Hurricane Carnosauria was the fastest soulbond.
Other than that it was also the strongest with the most liquefied mana drops inside its mana core.
But this was also not important for Jason right now because he stared through the young man riding on the Hurricane Carnosauria as he cursed.
"Why did this idiot steal one of the petrification serpent's eggs???"
Isga and the young man in front of him stiffened when Jason said this.
"What did you say?? WHO?" Isga's voice turned ice-cold which was something Jason hadn't seen from his new friend before.
"Eh...the young man on the Hurricane Carnosauria...didn't you two know that? Why are you all even in this large group? This doesn't look like a picnic to me?"
While Isga was fuming in anger, the young man in the front explained the situation to Jason calmly.
"First of all, my name is Yune Shiabi, and I'm from the Shiabi clan. You should know about it, right? Even if you don't, it doesn't matter. What you should know is that every few dozen years, the Mythic Garden gives birth to a fruit called 'Fate changing carado'
There are multiple things you can do with the fruit but the most important effect of it is that you can re-awaken your soul if you eat the fruit whole.
However, this is not what we were supposed to do. In the end, Canir's most prominent alchemist was able to mass-produce a potion called "Soul enhancing"-potion after he had gotten his hands on this fruit the last time it emerged.
There had been around 100 potions concocted and every single one of them was worth a huge fortune which some influential families have procured over centuries… Either way, the effect of such a potion is extremely potent and allows the person who drinks it to change his or her fate completely.
From a three-star soul awakening to a four or even 4.5-star soul awakening, everything was possible as long as you were talented enough!
I think you can already imagine what we were supposed to do...and that was definitely not to steal the petrification serpent's precious egg, causing it to enter a berserk state… That bastard from the Wirad family will get to know what it means to be besieged by several big clans once I get out of here...this f*cking son of a b*tch"
In the beginning, Yune's explanation was calm, but it turned more and more violent which caused Jason to gulp down his saliva
'I guess the Wirad clan will have a….large problem soon…'
Jason saw that this young man from the Wirad family was trying his best to hide the small egg that was placed in the pouch that hung on his belt.
However, his mana eyes perceived everything which included the mysterious color enveloping the petrification serpent's egg.
'If the petrification serpent wouldn't be behind us, I would give everything to get my hands on that egg….'
He had started to daydream once again, only to be interrupted by his soul that began to revolt against the petrification serpent's curse.
Shaking violently, the soul amplification curse began to change from a decrease of 50% to 40%, down to 10% before it shot up again.
It was as if his world and the soul amplification curse were clashing, trying to find out who the strongest is.
This allowed Jason to understand that not his origin as a Celestia halfling had been the main source for the Debilitation Centaur's curse to be inconsistent.
Rather than that, it was his soul world core fighting against the foreign object which the curse targeting him, was!
However, in that case, Jason couldn't say for sure whether his soul was influenced by the Celestia DNA he received.
The same was now occurring with the petrification serpent's race-specific weakening curse!
As such, he tried to get the hang of himself as he mumbled to Isga and Yune
"Should we change our direction and drift away from the Hurricane Carnosauria? In that case, we wouldn't be targeted by the petrification serpent!"
Jason's idea was logical and the best way out of their tricky situation.
Unfortunately, this would mean sacrificing everyone else which was something Yune didn'T want to do.
He rejected Jason's idea when Isga mumbled once he calmed down a little bit.
"If we're able to get rid of this son of a b*tch from the Wirad family, there shouldn't be a problem. The petrification serpent would get its offspring back and get revenge too...But that would be difficult too because the Wirad family would not only complain to the person who caused their descendant's death but probably declare war.
In the end, you can only see the petrification serpent's egg, right? You have no other evidence we could use to justify getting rid of that bast*rd…."
Somehow, Jason was glad that Isga was able to analyze everything level-headed but his words were somewhat vulgar which was not like he got to know him in the Mythic Garden.
Suddenly, he got an idea as he asked
"Is the fiery sabertooth tiger able to run faster? Maybe even take over the Hurricane Carnosauria...Just for a few seconds?"
Yune pondered for a moment before he shook his head.
"We won't even come close to the Hurricane Carnosauria…"
Using his mana eyes, he tried to find something that could help them because the petrification serpent was approaching them at a rapid pace.
Suddenly his gaze strafed past Yune before it returned to the young man in front of him.
Thinking about what he should say, Jason got an idea
"Yune...didn't you say that you come from the Shaibi clan? In that case, it wouldn't be surprising if you have a spatial affinity soulbond, right?
When Yune heard this, he was astonished for a moment before he nodded his head which caused Jason to question him further.
"In that case, you should be able to open a spatial gate too… at least I think, or is that not the case? If you can, how far is the distance? Can you create a small gate a few meters in front of the Hurricane Carnosauria?"
Understanding what Jason wanted to implement, Yune had to bring him back to reality as he said
"I might be able to create a spatial gate in front of the Hurricane Carnosauria but it wouldn't be large enough for the whole Carnosauria to fit through. This would shatter the portal, and make everything useless."
However, Jason couldn't help but turn serious as he asked
"Who said that the Hurricane Carnosauria should fit through the spatial gate if I'm enough?"

chapters.title: Chapter 383 - Desperation
chapters.content:
Isga who listened intently to Yune and Jason's discussion couldn't help but exclaim
"What the hell do you want to do? Don't forget that we are all cursed by the soul amplification curse….you know that you can't rely on that? With your current strength, you shouldn't be able to steal the petrification serpent egg from someone at the Lowest Lique stage without any soul world amplifications!
Jason felt good to see how worried Isga was, when he said
"I should be able to negate the soul amplification curse for a short moment...with the fortified soul conjunction I have and the strength I receive through it, my combat prowess should be on par with the young man from the Wirad family….
Taking him by surprise, everything should be good...I guess?"
Both Isga and Yune couldn't help but turn around to Jason to look at him, thinking that he was too full of himself.
It may be something special that he was able to suppress the soul amplification curse but this caused them to wonder why he wanted to risk his life for strangers.
After Jason would get his hands on the petrification serpent egg, what would he do?
Approach the petrification serpent and tell her that he got his hands on the egg in order to bring it back?
Most beasts with liquefied mana were intelligent but to what degree would a Low Lique stage beast be able to stay calm and think rationally, even more so if it was about their offspring?
The petrification serpent was in a berserk state which told everyone that it was implausible to expect rational thinking.
Jason was definitely not a saint and he wouldn't do something suicidal like that under normal circumstances.
It was also not something he wanted to do either, but Jason perceived something which changed his stance.
Saving the prodigies that wanted to obtain the fate-changing carado fruit, might even be a disadvantage to him because Jason could tell from which family some of them belonged.
From rumors and secured information he had received through his masters, he could roughly estimate which family was good and what family was bad.
However, in the end, almost all big families, clans, and even companies had something to do with the foreign races and human trafficking!
Most of them decided to only use criminals to trade with, but Jason was still not sure what to think about this.
As such, rather than doing something suicidal to save others he didn't even know, Jason followed his instincts.
Those instincts in addition to what his mana eyes perceived told him that he had to get his hands on the petrification serpent egg that was in the hands of the young man from the Wirad family.
While his instincts were screaming out their desire to secure the egg, his mana eyes were able to perceive a thick aura enveloping the petrification serpent egg.
This was not the strange, unknown, and mysterious color Jason could also perceive but rather the unhatched petrification serpent's desperation and hopelessness it released.
Astonished about this, Jason couldn't help but look at it more intently.
It was similar to the Earth Dragons and foreign races who were able to release emotion intertwined mana, only that the beast in front of him was still unhatched.
Yet, it was already desperate enough to exhaust itself by doing something it shouldn't be able to do.
Jason could only assume that the unhatched petrification serpent was aware of its fate if the bipedal beast that abducted it were to be able to escape from its mother's pursuit.
However, this was not enough to convince Jason to do something as suicidal as ambushing two Lowest Lique stage beings that were much stronger than him, just to retrieve the petrification serpent egg.
The young man might be on par with Jason's strength if he were to take him by surprise but the Hurricane Carnosauria was something Jason couldn't take lightly.
Even after it was targeted by the weakening curse, its strength was still manifold higher than Jason's.
The final factors that caused Jason to change his attitude was a combination of everyone's desperation, which was the smallest reason for him to act like that
More important was the desperate aura around the petrification serpent suddenly targeted Jason, who was more than several dozen meters away from it!
While the petrification serpent mother was still around 300 meters away from the slowest Lowest Lique stage beast it was pursuing, the fiery sabertooth tiger Jason sat on was in the center of the whole group, around 50 to 100 away from the Hurricane Carnosauria.
When Jason sensed that the unhatched petrification serpent seemed to undergo a substantial change which caused its aura to be released in a radius of around ten meters, he was already astonished.
However, seeing that it began to concentrate its aura on a single target which he seemed to be, Jason couldn't help but feel shocked.
After he was enveloped by the unknown aura the unhatched beast had released, Jason felt weird and uncomfortable, but at the same time energetic, thinking that he should help out.
In the end, he felt that the unhatched petrification serpent wanted to tell him something, and he was just unable to understand what was going on.
Nevertheless, Jason was able to tell that nothing would happen to him if he were to retrieve the petrification serpent.
There was nothing reassuring in this thought and just his own instincts that told him to help after he had been enveloped by the weird, desperate aura.
'Did the unhatched petrification serpent target me with its weird aura because of the same reason as the Earth Dragons? They said that he was enveloped by something, which they had also called aura.'
This aura seemed to turn him into a more trustworthy person and Jason couldn't help but think that this might be the reason for the unhatched petrification serpent to rely on him.
'Or did it choose me because of something else?'
Jason didn't know why the unhatched petrification serpent had chosen him as its target, but he could tell that it was better if he were to do something instead of sitting around.
He and everyone else would die if that were to be the case, and Jason loved to live which was unsurprising.
"F*ck it! Let's do it...Yune, can you create a spatial gate behind me and the other, connected gate around five meters in front of the Hurricane Carnosauria...maybe one meter to its left...that is if you can do that accurately while we're running on that pace...Isga, I'll change my position in a moment. Can you use your whole force to push me through the gate with all your might? After I manifested my soulbond's wings I should be able to take a stance, allowing you to push my feet…"
Both Isga and Yune were pondering for a moment when Isga suddenly asked
"Are we...like seriously considering this?"
However, Yune couldn't help but say
"It's not the worst plan...to be honest, as long as the petrification serpent mother retrieves its egg, nothing should happen...The only problem would be how to deliver the egg without breaking it! It might be more endurable than other eggs due to the durable eggshell it should have, but throwing it through the air wouldn't be the best decision either."
After he said so, Yune smiled lightly at Jason, with gratitude glimmering in his eyes
Yune seemed to have accepted the plan without further ado, which caused Jason to look at him weirdly
'Is he even weirder than I am? Does he think I do that to help everyone?'
"Let me take care of the delivery too, just don't bother about me and leave once I retrieved the petrification serpent egg. There is no need to involve more people than necessary."
When Jason said that, he felt slightly guilty to deceive Yune with the last words he said, as they were utter garbage.
After a few seconds passed Yune and Isga nodded their head, accepting Jason's tactic, if one were to call it like that.
The petrification serpent mother was now only 200 meters away from the slower lowest Lique stage beasts.
Time was ticking and the three prepared themselves quickly.
Jason manifested one of the Viridi-Starstream daggers in his hand while leaving the other hand empty while Yune took a few deep breaths.
Isga rolled up his sleeves as he tested a few motions on how to throw Jason to receive the most efficient outcome.
After that, Artemis' wings manifested on Jason's back which he laid close on his back as he asked.
"Is everyone ready?"

chapters.title: Chapter 384 - Winged Thief
chapters.content:
Isga was still unable to understand why Jason would do something as suicidal as retrieving the petrification serpent's egg and delivering it back to its mother too!
The former was still something he could understand if he were to think about it carefully, over a long period, but the latter was definitely ununderstandable.
However, if Jason wanted to do it, he could at least give his utmost effort to provide Jason with the best support.
That was at least what Isga thought.
As such he tried out multiple movements to figure out how to push Jason, and when he saw how Jason positioned himself, he couldn't help but think that his new, yet, suicidal friend knew what he was doing.
Taking the stance Jason took in addition to the strength he could utilize to push him into account, Isha was able to predict how fast Jason would be.
Yune gave them the sign that he was ready which intensified the tension around them within a moment.
Isga's finger itched while Jason took a deep breath to calm down.
Counting down from three, Yune manifested the spatial gates at the exact position Jason wanted them to be once the countdown had finally reached zero.
At the same time, Isga used the majority of mana that was left inside his mana core to circulate it through his arms.
This enhanced his strength and Isga pushed Jason with all his might.
Meanwhile, Jason used a large amount of mana to insert them into Artemis' wings that were still tightly folded on his back.
Meanwhile, Jason's soul world core used all its might to suppress the petrification serpent's soul amplification curse for one second.
This allowed Jason's strength to soar by several levels at once!
In less than a quarter of a second, he was already pushed through the spatial gate as he emerged on the other side of it, facing the more than six-meter tall Hurricane Carnosauria that was baffled about the suddenly manifested spatial gate, only for a winged human to shot through it.
Not even a full second passed when Jason shot past the Hurricane Carnosauria that couldn't react in time.
The young man from the Wirad family was even more baffled than his soulbond as he exclaimed in shock, only to see a mana weapon glimmering in the masked, winged human's hand!
He wanted to unsheathe his longsword to defend against the oncoming attacks as Jason emerged on the young man's side.
At that moment, Jason sliced the Viridi-Starstream dagger across the young man's waist, cutting off the pouch on his belt.
Additionally, he inflicted a small cut that was however not something that mattered to Jason.
He had wanted to retrieve the unhatched petrification serpent, nothing more or less!
Opening Artemis' wings after he had grasped the cut pouch that was about to fall from the ground, he soared into the air before anyone was able to react.
All of that happened in one second and once that second had passed, Jason felt how the soul amplification curse backlashed.
The soul world core was unable to hold back the curse that was seen as a foe, decreasing his combat prowess once again.
After he got his hands on the unhatched petrification serpent, Jason was unsure what he should do next.
He was currently more than 30 meters in the air, looking after the large group of several hundred prodigies mounted on their soulbonds.
Averting his attention to the petrification serpent whose bloodlust intertwined mana was targeting Jason; the beings with its offspring in his hands.
Shivering, Jason had the sole desire to run away as far as possible when the unhatched petrification serpent that was still in its egg, began to release a soothing aura that was targeted its mother and Jason.
While Jason's fear began to dissipate, he could feel that the horrifyingly high pressure of the bloodlust intertwined mana reduced drastically.
Unbeknownst to himself, Jason caressed the petrification serpent egg as it was already an instinct for Jason to caress everything that released any kind of aura towards him.
This was something Artemis and Scorpio became proficient in as they demanded to be caressed almost all the time.
When the unhatched petrification serpent that was connected to its shell felt this, its soothing aura changed to joy which was the complete opposite to the desperation it had released only moments ago.
The moment, the petrification serpent mother noticed this, it retraced its bloodlust-intertwined mana was retraced, confusion spreading through its entire being.
Jason was also confused because he felt such intense emotions within him originating from his soulbonds that were currently cursing the unhatched petrification serpent as it was caressed and they weren't.
Even Solaris, the black origin flame felt like Artemis and Scorpio. It may be unable to be caressed like Jason's other soulbonds but after it sensed how much attention Artemis and Scorpio had received, it wanted to have the same amount of attention than they had!
All of that only began to happen after Solaris evolved into a Tier-1 flame, which allowed it to become a true sentient being.
Jason, whose tension was on a completely different level couldn't help but frown.
Suddenly he sensed several wind blades flying towards him at a rapid pace.
Distracted by his soulbonds' nagging and the unhatched petrification serpent's joyous aura that was directed towards him, Jason was unable to notice them early enough.
Thus he was unable to evade them properly!
The most he could do, was to instinctively release a thick wall of black flame as they were the affinity he was the most proficient with.
Using every trace of mana left within him, the black flame wall was extremely thick and compressed, burning the mana that held the wind blades together!
However, two out of the batch of several wind blades made a big curve around the wall of flames!
Their trajectory had been changed mid-air, but they were still controlled to a certain degree, allowing them to shoot towards Jason.
Piercing through his wings, they were almost severed and Jason had to dissolve them to prevent any major injuries that? Artemis could obtain.
Even if he was sorry for Artemis' who screamed out in pain, he couldn't help but care about his own situation right now as he fell to the ground from an altitude that was more than 30 meters.
Suddenly he saw multiple more wind blades shooting towards him and his eyes widened involuntarily.
While he tried to evade the wind blades earlier, the pitch-black mask loosened up, revealing his face to the petrification serpent mother that couldn't help but eye Jason weirdly for a quarter of a second.
However, Jason couldn't care less about anything except the wind blades that shoot towards him as he switched out Artemis, who was still in his mana core, with Scorpio.
Only a moment later, his whole body was enveloped in a thick sapphire blue exoskeleton that looked like he was wearing a full-body armor.
Even his head was included as a thick and long stinger grew out of his coccyx.
Scorpio's mana core was barely at the Lowest Lique stage but his defense capabilities were nothing to scoff at.
Nevertheless, the several wind blades that shot towards him pierced into Scorpio's exoskeleton and it was as if they targeted exactly the same area.
The young prodigy from the Wirad family seemed to have high proficiency with the wind affinity that was almost at the Low Lique stage which allowed him to control the wind blades accurately.
When Jason noticed this, he cursed out loud before he curled up his body, protecting the petrification serpent instinctively.
At the same time, he accessed the mana sphere bracelet which he was still wearing to draw out as much mana as he could handle right now.
Enveloping himself with the mana Shane and Dalia stored within, a thick cocoon formed, protecting him from the high-velocity wind blades that shoot towards him.
Just a moment later, he crashed into the ground, forming a small pit.
Now that he was enveloped in a mana cocoon Jason knew that he was fine for the next few seconds which caused him to take a short glance to see how injured Artemis was.
In the beginning, he thought that her wings might have been severed but that was fortunately not the case.
Adding the fact that the body parts manifested through the fortified soul conjunction weren't exactly the same as the original, Jason could only sigh in relief.
A small part of the injury the replica sustained would be transmitted to the original, which was something nobody knew the reason about, but that was everything that would happen!
As such Artemis seemed to be fine, even if her wings were hurting, while Scorpio's exoskeleton had a deep cut in the back.
Jason knew that one of the wind blades pierced into his back too!
Its might was fortunately drastically decreased by Scorpio's exoskeleton, the mana-grade-2 leather armor he was wearing and the fact that Jason explosively released the mana sphere's mana, everything was fine.
Now that Jason laid on the ground, without a single trace of mana left, while most of his energy was used up to manifest Artemis and Scorpio's body parts, he could only take a look at the petrification serpent egg which he embraced tightly.
It released a worried and fearful aura as Jason's attention was diverted to the direction in which the petrification serpent was previously at.
However, instead of being 200 meters apart from him, the petrification serpent mother had already appeared right in front of him as it opened its huge mouth as if it wanted to devour the cocoon enveloping Jason and the petrification serpent egg.

chapters.title: Chapter 385 - Gathering Of The Strongest
chapters.content:
Jason was astonished to see that the petrification serpent wanted to devour them, but somehow he wasn't scared.
There was no killing intent radiating from it and rather than that, Jason felt a sense of gratitude emerging within him.
This was weird because he shouldn't feel like that for anything, only to notice that this feeling stemmed from the petrification serpent mother that took the cocoon, enveloping him and the unhatched petrification serpent, into its maw.
Supplying the cocoon with more mana to prevent anything unpredicted to happen, Jason noticed multiple emotions flooding him.
Most of them were from the petrification serpent mother that thanked him, while the unhatched petrification serpent tried to figure out more about Jason, who was completely different from the bipedal beast that had abducted it.
Jason was also different from what its mother told the unhatched petrification serpent about those bad bipedal beasts.
He didn't have any bad intentions and his aura was drawing the unhatched petrification serpent towards Jason which caused it to release its aura towards its mother as if it was trying to communicate.
Thanks to his mana eyes that perceived everything with mana around him, Jason could tell that their way to communicate with each other was unique, yet extremely efficient as they didn't have to use any noises.
Somehow, he was extremely calm and not a tiny bit worried that something might happen to him.
Subconsciously he continued to caress the black egg while the petrification serpent turned around, halting its pursuit.
Slithering back, the young prodigies, who continued to ride away from the petrification serpent as far as possible, sighed in relief.
Meanwhile, Yune glared at the bastard of the Wirad family who had attacked and almost killed Jason.
In the end,? Jason who was not only young and with a high mastery to absorb mana but had also fortified soul conjunctions with his soulbonds, ended up in the petrification serpent's stomach.
He wanted to kill this bastard so badly but he couldn't do that because there were witnesses. With the possibility of waging a war, Yune was unable to do as he pleased, only to see that Isga was oddly calm.
"Hey, Isga? Wasn't your friend killed right now, how the hell are you so calm?? Shouldn't you be enraged or at least a little bit sad about your friend's fate….?"
However, Isga's answer baffled him as he calmly said
"You know what?... I don't think he is dead… I saw the same thing you did but why do I feel like he is still alive? Even weirder is that my instincts tell me that he will return stronger than he already is…"
Yune couldn't even remotely comprehend what was going on with his friend, but instead of bothering Isga about this, he could only sigh deeply, hoping that his words were true and that Jason didn't die through someone like Fae Wirad.
"Alright, let's hope that he survived!"
Two hours passed and Jason thinned the mana around the cocoon in order to use his mana eyes to figure out where they were heading to.
There were only 8 days left before the Mythic Garden rift would close and it would be bad if he were to be unable to leave it.
It was not like it would be devastating and the cause for his inevitable death, but it would interrupt the plan he and his masters had made up.
In the end, he had to do a few things on Argos which he couldn't do inside the Mythic Garden, and waiting for another six months wouldn't be helpful either!
On the other hand, it might be great for him to increase his strength to a great extent if he were to stay inside the Mythic Garden too.
Nevertheless, his plan, for now, was to survive, leave the area in which the petrification serpent was currently inside and search for a suitable cursed beast to form a soulbond contract with.
He had already formed a great bond with the petrification serpent egg which he was currently caressing in his hand, but Jason doubted that its mother would allow it to leave with him.
Furthermore, Jason couldn't even say for sure that the unhatched petrification serpent felt the same about that bond as he did.
This thought was quickly interrupted by the things his mana eyes perceived from the surroundings which the petrification serpent mother had entered.
Goosebumps covered his body and the only thing that allowed him to remain calm was the fact that he had manifested Scorpio's exoskeleton in addition to the fact that he was currently inside the petrification serpent's mouth.
'I have to stay calm now...I'm inside one of the strongest beasts within the Mythic Garden and even multiple Low Lique stage beasts shouldn't be enough to kill it...I guess? But WHY are there more than a dozen cursed and blessed Low Lique stage beasts in front of us???'
Jason was unsure what was going on, but he could feel the petrification serpent mother's shock, telling him that this encounter was definitely not something it planned out before!!
'Am I haunted by bad luck?' Jason began to wonder as the petrification serpent mother dug a small pit with its head before it laid down the cocoon, without anyone noticing it.
Unsure about what would happen now, he couldn't help but feel that something extremely bad was about to happen.
He terminated the supply of mana from his mana sphere and the cocoon enveloping him and the petrification serpent egg began to dissipate.
Jason was immediately vigilant against everything because his mana eyes perceived the outline and familiar mana fluctuations of the Demonic Three-eyed Wolf.
As such, he had to be careful of beasts and possible curses.
Looking around, he noticed that the area he was inside was not only filled with thick mana currents but that it also looked like the intersection of several environments.
On his left, Jason saw a mountain, while the gigantic forest he was already familiar with was right next to it.
However, there was also a swamp next to the mountain and right next to the swamp were flatlands.
Other than that, there was also a forest with smaller trees, a flower plain with small hills, a jungle, and a forest whose outer appearance indicated that the whole area was dead.
'Why did the petrification serpent bring us to the center of the Mythic Garden...at least I guess it's the center...More important than that is however the question of why exactly the petrification serpent is so astonished to see the other overlords here? Is that something odd?
Unsure whether he should wait for the petrification serpent that slithered away from him and its unhatched offspring, releasing a weird aura that seemed like it wanted to bid farewell, or that he should run away as far as possible, taking the petrification serpent egg with him.
At least that was how Jason tried to interpret it. He was unsure whether his translation was corret or not!
Meanwhile, the petrification serpent egg was releasing an enormous amount of emotions at once which it wanted to target its mother, that was not there anymore.
As such, Jason was targeted with the emotions as he was the being the unhatched petrification serpent egg was the closest too.
This was at least what Jason thought when he suddenly remembered that there should be more petrification serpent eggs.
Initially, he didn't understand why the petrification serpent mother approached Mythic Garden's center, but after he thought about the other eggs it had, Jason began to wonder if they were in a nest at the center.
'Is the center some sort of place to give birth and raise one's offsprings?' He asked, not sure if his assumption made sense or not.
However, it was a fact that the petrifaction serpent slithered towards several of the most terrifying ranked beasts of the Mythic Garden, who were waiting for something.
They were unmoving and not fighting against each other and Jason couldn't help but curse quietly as he tried to calm down the unhatched petrification serpent that began to shake in his hands.
He remembered what the earth dragon transmitted about his aura and eyes as he inserted mana into them before his eyes were trained on the egg in front of him.
Thinking about something nice and not the petrification serpent's death that seemed to be inevitable, and a desperate attempt to rescue the remaining eggs, his eyes began to glow faintly.
This glow enveloped the unhatched petrification serpent's egg gently, calming it down, halting the forced hatching process it was about to initiate.

chapters.title: Chapter 386 - Inevitable Fate
chapters.content:
After the petrification serpent egg stopped shaking, Jason continued to stare at it with his glowing golden eyes until the complex set of emotions within the unhatched petrification serpent's aura began to calm down.
Jason was unsure if talking to it was helping but he felt like doing so.
Once he saw that everything seemed fine, Jason could finally avert his attention from the petrification serpent egg to the more important, and dangerous Mythic Garden center area.
Since he was distracted before, Jason didn't notice what happened when the petrification serpent entered the center, but from the looks of it, there had yet to start a fight.
This astonished Jason a little but it allowed him to hope that the assumption he had was wrong.
The distance from his location to the center was several hundred meters, enough to stay hidden as long as his mana core was concealed and the petrification serpent egg in his hands didn't act up.
Looking towards the center, Jason perceived the outlines of the Demonic Three-eyed Wolf, the Boneflame centipede, and a humanoid being with horns and the lower part of a goat, also called Satyr. This was most likely the Dark Satyr!
There were also a few more beasts he couldn't perfectly decipher left, but from the information he had read within the handwritten Mythic Garden book, there were probably the deathbed flower, the Silver eyed rabbit, the Millennium cotton shep, the winged fortune tiger, and the draconic fate Hawk.
Even one or two of those beats Jason saw would be enough to be a threat to the petrification serpent mother that had already exhausted itself by releasing the bloodlust intertwined mana for a long period.
Jason was also sure that the petrification serpent egg hadn't been laid for a long time which might be an additional factor for the petrification serpent mother's exhaustion.
However, even though the current situation looked perilous, Jason couldn't just leave with the petrification serpent egg.
At least not until he saw that the petrification serpent would be attacked by the present Low Lique stage beasts that harbored all kinds of curses and blessings.
It was not like he didn't want to run away as far as possible but then, Jason had to take the egg in his hands with him because he was unable to abandon it.
He might have not known the unhatched petrification serpent for more than three hours but this short period was already enough for him to decide that he wanted it to face reality.
This might sound dumb even for Jason because the petrification serpent has yet to hatch but its intelligence seemed to be on par with beasts that had liquefied their mana already.
As such Jason knew that running away would be worse for the unhatched petrification serpent as it might never find out whether its mother survived or died.
Being unaware of its mother's fate would be worse than knowing that it died and Jason could only sigh deeply as he mumbled.
"Once the situation turns too dangerous, I'll run away... just that you know!"
He was not even sure if the unhatched petrification serpent was able to understand him to some extent as it shouldn't be the case, but unbeknownst to himself, Jason spoke in the universal language of all foreign races.
This allowed the petrification serpent inside the egg to understand the rough meaning of Jason's words.
What he didn't know was that not only every foreign race could speak the universal language but that also all beasts were able to roughly understand words spoken in the universal language too!
Seeing how calm the unhatched petrification egg turned, Jason couldn't help but feel that his words had some kind of effect.
He told himself that the calmness he radiated had to be the reason for it to calm down before he focused his full intention on the center of the Mythic Garden where the tension seemed to intensify.
When he saw this, Jason couldn't help but grit his thought as the climax of tension had been reached, which caused every present beast to unleash their entire mana and abilities.
The surrounding landscape vibrated and it felt as if every leaf, blade of grass, and tree began to move from the sheer mass of mana those beasts had released.
The fight had yet to start but Jason could already tell that it was over when he saw how terrifying the unleashed mana that was intertwined with all kinds of blessings and curses.
There were only a few beasts in front of Jason that possessed an affinity, but that was not necessary because he would never underestimate a beast that was able to release such a huge amount of mana at once.
In fact, he was able to tell that they had yet to go all out!
Subconsciously, he took a few steps back when he saw that the blessed beings utilized their blessing to the fullest extent while the cursed beasts targeted the petrification serpent as their sole target with the curses they harbored.
Gritting his teeth, Jason could only say sorry, when he took a few more steps back until he saw how the weakening curse on him dissipated into thin air as the petrification serpent unleashed everything it could to overload the curses it harbored.
At least that was what he assumed to happen because he was unable to explain what his mana eyes perceived.
The petrification serpent's weakening curse decreased each of the surrounding beasts' combat prowess by roughly 30% which shocked Jason a lot.
However, overloading the curse was not something that came without backlash and Jason perceived that the petrification serpent mother's mana fluctuation became unstable.
'Did it already exhaust its whole mana?' He began to wonder as the black scaled egg in his hand began to release its sadness within the aura it released.
'You can also tell….right?' Jason was unable to ask this out loud but he could tell that the unhatched petrification serpent could sense that its mother would inevitably die during the next few minutes.
It was unknown why exactly the strongest beasts of the Mythic Garden established an alliance against the petrification serpent but Jason thought that a dozen eggs it laid had to be the biggest input.
A single petrification serpent was already considered terrifying to each of the strongest beasts, but a dozen of them meant their imminent death!
That was if they were to allow those eggs to hatch and grow to the same combat prowess its mother had!
They were unable to accept this outcome and thus decided to enter the center of the Mythic Garden where they encountered the other beasts.
Instead of attacking each other, they had formed a silent agreement that was starting to show its true color.
Without a single sign, all beasts attacked the petrification serpent at the same time, overwhelming it within a few minutes.
The weakening curse showed its effect, allowing the petrification serpent to seriously injure the Silver-eyed rabbit and boneflame centipede, but that was already the most it could do against the onslaught of several of the strongest Mythic Garden beasts.
When Jason perceived that the fight was more like a desperate means of the petrification serpent to inflict a few injuries in order to slither towards a certain location, he could hardly suppress cursing out.
Instead, he said "Sorry" in the universal language before he turned around in the opposite direction of the center.
Exerting the weightless steps technique he escaped from Mythic Garden's center, preventing any of those present Low Lique stage beasts from perceiving that he had been there...

chapters.title: Chapter 387 - Will You Come With Me?
chapters.content:
Almost a whole day had passed since Jason had run away from Mythic Garden's center but he was not even remotely close to the rift or surrounding area of it.
Owing to the fact that Artemis' wings were badly injured and recuperating slowly, he had to remain on the ground, where many obstacles and strong beasts forced him to take long detours.
??
Adding that the unhatched petrification serpent was releasing its frustration, sadness, and agony with its aura throughout those 24 hours, many beasts had been attracted to him.
This forced Jason to fight or run away before those stronger beasts were unable to find him anymore.
In the end, he was not even sure what he should do with the petrification serpent egg which he embraced.
It would be the biggest lie he ever told anyone, if he were to say that he didn't want to contract the petrification serpent as his soulbond, however, Jason was unsure if this was something it would even accept willingly.
He could also force it but that was not something Jason wanted to do as he wanted to create a fortified soul conjunction with every beast he was to bind.
After he had witnessed how powerful a fortified soul conjunction was, Jason couldn't help but think that he had to have one for every beast he bound to his soul world.
Furthermore, he couldn't help but be curious how exactly curses would be affected by a fortified soul conjunction.
However, in the end, this was not important to the petrification serpent egg.
If it wanted to take revenge on the other beasts, Jason would most likely be unable to bind it as his soulbond. He was not even sure whether he would become too strong in the next six months or if the Jual clan would change something in their assessment, preventing strangers from entering the Mythic Garden ever again.
As such, he wouldn't be able to promise the unmatched petrification serpent to take revenge on its mother for its entire life! Binding a beast that would regret not being able to take revenge on its mother's murderer would be bad, to put it simply.
At least if that was what the petrification serpent planned!
There was also the possibility that beasts like the petrification serpent thought differently about revenge because it was normal for beasts to prey on each other.
With that in mind, Jason couldn't help but feel a small ray of hope emerging within him.
It might be weird to feel like this, shortly after an unhatched beast lost its mother, but Jason's own situation was not great either.
He had at most one week left before the Mythic Garden rift would close for six months and Jason didn't want to stay inside the rift any longer.
That was if he were to be honest with himself.
If possible, he would bind a suitably cursed beast and rush back to the underground island.
Jason was seriously pondering whether the Mythic Garden or the Jual clan was more dangerous to him, and in the end, he decided that he should try to find a way outside the underground island as quietly as possible.
He remembered which teleportation circle the sovereign-ranked guardian had used and his mana eyes perceived also the 'secret' passcode that was intertwined into the magic circle.
As such, he was confident in leaving the underground island secretly as long as the remaining mana inside the magic sphere was enough to empower the transportation circle.
However, this was not something Jason should be bothered about right now. There was a large horde of cursed Mid-unblemished beasts in front of him, staring at the petrification serpent egg inside his left hand.
This caused him to frown, as he began to wonder if the egg in his hand was valuable to those Longhorn jackals that attacked and cursed him with a weak destructive curse.
This curse was a weaker version of the Demonic Three-eyed wolf's horrific destructive curse, however, instead of being able to injure someone badly, it created illusionary pain if the opponent was stronger than the Longhorn jackals.
After being targeted by around 100 of those weak, destructive curses, his entire being was overwhelmed by illusionary pain.
Gritting his teeth he unsheathed the light longsword with his free hand as he charged towards the Longhorn jackals.
His lips curled upwards as he manifested two large liquefied balls of poison which he threw towards the center of the longhorn Jackal's horde.
However, instead of maintaining the shape of a ball, Jason forced them to burst open in the most crowded area.
The corrosive poison splattered everywhere, hitting several dozen longhorn jackals that cried out in pain, as Jason emerged in front of the first opponent.
He had yet to dissolve Scorpio's exoskeleton and his stinger, which he did not do because he wanted to increase his pace with Scorpio's entire soul amplification.
Using the stinger as a third means to attack next to his elemental attacks and the light longsword he pierced through the first longhorn jackal's head, everything went much smoother than he expected.
The only issue was that he had to pay attention to the petrification serpent egg in his hand as he was shaken wildly.
He twisted his body several times, evading the longhorn Jackals' longhorns that were almost half a meter long.
In the end, the Jackals had the size of a horse foal, were black in color with white-yellowish longhorns on their forehead.
It looked ridiculous but Jason took them seriously even if their strength was only comparable to Mid-Unblemished beasts. He was much stronger but he shouldn't take the large horde in front of him lightly which might kill him if he were to do a wrong move.
Then minutes later,? Jason stood in a field of sizzling soil and corpses while the manifested stinger and his light longsword were drenched in crimson-colored blood.
The petrification serpent egg was releasing emotions, Jason couldn't decipher.
However, instead of thinking too much about it, he continued to walk towards the direction he presumed the rift to be located.
Three hours later his mana eyes were able to perceive the outlines of the big, complex rune that created the rift.
Nevertheless, he didn't rush towards the rift which he wanted to do in order to leave the Mythic Garden.
Instead, he looked at the petrification serpent as he said
"I will leave this place soon and it's unlikely that I can come back in the future. If you want, you can come with me as one of my companions! I won't force you but your chances to survive inside the Mythic Garden without being nurtured and protected by your mother are small. Furthermore, you won't be able to become strong enough to take revenge on your mother's murderer because they might hunt you down once you're expose …"
Jason said nothing but the harsh truth. It might be harmful to the petrification serpent if it was able to understand his words, but in the end, it was better to know the truth than living oblivious to it.
Noticing that the petrification serpent didn't understand anything, Jason pondered what could have been different to the time it was able to comprehend his words, which caused him to speak in the universal language out of instinct.
After that, the petrification serpent released several complex emotions within its aura, which Jason could hardly separate.
They were so complex intertwined with each other and overlapping that he decided to not mind it for the time being.
Instead, he walked towards the rift that was still quite a distance away from him.
When he entered the plain are around the rift he was able to see many young human prodigies talking to each other which caused him to cover his face because he didn't want to be seen by the wind affinity used from which he stole the egg.
As such he turned around to distance himself a little bit again when he remembered that the young man from the Wirad family shouldn't have seen his face.
However, in that case, there was still the egg in his hand which was something he shouldn't openly show someone else in order to prevent greed from igniting within them.
When he saw that the unhatched petrification serpent retraced its complex emotion, indicating to Jason that it calmed down, he couldn't help but ask hopefully.
"What's your choice, little one? Will you come with me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 388 - Leaving The Mythic Garden
chapters.content:
Jason understood that the unhatched petrification serpent had problems understanding him, but when he released his soul thread to show it, the language barrier between them didn't matter anymore.
The petrification serpent within the black egg understood instinctively what Jason wanted to do, yet, it was unsure what exactly it wanted.
??
Revenge?
Freedom?
Aventuring?
In the end, the unhatched petrification serpent had yet to hatch and it couldn't be considered an overly intelligent beast because it was still developing.
The petrification serpent mother laid the eggs a few days prior and the unhatched petrification serpent couldn't understand the meaning of most things.
To put it simply, it didn't think about revenge right now but it was only filled with sadness.
Nevertheless, more than three hours passed before Jason received something similar to an answer.
Shaking lightly, the egg in his hands released an aura whose meaning he couldn't understand.
However, before he was even able to ask anything else, Jason's mana eyes perceived an astronomical amount of mana arising nearby the horizon.
This mana stemmed from multiple beasts and Jason was already familiar with them which caused him to disregard everything as he said
"I don't know if you accepted me but I'll have to do this to survive. Don't release your aura when you want to remain inside the Mythic Garden and target me with it if you want to come with me….But HURRY UP!"
Jason was unsure if his assumption was correct but if what he received was correct most terrifying ranked beasts that killed the petrification serpent mother were now hunting the small unhatched petrification serpent.
The egg was in his hands and if he didn't hurry up and escaped he would be dead too.
As such he gave the petrification serpent one last chance.
While he exerted the weightless steps technique to rush towards the rift whose surrounding area Jason left to prevent attracting too much of a commotion, he sensed that the unhatched petrification serpent targeted him with its aura.
Taking this as permission, Jason released a thick tread from his soul which he smoothly moved through his body before he used Scorpio's exoskeleton to cut his free hand at a sharp edge.
After that, he dissolved the exoskeleton subconsciously as he used his free hand to cover the greenish-black egg with which he started to form a soulbond.
The pace at which the soulbond contract was formed was too slow and Jason panicked for a short moment when he noticed how high the most terrifying ranked beasts' pace was.
Appearing inside the plain area where he saw many students talking to each other he could only do two things.
The first thing he did was to accelerate the pace at which the soulbond contract was formed by forcefully injecting more of his soul into the petrification serpent egg.
This wouldn't cause any major injuries but a slightly uncomfortable sensation until the contract was completed
'One minute….that should be fine!'
Meanwhile, the second thing he could do to prevent a massacre nearby the rift to happen was to shout out loud
"There are several of the most terrifying ranked beasts running towards the rift!!!"
Jason amplified his voice with mana, and there was nothing else that had to be said.
Even if Jason lied, the other young prodigies who had heard him, only doubted him for a few seconds before they perceived how fast he was running towards the rift.
He looked like he was extremely stressed, running for his life which gave the young prodigies Jason had already run past enough reason to pack up their stuff within a few seconds.
Exerting their own movement technique, they followed Jason while most of them were even able to overtake him, thanks to their high mana core rank.
However, Jason didn't bother about that because he had to finish forming the soulbond contract before he would be able to pass through the rift.
He felt uncomfortable with others seeing that he had the egg of a petrification serpent in his hand and it would only be worse if someone outside the Mythic Garden were to see this.
While he could fight against everyone inside the Mythic Garden if he were to be desperate enough, on Argos there were too many strong humans he couldn't fight yet.
Jason might only be 15 years yet, but he was able to fight prodigies at the age of 20. That was under extreme condition, but Jason was confident that he could do it!
As such he would only need enough time to become strong enough to face even stronger opponents.
Unfortunately, he couldn't disappear from the sight of the underground island just like that which he had hoped for because he felt that the 6 months he and the other prodigies had spent within the Mythic Garden changed a lot on the Archipelago and Canir.
Only half a minute passed when Jason slowed down because there were only 100 meters between him and the rift that could save him from the most terrifying ranked beasts that were about to charge out of the small forest he had walked through a minute ago.
"I'm sorry little one!" Was the only thing he could say as he unleashed his soul world's full might, forcing its way through the soul thread Jason had loosened in order to form a bond with the unhatched petrification serpent that began to shake violently.
Meanwhile, Jason was able to see the outlines of the Demoni Three-eyed Wolf behind those of a two-meter-tall rabbit which he assumed to be the silver-eyed rabbit.
Accelerating his pace again, he could hear the first prodigies screaming out in shock when they saw that Jason's words were true and that he didn't lie about the fact that some of the most terrifying ranked beasts were headed towards them.
The Demonic Three-eyed WOlf targeted a few prodigies with its curse, which was unable to kill anyone due to the enhanced weakening curse it was still targeted with, even after the petrification serpent mother had died.
As such, Jason sighed in relief, thankful that he wouldn't die just by being targeted from the Demonic Three-eyed wolf's destructive curse.
Increasing his pace again, Jason charged ahead and he appeared right in front of the rift when the unhatched petrification serpent egg entered his soul world.
At this moment, he stepped through the rift while noticing that the petrification serpent's curse began to reach out to his soul world core, infesting it.
Inside the rift, Jason's eyes were blindfolded once again but instead of inserting mana into his mana eyes to dissipate those blindfolds, he focused on his soul world which he entered mentally.
There, he saw Artemis, Scorpio, and Solaris staring at the egg that was right next to the soul world core, releasing its curse towards the core.
This caused the soul world core to retaliate and the same scenario that happened with the prior curse he was targeted, occurred once again.
His soul world shock and the soul world core was trying to push away the curse that tried to establish a new shelter within the core.
Before, Jason was just targeted by a curse, but this changed completely now that he had formed a soulbond contract with the said cursed beast.
It would be extremely difficult up to impossible to revolt against the race specific weakening curse which the petrification serpent harbored.
Jason was unsure how much time passed but he could tell that something about his soul world core changed substantially.
Suddenly, Jason's eyes began to hurt and the only thing he sensed from the soul world core was the fact that 10,000 soul energy units had been consumed by it to create something.
Unfortunately, he was unable to see it because the pain spreading through his eyes was tormenting him.
