chapters.title: Chapter 389 - Infiltration? War?
chapters.content:
Jason didn't expect the curses, which the unhatched petrification serpent inherited to him would take effect almost immediately.
This was unpredicted but at the same time good to occur right now instead of an even worse timing, like in front of the woman from the Jual clan!
??
If that were to happen, Jason would need to have a huge amount of luck or the best acting he could deliver to anyone doubting him.
Initially, he had planned to investigate the things he could see within the rift itself, like the large green planet or the curse enveloping it, but that became insignificant.
Right now, he had to endure the race specific weakening curse transforming his soul world core while the petrification curse wreaked havoc within his mana eyes, trying to change something too.
Jason knew that the petrification curse he inherits from the unhatched petrification serpent would be advantageous.
Thus he could easily endure the pain, but Jason was unsure if his soul world core was strong enough to overcome the weakening curse.
Something changed about the soul world core and Jason only felt that it had absorbed 10,000 soul energy units to do something, yet, he was unable to figure out what exactly it was.
This was not only annoying but the pain in his eyes prevented him from doing anything further.
An unknown amount of time passed before Jason had been expelled from the rift while the pain in his eyes had intensified.
Meanwhile, his soul world core transmitted illusionary pain towards him which was spread through his entire body.
When he left the rift, Jason had to rely on the mana fluctuations to scan everything in his surrounding.
His strength was still unrestrained and comparable to someone who had barely advanced to the Lowest Lique stage.
From his mana fluctuations, Jason perceived that there were many shocked and shivering young prodigies next to him which allowed him to comprehend that they had escaped death closer than initially expected.
However, Jason didn't think that it was as close as the others thought. The situation was not desperate enough to shiver and behave like pushovers.
At least not if one was arrogant enough to call themselves prodigies.
Walking around the young men and women that laid on the ground, gasping for air, happy to have survived, he could hear a familiar voice echoing through the whole underground island.
"What the hell is our family doing? MOM!! Explain to me what I've heard about the slave market and don't even try to fool me!!"
It was Milan and from his voice, one could tell that he was furious.
On one side,? Jason was happy to see this, but on the other hand, he found this act extremely foolish and naive.
Yet, what astonished him was the other familiar voice he heard.
"Calm down Milan! Let's wait for Suo and then I'll bring you away!! You don't even know what happened here during the last six months...I will explain everything later, alright? Just calm down!"? It was the voice of the woman, who he assumed to be the vice-head or matriarch of the Jual Clan, the person that had called him out for having a fortified soul conjunction!
"HOW can I calm down right now? Not only did nobody in our clan tell me what was going on but I had to hear this from someone I just got to know? If he didn't ask something about the slave marked by accident, I would have never heard anything about it! When would you have told me about it?? WHEN?"
Suddenly, right about the time he wanted to advance the discussion with his mother that everyone on the island could hear through the sheer volume he spoke out of anger, Milan sensed that his legs gave in.
A moment later, he felt a hand around his shoulder holding him with force which would have been uncomfortable if he didn't felt the overly familiar mana fluctuations of Jason.
Looking towards Jason whose eyes were closed, thick drops of blood leaking from them, he could only exclaim
"Jason! What the hell happened with you?"
Holding his ear with the free hand, Jason couldn't help but say in a quieter voice
"Hey Milan...I think you shouldn't be so loud right now"
Smiling lightly he whispered
"At least not if you don't want to humiliate your mother in front of a hundred descendants from all kinds of influential families and clans."
Jason went all-in right now!
Instead of running away from the Jual-clan, acting as if he had something to hide, he had chosen the exact opposite path that should work out too.
He might have something against the Jual clan's attitude towards their weaker citizens and the fact that they enslaved humans, but that was something Jason had to set aside for now!
When he heard that the woman who had called him out before was Milan's mother, Jason couldn't help but rejoice.
If everything worked out, he would be able to come out of the underground island unscathed!
Turning towards the woman with two solidified and a third, almost constructed prismarine crystal within her mana core, Jason bowed lightly before introducing himself.
"Hello, my name is Jason and I was the person who accidentally revealed the slave market to Milan while I was with him and Isga inside the Mythic Garden. I'm sorry, but I guess it's better that he knows now, right?"
Jason was unable to see the woman, who Milan quietly introduced as Yvonne Jual, because his eyes were still aching as if they were burning in hell's fire.
The only advantage that prevented him from screaming out in pain was his high resistance to pain and the fact that Solaris, the Tier-1 black origin flame enveloped his eyeballs with its flames, soothing the pain.
It was an uncomfortable feeling but seemed to help a little bit.
From the outside, it looked weird too because the dried blood around his eyes highlighted the black flames that could be seen through Jason's eyelids.
However, instead of showing interested in this, Yvonne Jual size-up Jason as she said
"Weren't you the young man with the fortified soul conjunction? In 6 months...you increase your mana core rank from the 4th Expert rank to the 2nd Master rank...not bad...but not something someone with a superior talent should be proud about.
At least not if you are the one who actively absorbed mana with Milan and Isga at one branch of the exposed mana vein…"
When Jason heard this, he thought that Milan had told his mother everything.
As such he couldn't help but turn around to Milan as he quietly mumbled to himself
"Are you a mama's boy?"
Shaking his head, Jason was glad that Milan didn't say anything about his age, when he heard him retorting his mother
"What are you saying mom? His mana absorption rate is amazing, it's just that---...."
Before Milan could even finish his sentence he saw a fist, he hadn't seen coming, emerged right before his eyes as Jason lightly said with a faint smile on his face
"Do you want to pick a fight?"
He was obviously joking but Milan was shocked that he was unable to see the fist that seemed to have appeared out of nowhere.
Meanwhile, Yvonne who saw everything much slower could tell that Jason's physical strength was already on par with her son who had said that he advanced to the Magus rank.
That meant Jason's mana core rank was not his entire strength. As such she scanned his mana fluctuations, only to sense that they were also on par with her son's.
"Soul amplification?" She just mumbled which caused Jason to stiffen.
The pain in his eyes increased and Jason could also feel that the soul world core was about to merge with the curse it inherited after the soulbond contract with the petrification serpent egg had been completed.
If his strength were to suddenly plummet in front of Yvonne Jual and Milan at that, he would have lots of things to explain or quite a few problems at hand.
As such he straightened his back as he said
"I need to go back now. I need to report my arrival!"
This was neither entirely true nor false but he had to say it like this to tell Yvonne that someone was waiting for him, most likely a big family or hidden, ancient clan.
At least that was the most logical explanation for Jason's high strength.
Yvonne who thought exactly what Jason wanted her to think pondered for a moment as she said
"Just tell me where you have to go...If you're a friend of Milan, I shouldn't allow you to leave alone...at least not right now!"
This confused both Jason and Milan
"What is that about 'right now'? Did something happen?"
"Jason, if you're in a hurry you can leave, just go to Louis and tell him where you want to go, but it would be best for you to stay here for the next few days and leave with all of us at once…
I don't want to scare you, but it looks like we are facing an infiltration of foreign races right now!!"
"WHAT?!" Jason shouted out loud which attracted the attention of the surrounding young men and women that tried to get the hang of themselves.
He quieted down in an instant? and could only think about the Shadow walkers as Yvonne sighed
"It's pretty obvious for all clans that foreign races collude every clan to have a stable supply of humans which they want to turn into some sort of super humans or experiment with them.
At least that is what we have been doing, but if I were to be honest, I'm not sure what they're doing with the people we are sending over.
In the end, we are insignificant and if we can become a little bit more important by colluding with the foreign races to stand up against them in the future, some people have to be sacrificed too!"
'And those people are the weak, right?.... But...does she truly understand how insignificant our race...or even Argos is?'
Jason didn't say anything but he was able to understand how Yvonne thought according to her attitude and how she acted which included the fact that she was not even a little bit suspicious about his identity.
She was probably even aware that his identity for Terebrean as "Jason Laere" was faked, but that didn't seem to bother her.
Instead, she explained and proved several things he and his masters only assumed to be correct.
However, the thought that they could defeat those foreign races that supplied them with a minuscule part of their own resources, was absurd, if one were to put it nicely.
"Unfortunately, some foreign race's tactics seemed to have changed and several races, that mainly included the alliance around the Shadow walkers. We have already encountered more than a hundred Shadow walkers and every single one of them is as strong as I am, if not stronger...The worst, however, is the fact that they don't seem to care about maintaining a good relationship with us anymore because they started to abduct prodigies from big clans too!!
This has never happened and mankind is about to establish a large alliance and wage war to protect our offsprings!"
When Jason heard this, he couldn't help but blurt out
"What bullshit...wage war against those who see our race as mere toys...great idea!"

chapters.title: Chapter 390 - Misconception
chapters.content:
Yvonne was astonished about how vulgar Jason's words suddenly became.
"Bullshit?" She was about to lecture him that it was important to retaliate now that the foreign races started to infiltrate mankind's territory when Jason's words echoed in her mind.
??
"Toys..? That's something new. I've heard livestock or resource but we've never been called toys"
Jason felt Yvonne's stare on him while her anger seemed to be substituted with questions.
This caused him to ask bluntly
"I don't want to be too brisk but Mrs. Jual, you said that our race is insignificant, right? However, at the same time you're talking about fighting back with the resources we receive through the foreign races... Don't you think that they know what they're doing and expect this reaction? The resources they hand out in exchange for getting their hands on a constant supply of humans should be negligible or even worthless to them…
Let me ask you two questions. What do you know about the insignificance of our race?... And what would you say if I tell you that it's even worse than you might think?"
Jason's reason to ask those questions was not to let Yvonne Jual have a reality check or allow her to receive more information about other planets than Argos.
Rather than that he wanted to see how she would react and what she was going to do once he told her something she would never accept to believe.
He had failed to accomplish the third task which he had given himself during the last few months; getting to know what ingredients were needed to create the addictive cultivation drug.
However, that was not necessarily bad! From the looks of it, Yvonne Jual was not a completely bad person and Jason could tell that she was different from Jael Drake.
At least to some extent...
She cared about her two sons and even offered Jason to bring him away once everyone left the underground island.
This was something he didn't predict beforehand and it made him a little bit curious about more things.
He wouldn't accept her offer but Jason could figure out quite a few things if he were to talk with Yvonne for some time.
Unfortunately, before the Jual clan matriarch could say something, someone rushed out of the crowd of young prodigies that were about to leave, charging straigth into Jason and Milan.
Jason, whose mana fluctuations were fully expanded, noticed this and took a step aside.
Thus Isga, who was overjoyed to see Jason, crashed into Milan.
Both laid on the ground but Isga stood up hurriedly as he shouted.
"Jason!! You are alive! That's great.. But how and what is wrong with your eyes? Where is the petrification serpent now? Did the other most terrifying ranked beasts pursue you because of the petrification serpent's egg scent that lingers on you?"
At that moment, Jason had never been as frustrated to have become friends with someone like Milan and Isga as he was right now.
How could their timing be so bad...every single time at that?
This was not the first time and Jason felt that it wouldn't be the last time either.
While Jason was lamenting about Isga because he revealed too many things that not everyone on the underground island was supposed to hear, he was astonished that he didn't hear Milan asking him about what had happened.
Isga had already started to tell the story from the moment he encountered Jason who had manifested white wings on his back at that time.
His storytelling ability was superb and Jason who was dragged out of his thoughts couldn't help but listen intently until he remembered that he was exposing that he had survived the last incident with the petrification serpent egg in his hands.
However, it was already too late and if he were to intercept Isga, everything would become much more complicated than it had become.
As such he thought of a good story to explain how exactly he had survived.
When Isga explained that everything was Fae Wirad's fault as he had stolen the petrification serpent's egg, Yvonne and Milan became angry.
Milan was angry because his friends had almost died while Yvonne Jual's anger stemmed from the fact that their family's reputation could have suffered if there had been an incident inside the Mythic Garden.
The death rate of 80% was a clear sign that the Mythic Garden was dangerous, but she encountered more than enough families spreading false rumors that her clan killed their prodigies within the Mythic Garden!
If those prodigies that had been searching for the fate-changing fruit died at once, the Jual clan would have suffered a lot.
As such, she was glad that Jason, Isga, and Yune had solved the problems from occurring.
However, what astonished her were two facts. One fact was that Jason had obviously established two fortified conjunctions.
This was something she understood when Isga continued with his story as he explained how Jason protected himself with the sapphire-colored exoskeleton he summoned after the white wings had almost been cut.
The second fact was also the most important point! Jason was still alive after the petrification serpent mother devoured him!!
It was likely that she only put him into her mouth to take care of her egg, but the fact that the petrification serpent mother didn't release her mana kill Jason shocked Yvonne a little bit.
According to the information they gathered for more than a century, something like that had never happened!
The same could be said for protecting a beast egg, with one's body while the mother beast saw them being attacked by another human.
As such Yvonne couldn't tell if that was something similar to gratitude from the petrification serpent, to have saved its offspring, or if Jason survived because he was special, which was pretty obvious.
Not only was his name obviously faked, but, somehow, Yvonne Jual thought that his whole Hidde-Prodigy assessment was planned and that not even his age was correct.
His soul-awakening should have been higher than a common 4-star rating too, which was not less shocking.
However, Jason's strength was on par with her own son while Jason's mana core rank was one whole rank below Milan's too!
Clearing her throat, Yvonne was not sure what to say because something like the scenario she had heard about had never happened to her.
Not only was Jason extremely mysterious and from an unknown background but it looks like he knows more about the strength foreign races have and the human race's insignificance.
Recalling Jason's words 'What if I tell you that it's even worse than you might think?', she couldn't help but contemplate asking him for more information.
Suddenly, Jason noticed that the pain his soul world core caused him began to dissipate which was extremely bad.
Under normal circumstances he would be glad to feel less pain, but not if he couldn't tell what kind of reaction he would receive from others if they were to find out that he bound the petrification serpent egg to him.
Averting his head to Yvonne Jual, he suddenly said
"How can I leave the underground island? If it's possible I would go back to Asga again!"
Milan and Isga were astonished that Jason wanted to leave so quickly and it was only when they saw a thick sweat pearl running down his temples, their astonishment turned into confusion.
"Are your eyes hurting too much? How did you even hurt them? Will you go back to your family to heal them?" Milan suddenly asked which caused Jason to extinguish the black flame around his eyes.
The petrification curse within his eyes was unleashed and small drops of blood poured out of the corner of his eyes before Solaris ignited the flames again.
This took less than a second and Jason began to wonder if he would have already bleed out without Solaris's help.
After seeing Jason's state, everyone's doubt was cleared.
Even though Yvonne became curious about the healing flame Jason seemed to have contracted as his soulbond, she understood the situation.
'He has two fortified soul conjunctions from a winged beast and one with an exoskeleton...and now a flame that has a healing or maybe recuperating ability? He can't be 17 years old...otherwise, nothing would make sense!!'
As such, instead of answering Jason's question immediately, she asked him about his age.
The moment she asked this she noticed that Jason avoided her which was expected and Milan was about to say something only to stop himself.
This caused Yvonne to lift her eyes, confused that Milan, who told her every little detail about everything that occurred to him which he had always done since he was a small child.
"I'm younger than my ID says, that should be enough, right?" Smiling lightly, Jason openly said that his identity was faked which reassured Yvonne in her thought that the youth in front of her belonged to an ancient clan.
Some stricter ancient clans didn't like it if their prodigies revealed their information because of multiple reasons. Either they wanted to have their peace, protect others connected to them or it had a different, deeper meaning.
In the end, this was not important to Yvonne, and only one's combat prowess was important!
Yvonne sighed after this and decided to let Jason off her hook. There was no need to pressure someone from the younger generation and there was only one thing she wanted to know from him.
"I can activate the transportation magic circle that brings you back to Asga, but can you answer one last question?"
Nodding his head, Jason couldn't help but feel that he knew what bothered Yvonne and her question was similar to the one he expected.
"What did you want to tell me when you said that mankind might be less insignificant than I think? Our planet is one among a few dozen and only awoke a few centuries ago, while other planets are a few centuries to one millennium older, is there more?"
When Jason heard this he couldn't help but laugh out loud, which confused everyone around them.
"That's probably what your trusted allies from the foreign races told you, right? Never heard something so ridiculous! I think you wouldn't even come close to the truth if you add a few zeroes to everything you said!"

chapters.title: Chapter 391 - Are You A Zombie?
chapters.content:
Jason didn't plan to reveal everything he knew to the others but he couldn't help but feel like the foreign races were truly perfect at playing push-and-pull.
First, the foreign races acted as if they were barely strong enough to be on par with the strongest human powerhouses in order to make trading agreements with them, and now they thought it was necessary to lie that badly?
??
Were they trying to be considerate? What crap!!
However, in the end, he had to acknowledge that the foreign race's behavior was extremely smart which included the way they had played the big clans.
Those foreign races even divided the human race amongst each other without creating a war on Argos.
That was at least as long as nobody started to be greedy!
Nevertheless, Jason couldn't help but think that everyone was too naive, thinking that their gains from the trading agreement with the foreign races were enough to start a riot against the foreign races.
At most, those big clans that colluded with the foreign races were business partners, more likely their underlings.
Right now Jason could reveal almost everything without being looked at suspiciously which was all thanks to Yvonne, who was firmly convinced that Jason hailed from an ancient clan. Furthermore, she thought that he might be one of their most talented, young prodigies.
This would also explain why he knew more information.
According to what she knew, the ancient clans were more knowledgeable than most big clans in almost every aspect.
She was not sure about their combat strength but in her opinion, they should be stronger too!
The sole reason for those ancient clans to be unbothered about reigning Canir and the Archipelago was probably the fact that governing humans was seen as a hassle, wasting too much precious time that could have been used to absorb mana.
"100x times...So several hundred planets and hundreds of millennia...shouldn't that mean that they're much stronger than what they show us? We are at the sovereign rank after around three centuries...what.."
Yvonne was visibly shocked but Isga and Milan didn't fare better than her. Instead, they looked even worse.
Jason perceived everything through his mana fluctuations that scanned the whole area around him and couldn't help but slap his two friends back with all his might.
With a loud smack that echoed through the surrounding, Isga and Milan screamed out as Jason said
"How about you two calm down? What happens to you guys after I depart? If I hear you guys slack off, just because of the things I told you, I'll tear you apart! Or even worse...make fun of you guys!"
Smiling lightly to ease the tension that had accumulated within Isga and Milan during the past few minutes, they looked at each other while rubbing the sore spot Jason had hit, before laughing out loud.
Jason felt good right now because he sensed that Isga and Milan were real friends, however, he couldn't even enjoy it as he sensed that the race individual weakening curse, which the soul world core had inherited from the unhatched petrification serpent, was showing signs of its effect.
His smile vanished while the petrification curse in his eyes intensified.
Holding his head with his hands, blood started to poor out of them again.
"Can..we depart please?"
Jason had yet to say how his eyes had been so badly injured but that was not important right now.
Isga and Milan tried to help Jason, only to feel that their body stiffened as if something electrocuted them when they touched their friend.
This was weird but they ignored this weird sensation and gave their best to help Jason out. Suddenly, Yvonne picked up Jason, who was baffled for a short moment.
"Asga, right? Let's go!"
After taking the first steps she mumbled, slightly embarrassed that she had to ask this
"That might be the worst time to ask this but Milan never lied to me because of someone else, and he doesn't have many friends, so give him your contact details, please?"
Even though the pain in his eyes increased Jason was still able to understand what Yvonne said
'Is that motherly love? Weird...She said 'please' too...That's unexpected' He told himself quietly as he answered
"I already gave them my contacts, I'll save them in the other quantum bracelet too…"
Instead of 'new' quantum bracelet Jason said 'other' in order to maintain his identity as an assumed descendant of an ancient family.
Yvonne Jual sighed in relief before she rushed towards the transportation circle which she activated by injecting her mana
"I know your situation is not really the best, and I would accommodate you to your clan, but I want to wait for my other son to come out of the rift...from what I heard earlier, the rift is too dangerous and I don't feel comfortable…"
Jason nodded his head before he heard Isga and Milan bidding farewell to him too.
In the end, he could only shake his head and think that both were way too nice. What would happen if they would end up as enemies?
Was that even something they imagined? Jason didn't know but he knew that some big clans had been tricked into signing problematic soul contracts that forced them to follow the foreign race they were contracted with into war, if necessary.
Their contracts might be shallow too, but nobody except those who signed them knew about the truth!
According to what Yvonne told them, war was exactly what the big clans were trying to start against the Shadow walker and their alliance!
Jason was also relatively sure that the Shadow walker and other races that belonged to their alliance came to Canir because of his existence.
'As long as one halfling can be born, it is possible to breed more!!' Was probably what the shadow walker race thought and Jason was not sure whether this made sense or not.
It might be possible, but such an existence should have been known.
There could also be the sole exception of accidentally encountering a suitable race whose genetics were not too far apart, allowing a halfling's birth.
But that wouldn't make sense either because humans were compared to toys while the Celestia race was obviously much stronger than the Shadow Walker race as they feared them!
In that sense, their genetic pool should be far apart and this assumption Jason did, should have been wrong too. That was if he didn't miss an important fact that might change everything!
The teleportation magic circle Yvonne had activated manifested around Jason, teleporting him back to Asga where his mana fluctuations couldn't sense anyone's existence.
However, in order to be sure that nobody was around, he released poisonous mist which would force others that might be inside the room to move or protect themselves.
He would be able to hear the sound of corroding clothes too.
As such, he could be relatively sure that there was nobody inside the room he was currently in as he opened his eyes by force.
It was still hurting and the flames enveloping his eyes were obstructing his sight, but he was able to take out his quantum bracelet and message his masters that he had returned.
After that, he closed his eyes again, extinguished the thick poisonous mist and left the room before he walked outside the small, shabby house as if nothing happened.
Once he was far away from the house to feel safe, he opened his eyes to call a shuttle that brought him to the dome right next to a one-star wild zone.
This took less than 20 minutes and Jason was relatively sure that Shane would be there soon.
As such he forced his eyes to remain open before he exerted the weightless steps technique to accelerate his speed by 60%.
Running through the dome wall and one-star wild-zone his mana eyes perceived familiar mana fluctuations which caused Jason to smile, even though everything was painful.
His eyes felt like they were pierced by several thousand needles from the inside and outside, while his soul world core unleashed the race specific weakening curse, drastically reducing his soul amplification to 0%.
Overwhelmed by the sudden exhaustion that was his body's reaction to the sudden weakened state, Jason was barely able to see that Shane appeared before him.
"Wow…Jason..are you a Zombie?"
After that he was unable to stay conscious as he fainted with a smile on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 392 - Curse Regulation
chapters.content:
An unknown amount of time flew by before Jason woke up inside the large and soft bed that was placed in his small, but comfortable room.
He felt still exhausted and Jason knew that this sensation wouldn't disappear within the next few days.
??
This was because his whole soul amplification had been nullified by the race specific weakening curse!
Jason's eyes weren't hurting anymore and he could take a look around, trying to figure out where his masters were.
Getting out of the bed he noticed the dried blood below his eyes, thus he washed up and changed into a clean set of clothes.
'I can sense that the petrification curse has set its roots within my eyes, while my soul world core seems to harbor the race specific weakening curse...but what did the soul world core do with 10,000 units of my soul energy?'
Even if he was still exhausted and felt like he could sleep for several days, getting to know what exactly was going on with his body was important.
Looking inside the mirror, Jason noticed that nothing about his eyes or appearance seemed to have changed.
However, what was different from before was that his eyesight seemed to have improved again.
Other than that, he couldn't help but feel the desire to test out the petrification curse he had inherited from the unhatched petrification serpent that was completely silent.
From the look of it, Jason could compare this state similar to human behavior of denying a traumatic event before one would have to accept it slowly.
This assumption might as well be wrong but it was not really important right now because Artemis, Scorpio, and even Solaris were next to the egg, consoling the petrification serpent.
They weren't next to him to demand carcasses but were taking care of their new member of their family!
As such, Jason could take care of his own things for now and he was about to leave the soul world when he noticed the changes about his soul world core.
Approaching it,? he was unable to tell what the change of his soul world core was aiming at.
There were two new, larger runes carved onto the soul world core that was already filled with all kinds of mysterious runes and carvings.
Yet, what made those two carvings special was the fact that the race specific weakening curse had been transferred within those runes.
Lifting his hand he touched them lightly with the tip of his fingers as a stream of information flooded his mind.
It was as if he received incomplete notes about how to use those two runes properly.
The only issue was that these notes were 'incomplete' and lots of information were missing.
Apparently, his soul world core absorbed 10,000 soul energy units, when the petrification serpent's weakening curse had been inherited to the core, recording everything that happened afterwards to the smallest detail.
This astonished Jason and he couldn't help but think that his soul world core was amazing as he began to skim through the memories which the notes transplanted to him.
From what he understood, the two runes were similar to a deceive that regulated specific things.
It was as if those two runes were a controller with two possible settings.
One rune was currently glowing in a faint, dark green almost black color while the other new rune had neither the curse transferred from the soul world core nor was it glowing!
However, this was something he had already expected after he digested the recorded information within the notes.
Only one set could be activated at a time and the number of possible settings was unknown to Jason.
It felt like those two runes representing the possible sections were only the bare minimum, while he had yet to configure the second, empty rune!
Jason was not sure how he could configure the second rune but that was not something he had to find out within the next few minutes.
After he found out that his soul world's amplification didn't have to remain nullified, Jason was relieved.
He had already imagined the worst of the worst and thought that he had made a huge mistake.
However, the curse he had inherited was a race specific weakening curse that didn't have the constant decreasement which he had noticed when the petrification serpent had cursed him before.
This allowed him to stay calm from the beginning.
It would be weird if the curse changed substantially after he inherited it!
Furthermore, from what Isga told him, a soul world amplification curse was stagnant.
Yet, Jason knew that he was different! He was neither a human nor from the Celestia race but a halfling!
This was probably why he had been so confident that he wouldn't receive the petrification serpent's full curse.
That his soul world core was able to hold against all kinds of curses that targeted the soul world amplification even before binding a cursed beast to his soul, allowed him to be confident enough that the soul world core would be able to negate the curse for a short period.
With that thought in mind, he was fine with training how to manually negate the amplification curse to a certain extent, which was fortunately not necessary.
His soul world core made it much easier for him to handle everything, and the only thing he had to do was to fill the second rune with the desired characteristics of the race specific weakening curse and select his choice.
In that sense, Jason began to wonder how often he would be able to change the settings or if that was something he could do whenever he wanted.
However, after he perceived something else about his soul world core that had changed, Jason knew that the latter was not something he could do.
The weakening curse within the soul world core was surrounded by a small translucent marble with one small, faint glowing rune engraved in it
This rune was slowly enlarging and the glow was becoming more vibrant, but from what Jason perceived with his great eyesight, the pace was negligible.
From the looks of it, this marble was what the two runes controlled which meant that the curse that was currently stored within the small marble was activated as Jason had already noted.
'Does that mean I need to wait until the rune engraved on the marble has stored enough energy to enlarge itself again? Only then will I be able to use a different setting? Isn't that a little bit too harsh….will this pace even accelerate if I become stronger or is the period the same until the day I die??'
Jason couldn't help but feel that he had been conned, which stemmed mainly from the fact that it should take half a year before he would be able to use a different setting.
This meant that he had to wait half a year to change from his nullified amplification state to a different one.
'At least I can absorb mana much faster now...the difference between having a mana core size of a lowest Lique stage or a mana core size of an average 4th Master is enormous! My combat prowess might have decreased drastically, but who said that I have to fight someone in the next few months?'
Telling this to himself, Jason decided that he would use the next six months to break through as many levels as possible while continuing to practice the body refining technique, Netherworld's fort!
Thinking about the things he wanted to do, he suddenly recalled the splitting mind technique.
Thus, he rushed outside his room, not minding the exhaustion that weakened his body further.
He searched for his masters to tell them everything that had happened to him before he wanted to ask them if they had been able to procure a brain-protection treasure as they promised.
Furthermore, there were also other things he was curious about, like what had happened to Canir and if the big clans were really going to wage war against the foreign races that infiltrated Canir with a much higher number than they normally did.
Jason was not sure how smart this was because the Shadow Walker and their allied forces were likely to have formed a soul contract with other big families that would have to start fighting against the other big clans in the worst-case scenario.
Other than that, there was also his worry that the Shadow Walker sent out their forces to take care of mankind!
If the basic instruction within the Terra-grade manuals Jason possessed was already talking about the four stages, Mortal, Lique, Prismar, and Ascendion as if they were nothing special, for an extinct race at that, he didn't want to find out what kind of combat prowess races like the Shadow Walker's warriors could attain!

chapters.title: Chapter 393 - Isn’t That Cheating?
chapters.content:
When he found his masters, who were currently observing Emily's concocting process of a potion, Jason couldn't help but be interested.
It was unsurprising that Dalia taught Emily, whom she treated like a princess, how to concoct, but Jason was curious about how she was faring.
??
Emily was unable to purify the potions she was currently concocting but there was no mistake, at most something negligible that wouldn't make a difference to the potion's efficiency.
Concocting a grade-1 potion after learning how to concoct for half a year was not bad, considering that Emily didn't have a superior mana mastery, mana eyes to perceive the mana flow perfectly or an origin flame which made everything easier; she was truly fast!
Jason was a unique case with several advantages that made even his masters jealous, thus, Dalia was glad that she was able to teach Emily at a normal pace.
She took Emily in as her second disciple because her ambition and determination to become stronger were truly shocking.
After the Golden-Soul shop reduced their exhibited goods drastically, the number of customers became fewer too.
As such, Emily didn't have to come to the shop, which was something Dalia had decided.
Focusing on becoming stronger, Emily's mana core rank increased to the 7th Expert rank while the emerald-colored egg she had bound finally hatched.
It took a long time, but the hatched beast was a Lesser typhoon Roc, which astonished both Dalia and Shane.
Rocs were seen as extremely powerful beasts, superior to eagles, and labeled as Overlord of the Sky.
Only Dragons and other mythical beings were comparable to a Roc. It was said that only a few Rocs had ever been seen on Argos but when someone saw them demonstrating their strength, it had always been terrifying and devastating to their surroundings.
As such, everyone was overjoyed after the Lesser typhoon Roc hatched, only for Dalia to freak out when she remembered that Emily's vessel would hardly be strong enough to receive the amplification of a mythical beast at the Guardian stage.
In that case, it was a blessing in disguise when Emily told Dalia and Shane how much of a soul amplification she received from the Lesser typhoon Roc.
Emily was unable to tell the exact number, but comparing the increase her mana core size received to the rank the lesser typhoon roc had, they could estimate that Emily's amplification was about 5%.
This was not much, but perfect for Emily, who was unlikely to face any problems with a bursting vessel in the future!
As such, the pressure on her lifted because her mana absorption wouldn't be slowed down like it was the case with Jason. She would have to tell her soulbond to halt its advancement before entering the Lique stage but that was not really an issue.
Furthermore, she would be able to increase her mana core rank quickly once her soulbond halted its own advancement due to the large difference of a 5% soul amplification with a single soulbond to that of a 33% soul amplification with two soulbonds.
**
Less than 20 minutes had passed before Emily finished concocting the potion:
Wiping away the sweat on her forehead, she turned around to Dalia, only to see that Jason stood in the doorframe.
"Jason! You're awake!" She shouted out with a smile on her face, which confused Jason a lot
'Why are you so happy??'
Turning around, Shane and Dalia saw that Jason stood behind them, but instead of being overjoyed, their expression was a little bit sad.
"You...were supposed to lower your soul amplification...not nullify it…."? Shane said as his lips curled downwards.
Meanwhile, Dalia gave him a hug saying "It was probably hard on you, huh?"
'What the hell is going on with them?' Jason was utterly dumbfounded about their behavior, but thinking about it for a short moment he understood it.
Initially, they wanted to decrease his soul amplification to around 10%-15% and knowing that a curse was stagnant, both Shane and Dalia were sure that Jason did something he shouldn't have.
However, thinking that he would have never bound a cursed beast without proper reasoning, it had probably been a necessity to survive.
Yet, Jason was still happy as he said teasingly "Even if my soul amplification would be nullified, it could be cursed to increase it again, which is however not necessary"
With this Jason was talking about Isga's case. He used the Debilitation Centaur's soul amplification curse to increase his amplification from 0 to 10% as it was impossible to have a negative soul amplification.
At least that was what Isga's father found out.
Jason's soul amplification was a different case and in the beginning, he had even thought that his soul amplification would be decreased by 50% as it was the case with Artemis' 100% soul amplification when she was inside his mana core.
This would, under normal circumstances, mean that his soul amplification should hit 0% from 33% and then 'decreased' to 17% which would have been perfect.
However, it seemed like weakening an existing amplification below 0% was not possible and Isga's case with a soul amplification of 0% was something rarely seen.
Smiling at his masters because they were worried about this, Jason could only wave his hand, indicating that they shouldn't be so worried!
"I think it would be better if I explain what happened inside the Mythic Garden. After that, everything will be much clearer and It will be easier to demonstrate what is going on...After that, I need an explanation about the Shadow Walker's infiltration and what other races I have to pay attention to!"
When they saw how serious and confident Jason was, his masters couldn't help but feel that he had matured a lot during the last six months!
Meanwhile, Emily couldn't help but think that Jason's current combat prowess was probably only a little bit higher than her own, which made her extremely happy.
She worked so hard during the last few months to become stronger with the goal to defeat Jason. Emily was not sure why that was one of her goals when she started to practice mana, but he had saved her and she wanted to repay this debt by all means!
Other than that, Dalia and Shane were praising her a lot, but deep within her, Emily knew that her own talent was nothing compared to Jason's.
Otherwise, Dalia and Shane would be astonished to see her improving so fast, which did not happen.
Through this, she felt the need to become stronger at a rapid pace, increasing manifold, only to see that Jason had already returned.
He had reached the mana core rank of a 2nd Master even though he was barely 15 years old, and this was without adding the high soul amplification he previously had into account.
They entered the living room and sat down.
Dalia took out a few freshly cooked dishes which were left from their lunch and placed them in front of Jason, who eyed them with desire.
Devouring every single dish Dalia took out of her storage ring, the others could only stare at him wondrous as Jason revealed the fact that he didn't eat much throughout the last six months.
There hadn't been enough time or safe places where he could have cooked something, while the other dishes he brought to the Mythic Garden had to be rationed.
But that was not important because the surrounding mana and the nutrition he obtained through the medical solutions were more than enough to stay alive.
Rather than that, he was full of energy within the Mythic Garden, which was the most important point that changed compared to now.
After explaining every little detail to his masters and Emily, three hours had passed.
"That's...Is that good? Or bad?" Dalia mumbled when Shane thought 'Should we lecture him for being too full of himself or praise him for achieving such a great feat?'
Jason could tell that his masters were contemplating about something after they heard his story which caused him to smile drily.
Meanwhile, Emily could only stare at him with doubt
"So...the origin flame evolved and your mana core has the size of an average 4th Master rank even without a single amplification? Now your soul world core can also switch between the percentage your soul world amplification is decreased? That's cheating!!"
Emily had hoped to catch up to Jason, who was even younger than she was...but now this goal moved far into the distance.
This was frustrating and it was difficult not to see how baffled Shane and Dalia were about this revelation.
The pride she had built up in the last six months was instantly shattered, but instead of being discouraged, or holding a grudge against Jason, she couldn't help but feel even more motivated.
Furthermore, from Jason's explanation, she could imagine how hard he had worked and the final results were obvious!
As such, she didn't feel that Jason was more like a role model, who had saved her, than someone she should hold a grudge against.
Suddenly after Jason had explained everything about the curse and his soul world core, that was able to switch between two different settings to curse his amplification, he said
"If possible I want to create my second sub-area with the mind splitting technique as soon as possible. After that, It would be best for me to go into solitary cultivation at a secure place with a huge amount of mana…"
It looked like Jason had already made a plan to utilize his current state perfectly when Shane asked
"You want to return to Astrix, or more likely Cyro-City and make use of the huge mana vein?"
With a sly smile on his, Jason gave Shane a thumbs up, showing that this was exactly what he planned to do when Dalia said
"We found a suitable fruit to protect your brain, but are you sure that you want to go to the Drake family's territory after what happened? You haven't heard what happened during the last few months! Everything is in chaos thanks to the Shadow Walker's, their alliance, and how a few big clans started to act suddenly, right?…"

chapters.title: Chapter 394 - Confusion
chapters.content:
Jason was not really astonished to hear that Canir and the Archipelagos changed substantially after Yvonne had explained everything.
It was one thing that the Shadow walker and a few other foreign races appeared which Jason assumed to be his fault to some extent, but that the majority of big clans expected to stand a chance against those foreign races was ridiculous.
??
One or two Shadow walkers with seven or eight solidified prismarine crystals should be enough to annihilate mankind!
'Is it even necessary for them to send their powerhouses?'
This was something Jason was unsure about but he couldn't help but feel that it was frustrating.
After Jason had explained everything that happened during the last few months, both Shane and Dalia's mood became better which was clearly visible.
As such, they started talking about what happened on Canir and the Archipelago while he was inside the Mythic Garden.
One hour later, Jason couldn't help but scratch the back of his head in confusion as he mumbled
"It's neither great nor bad...why is it so confusing?"
Everything Shane and Dalia told him seemed to be extremely confusing and Jason took a while to get the hang of everything.
Apparently, three foreign races invaded Canir and the surrounding islands with more than one hundred individuals in total.
Namely, those foreign races were the Shadow Walkers, Doom Crawls, and Virady.
The majority of invaders were Shadow Walkers that had around three solidified prismarine crystals in their mana core.
This was equal to the cultivation rank of mankind's powerhouses!
However, every Shadow walker had a refined physique that enhanced the Shadow or Darkness affinity they were born with by a large margin.
Not only was their affinity comparable to that of mythical beasts at the same stage, but they learned how to utilize their affinities much better than humans did.
In the end, the body refining techniques mankind obtain by trading with foreign races were the most basic which was something all foreign races did intentionally in order to prevent mankind from becoming too strong.
This was one of the few things they had agreed on doing and Jason had already expected something like that.
Even his Netherworld's forte technique was worse than the technique Milan had obtained.
This meant that the highest Terra technique foreign races exchanged with humanity were probably at the Terra-advanced grade.
It also meant that the foreign races should have stronger techniques than those. At the same time, it also suggested that foreign races didn't fear handing out certain techniques and guides.
If one were to think logically about the provided intel, it would be better for the big clans to combine their forces and build an indestructible fortress.
That was if something like that could exist and stay strong against the forces of stronger races!
It was embarrassing but humanity was considered nothing but a mere toy for most foreign races and it was already a wonder that mankind had been able to retaliate against those foreign races for such a long time!
This caused Jason to wonder if he missed something important.
Not only had the infiltrating foreign races abducted several hundred children, but it was uncommon and weird that the vast majority of them were normal citizens.
Were they unable to figure out which human children were talented, blessed with a good mana aptitude, and high-star soul awakening?
If it was like that, everything would make sense but in that case, Jason would suspect that their intelligence was below that of mankind.
'Maybe the Shadow walkers think that one's affinity is important to procreate with humans?' That could be the case and Jason could only think that the Shadow Walkers were experimenting with a few things.
Most of the abducted humans had also been young women which told Jason that they were trying to impregnate women instead of getting impregnated.
However, it was not like it should work either way because the Shadow walkers' genetic pool was likely to be the furthest away from that of humans.
At least among all three races that were currently infiltrating Canir and the Archipelago.
While Shadow Walkers were a darkness-, or in some rare cases, shadow attributed race whose only similarity to humans was the humanoid outer appearance, there was nothing else that was even remotely similar to the human race!
At least that was what Jason knew.
Meanwhile, the Doom Crawl and Virady race had at least a physical body which was something Jason was not sure about the Shadow Walkers.
Doom Crawls were humanoid beings too, with dark purple-colored skin, two arms on each side, and a total of four eyes. They were commonly five meters tall with a bulky physique that highlighted their height.
This made them already interesting to Jason, but more importantly was that they were a foreign race without a single affinity.
Yet, their physical strength was extremely strong and superior to most foreign races!
They're able to fight on par with other races that possessed affinities without any other means than their physique which clearly demostrated how powerful Doom Crawls were.
Doom Crawls had horns protruding out of their forehead and according to the information mankind could gather, those Doom Crawls with two horns were stronger than the one-horned Doom Crawls, while the size of their horns seemed to be an indicator for their combat prowess too.
Yet, the most important fact about them, which was also the reason they were named 'Doom' was that they harbored a curse!
Even if Jason found all of that intriguing, he was still doubting if the Doom Crawls were able to procreate with humans or not.
However, the most likely candidate to procreate with humans was the Virady race because they're almost completely the same as humans, whether it was their appearance or size.
Only their red, golden, or amber-colored eyes in addition to their mostly white to silver-colored hair were what made them different from humans.
Viradys had paler skin than most humans but more important than that was their innate desire to drink blood which made them comparable to Vampires.
Vampires were bloodsuckers, at least if the things Jason heard from fairy tales were true.
It made him believe that a humanoid race similar to those vampires existed.
Was that a sign that the Virady race was the same as the Vampires from Argos' nightmare-like fairy tales? Somehow, to Jason, this was not impossible to imagine.
Many beasts that had been deemed as extinct or about which had been written in fairy tales re-appeared after the mana outbreak when the rifts manifested!
However, in the end, Jason was not scared about the infiltration of the Virady, Doom Crawls, or even Shadow Walkers, simply because there were only a few of them.
According to Shane's intel, the number of foreign races was becoming less too.
This indicated that they had found enough humans that had a suitable soul-awakening according to their affinity or whatever criteria the foreign races had selected to abduct humans.
It was unlikely that Jason would be found under normal circumstances.
That was at least as long as he remained hidden for the time being, which was exactly what he wanted to do, even if there hadn't been the foreign race's infiltration, to begin with!
What worried Jason was that it didn't look like the big clans were about to stop gearing up.
Shane even told him that the heads of more than 20 big clans were holding a large gathering!
As someone who had nothing to do with those big clans, this gathering looked suspicious.
At the same applied this made Jason understand how big the desire to retaliate and fight against the foreign races was, even if the direct threat hailing from them was already dimming!
The number of infiltrating foreign races was already dwindling, so why would the big clans start to fight against them, risking being eradicated?
Instead, they could protect their prodigies by hiding them for the time being, sending them to secure locations or into solitary cultivation, instead of allowing them to roam around as if everything was perfectly fine!
The big clans' decisions were irrational and weird, and even Shane and Dalia were unable to explain Jason, what exactly was going on.
There was obviously something wrong, and the bad premonition he was feeling intensified when Jason heard, who the person that suggested waging war against the foreign races was.
It was Jael Drake, who was labeled as one of the strongest humans since he had been able to slay an Ice Dragon at the Mid Monarch rank!
The number of Sovereign ranks was not exactly large and there had yet to be a handful of humans at the Mid-Sovereign rank.
Nevertheless, Jael Drake, who had yet to reach the Mid-Sovereign had been able to slaughter a Mid-Monarch ranked Ice Dragon which was something nobody except him could do!

chapters.title: Chapter 395 - Overthrown Island
chapters.content:
Nobody was unsure whether it was true that only Jael was strong enough to do a feat as he did, but the number of humans who were capable enough to do that could be counted at one's hand.
Most of those were probably the leader of ancient clans and blessed with great soul-awakenings, a superior mana aptitude, or even in possession of a special trait.
??
However, Jael had nothing of that! His soul-awakening was only above average among the big families, at most, while his mana aptitude was great, yet not superior.
Instead of a trait, he had a unique soulbond that gave him an extremely strong ice affinity, that was as strong as its mother's while the cultivation manual to transmute his mana to that of ice mana was extremely precious.
He had only obtained this manual that was labeled as a "Heaven" grade and the 'Sky frost Spear' that had pure elemental runes engraved into it by signing a complex, yet beneficial soul contract with the My?ldra race, he had encountered inside the rift where he had abducted the Ice Dragon egg.
With blue skin, curved horns protruding out of the side of their head, sky blue eyes, and scales covering their upper body, they seemed like a ferocious race which they were!
The My?ldra race was extremely powerful and even the youngest generation was as strong as humanity's strongest powerhouse which everyone noticed as one of those younglings that looked similar to a young man, manifested a thirty meter long icicle which it shot towards one of Jael's men, killing him in an instant.
This shocked Jael and his underlings greatly and they were about to die when the My?ldra race youngling stopped attacking when Jual and everyone else released their soulbonds to fight next to them.
The My?ldra race's leader was astonished and both sides withered the chance to obtain benefits from the other party which caused them to create a complex and lengthy soul contract that was supposed to exploit the other side.
However, how should Jael have known that he was subtly influenced by everything he had obtained from the My?ldra race, slowly twisting his mind, manipulating him, turning him into a marionette without him realising?
Jael Drake was still of the opinion that everything he did was for his own benefits and that it was his superior intelligence that allowed him to exploit a mighty race.
Yet, both the manual and spear were meant to influence his mind in the direction the My?ldra race wanted. While the manual was changing Jael's mana transmutation, it also changed the instinctive repulsive behavior every living being had against certain abilities, runes, and curses.
The Sky frost spear was powerful, yet, also extremely dangerous if wrongly used which was exactly what the Drake patriarch did. There was one particular rune engraved inside the spear, one that was not allowed to activate while using the Sky frost spear.
Without being aware of this, Jael Drake activated all of its runes every single time he fought with the Sky frost spear, which released an effect, changing the mental state of the spear wielder over time
It was similar to a slow acting curse, one could hardly find without the necessary knowledge that humanity didn't have.
As such, everytime the My?ldra race exchanged goods with Jael Drake, they tested how far the curse had progressed, only to wait for the perfect timing to initiate their plan.
When they heard that other foreign races started to infiltrate Argos, the individuals that were assigned to said plan sensed their chance, which was how the current situation occurred.
However, nobody was aware of what happened to Jael Drake and why exactly he had changed by 360 degrees during the last few months.
The vast majority thought that he turned insane after the Ice Dragon attacked the Drake clan's headquarters.
Furthermore, it was unsure why Jael Drake had turned Astrix, the island he governed into some sort of prison, but one thing was sure; living on Astrix as a prodigy was unthinkable because all of them had been taken to Canir!
Meanwhile, the untalented remained on Astrix, acting as if nothing happened, trying to continue living their life peacefully.
But, was that even possible?
Only the weak, injured, or old and untalented remained on Astrix, drastically decreasing the average combat prowess on the small island.
Every single city was understaffed and the number of guards was a tenth of what it had been before Jael Drake cleansed Astrix from everyone talented.
This allowed beasts to roam through all zones without anyone being able to hold them back from leaving their designated wild zone as it had been the case before.
Magical and Guardian ranked beasts noticed that something had changed too.
The same applied to those beasts inside the Sanctum that was situated in Cyro-City.
In the end, it didn't require much intelligence to notice that not a single human was outside the dome, searching for beasts they could hunt.
As such, those beasts within the large zones they had inhabited for a long time ventured outside.
Slowly, Astrix turned chaotic and it was only when the first horde of Unblemished ranked beasts pursued by a magical ranked beast, accidentally entered the Dome that everything had begun to change from a bad state to the worst possible!
Not only did the Drake clan abduct everyone with talent, leaving those weak and untalented behind, but he didn't show any mercy at all as he had ordered his underlings to take Astrix's resources away too!
In the end, the Drake family abandoned the entire Island they had governed, leaving it to the weak and all kinds of beasts that started to create a massacre inside the cities that were unable to maintain the dome's defensive measures that required a huge amount of mana to supply them consistently.
Only six months had passed, but the whole Island had already been overthrown and only a few cities had been able to avoid the worst-case due to the dome's defenses that worked properly there.
This was only owing to a few old, yet prominent merchants that used up their stockpiled mana stones to supply the dome with enough mana to protect them for the next few months, if not years if necessary.
After that, they would have to face their inevitable death the merchants had barely postponed.
When Jason heard this, he couldn't help but feel that Jael Drake was truly insane!
But other than that, it also made him wonder why not a single big clan wanted to claim Astrix island for themselves.
Only when Shane explained the situation clearly, Jason began to understand the reason for the big clans' behavior.
The major reason for not helping the citizens on Astrix was the fact that the benefits one could obtain on Astrix had become insignificant.
What use was an empty island with destroyed cities and a population of a few, untalented citizens that used up a large quantity of star-notes without giving anything in return?
If one were to send help, one would have to send several Lord ranks because several humans at the Grandmagus rank wouldn't be enough to cope with the dangers on Astrix anymore!
Furthermore, the earth dragons that had waited angsty for several months, only to notice that there was not a single young human taking away the two remaining earth dragon eggs, began to understand that something was wrong too.
It was dangerous, but they had to figure out what was going on.
This led one of the bravest earth dragons to return to the surface in the same way they had taken more than a century ago when they had been forced to enter the underground hall.
After it was clear that not a single human was left, the earth dragon called its brethren that were shocked about the news.
Time passed slowly and the earth dragons turned into Astrix's overlords, free from mankind's reigns.
The soul contract they had signed never mentioned a case like that and only stated that they would be hunted if they were to return to the surface.
However, who was going to punish them, now that nobody governed Astrix anymore?
Sending out several Lord ranks would be dangerous after the Earth Dragons regained their complete combat prowess too.
As such the dangers and expenses to reclaim Astrix were not worth the benefits one could obtain.
The only benefit most big clans could see was the large mana vein, but that was everything valuable left on Astrix!
Rather than gaining something, it was more likely to bring losses!
Jason could understand their reasoning to some extent.
If they had to send one of their few sovereign ranks, who knew what would happen in those dangerous times that were about to start.
From the looks of it, big clans didn't seem to trust each other anymore and even the gathering should be a charade lead by several foreign races that remained in the shadows.
It was the sad truth, but Jason had to acknowledge that it was not feasible to reclaim and save those who had survived on Astrix until now.
At least not right now!
Even though some hunters wanted to help, they wouldn't dare to venture to Astrix, in fear that they might be abducted from the Drake family that could return suddenly, without notice, forcing them into signing an enslavement-like soul contract, or to die!
In times like these, nobody knew what was going on and Jason was sure that not even the big clans could get the hang of the whole, big picture!
Maybe, something would change in the next months, but Jason doubted it.
Reality was cruel, but those without powers or connections could only accept their fate or fight against it with all their might!

chapters.title: Chapter 396 - Using One’s Disadvantage As Advantage
chapters.content:
Humanity was still not at its worst as the mana outbreak and emergence of the rifts more than three centuries ago were far worse, but right now, nobody felt secure or protected anymore.
Not even the big families were able to announce that they were confident in their own strength right now which was something that had rarely occurred.
??
From the beginning, those families had the best capabilities and fewest casualties compared to the untalented citizens or unfortunate clans that had to face beasts much stronger than they were.
In the end, Jason couldn't help but feel that the situation they currently faced had been worsened due to the Drake clan's actions.
Abandoning Astrix was one point, but suggesting to wage war and announce a gathering even though most invaders of foreign races had already left Canir was suspicious!
If one were to think about it, this could only be a trap and Jason doubted that the other big clans were unaware of that too.
Adding the fact that the Drake clan was unlikely to intend fighting against all big clans at once, alone at that, Jason was sure that the foreign clan supporting Jael Drake planed something too
However, the same should apply to the other foreign races!
That was if they were able to comprehend what Jael Drake and the foreign race supporting him were planning to do!
This was highly likely and Jason began to wonder when the charade would be uncovered, revealing everyones' real intention and the races behind them.
Yet, more importantly for Jason were two points. He was not allowed to be found because he had yet to find a way to conceal the fact that he was a halfling from the Celestia race while the other point was that he had to become stronger, as fast as possible!
The former point was something Jason had no idea about how to solve. Not only was there a weird aura around him according to the transmitted thoughts he had received from the earth dragon, but apparently his eyes were similar yet not as distinct as his aura.
As such he had to find a way to conceal his aura too! Otherwise, he would have to face a few foreign races and their possible wrath, greed, or jealousy!
Nobody could promise him that other races would react similarly to the Shadow Walker.
Thus, concealing his aura was important too!
Other than that, he had yet to create his second sub-area and reach the Lique stage!
Furthermore, Jason allowed both Artemis and Scorpio to advance their strength now that he didn't receive a single percentage from his soul amplification anymore.
He could exploit his weakened state like this.
At the same time advance his mana core rank, once he had found a great location to absorb a lot of mana without being interrupted by other races or someone else.
The large mana vein below Cyro-City was even more alluring than it had been before because the only living beings that could attack him there, were beasts.
There was a beast whose potential colors he had never seen before but it had been hibernating for three centuries, meaning that there shouldn't be an issue with that!
As such, instead of staying on Terebrean inside the small city Shane and Dalia owned a house, he decided to use his nullified amplification to the fullest extent.
Turning to Dalia he asked
"If it's not too much of a hurry, can I use the mind splitting technique...like right now? I know that I woke up only a few hours ago but I don't think that I should waste too much time. Even more so after hearing what is currently happening on Canir and other Archipelagos!"
Both Dalia and Shane expected that something similar to that would happen while Emily was also similar to Jason.
She felt extremely weak, like a pushover, and wanted to become stronger as soon as possible.
However, she didn't dare to refine her brain because Dalia and Shane had yet to acquire another brain protection treasure.
If they hadn't promised Jason that they would be able to procure the brain protection treasure for his second sub-are they would have given the one they were able to obtain to Emily.
Yet, Jason was the most talented with a great soul awakening, superior mana aptitude, and even more important, a great mindset.
Adding his soulbonds potential, it was difficult to compare to Jason, which was what Emily understood fully.
Furthermore, once Jason was strong enough, he could protect the people around him and prevent a war between humans to break out.
This wouldn't mean he would be able to fight against the foreign races, but Jason was sure that most stronger individuals of foreign races had something better to do than fighting against each other to procure a few more soldiers, or whatever humans had been used for by them.
Thinking back to the time where the three foreign races appeared in Cyro-City, it was obvious how astonished the Ganasia and Deepsea Scion race envoys had been when they saw the Shadow walker who was said to be a prodigy from the younger generation.
Thus, one could say that it was more likely to send lower-ranked individuals to Argos as long as nothing special happened.
On the other hand, once the first stronger individual from a foreign race was sent over, other races would follow soon, which was definitely not something mankind wanted to witness.
In the end, Emily couldn't do anything against those foreign races because she was way too slow in accumulating mana and becoming stronger, while Jason seemed different than her!
As such, she remained quiet and followed her master, Shane, and Jason without saying anything.
Barely ten minutes later, Jason stood within a large magic circle that was intertwined with multiple mana isolation-, a mana vortex- and dissolution runes.
Those runes were supposed to dissolve all mana stones, gather the mana in the center of the room and isolate everything that happened from the outside.
Meanwhile, the mana isolation rune was also supposed to prevent mana from leaving the magic circle and Jason felt like he had to face a Deja-vù right now.
However, instead of being scared, he knew what he was supposed to do and there was nothing that could hinder him in following his dream and desire to become stronger.
Taking revenge on his mother was one goal, but rescuing the whole Fler family and protecting everyone else who was important to him was even more important.
Once everything would be over, he might be able to venture to other planets and see how strong other races truly were but that was something for the future and nothing he should think about right now.
With the small jade-enveloped box in his hands, Jason approached the magic circle's center while Shane threw out a huge bulk of mana stones to fill the whole magic circle at once.
"That should be more than enough. Give your best and finish it quickly. I can't promise if the isolation runes are perfect because I had to intertwine everything, making one rune out of all of them!
As such faint mana fluctuations might leak, alright?"
Jason nodded his head, understanding that they might be exposed if he were to take too long.
Taking out the fruit, called "Ascor brain merua protecto", Jason noticed that it was not enveloped in a particular color or the mysterious color Artemis and the unhatched petrification serpent were enveloped with.
This indicated that the fruit didn't have a great quality!
However, from the looks of it, its mana fluctuations and everything Jason saw within the fruit spoke for the opposite.
This allowed Jason to tell that the quality might not be perfect but that its grade was extremely high.
Gobbling down the tennis ball-sized fruit in three bites, Jason sat down as he activated the large magic circle at once.
Manifesting around him, Jason was able to perceive the magic circle's capabilities and the Ascor brain merua proteco fruit's effect directly.
Enveloped by a thick gree membrane, his brain was protected and seemingly even recuperating without the need for Jason to do anything.
As such he could take a deep breath as he began to absorb the dissolved mana that was drawn to the vortex that manifested within the large mana vortex rune Shane inscribed into the center of the magic circle.
Jason didn't ask his soulbonds to do anything, but before he had started to refine his brain, Artemis, Scorpio and even Solaris accessed their fortified soul conjunction with him to transfer Jason's pain.
When he sensed this, he couldn't help but feel the warmth rising in his heart as he started to exert the mind splitting technique according to its described way!
Endless pain spread through his brain as it was refined, but only a moment later, Jason could hear his soulbonds screaming out in pain while his pain had been reduced drastically!
