chapters.title: Chapter 647 - Not Yet
chapters.content:
Even though the Devir, Zar, sounded enraged about being underestimated, his instincts told him that Jason was a little bit dangerous.
The young human in front of him didn't even budge, but the aura and Stigma he saw and sensed were already enough to make him pay a tad more attention to Jason.
Other than that, his mana fluctuations were firmer than they should be at his cultivation base, which indicated that he was stronger than one would think at first glance.
Nevertheless, Zar didn't even think about backing off as he entered one of the combat rings, followed by Jason, who was looking around as if he was in search of something specific.
'The body refinement and cultivation techniques used by the Tritans don't look bad...at least if I see the results properly! In that case, they should have good martial art techniques too….I wonder if I can learn one of them…'
Using his Emperor Eyes, Jason scanned every single of the cadet's body, trying to figure out what kind of Body refinement, and Cultivation technique they were using, in order to perceive the rough level of progress.
With Terra-Advanced, or Peak techniques as strongest techniques, the humans on Manyr, and both the Aeus and Devirs were simply at the level of common races.
However, Jason didn't think that the Devirs and Aeus were common races, and the same applied to the Manyrs.
All three races had an equal chance to undergo a double awakening and met multiple more requirements to be considered a higher race.
As such, it was not unlikely that a few Heaven grade manuals were in the possession of existences like Luna, and other powerhouses of the respective races.
This was interesting, but at the same time, Jason couldn't even be sure whether Luna was a human of the Manyr race, or if like him, she belonged to another planet.
In the end, this didn't matter, and the only important factor he had wanted to figure out was the rough ranking of the three races because it was highly possible that he would create many issues for them.
At least, that was what Jason felt.
With that in mind, he entered the combat arena, facing Zar, who looked at him with a glare that caused Jason to smile bitterly.
It made him wonder how some people could have such low self-esteem that they would get enraged at the slightest provocation.
Shaking his head, he approached the opposite end of the gigantic combat ring that had more than enough space to let dozens of people fight against each other.
Yet, right now, it was completely empty, and the gazes of the multitude of cadets lingered on him.
Jennifer was hovering above the center of the arena, ready to start the countdown once Zar and Jason were ready.
Only three seconds later, the spar had already started, and Zar didn't waste any time, as he shot forward, unsheathing two daggers.
Crossing the distance of a hundred meters in a matter of seconds, he emerged in front of Jason, who hadn't moved a single inch.
'Is he afraid?' Zar wondered with a sly smile on his face as he stabbed the dagger in his left hand past Jason, only to twist it, aiming at his side.
Before the dagger could make contact with Jason's skin, he took half a step backward as he twisted his body to the right.
Jason's reflexes were lightning quick and predictably, Zar's attack missed its target, causing him to stumble forward as he suddenly felt something rough around the ankle of his right foot.
A premonition flashed through his mind, and he wanted to break out of the sudden entrapment, as he looked straight into Jason's eyes.
His eyes were sparkling but shockingly, their property had changed to that of a reptile, with golden-silverish eyes.
Unbeknownst to Zar, a second Stigma had manifested above Jason's already existing stigma, and the young arrogant Devir could only sense deep shock sweeping through his body. He flinched owing to the Petrification curse that affected his entire body.
Only a moment later, the race specific weakening curse began to act, infiltrating the Devirs' entire being, weakening his physical strength only slightly.
Because Jason's cultivation base was too weak and the gap between his opponent's cultivation stage to that of his own was high, the petrification curse and the race specific weakening curse's effect were not that great.
Nevertheless, it was more than enough after receiving Petri's amplification to occupy his mana core and fuse with his youngest soulbond which increased the effects of his curses.
Other than that, Jason could sense how his body was strengthened to an extent he had never felt before, making him believe that he might be able to reach the physical condition of a being at the Prismar stage soon enough.
This was great news, but at the same time, it made Jason wonder just how strong he would become while being at the Lique stage.
Nevertheless, this thought dispersed as quickly as it had emerged, only to be replaced by the sole desire to defeat Zar.
Having used Petri and his fusion, Jason revealed his secret, but that did not matter because he would rather fight by using a little bit more of his strength while being in a relatively safe position, than being forced to reveal himself only when it came to life-and-death battles.
With Petri's tail and eyes as the only body parts he allowed to be manifested, the five-meter-long tail was everything that could be perceived by the others.
They didn't see the reptilian eyes, but noticing that the long tail was coiled around Zar's leg, the moment Jason evaded him with a subtle movement, everyone expected to see something grand from their comrade, the Devir with the water affinity.
Unfortunately, this was easier said than done, as Zar had been interrupted for a total of two seconds owing to Jason's curses, which was more than enough time for him to finish off the arrogant Devir.
He didn't summon any weapon, but instead, Jason simply manifested scales on top of his knuckles.
The scales he manifested were extremely sharp, and could also help him pierce into his opponent's flesh it hit hard enough with.
With the scales he also received the bare minimum amount of protection, allowing him to launch a counter-attack with a multitude of high velocity, and powerful punches that aimed at the most vulnerable parts of the Devir's body.
One punch after another was initiated, but Zar was unable to move as he was pinned to the ground, held by the tail that was coiled around his entire right leg.
Because of that, Zar used his water affinity for the first time in the entire fight that had started less than a minute ago.
Enveloping his right leg with a layer of water, he didn't hesitate a single second, as the water shot outwards with a terrific speed as it seemingly turned into a blast.
This was unnoticed by the others, but Jason felt that his five-meter-long tail was suddenly pierced through by several water beams that felt like solid spikes.
Uncoiling the tail, Jason hurled Zar away as blood splattered from the tail that was pierced several times while Zar's leg was fully enveloped in a layer of water that had turned into spikes.
From the looks of it, Zar's condition was much worse than Jason's which was mainly owing to the accurately targeted areas at which Jason had driven his punches.
Nevertheless, the young Devir was still relatively fine on the outside.
At least, that was what most thought, only for Jason to smile brightly as he commented,
"If I were you, I would give up now, otherwise it will be a little painful!"
What neither the spectators nor Zar had realised because they had been distracted was that Jason had inflicted several scratches every single time he had hit Zar with his razor-sharp knuckles.
In each of these scratches, Jason had shot a fraction of Solaris' flame at the same temperature as Zar's body, preventing him from noticing anything.
After entering the young Devir's body, the flames simply stayed put, and thus were unnoticed by Zar who had been too distracted in getting out of the entrapment of his legs.
It was exactly because of this that Zar didn't even think about giving up as he shouted out,
"I'm not defeated yet!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 648 - Acknowledgement
chapters.content:
Hearing Zar, Jason could only shake his head, while Jennifer, who had watched every single movement of Jason, couldn't help but shake her head at the cadet's answer.
Meanwhile, the other spectators were astonished by Jason's combat prowess, while his ability to manifest a tail was simply ignored.
There were quite a few beings with unique abilities, and a transformation ability was amongst the most ordinary ones.
Furthermore, each of the cadets was special with something or the other being out of the norm in everybody's case, which turned Jason into one of the 'normal' people, only that his combat prowess was higher than everyone expected to be.
Nevertheless, Jason's confidence and the fact that he advised Zar to give up was something that made the other cadets angry.
It had taken them a long time to achieve their sense of pride after having been shunned by their own kind and thrown to streets with nowhere to go..
For some, it took a few years, but for the beings whose will had been destroyed, it had taken several decades.
As such, they didn't like Jason's statement, and were fuming. However, Jason gave them both a reality check and a wake-up call, making them realise just a few moments later that Zar should have listened to Jason by all means.
"If you're still willing to fight, don't hold a grudge against me for what happens next!" Jason simply said as he snapped his fingers, while similarly unleashing the minuscule fractions of Solaris' flame that had embedded themselves inside the young Devir's body.
On cue the black flames flared and erupted with no delay, burning through the hide-like skin of the Devir as he cried out in pain.
Nurtured by the mana they devoured, the flames increased in size, enveloping Zar's entire body within seconds throwing the crowd into a frenzy as nobody could believe, let alone understand what was happening right now.
Only Jason and Jennifer were silent and unfazed as if they had expected this outcome.
The young woman simply looked at Jason, thinking that he was playing around too much with the Origin flame and the weird transformation he could attain.
Jennifer was not sure what exactly this transformation was, because the scales looked exactly like those on the snake she had seen in the manor's backyard, a few days ago.
As such, she was able to come up with her own reasoning, only to realise that Jason might be even more interesting than she had initially assumed.
Smiling lightly, her desire to fight Jason increased as she comprehended that Jason was able to fuse with the beasts that had been next to him, and was probably stored somewhere in his body.
This was the only thing she was relatively sure of, and it would also explain the sudden increase in Jason's physical strength as the beast he had fused with probably enhanced it a lot.
It was a Pryr beast after all!
While Zar was using his utmost efforts to extinguish the flames that had enveloped and infiltrated his body, the water he conjured dispersed before he could make use of it.
Because of that, and the fact that Jennifer wanted to avoid anyone being seriously injured, she raised her hand.
"Stopp! The fight is over!!"
Jason was just waiting for the sign, and immediately summoned Solaris, who created a suction force, pulling all flames out of Zar, who slumped to the ground, excessively exhausted.
He could only stare at Jason, who had used him as a means to nurture Solaris, allowing it to advance slightly faster.
Under normal circumstances, Jason would have simply extinguished the flames within his opponent, but now he had wanted to help Solaris a little bit.
The fusion with Petri was dissolved the moment he had snapped his fingers, which had, in fact, ended the battle in Jason's opinion.
As such, the spiked tail had already dispersed while Jason's eyes had reverted to their normal appearance as well.
Walking towards Zar, he held out his hand only to say,
"Good fight, and sorry if it was painful, I didn't know how strong you were so I released the majority of my flames' strength!"
Initially, Zar was enraged by Jason's confidence, but now that he had fought him, the Devir knew that it wasn't unfounded.
His pride was hurt now that he had been so easily defeated, but he acknowledged Jason for being stronger than he was.
Despite that, it hurt to hear the words 'the majority of my flame's strength,' because it was almost as if Jason was trying to console him.
Nevertheless, with a deep sigh, Zar had to accept his loss, and instead of being discouraged, he acknowledged the chance of having fought a beast.
During the fight, he had noticed that Jason was still extremely young, and now Zar assumed that the young golden-eyed man was not even a human from Manyr, but somewhere else.
Thus, his situation was probably different from the other humans on Manyr.
Grasping Jason's hand,? Zar smiled lightly before he got up and seriously asked.
"Be honest, how much of your strength did you hold back??"
Even if he felt that this question would only hurt his pride, Zar couldn't help himself. He simply had to ask, and looking at Jason, who was contemplating the answer, it looked like he would have to swallow the last remnants of his pride.
If Jason had to be honest, he was not sure about the answer. Right now, he didn't want to utilise the abyssal effect of his Emperor Eyes because he was still unsure if the Chaos attribute inside his body would suddenly be released.
At the same time, Solaris' full power had yet to be unleashed while the Frozen flame that seemed to be his strongest attack and affinity, right now, was something Jason couldn't comprehend yet.
There were also all kinds of other things he had to pay attention to because he didn't use the Floating Sky movement technique during the fight, neither the pressure he had learned to comprehend, nor any mana to circulate through his body!
In the end, there were too many factors he hadn't used, but at the same time, some of them didn't gel together either way.
As such, Jason could only look at Zar apologetically as he said,
"I should...probably be strong enough to defeat Eran, and the other cadet Jennifer will choose at the same time?"
Without knowing the exact combat prowess of Eran, and the unknown partner, Jason decided that he should hold back, and not act too arrogantly.
However, his statement alone was proof enough that he had been holding back a lot, which caused Zar to look at Jason dejectedly, only to get himself together as he mumbled,
"I will definitely become stronger...much stronger, and then, I will defeat you!"
After having mumbled these words of encouragement for himself, Zar left the combat ring, where he saw his comrades that looked at him with a thumbs up.
"You didn't back off, buddy, good job to hold out against such a monster-like existence!"
"His fire affinity is way too strong, you tried your best, that's all we can hope for!"
"..."
".."
Seeing how everyone encouraged Zar, Jason couldn't help but smile, thinking that it was great to have motivating comrades who didn't laugh at someone for facing defeat.
Everyone's circumstances were different, and for people like Jason, their cultivation base was just the basic foundation of their strength, to begin with.
The other cadets and even Jennifer were now beginning to understand this, and his strong mana fluctuations were now making sense to them.
Jason was out of the ordinary, and comparing him to others at the same cultivation rank and stage simply didn't make sense, and neither would it do right with any of them.
This was exactly why Jennifer had thought of making Jason spar against beings at the Prismar stage because she had already sensed that the young man with golden eyes was different than anyone else she had ever met.
Her desire to fight him only increased, but instead of actively showing this, she simply ordered Eran and Lilya, one of the Variant Aeus, who was born with awakened cultivation veins of Maest and Pryr, to enter the combat ring.
Jennifer knew that Jason hadn't used much mana, and instead of giving him more to recuperate, she wanted to see how he would react under pressure.
'Show me some more, Jason!'

chapters.title: Chapter 649 - Two Double Awakened
chapters.content:
With eyes that flickered with interest, Jennifer's mind and focus was solely trained on Jason. The slight change in her body language was noticed by the other cadets, who couldn't help but stare at their Instructor as if they didn't know who she was anymore.
"Why does Coach Jennifer look like she will pounce at the newcomer at any moment?"
"You saw that too, right? I feel some sort of tension between the two of them...maybe they will also fight?"
"Or...maybe, there is something more between them? He arrived with her, and they seem oddly close...but maybe, it's just my imagination?"
Suddenly, the voice of a young man resounded behind the gossipers, who turned around, only to see one of the few cadets that were considered real prodigies.
It was Rex, a human of the Manyr race. Considered to be a mutation, he had awoken the Maest cultivation vein, and was thus cultivating with mana, just like Jason did!
"Why would Jennifer pounce on that young man? He cannot even be considered a prodigy, and is nothing but a show-off! He probably won't even be able to defeat Eran and Lilya...Jennifer won't look at him after he has been defeated!"
Staring at the three gossipers in anger, Rex said in a dominating voice and the others quickly retreated, leaving Rex alone as they merged with the crowd of other cadets that wanted to spectate the battle.
Averting his gaze to Jennifer, who he eyed with fervor as he licked his lips, he just noticed that her eyes were truly trained on none other than Jason.
This caused him to grit his teeth, while his fists were clenched.
Rex's nails pierced into his palm, and were digging into his skin as his thoughts were going wild.
'Why is she staring at the newcomer like that? I've been here for years, trained by her personally, but she never looked at me as she looks at this youngling?'
Unable to understand what made Jason so special except his combat prowess that made him barely as strong as some prodigies that were considered average, Rex couldn't help but feel that the world was unfair.
While Rex was practically seething in rage, the other cadets noticed his expression, which made them increase their distance further, as an ominous aura was radiated from him.
Having reached the Ascendion stage, Rex was a strong contender, and his aura and mana fluctuations were not to be taken lightly.
Thus, even Jennifer realised that something was going on behind her back, only to ignore it like she had grown accustomed to ignoring the lustful gazes of others.
It was not a rare occasion for someone to look at her lustfully, but as long as they didn't dare do anything, she would leave them alone.
Ignoring those gazes was easier than attacking every single one of her admirers.
This was something her master had advised Jennifer too, and only when someone was starting to be too pushy, should she set an example, the crueler, the better.
Ignoring what went on behind her, Jennifer continued to stare at Jason, whose golden eyes were glowing brightly.
Knowing that he was appraising the strength, affinities, other unique characteristics, and possible combat prowess of his opponents, Jennifer couldn't help but think that Jason's special eyes were extremely useful.
Being able to determine whether he was strong enough to face someone, or not was crucial, while perceiving unique characteristics of certain opponents was similarly important.
It was exactly because of this that Jason was able to perceive that Lilya, who looked like a perfectly normal Aeus, was, in fact, a mutant who had awoken the Path of Pryr and Maest.
Jason could tell that most cadets had either double awakened cultivation paths or that one of the paths were extremely strong.
Thus, he couldn't take them lightly as he himself pursued only one cultivation path.
In the end, he didn't think that it was normal for so many double awakened individuals to be found in such a small space like the cadets training camp, but at the same time, Jason assumed the circumstances to be slightly unique.
'Tritans...just what kind of organisation is that really...Are they really as good as the City Lord and Jennifer think, or do they harbor ill intentions about the territory enveloping the Devir, Aeus, and Human race?'
Jason didn't trust strangers anymore as he had to get to know them to a certain extent to make up his mind about who they were, what their plan might be, how sincere they were in whatever they did and said, and most importantly, how they treated others.
Owing to this, he trusted Jennifer the most out of the people he got to know during the last few months as she was honest, sincere in her approach to rescue those who were likely to be executed by the Devirs and Aeus, and Jason's gut feeling told him that she was trustworthy.
Other than that, the City Lord was nice, even though she seemed to have been hurt, while Pera was a good person, just a little bit naive for her age that was likely to have reached a few hundred years.
However, that was exactly what made Pera genuine which Jason liked.
Thus, trusting these three women, for now, was more than enough for him to hope that the Tritans' organisation pursued a path that resulted in everyone's freedom, and not in being oppressed.
This was something he was genuinely hoping for.
Nevertheless, right now, he had to avert his attention from the Tritans to the two double awakened individuals in front of him as both of them were about to break into the Prismar stage with their cultivation rank.
Having two vessels within them, they were cultivating in both at the same time, using specific cultivation techniques that required an enormous amount of cultivation energies to be absorbed.
Owing to that, their progress was much slower than anyone else's, but at the same time, their prowess increased much more.
This was exactly what Jason had undergone by being required to use three times the amount of mana to liquefy a single drop of mana.
It required more time to absorb the necessary mana and liquefy it into a single drop, but at the same time, it made him much stronger than anyone else at his cultivation base!
Jason assumed this to be one of the strong, yet hidden perks of the Celestia race!
Adjusting his stance, Jason didn't even think of holding back against the opponents in front of him.
Eran was at the peak of the Lique stage, while Lilya could already be considered to have progressed halfway into the Prismar stage with one half of the first solidified prismarine crystal having been constructed.
Thus, Jason had to be careful which was the reason for him to allow Artemis to enter his mana core without any delay.
The cooldown on the fusion lasted only moments as he and Petri had barely used any energy to manifest a five-meter-long tail in addition to fusing their eyes.
Nevertheless, Jason knew that he was unable to directly fuse with Artemis.
However, that was not even what he had planned, from the beginning.
His plan was different because his liquified mana drops were already enough to consider him as a being at the peak of the Lique stage, as each of his mana drops was comparable to three normal mana drops.
With that in mind, Jason couldn't help but smile, thinking that fighting Eran and Lilya will be extremely interesting. They were both double awakened, and strong enough to destroy him without any problems if he were to have nothing else except his cultivation base to increase his combat prowess with.
However, that wasn't the case, and with a bright smile on his face, he eagerly awaited the spar to start.

chapters.title: Chapter 650 - Realisation
chapters.content:
The moment Jennifer initiated the fight, Jason circulated a large amount of mana through his body, while exerting the Floating sky movement technique at the highest mastery he had comprehended until now.
This more than doubled his speed right off the bat, allowing him to cross the distance between him and his opponents in no time.
Both Eran and Lilya had an extremely strong physique as they cultivated in the path of Pryr and another one, however, Jason's speed was still much faster than theirs.
Emerging in front of Eran, who had just swung back his spear to start running, Jason smiled cruelly, as Byakur manifested in his hand.
Ready to slash out, he didn't even hesitate to insert a huge amount of mana into it. Leaning forward, his face almost touched the ground as Artemis' wings spurted out of his back.
Only a fraction of a second was required for the wings with a wingspan of more than 10 meters to unfold as Jason pushed himself up from the ground with every ounce of strength inside his body.
Catapulting himself into the air he saw many things happening at the same moment.
Jason exerted both the petrification and race specific weakening curse with a large amount of mana that interfered with Eran's capabilities to retaliate as he was stuck in his place for a quarter of a second.
This quarter of a second was enough to envelop Byakur with a layer of black flames that erupted from within the weapon. Jason slashed out from the ground vertically, using his own force and the momentum of being pulled high in the air.
The move he had just initiated had been complex, but seeing blood splattering on the ground from Eran's body, Jason nodded his head proudly.
However, his pride lasted only for a second when he realised that there were suddenly two Erans, instead of one. The second one was standing right behind the Eran he had just seriously injured.
It was only then that his Emperor Eyes perceived a subtle difference between the two bodies which caused him to blurt out uncontrollably.
"Decoy?!"
Eran was shell-shocked by Jason's merciless attack, but his instincts had allowed him to react early enough, using almost all of his spiritual force to create his doppelganger, protecting him from being heavily injured.
Jason realised that Eran didn't have any spiritual force left in his spirit sea, but had more than enough primordial energy within his body, while Lilya was still completely fine.
She had already predicted Jason's move, so she quickly circulated both primordial energy and mana through her cultivation veins.
This increased her speed and strength exceptionally.
With this, Lilya grew confident that she was stronger and faster than Jason, which caused her to flap her wings as she pushed herself from the ground, pursuing the young man, who had already reached an altitude of more than 10 meters.
Even if he was unable to defeat Eran right off the bat, he was not severely restricted and did not have much difference from a normal cultivator with a single cultivation vein.
Thus, his combat strength shouldn't be much different to someone at the peak of the Lique stage, and, at most, it was strengthened through his physique, the result of his cultivation, and possible martial art techniques.
Nevertheless, this didn't make up a difference of strength one received from more than 5000 drops of liquefied mana.
With Artemis occupying his mana core, Jason's strength was already close to reaching 18,000 drops of liquefied mana even without utilising an affinity, one of his abilities, or his Celestia aura and Stigma.
By using only one or two extra abilities, he was already close to reaching the Prismar stage, which was evident as he had just defeated Zar, the Devir, who was in fact, at the Prismar stage.
Thus, Lilya's seemingly confident approach towards him was nothing but a charade Jason had purposefully instigated after he had noticed that Eran had protected himself.
If he were to be honest, Zar had felt like a stronger opponent than Eran because the Devir hadn't given Jason an opportunity to attack him right off the bat.
On the other hand, Eran had made this big mistake in giving Jason the opportunity to attack, which resulted in Eran having to create a doppelganger which was something he was only learning to do right now.
Because of that, the spiritual force he had to consume to achieve this feat was much higher than usual, but that was not something Jason could be bothered about.
He had slowed down his pace after propelling himself into the air, luring Lilya to follow him into the sky, where Eran couldn't reach them easily.
Lilya should've known better than to leave behind her partner, but she did so nevertheless thinking that Jason was not much of a threat.
Despite seeing what he had done to Zar and just a second ago, to Eran, she felt that she could take him down.
Thus, she made the big mistake of pursuing him into the sky, only to see him suddenly turn around.
Through this sudden change in movement, Lilya didn't even think of halting in her tracks as she wanted to use her momentum to injure Jason heavily.
As such, she was fully prepared to pierce her thin longsword right into him, the moment they would clash.
Unfortunately, Lilya was still underestimating Jason, only to realise how wrong she was as he erupted with his Stigma and Celestia aura that had been idle for some time.
Increasing the pace at which he could circulate mana through his body, the speed at which he could exert the Floating sky movement technique increased consequently, while the potency of every particle of mana was enhanced.
Thus, with his Stigma and Celestia aura activated, Jason once again exerted the petrification and race specific weakening curse, only with a much higher amount of mana that caused Lilya to stiffen mid-air, taking away the upper hand she had gained over him.
At the same time, Jason had already begun to dive towards Lilya, who could only watch in horror as he slashed at her with the same mercilessness as he had done with Eran.
Taken off-guard, she could barely lift her thin longsword, only to finally realise that even Jason's raw strength was much higher than what she had assumed.
Her eyes widened in shock and she was about to explain something, but the words died on her tongue as she coincidentally stared into Jason's golden-silverish eyes that radiated nothing but the pure desire to win against her.
This moment allowed Lilya to understand that there were huge differences between Jason, and the opponents he was sparring against.
While she, Eran, and even Zar weren't fighting with their life on the line, considering him as an insignificant being, Jason was fighting seriously, trying to win by all means.
He might have been experimenting a lot, but even that was done genuinely without a single trace of indifference while heading towards his opponents.
Somehow, this shocked Lilya more than she could have ever thought as even Jason's high combat prowess was less impressive in comparison.
'Just what kind of monster did Instructor Jennifer pick up?!' Lilya wondered as she tried to retaliate against Jason's force, only to stare in astonishment at how Artemis' wings were retracted as black flames manifested behind him.
"Fuck!" Lilya swore under her breath as she noticed what was about to happen, barely perceiving the sly smile on Jason's face.

chapters.title: Chapter 651 - Testing
chapters.content:
Lilya attempted to protect herself the moment she noticed the black flames behind Jason's back in addition to his scheming smile.
Using a vast majority of her primordial energy and mana, she inserted it into her strongest defensive technique which she exerted, the moment the black flames behind Jason's back erupted.
The sudden heat, and the gravitational force that had done its work for the entire time... Meanwhile, Jason, who was hovering above Lilya, still clashing with her, was propelled towards the ground of the arena, where they crashed into.
Only a moment later, an explosion occurred as cracks appeared on the ground where Lilya had been catapulted into and saw herself spit out blood.
Just at that moment, Jason, who was completely unscathed, began to release dense mist that enveloped him and Lilya while the mist began to enlarge at a rapid pace.
Being able to see clearly through the mist owing to his Emperor Eyes, Jason let Byakur vanish into the soul world, only to lash out with his empty hand, knocking out Lilya, who was still wriggling, trying to defeat Jason.
In the end, Jason had to acknowledge that the cadets were somehow, both stronger and weaker than he had expected.
Under normal circumstances, he would have an easier time against opponents with the same combat prowess as the cadets, but at the same time, their will to fight was a little bit low, decreasing the strength they utilised at a time.
This was somewhat disappointing.
Nevertheless, Jason was glad to have fought against the last three opponents that were all different, and unique in their own way, only to recall that Eran was still standing in the arena.
'Right...I just hit his doppelganger!'
It was interesting how the Cultivation path of Spiral could be used, and Jason assumed that the doppelganger was just one of many tricks one could use to play with someone's mind.
Eran's instinctive behavior had caused him to protect himself in the safest way, which was to create a doppelganger.
Unfortunately, this used his entire stored spiritual force, preventing him from combining his spiritual force with mana, decreasing his strength tremendously.
Thus, after having knocked out Lilya, Jason continued to release the icy mist, only to completely retract his Celestia aura and Stigma, making himself almost invisible.
Only his mana fluctuations that were also restricted to the extent at which he could barely release enough mist with the use of his ice affinity, were an indicator of where he was standing.
Unfortunately, this forced Eran to rely on his mana perception, and not on his eyes, while Jason could see everything clearly.
Trying to figure out how high the mana perception of the cadet Jennifer had chosen for him to fight was, Jason didn't even think of entering close combat with Eran for the time being.
Instead, he waited for some time, trying to figure out a few things about the cadets, only to feel the eyes of someone on his back; eyes that were boring down into him with their anger.
It was a human at the Ascendion stage, following the path of Maest, and his mana core seemed extremely interesting.
Nevertheless, Jason couldn't be bothered about all of that because the anger targeted at him by this individual was not good. It felt like a special kind of hatred, reserved only for him.
'Did I kill his entire family, or is he enraged because it looks like I'm playing around? What else could I have done to him?...'
In the end, he had no idea what he had done to the young man to incite his rage.
Thus, Jason simply decided that said cadet had an anger management issue, which was the most likely reason in his opinion.
Despite that, Jason couldn't help but think that it was better to finally end the battle, now that he had given Eran some time to find him.
As such, he released everything at once, only to push himself towards Eran, and arrived in front of him a moment later.
Because Eran couldn't see anything, he reacted a fraction of a second too late. He could barely perceive that Jason was exerting his movement technique, while circulating mana through his entire body, only for everything to be further enhanced owing to the fully unleashed Stigma and Aura.
However, that was not all as Jason had propelled himself towards Eran, the moment he pushed himself from the ground, accelerating the speed he could reach even more.
Thus, the moment Jason appeared in front of Eran, it was already over for the cadet as he moved his hands towards Eran's abdomen to reveal a compressed, black flame that emerged within it.
Shooting out one of Solaris' compressed flames, Jason saw Eran get flung more than a dozen meters away, who felt something burning through his abdomen.
A moment later, this sensation dispersed as the compressed black flame dissipated into thin air.
Only a moment later, he had appeared at the position Eran had landed, only to smile faintly as he apologised.
"Sorry, I went a little bit over the top with the last attack!"
Eran looked at Jason as if he was a monster, only to shake his head.
'He almost killed me, huh?'
Accepting his defeat far more easily than the others, Eran stood up with a sigh before he replied,
"No problem… thanks for not killing me, I guess…"
Jason wanted to say something, but before he could, he noticed that Eran had already turned around, leaving the arena and him behind.
This caused him to smile dryly, only to turn around himself, where he saw that a few people had rushed to look after Lilya.
His ice fog had dispersed the moment he had begun to utilise his fire affinity, and it was only then that Jason could see the appearance of the man glaring at him.
It was a muscular human, with a height of more than 1.9 meters.
His expression was full of scorn and hatred could be felt a mile away from him which confused Jason, only to see his eyes flitting to Jennifer once in a while.
However, Jennifer was only looking at Jason with a radiant smile that could have multiple meanings.
After connecting the dots, Jason slowly began to understand what was going on!
'This guy is plain jealous that I get all of her attention! Doesn't look like he is confident with his own charm...'
Turning away, he could barely avoid the guy, whose name was Rex, from seeing his smile.
Jason found it ridiculous to see that he had managed to irk someone at the Ascendion stage just because of Jennifer.
However, somehow, he found it quite funny, and without even considering that Rex would attack him out of the blue, Jason approached Jennifer.
Even if he would attract the rage of Rex, or even more cadets, he was eager to fight Jennifer. Ever since he had seen her, he had been trying to figure out how much of a difference it would be to fight someone with three awakened cultivation veins, and several more unique characteristics.
One could say that Jennifer was his first opponent with multiple traits, or special characteristics such as being a Halfling with repulsive elemental affinity seeds in her mana core, or her three cultivation veins.
As such, his battle intent was noticeable, which caused Jennifer to smile from ear to ear as she said.
"Rest until your mana is replenished, I want you to unleash your full potential when we fight!"

chapters.title: Chapter 652 - Two Monsters
chapters.content:
Only two hours passed after Jennifer had advised him to rest a little bit.
In that short period, she trained the other cadets, awaiting Jason to fully recuperate.
She eyed him once in a while, and during one such stolen glance, he sensed someone's rage lingering around him.
It was Rex, and Jason couldn't help but feel odd to be eyed as the love rival of someone at the Ascendion stage, without having done anything.
Jennifer was beautiful, kind, and extremely interesting, but Jason had never really thought of the possibility of being in a relationship or falling in love.
These things were something he had never had enough free time on his hands to figure out by himself because his time had always been scarce or the opportunity to even think about.
As such, before he even thought about finding a partner, Jason wanted to figure out what his plans for the future were, and if it was even possible to fall in love without endangering his loved ones.
He had already lost his masters and Scorpio, and without the necessary strength, falling in love was a luxury. He didn't think he could stomach the loss of someone as close as them again.
However, at the same time, Jason didn't realise that emotions were harder to control than he could have ever thought.
Love wasn't a choice, a decision that you made after weighing the pros and cons; it was something that just happened, even if the timing couldn't be worse!
Unbeknownst to himself, his heart that had been closed for anyone except his soulbonds, was slowly opening up to this mysterious girl.
After having lost those he had loved in the Great Argos war, his heart had been locked, but with a new chapter of his life manifesting the moment he emerged on Manyr, its shackles were shaking.
Thus, meeting Jennifer, someone who made him curious, was different than it had been during his puberty when he met someone who was beautiful or strong.
It was also different from encountering someone during or immediately after the Great Argos war, it was just something new and something that made Jason comfortable.
In the end, Jennifer was just like him which was, in fact, the reason that made them comfortable with each other, and equally eager to fight each other right now.
Thus, the moment Jason had fully recuperated, his mana entirely replenished, he got up from the ground where he had been cultivating to accelerate his mana replenishing process.
Jennifer noticed this immediately, and halted her lessons, telling the other cadets to simply continue with whatever they were doing before ignoring them completely.
This caused a commotion in the rows of cadets as they stared at Jennifer with a scheming smile.
"Is it what I think it is?" One of the Devirs said with a devilish grimace on his face, only for an Aeus to blush as she said,
"Maybe...it is?? Is she finally...That's something new!"? However, just as the female Aeus said this, Rex, who was standing close to the Aeus growled.
"Shut it, bitch!"
Releasing the intent to kill, Rex looked at them furiously and the cadets who were gossiping about Jennifer's behavior with bright expressions on their faces, quieted down.
They hadn't noticed Rex, and could only apologise multiple times before they retreated as far as possible from him.
Since their arrival to the cadet training camp that was hidden inside the hill on the barren lands, they had never witnessed Rex behaving like that.
Under normal circumstances, he would just eye Jennifer from a distance, ignoring the others who stared at her, sometimes even lustfully, however that had now changed.
Rex couldn't even approach Jennifer as he had been doing occasionally during the last few years because she had already rushed towards Jason the moment he had completely recuperated from the exhaustion of his earlier two fights.
Even if Rex acknowledged that he had underestimated Jason, it didn't mean he would let a newbie take Jennifer away from him.
Jason's combat prowess barely reached the Prismar stage, while his own was at the Ascendion stage!
He might be older than Jennifer, but what was the difference of a few decades, if the lifespan of Cultivators having reached the Prismar stage was well beyond thousand years?
It was negligible, and Rex as well as everyone else was aware of this.
Only talent and true strength mattered in the era of cultivation where the strong reigned and the weak were exploited and devoured.
However, in order to release one's full potential and strength, one had to reach a certain age, a fact every living being knew very well.
Even with unlimited talent, being very young, their inability to make full use of their potential made some prodigies succumb to their arrogance or to the fact that they had attracted the anger of someone they shouldn't have offended.
This was exactly what was happening with Rex, whose entire being was filled with anger and jealously, and poor Jason right now, who was completely ignorant to what he was doing.
In the end, it was not his fault, and neither was Jennifer's for being interested in Jason, the specific things about him, and most importantly to fight him, even if she had to restrict her strength.
Rather, it was Rex, whose uncontrollable emotions were causing chaos, as he watched Jason and Jennifer enter the combat ring.
Both the young halflings were oblivious to the fact that Rex was eying them, trying to suppress his emotions, waiting for the finale.
Jason eyed Jennifer intently, ignoring Rex's gaze that lingered on him.
Rather, he focused on Jennifer and the words she had said earlier that he should unleash his full potential.
He could do so, but initially, he was not sure if that was the best to do because his abyssal effect was still something he had no control over.
The control over the Chaos attribute in his body evaded him, and the mysterious being had returned to its slumber.
At least, that was what Jason assumed because even if he wanted to, there was no way for him to talk to it at all.
Thus, he was reluctant to use his abyssal effect or the natural pressure he had comprehended to release because it was intertwined with his chaos attribute.
However, this reluctance dispersed into thin air, the moment he noticed that Jennifer barely restricted her strength to the peak of the Lique stage in all three cultivation bases only to release all three cultivation energies at once.
They merged together, amplifying each other several times instead of deteriorating or negating each other as it would normally be the case for the three repulsive energies.
Jason had seen this once from far away, several months ago when Jennifer had fought against the army of the Aeus and Devir race in the barren lands while rescuing some humans from Manyr.
However, what he hadn't felt at that time was the overwhelming pressure that radiated from Jennifer, originating from the merging energies and a specific technique she was utilising.
With her aura, she enveloped the entire arena with its size of more than 100 meters in radius, causing the energies within her aura to vibrate wildly as if they were oppressed, and couldn't move at all.
Seeing this through the Emperor Eyes, Jason couldn't help but smile brightly as goosebumps appeared on his body.
"Why the hell did I even consider holding back? I need to be careful about not being beaten into a pulp…."
As such, Jason instinctively released his entire Stigma, in addition to his Celestia aura, while instructing Artemis to occupy his mana core once again.
Yet, instead of waiting, he immediately began the fusion process with Artemis that transformed his entire appearance in a matter of seconds.
The spar had yet to start, but both Jennifer, with her restricted strength, and Jason, who was preparing to use every trick up his sleeves, were ready to give their best!
Both smiled at each other, and they could feel the other's excitement to fight as the battle's countdown was initiated by one of the cadets who had been ordered to act as a referee.
"Just what kind of Monsters are they?!

chapters.title: Chapter 653 - All Out
chapters.content:
Everyone watching the battle couldn't help but feel astonished about the extent at which Jennifer was releasing her strength.
She might have restricted her cultivation base to the peak Lique stage, but using all three cultivation energies at once, and intertwining them with each other was already more than enough to make her extremely strong.
The pressure she released was overwhelming, but Jason could only smile as his entire being was transforming.
Fusing with Artemis, he was ready to go all out, ignoring his earlier reluctance to use the Abyssal effect.
While white wings with silver strands spread out of his back, his hair changed into the same color, only for pitch-black horns to protrude from his forehead.
A second Stigma manifested above his first one, while Jason's entire aura transformed from the pure, almost divine Celestia aura he normally had, into a wild aura that radiated cold and his sheer desire to fight to his heart's content.
Jason looked like he had turned into a beast, only to release the pressure he had comprehended during the liberation tournament.
Yet, instead of the chaos attribute that had been intertwined with the Abyssal effect before, an icy cold was mixed into the pressure which Jason amplified by inserting mana into the pressure creation process.
This resulted in the pressure exerted by him becoming more overbearing and denser, while his frosty aura enlarged, pushing back Jennifer's.
At that moment, the battle was initiated with both sides already having unleashed one of their strongest forms.
In the end, Jason was not sure whether Jennifer was giving her all or not, but he definitely was.
Even if Petri's fusion increased his strength to a higher extent, the fact that he could use the Frozen flame with a minuscule consumption of his mana, balanced out the small lack of strength.
Furthermore, Artemis' bond with him was much firmer, allowing the fusion to last longer.
Thus, Jason had chosen Artemis over Petri this time and summoned Byakur, which he enveloped in a thick layer of freezing flames.
Sky blue flames flickered around Byakur mirroring the color of his eyes after Jason accepted the entire fusion.
Exerting the Floating Sky movement technique at the highest mastery, his speed more than doubled as he pushed his left foot from the ground.
Small cracks appeared on the ground as he shot towards Jennifer, who had already manifested both of the swords he had seen a few months ago.
Smiling brightly, Jennifer took a deep breath before she used all of her three cultivation energies to exert some sort of technique as she disappeared from Jason's sight.
Even after his speed had more than doubled, he was almost unable to follow Jennifer's trajectory and caught off guard when she had already appeared, right next to him.
She slashed out, knowing that her speed was something Jason couldn't reach his current cultivation stage.
Yet, she was in for a surprise when she saw that Jason's eyes had already flitted towards the position at which she appeared a second later.
Gleaming brightly, it was as if they were saying, 'I got you!'
This caused Jennifer to feel a sudden sense of being overwhelmed, only to instinctively step away.
A moment later, sky blue flames with the height of several meters erupted from the exact position Jennifer had been standing a moment before.
Even if Jason was unable to cope with Jennifer's pace, the moment she slashed out, he was able to make his move as she had to slow down by a small margin.
This was more than enough time for him to react as he was able to partially keep track of her movements.
Jason was only capable of this because of his Emperor Eyes into which he had released a large amount of mana, but that was perfectly fine because his sub-area was rattling due to the influx of surrounding mana that it absorbed at a rapid pace.
Owing to the two Stigmas fully released at the same time coupled with the sheer force radiated by the combination of aura and pressure Jason released independently, his mana replenishing pace accelerated to an extent he had never expected.
Thus, the amount of mana he used to insert into his Emperor Eyes was balanced out, leaving enough for Jason to manifest the Frozen Flame that drained a negligible amount of mana.
Only through additional techniques that used mana, was Jason slowly using up his mana as it replenished too fast otherwise.
Nevertheless, his consumption was much lower than Jennifer's as she was using all three techniques at once, at a much higher extent, increasing her speed several times, which had allowed her to disappear from Jason's sight.
Not sure if Jason's reaction was a fluke, Jennifer initiated another attack, but this time, she wouldn't back off, if something were to happen.
Telling this to herself, she would rather evade it and attack backhanded instead of retreating instinctively as before.
Jason noticed a glint of determination in Jennifer's eyes that had only become firmer.
As such, he knew that another clash, but only at a much higher altitude was bound to occur.
Thus, without any hesitation, he began to use up the mana inside his Emperor Eyes' specific energy storage space, which was, in fact, the marble within his eyes.
He hadn't used this storage space for months because he had other things to pay attention to.
However, the amount of mana inside the small marble had reached a terrifying level, causing even Jason to be astonished.
As long as he didn't use up the entire mana inside the marble, it would be fine, as he didn't want his sight to go blurry again.
Yet, after thinking for a moment, he realised that this would only be a small sacrifice to win the fight of his life, against a being he was never ought to defeat, to begin with!
Using some of the stored mana inside the marble, he slowly nurtured the Petrification curse, the race specific weakening curse, and the Abyssal effect, trying to attain the highest potency of all three abilities.
The sudden surge of mana within Jason caused Jennifer to act immediately.
With the unique movement technique that required all three cultivation energies to be circulated through her body in a complex manner simultaneously, she disappeared once again from the sight of most cadets.
At this moment, Jason's eyes moved at a slow, yet steady pace, following the rough path Jennifer was taking, only to sense that something had changed.
'She is using spiritual force to trick me!'? He realised a moment later as his Emperor Eyes sensed nothing but Spiritual Force within the body, whose pathway he was following.
It was extremely terrifying to him that his eyes couldn't sense the obvious trap right away.
However, even more horrible was that he couldn't find Jennifer, even after the doppelganger dispersed into thin air.
Jason was able to sense her energy fluctuations but oddly enough, they were spread over the entire arena, which caused him to frown.
'It's the aura….' He could only think before he suddenly perceived that something had entered the range of his aura.
Having enlarged it as much as possible without using too much mana, Jason was able to figure that Jennifer was in the air and behind him, diving towards his direction at a shocking pace.
Realising how fast Jennifer had suddenly become, Jason felt that he wouldn't be able to turn around fully, let alone evade the oncoming attack.
Thus, he could already see how he was losing the fight right in front of his eyes, only to grit his teeth as he mumbled,
"As if I would give up now!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 654 - That’s Cheating
chapters.content:
Even if they were sometimes not seriously sparring, Jason was, in most cases, going all in, using his utmost efforts to win.
Without using everything one had up to their sleeves, they would never know how strong they were, and if it might be a stupid idea to fight specific opponents.
Furthermore, Jason hated losing, and even more so after not giving everything he could.
With that thought in mind, Jason's will to continue fighting, and to defeat Jennifer increased substantially, intensifying the ferocious, wild aura he released.
Merged with icy coldness, both his aura and the pressure he was releasing could be controlled freely, which allowed Jason to realise something he had never noticed before.
Normally, the Celestia aura was neutral, and without an affinity, but now while being fused this had changed. Now, he could use the Frozen Flame and his ice affinity, without an insignificant mana consumption.
This free usage included the entire range at which his aura and pressure were released.
Thus, Jason let out a sudden roar that shook the surroundings as he released a terrifying cold, enveloping his entire body with a pale sky blue hue.
His eyes with the exact same color were glowing brightly, but it was only when Jason's head was halfway turned, that Jennifer perceived this.
She had almost reached him, and there was a gap of fewer than 20 meters between them.
However, this distance suddenly felt as if it were kilometers to her as Jason's eyes brightened up.
Out of nowhere, a gigantic glacier of ice emerged between the two of them, creating a huge ice wall that she had to cross in order to reach Jason.
The glacier kept enlarging, pushing towards Jennifer.
She was forced to slow herself down while slashing at the terrifyingly huge mass of ice in front of her.
The cold radiating from the ice had unique freezing properties within it, and Jennifer realised that if she were to maintain contact with it using her bare hands, she would slowly start to freeze.
And this included the time she would use the energy within her body to try expelling the freezing property.
This didn't shock her, but it was astonishing as she was forced to use her own affinities to a certain degree, enlarging the darkness and light blade within her hand.
Only then was she able to hack and slash at the glacier to reveal what ought to be behind it.
Yet, what she saw was not Jason, but only a sculpture with his mana intertwined, causing her to look around in shock.
Instinctively, Jennifer looked upwards, expecting that Jason would attack from the air, just like she did.
However, instead of doing the obvious, she realised too late that Jason was not afraid of facing her head-on without the need to play tricks.
Jason wouldn't say out loud because his entire childhood had forced him to use tricks to win against his opponents in fights he was not ought to win.
In that period, Jason noticed that most people with a higher cultivation base, and even combat prowess, expected their opponents to surprise attack them from behind or at an unexpected angle.
It was exactly because of this that Jason was using his utmost efforts to not do the obvious as it was in most cases not even assumed.
Because of that, the moment he had manifested the glacier, he had created a sculpture of himself, using a fraction of his mana, only to exert the Floating Sky movement technique to quickly move around the glacier.
Thanks to this high speed, and Jennifer's distraction, he was able to appear below her only moments after she had destroyed the glacier.
Appearing below her, Jason immediately pushed himself from the ground, trying to approach Jennifer, who was still in the air, without the need to use his wings.
Ready to brandish Byakur that was seemingly craving for blood, Jason used every ounce of strength within his body to push himself from the ground.
It was exactly at that moment when Jennifer looked down, only to see him rushing straight towards her with an excited smile on his face.
Unable to evade him as she was mid-air, in addition to the extremely high pace at which he was approaching her, Jennifer could only turn to the side, preventing the most dangerous outcome, while using her two swords to deflect the attack.
However, instead of being worried about the clash, Jennifer was confident in her capabilities which made her release both her holy and darkness affinity at the same time, enveloping her body tightly, increasing every aspect of her.
Without her realising, the two repulsively affinities that had been released were working together, amplifying Jennifer's mixture of three cultivation energies.
Thus, her strength increased once again, giving Jason a hard time as their eyes locked.
When this happened, a radiant smile emerged on Jason's face, which made Jennifer extremely uncomfortable.
Had they not been fighting, this would have been different, but because they were currently in a fight, his smile worried her.
Unfortunately, her worry was already too late, as Jason released the combined force of his Petrification curse, the race specific weakening curse that both hailed from Petri, and the Abyssal effect, which was something Jason had for a long time.
Combining the attack of his curses and abilities by using his sheer will to battle, he saw them amplify each other, working together as a single attack that infiltrated Jennifer's mind and entire being in an instant.
Breaking through the protection mechanisms of her mind, which should have been extremely strong owing to her cultivating her mind in the path of Spiral, the attack spread through Jennifer like a wildfire.
Even though Jason wanted to emerge victoriously, he had instinctively restricted the power used into the Abyssal effect, fearing that something might go wrong, once again.
He didn't want another incident to happen as the last one had already been shocking enough.
Nevertheless, the sheer power behind his fully empowered curses, amplified by the Abyssal effect, were strong enough to hit Jennifer to the core.
First, she stiffened, only to realise that her entire body had undergone a weakening before her mind blanked out for a moment as she was thrown into an endless darkness.
Owing to her cultivation in the path of Spiral and Jennifer's unrestricted cultivation base at the peak of the Prismar stage, her mind was protected in multiple layers.
As such, she was only inside the endless darkness for less than a quarter of a second..
Despite that, Jennifer felt like dozens of years had passed, barely realising that she was still fighting with Jason, the moment he had appeared right in front of her.
Yet, even the millisecond of imprisonment in the endless darkness made her feel thoroughly confused which caused her to instinctively release the restriction on her cultivation base.
Thus, before Jason was even able to brandish Byakur, Jennifer accidentally unleashed the entire power of a being with three vessels at the peak of the Prismar stage, targeting him for a quarter of a second.
The pressure around him increased, and only a moment later, he was flung back to the ground where he came from.
However, as opposed to earlier, his speed increased several times as he crashed right into the battle arena, which caused him to spit out blood as his sight blurred.
"That's cheating!" He barely voiced out, only for Jennifer to regain her senses as she looked at Jason in astonishment.
"Huh, what?"

chapters.title: Chapter 655 - Recognition
chapters.content:
In the beginning, Jennifer didn't even realise that she had released the restriction on her strength.
It was only when she saw that Jason was unable to get out of the depths of the arena he had been bashed into, let alone move, that she understood what had happened.
This caused her to quickly retract the three fused cultivation energies as she dived towards the ground, to help Jason get up.
A worried expression appeared on her face, showing Jason that she hadn't done it intentionally.
Thus, he didn't say anything, and realised that Artemis' fusion had been severed.
Because of that, his strength receded, just like his appearance that returned to his usual self.
His entire body was sore, and he felt as if he wouldn't be able to move around properly for the next few hours.
In order to avoid this, he let Solaris enter his mana core, before manifesting its flames inside his body, soothing the pain and soreness within him.
This allowed Jason to turn towards his right side, where he found Byakur.
Releasing a faint thread of mana, he enveloped Byakur with it, allowing his soul weapon to return to the soul world.
Despite having mana within his mana core, the fight had evidently ended, even if it was different than both Jason and Jennifer could have hoped for.
Nevertheless, it had been exciting, and Jason couldn't help but smile, ignoring the pain within his body as he said,
"That was fun and extremely helpful! Let's spar more often from now on!"
Jennifer had been worried that she hurt him, but seeing that he was alright, she couldn't help but return him a smile too as she nodded her head.
"It's really interesting to fight you. Let's definitely repeat it!"
With that agreement both of them decided to fight more often against each other, thereby increasing their combat experience, combat awareness, polishing their instincts, reflexes, and most importantly, the bond that had just been established between the two of them.
The easiest way to get to know someone else was to fight them because one would get to know how others behaved, how they fought, and what kind of personality one had according to the subtle movements, and specific traits one perceived during a fight.
While it was easy to deceive someone under normal circumstances, acting sincere while, in reality, being someone else than one showed, this was something completely different during a fight.
It was not difficult to perceive if someone was holding back or forcefully adjusting their combat style in order to please others or even to do things one would never do under normal circumstances.
However, by using his whole capabilities, Jason had revealed everything in front of Jennifer, which allowed her to understand what type of individual the young halfling in front of her was.
What she comprehended about Jason was by no means bad, rather, it made him even more interesting than he had initially been to Jennifer.
Even if Jason couldn't truly figure out Jennifer because she had restricted her strength, including specific techniques,? the full capabilities of her affinities and other special traits she might have, he was still able to roughly gauge what kind of a person she was.
And this was satisfying enough to make him think that Jennifer was a strong yet kind woman, who he could trust to a certain extent.
She was interesting and by fighting her more often, it should be possible for him to get to know her better, which was something he wanted to do.
It was odd, but both felt that a bond had been created between the two of them during the fight, and both interpreted the bond in the same way.
They thought it was a simple bond of friendship and camaraderie.
Little did they know that they were simply unable to realise its true meaning!
While Jason's sore body was slowly recuperating, the process accelerated owing to Solaris' unique characteristics. Jennifer couldn't help but think that Jason was extremely powerful, and that it wouldn't take long for him to reach her combat prowess.
'He will be much stronger than I am right now when he reaches my age…' She thought, realising that Jason was already that strong when he had barely been on Manyr for a few months.
In the end, Jason was more than five years younger than Jennifer, and despite her requiring thrice the time and energy to cultivate, she had reached the peak of the Prismar stage in all three paths in her mid-20s.
This was shocking enough, but considering that Jason, who was only cultivating in one path, was likely to be stronger than that at this age, it was even scarier than Jennifer could imagine.
'I wonder from which races he hails…' Simple questions like this were just the beginning of the pile of doubts that further ignited Jennifer's curiosity in Jason. He was already deep in thought, thinking about the fight against Jennifer, and what he could have done better.
'Even if I don't have a martial art technique, the Floating Sky technique and my knowledge of the most basic techniques should be enough...or should I try to focus on learning a neutral martial art technique with which I can use Byakur and all kinds of affinities?'
In the end, a martial art technique improved one's combat prowess by leaps and bounds.
However, at the same time, it restricted one in the versatility with which said technique could be used, until one had a perfect mastery allowing the user to change the necessary movement sequence at will.
It was even possible to make specific techniques stronger by changing the order of movements, but for that, one would have to know the technique like the back of their hand.
In the end, this was not something Jason was fond of because most techniques he could obtain were, at most, at the Terra grade, which might sound extremely strong in comparison to fighting without a specific technique.
Yet, at the same time, his goals were already too high, and he would rather learn a Heaven's grade technique than any other.? It would make sense to use his utmost efforts to learn such a technique as if he had been born with its knowledge.
While being deep in thought, he also tried to recall how he had used the wild, ferocious aura as well as the pressure in combination with his ice affinity as it was something he hadn't been able to pull off before.
This was interesting and gave him more than enough information and knowledge he had to process.
'If I merge the pressure into my aura just like Jennifer, it should become even more terrifying, right?' He thought, only to notice that Jennifer was speaking to him.
"Jason...Jason!!!"
Shaking his head, he was brought out of his meditative thinking, as he looked straight into Jennifer's silver eyes whose highlights were the crimson outlined pupils.
"Yes?"
"We should leave the arena, so as to get it repaired and let the other cadets continue training!"
Nodding his head, Jason just recalled that there had been others except them, which made him take a look around.
The wrath in Rex's eyes was still apparent, but there was also something else gleaming in his eyes, which made Jason even more uncomfortable.
'Does he really consider me as a rival?' He wondered while trying to make sense of the weird feeling he got.
It was almost as if Rex had acknowledged him as a rival in multiple fields, only for Jason to be oblivious to what was going on.
Even if he was uncomfortable with that, Jason couldn't help but think that this might as well turn into something good.
As long as Rex didn't kill him everything would be fine, and from what he understood, the cadet at the Ascendion stage was even someone with an extremely high combat experience.
As such, it might as well help him to spar against Rex, under the condition that he survived.
'I should become a little bit stronger first...My combat prowess needs to reach the Prismar stage as quickly as possible!'
Right now, even if Jason didn't know about it, the need to become stronger at the fastest possible pace was even more urgent than anyone could ever expect!

chapters.title: Chapter 656 - Perfectionated
chapters.content:
Now that Jason had fought against Jennifer with his entire combat prowess, he knew what he had to improve on first.
He hadn't used the chaos attribute while fighting but that was because his control over it was simply non-existent.
Using something one couldn't control was not what Jason liked to do as it might end up in a disaster under any given circumstances.
As such, adapting to the subtle released chaos attribute inside his body had become an important priority for Jason.
Other than that, he wanted to perfectionate his mastery over the Floating Sky movement technique just like the three auxiliary techniques he had learned.
This would require lots of his time, and dividing his daily schedule in proper segments had now become important.
Using four days of the week for blacksmithing, concocting, and inscribing runes, Jason spent the remaining three days improving his combat prowess, whether it was sparring with other cadets or trying to comprehend something.
At the same time, he set aside several hours of each day to cultivate at a rapid pace, using the best suitable places in the surroundings to make use of Jason's high mana absorption.
He could further amplify this by unleashing his Stigma and Celestia aura in an unrestrained manner.
It was necessary for Jason to purchase certain things in order to produce goods with his auxiliary occupations which he would sell to gain a huge fortune and utilize it in several ways.
First of all, he felt the need for improving the mana and primordial energy supply within his soul world.
Through this, his soulbonds could cultivate without leaving the safest place he knew of.
Jason also wanted to try looking for certain martial art techniques; better cultivation and body refinement techniques that would allow him to become much stronger in a relatively shorter period of time.
Unfortunately, every single technique was extremely expensive, and the more interesting the technique he came across was, the more unique, rare, and thus more expensive it was priced!
Even if Jason were to save up all the funds he would earn through an entire year, he was not sure how close he would come to even one of the unique technique's price.
Thus, he had tweaked his strategy early on, knowing that the auction house of Lanro city was something one had to make use of.
Exploiting the need for not only strong but also different techniques, Jason could tell that most of the manuals that were simply lying inside his spatial ring and collecting dust were useful to achieve this.
Nevertheless, he couldn't sell all techniques at once, and had to make use of the high demand, low supply effect that led to skyrocketing the price for Terra- Intermediate and Terra- Advanced manuals he possessed!
In the end, Jason was not interested enough in the auction house to be present every single time he auctioned a Terra- Intermediate manual.
Rather, he scheduled all the Terra- Intermediate manuals to be sold once every day for the first two weeks, only to slowly increase the gap in time in which they were sold.
Thus, spanning over more than four months, the vast majority of manuals would be sold, leaving him with a total of 10 Terra- advanced techniques which he would sell at the auction house's bi-annual event auction.
Jason assumed that he would be able to make the biggest fortune out of his Advanced manuals by auctioning them off at the bi-annual event, instead of the common auction that was held every single day.
With that thought in mind, he had already ordered someone to evaluate it, and help him figure out whether the techniques were suitable to be sold at that event or not.
To his dismay, there were only three techniques that were eligible to be auctioned off at the semi-annual event.
This was not what Jason had expected, but after giving it some more thought he realised that the situation might turn out to be better than expected.
With all techniques being sold off in four months' time, the fortune he should have acquired was supposed to reach the requirement to purchase one good technique.
At least he hoped so because there was no way that he would continue to use Terra Advanced ranked techniques as it was the highest he had while even the cadets of the Tritans organisation seemed to be using stronger techniques!
Jennifer had offered to ask Luna, her master, about getting him a technique on his behalf, but without having ever done something for Lanro's city lord, Jason felt that it was wrong to simply ask for a strong technique.
However, this was mainly because he could tell that his greed would overwhelm him.
As such, he would probably ask for a Heaven ranked technique which was his final goal to attain during the next few months.
With everything prepared, Jason used the next four months to reach his highest possible combat prowess without neglecting a single trait of his, improving his overall capabilities tremendously.
Being considered highly talented in the means of cultivation, the technique he utilised may only be at the Terra- Intermediate rank, but that was not important.
If Jason were to cultivate while being seated, fully focused on the mana absorption and liquefying process, creating more than two dozen mana drops was no problem.
This was something Jason made use of, and he cultivated without holding back. This increased his combat prowess by sparring and comprehending important things while improving knowledge and proficiency in the three auxiliary occupations.
After four months, he had reached the perfect mastery of the Floating Sky movement technique, allowing Jason to move around at a rapid pace without consuming too much mana.
At the same time, his own cultivation speed progressed as well as that of his soulbonds.
He cultivated for several hours, every single day without fail, and because of that, in a matter of four months, he reached the peak of the 5th Lique stage. Now he had more than 4700 liquefied drops of mana inside his mana core.
Adding the factor that he required thrice the amount of mana than one would usually require to liquefy a single mana drop, Jason was more than satisfied with this outcome.
Meanwhile, Artemis entered the mid 4th Lique stage but Petri was even stronger than her as he entered the early 7th Lique stage!
However, that was not everything Petri had achieved.
He had liquefied a total of three more Life force drops, increasing the total number of Life force drops to seven which enhanced Petri's physical strength further, only for Jason's to be amplified too!
Solaris, on the other hand, was not improving by leaps and bounds as he and his soulbonds were.
Nevertheless, it had already reached the Prismar stage, in which it was more difficult to improve the cultivation base by a large margin, using only four months.
Thus, Jason did not bother much about the invisible progress Solaris had.
Rather than focusing on the negative points, he was more interested in the pace at which Solaris was gathering mana and soul energy to continue advancing.
Even if Jason was satisfied with his own cultivation progress and that of his soulbonds too, there was something else that made him much happier.
Finally, after a total of four months, he was able to tell the cultivation base of a being that had cultivated in the path of Pryr, almost perfectly!
