chapters.title: Chapter 657 - Auction
chapters.content:
Using his Emperor Eyes to tell the difference of the degree to which a Pryr individual had refined their body and cells was extremely difficult.
Nevertheless, Jason had been able to achieve this, while procuring and digesting all kinds of information from the cadets he had fought during the last four months.
Owing to that, not only his combat experience increased but also his knowledge about the three cultivation paths, the special traits each of the paths had, and their respective shortcomings.
In the end, it was not correct to speak about weaknesses of a path, and rather than the said shortcomings it was more about the uniqueness of each paths' advantage that made it difficult for some to properly use it.
With that in mind, Jason was sure that certain cadets would have been better off if they had awakened a different cultivation vein.
Unfortunately, fate dealt an upper hand and said cadets had to adjust themselves to the given situation.
They might not even know that their talent was seemingly wasted with the cultivation path they were fated to follow, and Jason couldn't help but think that it was better that way.
Otherwise, it might as well lead to a wound in their heart, preventing them from being fully focused on cultivating until both the injury and mentality would be fully tended to.
Jason also thought that his own situation might be similar, even if he was not exactly sure about that.
If he had been fated to awaken a different cultivation vein, would this have changed something for him or not?
Questions and doubts swirled through his mind once in a while, and they distracted him more from what happened in his surroundings than anything else.
Thus, only now did he notice that it was almost time for the bi-annual auction event as four months had already passed, while the fortune he had acquired during the last few months had increased substantially.
Jason had lost the count of Ascendion ranked cultivation resources he had obtained because he had tested giving mana stones of the same rank to Artemis.
With this, he wanted to accelerate her cultivation speed, which worked perfectly fine, had they not encountered the problem wherein Artemis almost exploded owing to the tremendous mass of mana that was sealed within the mana stone at the lowest quality.
Nevertheless, it worked, and except for the feeling of being torn apart, Artemis liked the fact that she could hasten up her cultivation speed, doubling it.
If her body would be able to fully cope with the Ascendion rank mana stone, her normal cultivation speed might even quadruple.
Unfortunately, this was easier said than done, and by feeding Artemis with mana stones at the Prismar rank, Jason could see the progress in which her cultivation speed was already doubling.
This seemed to be her current limit, but Jason was already extremely fond of that, thinking that she was truly his most talented Soulbond.
Even if she was the weakest as of now, this wouldn't be the case forever, even less after Artemis would finally undergo her second evolution.
Jason was not sure what exactly Artemis' racial limit was because even as a snowflake owl she could easily break through her racial limit.
Despite that, Jason felt like Artemis had already reached this form's racial limit, which made it more difficult for him to believe that she wouldn't evolve soon.
She was ready to evolve too, and both Jason and Artemis believed that she was only missing a small push, which could probably be done with an item she required.
Hence, Jason had started to research all kinds of peak Prismar, and normal Ascendion stage items that had an ice attribute or unique characteristics with which Artemis might be able to initiate her evolution.
In the end, finding a suitable item was easier said than done because Jason didn't think that most of the ingredients and materials which he found were what he was looking for.
Something or the other was always missing, but instead of being discouraged by this, Jason felt that the more exotic the item he was looking for was, the better.
The rarer an item, the better its effect.
This was something Jason had realised since he was young, and oddly enough, he was still confident to find what he was looking for soon, even if the item he required was extremely rare.
Jason hoped that the auction house would become the treasure trove where his search would finally come to an end.
However, at the same time, this made him worry that he might not have enough funds to purchase an item if he were to find what Artemis required.
Even if purchasing said items might require every single mana crystal he had, Jason would gladly use them because it would benefit him far more than a rare technique for the same price.
Finding a specific item had much lower chances than a suitable manual for him to use, thus, he knew his priorities. What came in as a pleasant surprise was the information that Jennifer was attending the bi-annual auction too.
She was going there in place of the City lord to purchase specific things they required, and Jason didn't hesitate to ask her if she wanted to accompany him.
During the last few months, their bond had strengthened, and they felt comfortable around each other, even if they didn't say anything.
The sole fact that they were together was enough to make them be at ease, which was something the cadets, Jennifer was training, had noticed too.
Even Rex couldn't help but realise that his chances were dwindling because the attitude with which Jennifer interacted with him was worlds apart from how she treated Jason.
He found it ridiculous and it made him furious, but without the authority to lecture Jason, let alone the fact that he didn't have enough strength to make Jennifer his, Rex shut himself off from worldly matters.
Instead, he started to cultivate as if he was possessed. Through this, he wanted to become stronger at a rapid pace, in order to defeat Jennifer at least once, while clearly showing that he was much better than Jason.
One could say that it was his last resort, but the desperate attempt made everything only worse for him because he didn't intervene in the progression of Jennifer and Jason's bond.
Thus, the two of them went together to the bi-annual auction.
In front of the auction house, they were able to see a huge crowd of people that wanted to enter the large entrance of the building in order to spectate the auction and bid on it.
Jason had already estimated that they would have to queue up and wait for several hours, only to see Jennifer smiling brightly at him as she took out two golden tickets with four big written letters on it.
[VVIP]
This caused Jason to only stare at Jennifer for a moment while she dragged him along, ignoring the hesitance in his eyes.
"Why are you suddenly so hesitant? I obviously would take you with me. Who else am I going to the auction with?"
Teasing him, she smiled, only to pass by the queue of people all of whom looked at Jennifer for a moment, only to turn back as they realized that it was the City lord's disciple.
However, just a moment later, their gaze returned to Jennifer and noticed the young man, who she was dragging along with her.
Jennifer's appearance was already superior, even after her cover up.
Yet, Jason's broad body that could be described to be athletic, with a surplus of muscles, gave him the vibe of someone who cultivated in the path of Pryr. To top it all, his flawless facial features and charming golden eyes made him look exotic.
Thus, he was even more unique than Jennifer in the onlookers' opinion.
Despite giving off the vibe of cultivating in the path of Pryr, Jason was obviously cultivating with mana which was noticeable through his mana fluctuations, but that was not important right now.
The City Lord was known for loathing men, which was the reason for everyone to believe that the same applied to everyone else under her banner.
Evidently, this was not the case, otherwise, Jennifer wouldn't smile brightly while pulling Jason along, only to disappear from the queued up people's sight, the moment they entered the auction house with their [VVIP] tickets.
If the sight of Jason, right next to Jennifer was already shocking to these citizens, how would they react, if the news that he lived in the City lord's abode, freeloading on the City lord's kindness, reached them?

chapters.title: Chapter 658 - Path Of Wealth
chapters.content:
Initially, Jason had been under the impression that the entire city would already know about his existence and the fact that he lived in the City lord's manor.
However, to his astonishment, the merchant's appraisers he had encountered during the last few months, were more professional than he'd thought. They had not disclosed any of his information to others.
They might have been astonished that a man lives in the City lord's abode, where men were forbidden and severely punished under normal means, but keeping their public image clean was more important.
It was simply not worth revealing Jason's information in exchange for tarnishing their reputation and incurring Luna's wrath!
When Jason entered the auction house for the second time to hand out all manuals he had wanted to schedule to be auctioned off, he immediately realised how much the interior had changed.
From looking relatively plain, Jason could now see all kinds of items that were exhibited behind glass showcases.
These were a few items that were auctioned off, and the three Terra Advanced techniques that were considered unique were amongst them.
Their price was extremely high, to begin with, in Jason's opinion, and he couldn't help but feel glad about having made a deal with the auction house the first time he had entered it.
Even if it had been a little bit problematic, Jason was able to pull off a little trick.
He had only three rare cultivation techniques to sell, however, based on their rarity, they would be overly expensive which made it impossible for ordinary citizens or small income families to purchase them.
As such, Jason had simply told the manager who had coincidentally appraised his items, that it might be a good idea to please the smaller or medium-sized income families during the bi-annual auction event too.
Thus, it would be good to use the remaining seven manuals to start off the auction as some sort of an appetizer and bring forth the main course immediately afterward.
Even if the manager knew what Jason was trying to pull off, he thought that it was a good idea, considering that the remaining seven manuals were still quite rare, just barely not within the standards of the bi-annual auction event.
Considering the idea Jason had proposed, the manager had called the City Lord to seek her permission. She was the one governing everything and in charge of the given rules after all.
Luna had accepted Jason's proposal without hesitation because the manuals were still rare, just barely below the standards.
But that was not the main reason for her grant permission. Rather, it was the fact that Jason was the one to have made this proposal.
In the end, she may be in charge of the Auction house, but it didn't necessarily belong to her. A neutral organisation had wanted to build the auction house, and in exchange for her approval, conferred her with the bare minimum rights to change the rules to a certain extent.
Because of that, Jason was able to get rid of all his manuals, only to see that the price for the non-exotic manuals was already priced at 5 large-sized cultivation stones at the Ascendion rank.
A single medium-sized cultivation stone at the Ascendion rank was the price at which merchants purchased the Terra- Intermediate manuals, only to sell them for at least ten times that price once again.
While a single medium-sized cultivation stone had 50 times the amount of energy sealed within itself than a small-sized cultivation stone, the same difference applied to large- and medium-sized cultivation stones.
They had 50 times the amount of energy sealed within, coupled with an even higher mana purity!
Thus, even a single large-sized cultivation stone was extremely valuable, and each of the seven Terra- Advanced techniques was priced at 5 large-sized cultivation stones.
Merchants would sell them for at least 15-20 too, or maybe even at a higher price, which made Jason realise that the fortune he had procured from his relentless work and selling of Terra-Intermediate technique was less useful than expected.
Fortunately, his cultivation manuals were unique in the sense that they didn't exist on Manyr.
This made every single technique he sold much more expensive than its usual price, which was now, at the latest, noticeably higher.
While he had procured around seven large-sized stones at the Ascendion rank, if he converted everything he had earned, this fortune would be earned several times today with the sale of each technique.
This caused Jason's mood to brighten up further, even if he would lose 20% of his profit to the auction house as its fee.
Their cut would eat a sizable chunk of his income, but Jason assumed that he would earn much more from the auction house than the merchant would give him.
Thus, he began to ponder if it was possible for him to copy a technique to earn an even higher fortune.
Unfortunately, this was not as easy as it had been on Argos, with the neutral body refinement manual or the translations of other manuals because copying didn't work that way.
In order to properly copy a technique, he had to be able to use it at the perfect mastery, giving him the chance to imprint his knowledge directly onto the technique.
In the end, this would mean that he had to learn all techniques at the perfect mastery before copying them, which would require a great deal of effort.
'Maybe, I should make a few copies of the Floating Sky movement techniques and stockpile it so as to use them when I am in dire need of some funds…'
Handing out the technique he was using was not necessarily the best he could do because others might be able to figure out its weak points after reading the manual.
As such, he would only copy and sell the FLoating sky movement technique if he was in a desperate need of funds!
With that in mind, Jason was able to retain his calm as he began to look at the other exhibited items, trying to evaluate what made them special without reading the description.
This was something he had always wanted to perfect- the utilisation of his Emperor Eyes in order to use them in the wilderness without the need to know every single herb, tree, plant, ore, and other things that might be valuable, or possibly even dangerous!
If he were to be able to do that, many possible issues could be prevented while not a single opportunity would slip through his hands.
With his mind fully occupied in trying to appraise items with his Emperor Eyes, Jason didn't even realise that he was subconsciously walking next to Jennifer, who stared at him, trying to figure out what exactly he was doing.
Jason had inserted a tremendous amount of mana into his eyes, and without knowing what exactly his special trait was, Jennifer could only think that he was trying to perceive the energy fluctuations from the items that had been exhibited.
Just at this moment, Jason stiffened as he halted in his tracks, looking like he had been petrified which made Jennifer squint her eyes, wondering what happened.
What she didn't know was that Jason's soul world had begun to shake violently out of nowhere, causing him to freeze in his tracks, as Artemis screamed out from the depth of his soul world.
She released her excitement, transmitting it to Jason the moment she felt the aura of a specific item that was exhibited.
'Is...that item that she needs to evolve….really….just why?!?'

chapters.title: Chapter 659 - Frozen Lunarium
chapters.content:
The exhibited item that attracted Artemis' attention looked ordinary but through the Emperor Eyes, Jason was able to see the truth behind the seemingly ordinary appearance.
In the end, it was just a head-sized orb that was white, half-transparent with a silverish, liquefied core inside.
Taking a look at the name and description, Jason figured out that the orb was called Frozen Lunarium, an item at the Ascendion rank that could be used to enhance one's ice affinity if channeled through the orb.
For people that had an ice affinity, and didn't use any close-range weapons, but relied on a wand, this would come in handy and was extremely strong.
However, considering that the Devirs couldn't awaken an ice affinity, while the humans on Manyr didn't even have a mana core, Jason could tell that its price wouldn't be too high.
Only a small number of Aeus should be able to use the orb in front of him.
Amongst that little group, even less would use a wand, or weapons that solely focused on increasing their ice affinity.
Because of that, Jason was confident that he could purchase the Frozen Lunarium, only to see that its price was 10 large-sized cultivation stones at the Ascendion rank.
Other than that there was the possibility to purchase it directly for 100 large-sized Ascendion rank cultivation stones, which caused Jason to halt in his tracks.
'Artemis definitely needs this to evolve...otherwise, she wouldn't react as she did…'
The instant purchase price was exorbitant for him, but the starting price was already high too. This made Jason believe that the Frozen Lunarium's use was more than just the effects he had read about.
Because of this, Jason turned to Jennifer, who was still looking at him as he asked,
"Is this ingredient even useful for anyone here? The description is not really special, let alone of any use to the three races that live in Lanro."
Jennifer noticed that Jason was interested in the Frozen Lunarium which made her believe that he had sensed something about it that might help his ice affinity grow.
It could also be something similar, but that was not important.
If he perceived an opportunity, it would be something good, and thus she averted her gaze to the Frozen Lunarium to take a look at its price before she commented,
"Frozen Lunarium has many uses. Not only does it have the obvious effect of strengthening the output of the ice affinity once channeled through it, but in most cases, it's used differently for potions!
Said potions are extremely difficult to concoct and if I remember correctly, two of the most important potions are the 'Rejuvenilizing' potion and the 'Frozen disease' potion.
The Rejuvenilizing potion is just what its name suggests, while the Frozen disease potion freezes all kinds of disease, even the most lethal ones, destroying them without leaving behind any lingering traces of harmful aftereffects to the body!
In the end, these potions require other items that are even more difficult to procure, but the Frozen Lunarium is still one of the more expensive ingredients.
As such, if you really need it, just purchase the Frozen Lunarium instantly.
It might seem more expensive at the first glance, but there are two families, one of the Devir and one of the Aeus race that require the Frozen Lunarium for their own plans.
Because of that, the price will definitely cross 100 large-sized Ascendion rank cultivation stones!"
Jason had listened intently, and after Jennifer finished her short speech, he looked at the Frozen Lunarium for a moment before he pondered on the ways he could utilise to procure the necessary funds.
Right now, he was still too poor, and only after the sale of ten manuals would his fortune be at an acceptable degree to let him have the luxury of buying something.
However, with that in mind, he knew that his fortune wouldn't be enough to purchase another treasure from the bi-annual auction.
Weighing the choices at hand, Jason pondered about it for a moment. Artemis was not exactly helpful because she was voicing out her eagerness to devour the Frozen Lunarium, like a child nagging for a toy.
She was even starting to demand it, which caused Jason to frown lightly, only to make up his mind as he transmitted his thoughts to Artemis.
[If you don't evolve after this, I will restrict our communication channel, Artemis! Then, you won't be able to manipulate me like now, because I very well know that you're doing this intentionally!!]
A moment later, Jason turned towards Jennifer, as he shamelessly asked.
"Jen, can you lend me enough funds to purchase the Frozen Lunarium immediately? I need it for something, but I won't have enough funds before the auction ends…"
Jennifer knew that Jason had auctioned multiple things in the auction house in the last four months, but what she didn't know was that he would have gathered enough funds to purchase the Frozen Lunarium after the bi-annual event!
'He is auctioning something off in the bi-annual event? And it gives him enough funds to purchase the Frozen Lunarium?'
Staring straight at Jason, Jennifer was both confused and curious, only to ponder about Jason's question for just a few seconds before she nodded her head, ready to answer him.
"I can purchase everything in the name of the City lord. So it shouldn't be a problem to purchase the Frozen Lunarium. I planned to do that, either way... Just pay her back whenever you can. If you plan to run away, just let me tell you that Luna does not like it when people deceive her…"
This astonished Jason, and at the same time, the latter part of the sentence that felt like an accusatory warning caused him to frown.
However, a moment later, he saw a sly smile on Jennifer's face, which told him that she was teasing him.
Jason realised that Jennifer trusted him to some extent because only she could purchase something in the name of the City Lord, making a credit if necessary.
Thus, he was thankful for her trust, which made him smile brightly as he replied,
"If that's the case, I should thank you! And, I want to instant-purchase the Frozen Lunarium. There is no need to wait for the Frozen Lunarium to reach a much higher price during the auction!"
With that being said, Jennifer immediately purchased the Frozen Lunarium, which was taken off the auction and away from the exhibition, attracting the surrounding Aeus' and Devirs' attention.
Their first thought was that the City lord purchased the Frozen Lunarium, in order to offend the two affluent families that had been troubling Luna for the last few years.
As such, taking away the Frozen Lunarium that both families required from right under their noses could be considered as delivering a tight slap on their faces.
It might enrage the families, but they were too weak to directly offend someone at the Specta stage, let alone injuring Jennifer before snatching the Frozen Lunarium from her.
Nevertheless, the moment the authorities of both families got to know what happened, they turned furious.
Without being able to actively do something against them, they simply decided to create trouble for Jennifer.
She was most likely at the auction to purchase more than one good, and being unable to purchase even one more item would mean that she would enrage the City lord!
Thus, the two families had just decided to form a temporary alliance against Jennifer in order to deprive her of the goods she wanted to purchase or increase the price she would have to pay, manifold!
However, how could they know that the City Lord had sent Jennifer to the auction house's event because of a specific reason, and not only because she trusted her disciple?
Unbeknownst to the authorities of the two families, Jennifer was completely unbothered after knowingly offending them.
Rather than being worried, or oblivious to what she had done, Jennifer was smiling lightly, secretly thanking Jason for giving her a challenge during this year's event of the auction house.
She was happy and Jason noticed this, which was extremely confusing.
'Is she still sane, or did someone hit her on the head?'

chapters.title: Chapter 660 - Counter
chapters.content:
After she received the Frozen Lunarium from the manager, Jennifer took Jason to the VVIP lounge of the auction house.
Only then did she give Jason the Frozen Lunarium and spoke in a conspiratorial tone.
"Because of this purchase, I probably offended the two families I mentioned earlier. So...you owe me a favor now!"
Even though she wanted to sound serious, in the end, she could only smile, expressing her joy about what had happened.
This caused Jason to frown at her, only to notice that a few more people were entering the VVIP lounge.
The VVIP lounge they were inside, was in fact, a huge hall that was separated from the rest of the auction house.
In front of Jason was a huge transparent glass wall on the first floor through which he could see everything. It gave him the chance to look at the hundreds of people who were already seated in the lengthy rows of seats on the ground floor.
Meanwhile, in the center was a simple stage, which was empty as of now.
Behind Jason, there was a bar the newcomers immediately rushed to as he heard them gossip.
"Do you think the City lord wanted to offend the Jul and Ori family? After everything they had done to provoke her, it should only be obvious that she delivers a befitting retort.
Still, I didn't expect her disciple to nonchalantly instant-purchase the item they need….it's not like they're too poor to do the same but the Jul and Ori family made an agreement to bet for the Frozen Lunarium to play it fair!"
This caused Jason to turn around, where he looked at two Aeus who were having their fun with the situation he seemed to have created.
"Either way, it was about time for the Jul and Ori family to get to know what happens if they continue provoking the City lord. I always thought that she was taking them too lightly, ignoring them which gave them the necessary time to strengthen their connections to the outside world!"
While the two Aeus were continuing to talk, Jason could only turn around, to look at Jennifer with doubtful eyes.
'Was it really okay for her to purchase the Frozen Lunarium?'
However, just as he thought that Jason imagined how it would have been if he'd purchased the Frozen Lunarium instead of Jennifer.
A simple visualization was enough to make him understand that he would have probably been killed and deprived of the Frozen Lunarium because he would be considered a nobody who had dared to offend not one but two influential families.
"Don't worry too much. My master ordered me to provoke and offend a few families that wanted to purchase certain items from the beginning.
Initially, I wanted to purchase the Frozen Lunarium later, even if it would have increased the price by a few times.
You know, some families still don't understand what they should do in the face of a powerhouse at the Specta stage, and some are not as oblivious and know their place.
Master finally decided to make it clear that she is not to be taken lightly, and that others should be put in their place every once in a while so that they pay attention to how they behave!"
Jason didn't expect that Luna would do something like this because he knew that the City Lord had been silent for decades, ignoring every single provocation that had happened until then.
It was exactly because of this information which he had procured while reading books in the auxiliary tower's library in addition to eavesdropping on others' conversation that Jason was so confused right now.
This made him ask Jennifer straightforwardly.
"Is there a reason for the City lord to react all of a sudden? I thought all of you have more than enough to do with the 'special' training in the barren lands…"
Jason didn't mention the cadets or the Tritans organisation.
Instead, he talked around it, though Jennifer still understood it. She pondered for a moment before answering,
"To put it simply, the reason is that the Devir and Aeus race have begun to cross their limits and master's patience is wearing off.
They've started to force Manyrs to choose one of the two sides, and if someone wants to stay neutral, they're treated harshly by both sides.
That's not all, and it wouldn't be enough to make my master act, but the families and clans of the three races seem to provoke Master more and more.
From the way I see it, the situation is not grave yet, but everyone is trying to find out what they're allowed to do in Lanro, and what is too much.
However, because the Master doesn't want to give them the chance to find out either, she wants to use the bi-annual event of the auction house to give everyone a warning!"
Initially, Jason had felt bad for giving Jennifer and the City lord a hard time, only because he needed the Frozen Lunarium, but that had changed now.
He was of the opinion that Luna's warning was still relatively light in comparison to what she wanted to show, but that was probably fine.
'Giving a light warning before the heavy punishment, huh?' Jason wondered before Jennifer took out a small book which she handed him.
"Take a look inside this book. The items that were auctioned off today are listed down. Everything we want to purchase as well as the things we want to bait the other families with is marked down in addition to extra information.
A few of our people also wrote down the normal price for all items, in addition to the assumed price at the auction house."
This interested Jason a lot, which made him open the thin book.
It didn't take him long before he was fully immersed in the heavy information that was written down in the book, and time flew by.
He didn't even realise that two hours had already passed as his immersion was only increasing with time.
The auction was just starting with an 'appetizer serving' according to Jason, where he wanted to sell off his less unique manuals at the Terra Advanced rank.
This was ought to make a small fortune that should end up with an equal sum than he had already accumulated during the last few months.
As such, it was a great deal he made there.
Every single seat was occupied in the non-VIP area, and the first few items, which were, in fact, Jason's manuals, were quickly auctioned off.
Jason, who had been deep in thoughts, only regained his senses when he heard a small commotion in the rows of people in front of him.
He had been standing at the glass wall that was tinted on the outside, preventing others from seeing Jason on the other side.
Thus, he immediately heard when people began to talk about the seven manuals that were displayed at the same time, only for the beautiful auctioneer to describe each technique in a detailed manner, highlighting their advantages, what they could do, and their requirements.
In the end, Jason knew that the techniques he sold were not overly powerful, but they were different, which made them unique to some extent.
Because of that, he wanted to know how many cultivation stones he would receive in exchange for them.
They were sold one at a time, but given the fact that all of them were put up for auction at the same time, Jason assumed that the manager was trying to pull everyone interested in a specific field of manual to the one they needed.
Thus, the first technique that was auctioned off had become the least attractive, which seemed to be the auction house manager's plan.
Even if Jason was not sure what the manager was pulling off, it looked like he was good at his job because the final result after all seven manuals had been sold was shocking.
"He really knows what he is doing. That's definitely a good profit margin!" Jennifer mumbled, which caused Jason to suddenly cough up as he realised how much he had earned in a matter of a few minutes.
'I'm not dreaming, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 661 - Main Attraction
chapters.content:
Jennifer nodded in approval about the profit the manager had earned, acknowledging his capabilities as she mumbled
"But where did they get these unique techniques from? They're definitely not from around here!"
All of the techniques sold by Jason were unique and different in comparison to most techniques the three races in Lanro had seen, and a few specific individuals would be able to make use of the techniques that had been auctioned off.
Some were born different than the norm and they were highly likely to be able to reap many benefits from techniques that were different than those anyone else was practicing.
Because of that, Jennifer had purchased three techniques, knowing that some of her cadets required techniques that were more suitable for them.
They were Variants, born with different cultivation veins than the usual ones, which made it more difficult for them to move specific parts of their body that were innately connected to different veins.
As such, some humans born on Manyr faced difficulties coping with mana cultivation veins because their bodies had been accustomed to being highly physical, or wisdom oriented.
Mystic energy, also called mana, focused on the energy field, and its cultivation, in addition to elemental affinities that could be comprehended and awakened.
The Tritans organisation had more than enough techniques, but all of them were similar, and not like Jason's that were different in their essence.
All seven techniques had been compiled by different races, and each of them focused on the special trait of their own race, instead of the certain norms as it was the case with the Devirs and Aeus.
They tried to construct every technique and make it usable for the Manyrs, despite not knowing what exactly they had to pay attention to.
Even if one of the cultivation veins within the Manyrs were in most cases not activated, they were still affecting them indirectly.
Thus, the techniques shared by the Devirs and Aeus were sometimes not as potent as they ought to be.
What Jason had only found out recently, was that a few techniques he sold off, could also be used by individuals that cultivated with other energies than mana without being affected by unawakened cultivation veins.
This was interesting, and also the reason why the final price for the seven seemingly normal cultivation manuals was so high.
"210 large-sized Ascendion rank cultivation stones...that's...definitely not bad.'
Deducting the 20% fee, and the fact that he had already lent 100 cultivation stones from Jennifer, or to be precise the City lord, his profit decreased rapidly.
Nevertheless, he would still have a total of more than 70 large-scaled Ascendion rank cultivation stones left if he were to include his own funds.
That was more than he could have hoped for because he expected the average for the rather normal manuals to be at around 10 cultivation stones.
Yet, in the end, with several larger families and clans betting, the prices for all techniques had skyrocketed with a particular technique reaching the price of 55 large-sized Ascendion rank cultivation stones.
When Jason had heard this for the first time, he was shocked, but Jennifer, who had purchased the technique, was extremely overjoyed which was confusing.
"Just what is so special about that technique? Isn't it just a martial art technique that uses both the cultivated energy and life force…?"
Initially, Jason had wanted to purchase and learn the martial art technique himself, but the downside of it had been too big to ignore.
He never wanted to learn a technique that used up his life force because it was simply too risky.
A single mistake could deprive him of his entire Life force, ending in a disastrous situation.
There were too many things he could make use of. Thus Jason didn't even think about it.
At the same time, another problem was that most people considered it extremely difficult to replenish their Life force.
However, Jennifer's commentary made Jason believe that he might have been wrong, which attracted his interest as it was simply logical.
"Even if you don't like techniques that use Life force, being able to defeat your opponent with a temporary improvement in your combat strength is nothing in comparison to being drained a little bit of Life force.
Furthermore, it's not difficult to replenish your life force, if you know-how, and it's even less problematic for those that cultivate in the path of Pryr!"
Nodding his head, Jason didn't say anything further. Instead, he silently watched the auction that continued without any issues.
After comparing the assumed final price written inside the small book Jennifer had given him with the real final price, Jason couldn't help but look at Jennifer with gleaming eyes.
As she had previously mentioned, Jennifer purchased all kinds of goods that were in high demand by other big families.
At the same time, she played around with those that wanted to seek revenge by preventing her from purchasing certain items. Instead, Jennifer used the very same items as bait, making others purchase them for an excessive price as she backed off at the perfect timing.
Amongst these baits were two of the exotic manuals he sold, which made Jason even wealthier than before.
One of the manuals was a body refinement manual that could be used by both Spiral and Maest Cultivators. Jason had only found it out when the Appraiser had evaluated his manuals.
Because of that, he now had a huge fortune with which he could purchase other things, even after the price for the Frozen Lunarium was deducted.
This made him happy, but on the other hand, Jason couldn't find anything suitable for his needs right now.
Even after reading through the tome, he was unable to find something he truly needed because he had everything!
Because of that, several hours had elapsed in which Artemis continued to nag him to give her the Frozen Lunarium, as she was desperate to consume it and didn't want to prevent wasting more time.
However, Jason didn't even move a single inch. He was not even thinking about giving Artemis the Frozen Lunarium right now because they were within a room full of Lanro city's elite prodigies.
There were even powerhouses from other cities who had paid a visit to the auction house just for today's event.
As such, it was not feasible for him to allow Artemis to emerge in front of him, just to devour the Frozen Lunarium before disappearing once again, returning to the soul world.
Thus, Artemis had to wait patiently, a thing she wasn't very good at.
In the end, Jason was able to calm down Artemis saying that it wouldn't take much longer, only to hear the beautiful auctioneer say something that confused him.
"My dear guests, now that we've reached the climax of today's event, I would like to show all of you the main attraction and highlight of the auction that everyone has been eagerly waiting for!"
While the others exclaimed loudly, cheering happily, Jason was oblivious to the main attraction because it was not mentioned in the book Jennifer had given him.
As such, he could only look at the stage, with confusion which was noticed by Jennifer, who smiled lightly.
"The auction house's main attraction is different every time an event is held and nobody knows what exactly the main attraction will be.
Even my master doesn't know it and she was only told that the main attraction would be extraordinary.
That's probably also the reason for so many affluent individuals from other cities to come over to Lanro city today!"
Jason just nodded his head before his attention returned back to the stage, where a covered glass box was brought up.
It was a big, long box and the moment he used his Emperor Eyes to take a glimpse at what was hidden within the seemingly normal glass box, a heavy headache overcame him.
'This concealment is tough,' Jason immediately thought, realising that even the glass box that held the main attraction was something he couldn't take lightly.
This caused him to smile, which only increased after he forcefully broke through the glass box's concealment by inserting a tremendous amount of mana into his eyes as faint droplets of blood trickled out of them.
"That's interesting!"

chapters.title: Chapter 662 - Spirit Kingdom
chapters.content:
With glowing, golden-silverish eyes and crimson-colored blood trickling down his cheeks, Jason attracted some attention from the surrounding that saw his bright smile and heard him say.
"That's interesting!"
This made most powerhouses understand that the seemingly weak Manyr had a special trait that allowed his eyes to see what lay behind the glass box.
However, this was seemingly useless as the lid of the box was taken off the moment everything had been prepared.
Even under pain, Jason couldn't help but smile at his impatience as he simply continued to use the vast amount of energy within his Emperor Eyes.
Seeing everything down to the finest detail, he sensed that there were a total of 14 objects that seemed to be in a liquefied stage, yet held together to maintain the shape of an egg.
This was already intriguing, but Jason was not interested in the appearance of the main attraction, but more about the fact that he sensed the pulse of life within each of the objects!
Astonished about this, he took a closer look, which allowed him to realise that 13 of the unique-looking eggs had the basic elemental affinities, thus following the path of Maest.
Meanwhile, the 14th egg was more exotic because it was smaller in size, silver in color, which made it look more graceful than the others, and it was swept through by spirit force!
He was just about to come up with his own conclusion when he heard the female auctioneer begin to describe and explain the main attraction and what made it so unique.
"Esteemed guests, this year's main attraction is something the auction house never had before. It is so unique that we weren't even sure if it could be the truth, or just our mind playing tricks.
However, fortunately enough, it was not an illusion, and we are overjoyed to reveal a total of 13 Eggs of Grand Spirits that followed the elemental path of Earth, Wind, Fire, and Water!"
Saying this the auctioneer took a pause, giving everyone time to digest what happened, only to hear a murmur echoing through the gigantic hall as everyone began to gossip with the people beside them.
Even the VVIP lounge was slowly becoming louder with a glint of joy and excitement within the eyes of all who were present.
"I thought Spirits were extinct in the Julandra region? Didn't they build their own kingdom thousands of years ago? How is it possible that the auction house obtained 13 Eggs...of Grand Spirits at that?! Don't tell me, they invaded the Spirit kingdom… are they insane???"
Hearing an elderly voice, Jason couldn't help but turn around to his right side, where an extremely old man was standing with anger and shock in his eyes.
The Julandra region was the region that included the entire territory of hundreds of powerful beasts, the Aues, Devir, and Manyr races, and Jason knew that this region alone was larger than Argos, by several times.
As such, he couldn't really imagine just how vast the region, let alone Manyr was. Nevertheless, he had heard of the Spirit kingdom as it was one of the Legends written in the books he read inside the auxiliary tower's library.
It was unknown how many types of Spirits existed, because some were formless, while others took the form of human-like beings, or animals according to their preferences.
However, that was not the important point, let alone the reason for the old man who stood less than ten meters away from him to be fuming in rage.
What made Spirits unique was their ability to purify and enrich their surrounding mana by simply being around.
Jason was not sure how it worked, but he was sure that their innate trait was that of purification and nourishment of mana, which was the cultivation path they followed.
Other than that, he had heard that the water, which was transmuted or generated by Water Spirits had unique traits, making it useful for other beings' health, allowing them to release their tension.
At the same time, the water was said to be extremely good to concoct unique potions.
This was also why Jason was interested in Spirits because all basic elements had unique traits making them extremely beneficial to have around.
While Water spirits were already good, the fire of Fire spirits could purify a body, releasing their impurities in the process, while Earth spirits were good at nurturing the ground around them, enriching it with mana.
As for Wind Spirits, they could control the energy currents in the surrounding, and move them at their will. Through this, one could construct an extremely powerful and potent cultivation place, which made it easier for them to cultivate.
Unfortunately, all of that was reason enough for them to be hunted down, caught, and sealed in certain places to act as mere tools to nourish other beings that wanted to exploit the Spirits' unique abilities.
Owing to this, they formed an alliance of sorts and that is how the Spirit kingdom came into existence. It served as a retaliatory force where only Spirits and normal beasts were allowed to live.
Every remotely intelligent race that gathered in societies was immediately hunted down, without any questions.
Jason had initially thought that this was a sick joke, but seeing the old man's expression, followed by the expressions of the other people that turned solemn after their initial joy, he couldn't help but take it seriously.
'If these Eggs come from the Spirit kingdom, someone must have taken them away without permission. That won't start a sudden war, right?' He suddenly wondered, only to hear the female auctioneer explaining the situation.
"I believe, the esteemed guests have already realised the uniqueness of the Grand Spirit eggs. But nobody needs to worry about the place of their origin.
They don't stem from the Spirit kingdom, but from a unique place that ought to remain a secret.
Even the auction house doesn't know where the source of these treasures but the individual that brought all 14 Eggs formed a truth soul contract with us, stating that the eggs don't originate from the Spirit kingdom.
With that being said, there are no problems, and everyone is allowed to bid freely, without restraint or the need to fear being attacked by the Spirit kingdom.
If anyone ever wanted to create a place to purify their body, improve their cultivation speed, or release the tension accumulated within their bodies after several days of arduous practice, the Grand Spirits in front of you are the best way to make all of this possible!"
With the given explanation, the powerhouses inside the VVIP lounge took a collective breath of relief and a faint smile emerged on everyone's face, only to be replaced by their greed as they subconsciously began devising tricks to claim the eggs for themselves.
This made Jason uncomfortable, and even the thought of trying to bid for a single Egg made him nervous.
He was most interested in the silver liquid Spirit egg because it was evidently a Mutation that made it follow the path of Spiral instead of Maest.
Never having heard something like this of a spirit before, Jason couldn't help but feel that he should try bidding for the Spiral Spirit egg.
Unfortunately, there were too many powerhouses eying the Grand Spirit Eggs, making him uncomfortable as he could already perceive the tension between the parties that were eager to procure a Spirit egg, even if it would mean that they had to offend each other.
'This won't end in a carnage, right?'

chapters.title: Chapter 663 - Half-mutation?
chapters.content:
Seeing the expression of the powerhouses, Jason didn't feel like bidding anymore.
This feeling only intensified when he heard the price at which the bidding of the Grand Spirit eggs began.
"10 superior cultivation stones at the Ascendion rank...that's..everything I have…!" He blurted out without realising, which caused Jennifer to look at Jason in astonishment as she mumbled,
"Where the hell did you suddenly obtain such wealth from!? Didn't you ask me to lend you 100 large-sized Ascendion rank cultivation stones? That's equal to just one superior cultivation stone!!"
Jason barely heard this and turning his head, he smiled teasingly at her. Trying to ease himself of the pressure around him he answered her,
"Well, to be precise, most of it is from you, or the City Lord!" The answer only confused Jennifer further which made Jason grin again. He was beginning to grow fond of their playful banter.
"You purchased a few manuals, right? Those were mine, and the others were also mine!"
The moment he said this, Jason's chest swelled with pride, only to see Jennifer's flabbergasted expression which made him add,
"But, those were also the last manuals I brought from my old planet!"
However, even after hearing that, Jennifer continued to wonder hence she asked,
"Didn't you say that your planet is barely considered to have entered the Innate phase and that it awoke its mana heart 350 years ago, or so?!"
Jason had opened up to Jennifer about his childhood on Argos, and many other things. Thus, she knew a bit about his past, including the fact that his old planet was scarce of mana.
"You seem to have forgotten that there were Higher races who fought in the Grand Argos war, as well!"? He simply replied helping Jeniffer recollect the same as Jason had talked about it a lot.
"Ah...yes, sorry Jason!" Jennifer spoke in a low voice, realising that she had made him revisit the very memories he would like to forget.
Despite Jennifer's small mistake, Jason's smile didn't vanish as he shook his head.
"It's okay. It is a thing of the past, and I have to cope with everything. But, let's get back to the topic. I have around 10 superior Ascendion rank cultivation stones, so...I won't be able to participate in the betting for the main attraction…
What a shame!"
Jennifer nodded her head, gauging what Jason hoped to achieve by purchasing one of the Grand Spirit Eggs, which would be extremely beneficial.
However, even she was not sure whether it was stupid to bid for the Grand Spirit Eggs, or not because their funds might not be enough, considering that there were more than a few dozen VVIPs from large cities inside the VVIP lounge who could spend money like water.
"I think so too..maybe even Specta rank cultivation stones might be used to purchase just one egg…"
Jason was not sure how valuable a Specta rank cultivation stone was.
Yet, after considering that a simple, and small Ascendion rank mana stone was enough for him to cultivate at a rapid pace for more than a week, Jason couldn't even gauge what the superior cultivation stones, let alone Specta ranked stones might be capable of!!
Despite that, Jason didn't feel the need to purchase more cultivation resources right now and only Artemis required some to accelerate her cultivation.
His own pace couldn't be increased much right now, as he used the Balance of the Universe's first stage.
Jason first had to familiarise himself with the second stage's main criterias before he would try to practice it, in order to further accelerate his cultivation speed.
Thus, he had felt the need to purchase the Spiral Spirit egg, and thereby bind a new, and unique soulbond.
It was his gut feeling that told him to bind it, but without the necessary funds, it was impossible to do that.
He couldn't ask the City Lord for more financial aid either because he was not sure how long it would take for him to repay everything.
There were several other factors he had to take into consideration, and being indebted to someone was not something Jason liked to be.
Thus, he simply smiled sillily at Jennifer, who made a quick call to the City Lord, using the messenger card.
Even Luna seemed to be unsure whether they should use their precious funds to purchase a Spirit Egg.
As such, Jason realised that it was even less feasible to loan funds for such a reason.
The auction had halted for a few minutes, giving everyone enough time to acquire more funds or make deals with other powerhouses to possibly purchase a Spirit egg together, and share the benefits.
Seeing this, Jason felt overwhelmed, only to suddenly hear an old woman's voice reverberating through the entire auction hall.
"Miss auctioneer, if I'm not mistaken, you mentioned 13 Eggs before, but it seems that there are 14, would you explain the reason for this? The 14th Grand Spirit egg seems to be a mutation, or from a more advanced elemental Spirit.
At least, that's what I believed, but from the intel I acquired, there shouldn't be a silver Spirit in the family of Grand Spirits!"
In the end, the question was something everyone had on their mind, but nobody had asked it out loud because they had been focusing on procuring funds or gossiping amongst each other.
As such, the question had moved to the backburner, only to reappear now that it had been asked.
The entire auction hall was filled with murmurs once again, and Jason suddenly tensed up, feeling that the following explanation might play into his hands.
Even if he had already given up, deep in his heart, he hoped for a specific scenario to occur.
It was selfish, but Jason couldn't care less about that right now.
Clearing her throat, the female auctioneer couldn't help but smile forcibly, only to explain what had happened.
"According to the appraisal and several examinations the auction house colluded, the 14th Grand Spirit Egg is slightly unique.
Because we hold our reputation dear, we won't lie to our esteemed guests. Initially, we planned to explain the heritage of the last egg after the other eggs had been auctioned off, but we should have come clean right from the beginning.
I sincerely apologise for this!"
Bowing deeply, the beautiful auctioneer caused an excited chatter to break into the rows of ordinary people who participated in the auction.
Never had they seen the auctioneer bowing down and apologising, let alone for something that they found trivial.
However, for the VVIP's, every single egg of Grand Spirits was very important.
As such, it was only fitting that they wanted to know what was the issue in the last one.
Thus, they awaited the auctioneer to explain what the problem was!
"In fact, the 14th Grand Spirit Egg has undergone a mutation, changing its mana veins into Spiral cultivation veins.
This may not seem like a problem, but everyone can see the Spiral Spirit Egg's size. Maybe, some of you can even sense that the spirit force inside the egg is extremely weak.
As such, we presume that the 14th Grand Spirit egg underwent an adverse mutation that might cause further problems.
The auction house can't guarantee anything, but after multiple examinations, we determined that it might be impossible for the Spiral Spirit egg to hatch, in the first place!"

chapters.title: Chapter 664 - Fools
chapters.content:
After the auctioneer said that the Spiral Spirit egg might as well not hatch, a wave of anger swept through the entire auction hall, with most powerhouses complaining about the insincerity of the auction house.
Furious of being kept in the dark, several powerhouses released their cultivation strength of a Specta as the old woman that had asked the question about the 14th Grand Spirit egg ordered in a commanding tone,
"Quiet down, trash!"
This would have caused another commotion, but the moment they sensed the energy currents of the old woman, even the other powerhouses quieted down.
Jason had already perceived the existence of a few extremely old powerhouses that had accumulated their strength over a timespan of thousands of years.
Thus, he was not even astonished about the sheer energy currents that rippled through the auction hall.
Yet, what caused him to raise his eyebrow was the fact that the old woman was standing next to a young Aues, who looked down at everything as if it didn't matter to him and everything was a waste of time.
Comparing the old woman at the Specta stage to the young man who was still at the Ascendion stage, Jason couldn't help but feel more curious about the young, seemingly nonchalant Aues.
However, instead of staring at the young Aues, who had noticed that Jason's eyes were glued on him, Jason averted his attention back to the auctioneer.
Yet, before the bidding could resume, an old man from the other side of the VVIP lounge suddenly asked,
"Is that everything the auction house has to say about the Spiral Spirit egg or is there more to know? The Auction house should reveal everything if they don't want to offend the big clans and families that specially came to attend today's event because they trust the reputation of Lanro's auction house!!"
Next to the old man, who was also a powerhouse at the Specta stage stood a young-looking girl, and Jason presumed her to be even younger than himself.
This was already astonishing, but what made him lift his eyebrow once again was the fact that she was a human who had mana veins, instead of a Spiral or Pryr cultivation vein as it was usually the case with Manyrs.
In the end, this meant that she was either a mutant just like people such as Rex or other cadets of the Tritans, or she was from a different planet, just like him.
Yet, what caused Jason's Emperor Eyes to gleam up was the fact that the young woman had already entered the peak of the Prismar stage.
She had one enormous, dome crystal enveloping the three large, rotating crystals, that contained three small prismarine crystals each causing Jason to nod his head in acknowledgment.
However, instead of giving her any more of his attention, he awaited the female auctioneer's answer.
Sweating profusely due to the sheer pressure she had to endure owing to the powerhouses comments, the auctioneer quickly explained.
"As I mentioned, it is not certain that the Spiral Spirit egg won't hatch, but the chances of it not hatching is high because the egg didn't receive the necessary nutrition when it was constructed in the body of its parent.
There are further problems with the Spiral veins, and the examinations concluded that the Spiral Spirit egg underwent a half mutation, transforming only a part of the mana veins into Spiral veins.
Thus, it is a gamble to purchase the Spiral Spirit Egg, while seriously thinking that one can hatch it.
In the end, the Auction house didn't want to auction it off, but the anonymous seller of the other Grand Spirit eggs demanded that we auction off the mutated 14th egg too!
Because of that condition, we can only reveal it to everyone, even if we didn't plan to make a fuss out of it!"
The last sentence caused Jason to smile lightly because it was something the female auctioneer blurted out in fear of receiving another surprise attack owing to the distinct pressure that was already radiated by the Specta stage powerhouses.
However, none of that happened, and everyone quieted down.
From the looks of it, the auction house couldn't ignore the seller's demands, which forced them to reveal all 14 Grand Spirit Eggs, even if they only wanted to sell 13.
Despite that, the information of the 14th egg was interesting, at least to Jason, who was one of the only people who retained his smile.
Even Jennifer and the other powerhouse frowned when they heard the details about the Spiral Spirit egg.
Initially, they had planned to bid for it, but even if they were powerhouses, what all of them hated the most was to waste precious resources.
Thus, they dropped their previous idea of bidding for it, even if the price was not extremely high for them.
Wasting their time and resources was not something they wanted to do, for something that was deemed as useless.
As such, there were a few impatient powerhouses that voiced out their opinion without thinking about holding back, let alone the common rules of the auction house, which stated that it was forbidden to intervene in the auction.
"If the half mutated Spiral Spirit egg is so useless, just auction it off to anyone, before we move to the true main event, which is the auction of the unscathed Spirit eggs!"
"I agree to this! Auction off the mutated egg first, and if someone wants to bid for it, it's fine...but why are we wasting our time with such useless talk about trash!"
While more and more people agreed to this, Jason could only eye everyone weirdly, thinking that all of them were stupid.
'Why do they trust the words of the auction house to such a degree? Shouldn't at least a few show interest in bidding for the Spiral Spirit egg?' He wondered, utterly dumbfounded. Meanwhile, the auctioneer kept her cool and accepted the bidder's opinion without complaint.
"As the esteemed guest in the VVIP lounge suggested, I shall start the auction for the half-mutated Spiral Spirit egg right away!
The starting price to bid shall still be 10 superior Ascendion rank cultivation stones!"
With that being said, the auctioneer awaited a bid as she forced a smile on her face, thinking that the end of the auction had become utterly chaotic.
However, instead of receiving even a single bid, she saw that the entire auction house had gone silent, turning the entire situation extremely awkward.
Even after two minutes passed, nobody bid, thinking that the price was way too high.
As such, the auctioneer was about to lower the price at any second, which caused Jason to frown because his opinion about the mutated Spirit egg was completely different than that of the others!
'Their thoughts are somewhat logical, but what makes them trust the auction house to that degree?
Furthermore, what the hell did the Auction house use to examine the mutated egg? A rock?!
How else could they be so wrong? The Spiral Spirit egg is neither injured nor trash, it simply underwent a partial mutation..
The mana veins have been completely extinguished, and replaced by Spiral cultivation veins.
In the end, the only issue is the dead mana veins that haven't been expelled from the mutated Spiral Spirit, which must be malnourished!'
Thinking that the Spiral Spirit egg didn't receive enough spirit force in the initial stages of its construction, Jason could only conclude that it lacked spirit force.
As such, unable to expel the dead mana veins, the egg's problems were increasing further to the point that they began to overlap, causing the problems mentioned by the auction house.
Because of the evaluation, Jason could conclude thanks to his Emperor Eyes, he couldn't help but feel that everyone was doing a big mistake in not bidding for the Spiral Spirit egg.
However, at the same time, he was barely able to contain himself from exclaiming as he took a deep breath to calm his jittery nerves. Awaiting the moment in which the auctioneer was just about to open her mouth to lower the price, he amplified his voice and said,
"I bid 10 superior cultivation stones at the Ascendion rank!"

chapters.title: Chapter 665 - Acquired
chapters.content:
In Jason's opinion, the others, who didn't bid for the Spiral Spirit Egg, were fools.
Thus, he couldn't prevent smiling proudly as he was suddenly eyed by a majority of the powerhouses at the same time.
Jason merely gazed at the stage, where the astonished auctioneer was standing, momentarily forgetting to do what she was supposed to.
His demeanor was nonchalant as if he didn't do anything special, only for the other powerhouses to question his reason for bidding.
However, even after wondering about it for some time, they couldn't help but think that Jason was just gambling, trying to grasp a huge opportunity, even if it was unlikely to happen.
Jason's bet caused a commotion in the rows of non-VIPs which made the auctioneer regain her composure as she announced,
"10 superior cultivation stones at the Ascendion stage have been bid! Does someone want to bid 11 superior cultivation stones?"
While the auctioneer waited for a few seconds to receive another bid, many things happened at the same time.
First, Jason had to control his emotions, and appear unruffled, while he was eyed and even swept through by tens of energy currents, investigating his cultivation base.
'5th Lique stage… I doubt he procured it by himself. Did he receive some funds from the City lord's disciple? Are they close friends?' One of the Aeus family patriarchs living in Lanro thought, just realising that Jennifer, the City Lord's disciple was standing next to a man.
However, only a moment later, the Aeus sensed that he was unable to scan through Jason's body as more than six beings at the Specta stage were trying to evaluate Jason by themselves.
This was uncomfortable, but Jason simply endured it, knowing that he couldn't do anything against it, either way.
'Is that an inactive stigma? And how does he have such distinct mana fluctuations despite only being at the 5th Lique stage….interesting!' The old man, who was standing next to the human prodigy, though. The prodigy looked younger than Jason.
He immediately shared his findings with his disciple whose eyes twinkled with interest.
"Are you sure about the stigma? That means he has someone strong backing him up...otherwise, he wouldn't be able to possess an artificial stigma!"
The young woman stated her assumptions, without even considering that Jason might have naturally created the Stigma.
"Doesn't that mean, his backing is stronger than that provided by my father? It's impossible for me to deactivate the stigma he engraved into my back, after all!"
These words caused the old man to glare at the little girl as he admonished her,
"Quiet down, if you don't want to expose your secrets to others! And, don't bother about this young man. He is already older than you, and his cultivation base is leagues apart from yours!
From the looks of it, he is nothing special, just let him waste his fortune on the Spiral Spirit egg. We will procure an unscathed one!"
Nodding her head reluctantly, the young woman fell silent but her eyes were trained on Jason. She noticed that there was something odd in Jason's facial expression and her gut feeling told her to bid for the half mutated egg as well.
Unfortunately, she was forbidden to 'waste' any precious resources, thus she remained silent as she heard the final words of the female auctioneer.
"Sold!"
How could the young woman understand that she not only felt uncomfortable about Jason's stigma, but also the fact that he nonchalantly used his entire fortune on an egg that was deemed useless?
In fact, the young, seemingly calm Aeus felt like he should have bid for the Spiral Spirit egg too, only to be forbidden to do anything, just like the young woman.
Little did Jason know that he had only been a hair's breadth away from losing the Spiral Spirit egg, forever.
Fortunately, this didn't happen, and he had successfully procured the egg.
After he heard the auctioneer's words, Jason couldn't help but smile brightly, happy that nobody else bid for the Spiral Spirit egg.
The sudden change in Jason's demeanor astonished everyone, and they couldn't help but label him a freak, or eye him with more interest.
They were curious to know the reason behind him being so glad about having purchased the half-mutated egg.
'Did I make a mistake?...No, I shouldn't!! He couldn't have sensed something we haven't, right?!' The old woman suddenly asked herself, only to shake her head, rejecting this possibility, before throwing a faint glimpse towards her disciple, the young Aeus, who looked at her as if he wanted to say.
'I told you!'
Seeing how happy Jason was with his purchase, Jennifer couldn't help but look at him with a mixture of confusion and interest.
She wanted to know why he had purchased the Spiral Spirit egg too, and if Jason had been able to see something owing to his eyes' trait.
Despite that, she would have to wait for some time because the 13 Grand Spirit Eggs were now about to be auctioned off.
Jason had to wait until the entire event ended before he would receive his purchase which was different from the Frozen Lunarium Jennifer had bought before the auction had started.
Thus, after he calmed down, Jason focused on the auction, trying to figure out how great his purchase was.
Comparing what the others would bid for the Grand Spirit Eggs to what he had paid, Jason was bound to be happy because he heard dozens of voices issuing bids the moment the auctioneer had opened the bidding for the first egg.
It was completely different from the bidding of the Spiral Spirit Egg, but this was exactly why Jason was confused.
He never expected that nobody would bid for the Spiral Spirit egg because he assumed that even the mutated form should have its worth.
Nevertheless, Jason wouldn't complain about it. Instead, he was thankful for their generosity of not bidding for the Spiral Spirit egg.
In the end, some might have wanted to bid for the egg, but instead of wasting their resources, they were ready to use the 10 superior Ascendion rank cultivation stones, which they had saved from not purchasing the half mutated egg, to raise the bidding amount of the other eggs!
However, what Jason didn't expect to happen only a few moments after the bidding of the first Grand Spirit egg began was someone raising the bid to an extraordinary level.
"1000 superior cultivation stones at the Ascendion rank!"
A moment before, the bidding price had just reached 100, but now it increased tenfold with a single bid causing a commotion within the rows of non-VIPs.
At the same time, the other VVIPs turned their heads towards the old woman who made the bid, glaring at her for a moment before returning their attention back to the stage.
Suddenly a second voice rang out, shocking the non-VIPs even more.
"1500 superior cultivation stones at the Ascendion rank!"
Jason's eyes widened at this bid, but the old man, who stood next to the young prodigious woman he had seen earlier, didn't seem to be bothered about the price he had just voiced out.
Despite the price Jason found to be already astronomical, the bidding continued, and only now did he truly find out that it was his pure stroke of luck that awarded him the chance to acquire the Spiral Spirit egg.
However, the powerhouses' interest was simply somewhere else, trained on the Grand Spirit eggs that were unscathed!

chapters.title: Chapter 666 - Obstacles
chapters.content:
Not believing his eyes, Jason looked at Jennifer in doubt, questioning himself if his ears were ringing.
The auction had just ended with the 13th Grand Spirit Egg and not a single one was auctioned off below 10000 superior cultivation stones at the Ascendion stage.
This fortune was enough to nurture hundreds of people, and it was barely the minimum amount spent for one of the Grand Spirit eggs.
Most of them were sold for an even higher price, which caused Jason to be even more confused about everything that had happened.
"Why did nobody bid for the half-mutated Spiral Spirit egg?" He blurted out, not sure what he had expected to happen.
In the end, the 13 Grand Spirit eggs had been 1000 times more expensive than the one Spiral Spirit egg he had purchased, which showed that the powerhouses had more than enough resources to purchase it.
It was only when Jennifer explained the situation that he understood it to a certain extent.
"Jason, there is a big difference between an investment with a fixed return rate and an investment into something that is bound to cost a fortune without knowing whether it is a treasure or simply trash.
While your Spiral Spirit egg has many issues, it was already examined beforehand and even the auction house didn't bother about it, at all.
As such, it is almost certain that the chance to find a solution to solve the egg's problems will be slim.
To put it simply, you will have to invest a fortune to have it examined again and procure information about the Spiral Spirit egg's issues before you start searching for a suitable solution.
This investment is not worth it, and everything combined might even be more expensive than what the other 13 Grand Spirit Eggs were priced at!
As for the unscathed and normal Grand Spirit Eggs, they can be hatched and sealed within a specific environment with the right tools, changing the surrounding area completely so as to provide them nourishment.
It might cost a small fortune to construct everything that will be close to perfect and efficient enough to use properly, but the long-term return is terrifyingly high once the preparations have been completed.
Thus, you will certainly get something in return, and it's worth more than the wealth that was initially invested to purchase them.
In the end, it will only need a few years, or more likely decades to make up for the total costs of everything you invested.
However, after that, you will only receive profit from the Spirits which is the reason for them to be auctioned off that high, in comparison to the Spiral Spirit egg you've purchased!"
Jennifer's tone was serious, and at the end, she even sounded as if she wanted to lecture him.
Despite that, Jason just nodded his head, understanding that it would be quite difficult to figure out that it were the dead mana veins that clogged up the Spiral cultivation veins in a complex manner.
This was essentially the reason for the auction house to call the Spiral Spirit egg a half mutation, and his fortune!
They were assuming that the dead mana veins were in fact, an unmutated part of the spirits cultivation veins, which would cripple it permanently.
Other than that, there was also the fact that nobody would know how to expel the dead mana veins without damaging the Spiral Spirit egg.
At least, Jason assumed that nobody would know, or be competent enough of doing something like this because a single mistake could damage the Spiral cultivation veins that were clogged up.
In order to achieve what he wanted to make possible, eyes like his were required in addition to a special means to expel the dead mana veins.
As such, Jason had many advantages because he met one of the requirements while he had already crafted a plan for the second one.
Solaris was his final solution to expel the dead mana veins, just like it expelled impurities from the ores he forged.
Jason knew that he had to tweak a little bit on the way he would have to use Solaris because he didn't want to hurt the Spiral Spirit egg, let alone injure it severely.
Thus, Jason planned to bind it to his soul, allowing him to feel his Spiral Spirit egg's pain.
Through this, he wouldn't have to rely on his instincts, but could clearly figure out when Solaris' flame was too strong, and when he could increase the temperature in order to reach the necessary heat to unclog the veins while not damaging the egg.
With that in mind, Jason eagerly awaited the moment at which he would finally lay his hands on the Spiral Spirit egg, only to realise that he and Jennifer were still waiting inside the VVIP lounge with a few more powerhouses.
Looking around, he noticed that the remaining powerhouses had successfully won bids for something.
Because of that, they waited in the lounge while everyone else had already left.
Many powerhouses were disappointed because they hadn't been able to procure the Grand Spirit eggs, and according to their expression and the glint of greed within their eyes, Jason could easily decipher that they had ill intentions.
'Fortunately, the City Lord didn't ask Jennifer to bid for a Grand Spirit egg! Otherwise, some of the greedier powerhouses would've possibly pursued us and stolen the items we procured!'
He thought, only to see the faint smile on the faces of the other powerhouses as they stared mockingly into the eyes of the other powerhouses that left the lounge empty-handed.
Seeing this, Jason couldn't help but feel weird.
It was as if some powerhouses were trying to provoke the other side, initiating a large-scale battle.
This was not even unlikely because most powerhouses were Aeus and Devirs that had been glaring at each other with killing intent the entire time.
A neutral city like Lanro was rare, and in most cases, the cities of the Julandra region were divided into the Aeus and Devir territory with only a few human settlements.
In the end, Manyrs were considered weaker than Aeus and Devirs, but that was majorly the reason for the fact that the Manyrs didn't have customised Aura techniques and other unique manuals!
Because they were forced to use the martial art, cultivation, body refinement and aura techniques of the Aeus and Devir race, the Manyrs were always held back to a certain extent, even if they only awakened a single cultivation vein.
Every race had slight differences in their physique, and this difference was not made up for in the techniques which the Aeus and Devir races distributed.
As such, Jason knew from the beginning that most Manyrs had more obstacles in their path to become just as strong as the two winged races.
However, instead of trying to become independent or creating their own, customised techniques, most Manyrs voluntarily submitted to the Aeus and Devir race.
Even Jason's progress was slightly restricted owing to the fact that the techniques he used were customised to a particular race.
Only the Balance of the Universe cultivation technique could be considered as a neutral technique, allowing most races with mana veins to practice it.
Nevertheless, even the Floating Sky technique was something Jason had to alter while exerting it in order to generate the most potential out of it.
As such, the obstacles in front of him were decreasing.
Now, he had more than enough means to become stronger with every single day that passed.
Exactly this was what Jason required to be because the dangers looming around him and those that had just become important to him were increasing just as fast, if not faster!
