chapters.title: Chapter 687 - Kinra Island
chapters.content:
There were only rumors about the event, but owing to the fact that the information hailed from beings at the Specta stage, most people around the Julandra region were inclined to think that it was anything but a rumor.
However, even the races outside the Julandra region seemed to be excited about the event because the warfares on the adjacent borders were becoming fiercer by the day.
Jason hadn't heard a lot about the races that tried to infiltrate the Julandra region, but there were quite a few.
This indicated that the Julandra region had to have something unique like special treasures or areas with extremely high amounts of natural cultivation energies.
If Jason were honest, he had yet to read more information about the region he was inside, let alone the adjacent regions.
Nevertheless, the information about Kinra island was interesting, and he was eager to find out more about it.
As such, Jason wanted to search for information inside the auxiliary tower's library.
The auxiliary tower appeared to be relatively unscathed, a fact which had astonished him, but at the same time, it shouldn't have been a surprise because the materials it was made of were stronger and sturdier than those used to construct the rest of the Manor.
However, before he was even able to enter the auxiliary tower, he had already received a message from Jennifer.
Apparently, the City Lord sought him, and with that in mind, Jason decided that he might as well ask Luna about information pertaining to Kinra island.
Inside the main hall, which was still under the reconstruction process, he saw Jennifer, the City Lord, and a few beings at the Prismar stage.
Jason was familiar with some of them, which allowed him to realise that they were cadets of the Tritans' hidden training camp.
He nodded his head, greeting them before directing his attention to the City Lord, who began to explain why had called upon them.
"Today, I asked a few of you to gather because I have both a request and an opportunity to give you all.
I want you guys to enter Kinra island after it finally resurfaces! This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity I can provide you.
However, in exchange, I want you to search for a specific item. If you can provide it, the finder will be rewarded very well.
Sadly, if nobody manages to procure the item, I would only complain about my misfortune….so what do? you all think about my offer?"
While the others' eyes twinkled with excitement and joy, Jason couldn't help but be confused. Jennifer had provided him with some information about Kinra island, but he was still lacking the most basic things.
As such, he couldn't help but ask,
"I don't want to sound rude, but why do you want us to enter Kinra Island? Wouldn't others at the Ascendion stage, or you be a better choice to procure that item?"
Unaware of the questioning gazes he was thrown, Jason simply looked at the City Lord, without any ill intentions.
'Does he not know about Kinra island?' The City Lord asked herself, only to recall that Jason didn't belong to Manyr, let alone the Julandra region.
Because of that, she accessed her spatial ring.
Taking out a document, she used her mana to make it fly towards Jason as she said,
"The file is filled with information about Kinra island.
However, to put it into simple terms, there is a barrier, preventing everyone with a cultivation base at or above the Initial rank of the Ascendion stage from entering Kinra island!
It should have been constructed in order to prevent those who were not eligible to receive an inheritance from entering it.
Furthermore, one has to be younger than half a century, which means that the barrier restricts both high age and cultivation base.
Rumors say that the barrier also restricts someone's talent, but that is something I cannot say for certain.
A long time ago, it was said that someone at the peak of the Specta stage wanted to enter Kinra island, but before he was even able to break through the barrier, the island began to move, vanishing in the depths of the ocean!
With that being said, it's not that others are unable to enter it, but the moment the island moves underwater we are unable to pursue it.
Maritime beasts are simply too ferocious and there are too many of them with a high cultivation base!"
Jason just nodded his head, without saying anything, before he heard the eligibility criteria to enter Kinra island.
This made him squint his eyes before he asked,
"So...people like Jennifer will be able to enter Kinra Island...in that case, am I not too weak to enter the Land of Inheritances, if we compare my strength to Jennifer's??"
Jason definitely wanted to enter the Island after hearing all the treasures he could find there, even more so after he learned that there was not one but multiple Ancient ruins and Inheritance sites on it.
Each of them was said to have been constructed by a being above the Specta stage, which made him curious about them.
Nevertheless, he was too weak, if people like Jennifer with combat prowess at the Ascendion stage were able to enter it.
Furthermore, the competition would definitely be fierce, which made it more unlikely for him to survive the trip, let alone receive an inheritance.
Inheritances would change the entire future of those who obtained them, possibly changing their constitution or other specific traits.
Seeing Jason's visible dismay, the City Lord smiled slyly, knowing what Jason had on his mind as she took out several manuals that released a faint aura.
'Heaven-ranked techniques!' Jason thought immediately, which caused him to look at Luna in confusion.
"Because I am aware of the dangers of Kinra island having once entered it myself, I shall give all of you one Heaven's ranked technique.
According to the provided information, it will take two months for the Island to resurface. Until that time, I want everyone to work hard and increase their strength as much as possible!
Afterward, I want my technique back, and you may retrieve it once you return from Kinra Island!"
When he heard the City Lord, Jason couldn't help but feel enlightened, only to realise that she was trying to use the technique to bait them.
Even if they started practicing it from today, they would still not be proficient enough in it two months later. Thus, they wouldn't require it anymore.
As such, after coming back from Kinra, they would have to return to the City Lord's manor, under the premise that they wanted to have the technique returned.
Owing to that, it was only obvious that some cadets doubted the City Lord's decision.
"I hope City Lord doesn't find this question rude...but what kind of item are we even supposed to search, and what can it be used for?" One of the other cadets suddenly asked, looking skeptically at the levitating Heaven's ranked technique.
It was odd for her to award such a valuable technique so easily. As such, the item which the City Lord was looking for, had to be extremely valuable!
Luna had already expected such a question, and without thinking too much about the suitable answer she said.
"The item I'm looking for is called Divine, or rather an Immortal Eye. In fact, it's an orb, which you can find in every single Inheritance site, but the number of people who have acquired one of the Immortal Eyes was scarce.
As for the reason why I need the Immortal eye, I do not want to tell you. Either accept that or I won't take you to Kinra island.
Without the help of a being at the Specta stage, you won't be able to come even close to the island!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 688 - What’s Wrong With You Two?
chapters.content:
Apparently, Kinra Island would always resurface in an extremely dangerous territory filled with many ferocious beasts that even some beings at the Specta stage feared.
As such, it was required to have someone strong enough nearby, who could protect them if something were to occur.
Jason had already realised it the moment the City Lord had said that she would take them with her.
Because it was necessary to be guided to the entrance of the Island by a being at the Specta stage, only a small number of mostly powerful individuals would be able to enter it.
Amongst those individuals, the majority were likely to be the Specta stage powerhouses' disciples, which was what everyone clearly understood.
Owing to that, Jason was not sure if it was really logical for him to accept the City Lord's proposal, even if she were to hand out a Heaven-ranked manual.
Meanwhile, the others had heard of the Immortal Eye before, which made them frown as they were unsure of what to say.
Within the last millennia, there had only been a few individuals who were able to procure the Immortal Eye, and because of that, the cadets knew that the City Lord was playing with fire.
However, this shouldn't matter for the cadets because if they were able to receive the opportunity to enter an Inheritance site, they may as well try looking out for an Immortal eye.
That shouldn't be much of a problem as they could at least give it a try.
As such, they were willing to accept the City Lord's proposal.
The opportunity to enter Kinra island was already great enough for them to ignore such a minor inconvenience, and the fact that they received additional support in form of techniques spoke volumes about Luna's need for the said item.
Yet, the very same reason made Jason feel confused.
'Why does she need the Immortal Eye, right now, right after we have been attacked? What's even the use of this object?'
Jason doubted that the Immortal Eye had nothing to do with the attack on the manor, but he didn't say anything.
Instead, he waited for the other cadets to agree to the City Lord's proposal.
After that, they were able to choose one of the Heaven-ranked techniques.
Picking the right one was not difficult because most of the cadets already had a permanent cultivation technique, which forced them to continue using it.
If they wanted to change the cultivation technique, they would have to destroy their entire cultivation, and start from scratch.
This was not something they would want to do, not when their cultivation base had allowed them to receive the opportunity to be able to enter Kinra island in the first place
After the other cadets were done, they looked at Jason, who was yet to make his decision.
However, rather than saying something, he remained silent as he contemplated his options.
In the past, he had acted recklessly, and if he were to have the same mindset, Jason would immediately accept the City Lord's proposal.
There was not much for him to lose if he were to increase his strength in the next two months.
Yet, that was exactly what caused Jason to halt in his tracks.
'How much can I improve my strength in just two months?'
Jason was confident that his combat prowess would improve a lot, but the difference between owning one prismarine crystal vs. two was already extremely vast.
With that in mind, Jason had realised that a single solidified prismarine crystal was roughly equal to owning anywhere between 20,000 to 25,000 liquefied mana drops.
This was something Jason could attain without too many difficulties, but twice, or triple that amount was not something he could easily achieve.
Doubling his strength in two months was already close to impossible, but reaching the peak Low stage of the Prismar stage's first threshold with three solidified prismarine crystals was not only impossible without a miracle, but it also wouldn't help Jason.
Everyone would be stronger than him, even if he could make the impossible possible, and there was only one state in which he would be able to defeat someone with a much higher rank.
Either, he would have to actively use external means like the Chaos attribute that didn't belong to him, or he would have to forcefully unseal his bloodline until it would almost tear his body apart!
Both the options were extremely bad because he didn't want to harm his body.
As such, he was about to reject the City Lord's proposal in order to walk the safe path, for the first time in a very long period, before Luna suddenly added something, out of the blue.
"Why are you already thinking of rejecting my proposal before even looking at the technique?"
This made Jason lift his head, only to look straight into the City Lord's eyes as two manuals appeared in front of him.
They were both Heaven-ranked cultivation manuals!
Jason didn't expect that the others would not choose the cultivation manuals, but after thinking about it again, that made sense to some extent.
'I guess they never hoped to get a Heaven rank technique, and thus chose a permanent Terra-Peak, or even -Superior cultivation technique?'
With his eyes glued on the manuals, he picked one to lightly skim through it.
However, not even ten minutes passed before he closed it once again with a frown on his face.
Picking the second manual suspended in the air, Jason read it as well, and similar to the first time, he closed it, barely within ten minutes.
With a deep sigh, he returned both manuals to the City Lord, only to state,
"I'm sorry, but it looks like I have to reject your proposal. With these cultivation techniques, I would be restricted to use only those two on a permanent basis... I want to be able to switch my techniques later!
Without a suitable technique, I won't be able to reach the combat prowess I have to achieve in order to survive on Kinra Island, even if I give my best..."
This caused the City Lord to stare at him in disbelief as she blurted out,
"Now you are picky too?! What is wrong with you and Jennifer, do you guys think we are at a charity event? How can you two be so weird?
As if you would easily find a Lunar ranked cultivation technique!!"
Looking at Jennifer, she simply grinned lightly, for the first time since the incident. Noticing the grin, Jason decided to reply with a smirk
"I'm pretty sure that even the Lunar ranked cultivation techniques won't limit me...I'm greedy you know!"
'And I know just how powerful my father's race is!!' He left the line unspoken while continuing to look at the City Lord as if he had nothing else to say.
Yet, only a moment later, Luna tried to calm herself as she turned towards the cadets.
"You guys can start preparing yourself! Jennifer will take you back to the hidden mountain. She will also accompany you guys in two months when it's time to depart!"
With that being said, Jennifer and the cadets were excused as they walked out of the main hall.
Jennifer was confused, but she had to train the cadets that were impatiently waiting to practice in their new techniques.
As such, she threw a concerned gaze at Jason before she finally left the hall.
'Nothing bad will happen, right?'

chapters.title: Chapter 689 - Scheming
chapters.content:
Once Jennifer and the cadets had left the main hall, the City Lord turned towards Jason, staring daggers at him.
"Just what's wrong with you? Where do you get the confidence to be able to procure a Lunar technique in the future?"
She sounded really annoyed which caused Jason to raise his right eyebrow as he didn't expect her to react like that.
'Why should she bother about the decision I make? It's not like I'm likely to procure an Immortal Eye, or whatever… Rather, I'll just die on Kinra island!'
His thoughts were quite straightforward, but instead of stating his thoughts out loud, he remained quiet.
"Why don't you think that I can obtain a cultivation manual at the Lunar rank? Those techniques might be mostly for Grand and Superior races to use, but why shouldn't I be able to procure a cultivation manual at that rank?"
His overly nonchalant tone caused the City Lord to look at him with squinted eyes. A few minutes passed in silence, and Jason was starting to feel uncomfortable under her gaze, only to hear a deep sigh.
"You're the same as Jennifer, stubbornly rejecting permanent techniques...are you really confident in finding a Lunar technique? How?"
Earlier, he had heard that Jennifer denied a high-graded Lunar rank cultivation technique because it would force her to permanently use it.
As such, Jason knew that Jennifer was also looking for even better techniques, even if the requirements her body needed were much higher.
If she wanted, Jennifer could cultivate in three different cultivation paths, each for one cultivation energy.
However, that would mean that she had to cultivate one technique after another.
Thus, Jennifer, or to be precise, the City Lord had to search for a suitable cultivation technique for her disciple, allowing her to cultivate in all three techniques at once.
Yet, to everyone's astonishment, Jennifer had denied accepting this technique because it would permanently restrict her from using any other cultivation technique.
This simple rejection had dumbfounded the City Lord, and those around, knowing that it was extremely difficult to find whatever Jennifer was looking for.
Fortunately enough, a Heaven-Intermediate cultivation technique with the suitable requirements had been found only a few years later, giving Jennifer the ability to skyrocketed her cultivation base to the stage she was now at.
For Jason, it would be less problematic to find a temporary cultivation manual because he only cultivated in one path.
Nevertheless, the City Lord was not Jason's master.
As such, she was not obliged to do anything for him.
Despite that, Luna decided that she would listen to his answer, before thinking of a solution because there was something that made her believe that it was essential to bring Jason to Kinra Island.
She was not sure about the reasoning, but it felt important for him, Jennifer, and even her own plan!
Thus, she calmed herself before staring at Jason, with all the impatience she could accumulate.
"I never know what my future will bring, but I'm not willing to accept a permanent cultivation technique at the Lunar rank!
I don't really care what others think about it, but owing to my heritage, I would probably be laughed at if I were to tell someone that I cultivate with a permanent Heaven-ranked cultivation technique.
To be honest, I don't think that it would be any different with a permanent Lunar ranked cultivation technique either, but I do not know that for sure!"
Jason's statement caused the City Lord to frown, but instead of complaining about his stubborn decision, she stopped for a moment, recalling the words he'd spoken.
'My heritage...laughed at...Wait!'
Staring at Jason, Luna suddenly asked with a slight hesitation.
"I think you once mentioned that your Aura and Stigma are natural...and also that your human heritage was enhanced due to your other bloodline, or am I wrong?"
Jason didn't move while looking at the City Lord but the words he said afterward caused her to feel a spark of excitement igniting within her.
"Everything you said is correct!"
At that moment, the City Lord's eyes went wide in shock.
'How did I never realise the treasure in front of me?!'
Her mind was rattling, and she forgot everything in her surroundings as she solely focused on Jason, who stood in front of her.
Suddenly an idea flashed through her mind, which caused her to take a deep breath as she released her mana in a specific direction.
This attracted Jason's interest, and he watched her curiously as she was accessing a storage device before he got distracted by the City Lord's following question.
"If I have a Heaven-ranked cultivation technique that wouldn't bind you to use it permanently, would you, first, enter Kinra Island, and second, answer me one question honestly?"
Jason was unable to comprehend why the City Lord was so desperate in trying to make him enter Kinra Island.
Because of that, he became suspicious of her intentions.
Despite that, Jason could clearly tell that she was not evil, otherwise, she would have subdued or even killed him the moment he arrived.
However, not knowing what she was scheming, he could only say,
"Even with a Heaven-ranked cultivation technique, would I be able to survive on Kinra Island? Let's be honest with each other, I am reckless and would normally enter any place that gives me specific opportunities.
Nevertheless, the land of Inheritances is something I won't be able to survive if other prodigies were to target me, which is not unlikely to happen.
One less competitor is what everyone wants after all!
I don't know what question you want to ask, but why should I risk my life for some unknown inheritance, if I have yet to fully unleash my bloodline, who knows if these inheritances are even suitable for me?
If you're serious, and you want me to go to Kinra Island, you will have to be honest with me, and even then I won't promise anything!!"
Right now, Jason wasn't going to be intimidated due to the fact that the City Lord was a powerhouse, or that she hated men because he wanted to make his stance clear.
She could force him to enter Kinra Island, but once he passed through the barrier, the City Lord would be unable to do anything to him, until the Island submerged once again.
As such, he remained honest, even if it could worsen his relationship with the City Lord.
However, that did not happen, and Luna could only look at Jason as a manual flew through the air, straight into his hands, before it stopped moving.
"Just take a look at it. Afterward, I'll tell you what I want from you, as well as some information about the inheritances.
I know you are weak in terms of cultivation base but I'm not oblivious to the extraordinary capabilities you have. Even if we ignore everything else, your eyes alone are unique enough to make me voice out a request.
You would be able to help Jennifer a lot, after all!
But now...read the technique first, afterward, I'll tell you what I truly want from you, okay?"
Jason just nodded his head, not even realising that he had already opened the manual.
Driven by his curiosity about the faintly glowing manual, Jason started to read, oblivious to the fact that his eyes were glued to the magical words written inside the technique.
Hours flew by, and it was only then that he lifted his head before he looked at the City Lord.
"This technique is...amazing!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 690 - Mythic Essence
chapters.content:
Almost everything about the technique that lay inside his hands was amazing, but the most impressive things were in fact two particular remarks.
[Remark: Mythic Essence Volume I can always be exchanged with other cultivation techniques.]
[Cautionary Warning: Mythic Essence Volume 1 requires an extreme degree of control over mythic energy; mana, superior Maest cultivation veins, very high pain tolerance, and free will.]
Jason found all of this already extremely interesting, however, there was also something else that piqued his curiosity.
[If two or three cultivation veins exist within the body, the practitioner is bound to sustain heavy injuries!]
Even if the other cultivation veins were not awakened, one would be unable to properly cultivate with the cultivation technique [Mythic Essence Vol. I].
As such, the technique was perfectly suited for Jason's current condition!
Because of that, he continued to read through the technique's first stage, only to lift his head when he realised just how strong the technique was.
Earlier, Jason thought that the difference between Heaven and Terra ranked techniques were little, but now, he couldn't help but ridicule himself to even think like that.
Shaking his head, Jason couldn't help but smile as he thought.
'As long as enough mana is in the surrounding area, It would be possible for me to accelerate my cultivation speed by multiple times…'
The requirements were harsh, and Jason knew that only races with extremely strong cultivation veins would be able to cultivate in it, without injuring themselves.
This should be intimidating, but instead, Jason couldn't help but feel that the technique was perfect for him.
Unfortunately, he couldn't openly show the City Lord how he felt because she would only continue to nudge him, trying to convince him to enter Kinra Island.
The technique was the best one he had seen in his entire life, and it didn't even force him to continue cultivating using the technique permanently.
As such, he was obviously interested in it, even more so after he realised that it was one of the unique Heaven-Intermediate ranked techniques.
In fact, the prefix 'Unique' was added because the effects it had were comparable to a technique at a higher rank, only for specific factors to degrade it to the Intermediate grade.
Thus, the manual Jason was holding had to be at the Heaven-Advanced rank at the bare minimum!
It was odd for the City Lord to own such a technique that was solely focused on mana, so Jason couldn't help but eye her for a moment.
"Are you cultivating in the Mythic Essence cultivation technique?"
Because there was no need to hide it, the City Lord nodded her head as she nonchalantly answered,
"It's one of the strongest techniques I acquired in my entire life. You may have to endure unbearable pain, but the speed at which you can cultivate is extreme. The first stage is just the beginning, and once you become immune to pain, you should try cultivating in the second stage.
Not only will the Mythic Essence technique allow you to cultivate at a rapid pace but your mana will also be purified while your Maest cultivation veins will be strengthened because they will be pulled to the extent that they almost tear apart!
The technique is dangerous, but also the reason for how I was able to reach my current cultivation base, despite being a mutant, with only a Maest cultivation path!"
When Jason heard this he almost exclaimed, only to think inwardly, 'I thought she was not from Manyr?!'
Apparently, that was wrong, which made it even weirder for her eyes to appear as they did.
Furthermore, Jason would have expected that humans that had awoken the Maest cultivation path would be treated well.
However, according to her eyes that had a faint trace of sadness lingering within them, this had to be wrong.
'Maybe their traditions have now changed compared to a few millennia ago?' He wondered, not sure how old Luna was, let alone what the Aeus, Devirs, or Manyrs' tradition had looked like during that time.
When Jason had been inside the Neutral city, he had not been able to see the true potential of their tradition as it was restricted.
Other than that, he didn't even leave the manor most of the time because he had more than enough things to pay attention to.
The fact that she was willing to hand over the cultivation technique she was using for herself, indicated that she would give up a lot as long as he would come with Jennifer and the other cadets to Kinra island.
As such, he decided that it was only fair to listen intently to what the City Lord was about to say.
While waiting for her to voice out the reason she wanted him to enter Kinra island expressly, and what kind of inheritances existed on it, Jason tried to comprehend the facts he had already acquired.
'With that technique, I might be able to enter the peak of the Lique stage in a mere two months, while focusing on other things simultaneously…'
This realisation was shocking, but at the same time, it clearly showed the City Lord's determination.
It didn't take long for Luna to start her explanation that was short but with everything Jason had to know for now.
"To be precise, I want you to follow Jennifer, and warn her about all kinds of dangers. There are hidden dangers inside the Inheritance sites, and someone who can see energy fluctuations should be able to detect most of them easily.
Your eyes are more important in places like inheritance sites than you might imagine, and your ability will come in handy if Jennifer has to face other opponents.
If you were to provide her with the necessary information, Jennifer will be able to know everything about her opponent, allowing her to create countermeasures before the opponent unveiled their trump card.
Other than that, I feel as if it's only possible to procure the Immortal Eye with your help. As such, I'm willing to lend you the technique I use, under the condition that you answer me one question!"
She didn't say anything about the inheritance sites, but instead, she handed him another file that looked similar to the first one.
However, this time it was thicker.
As such, with two files about Kinra Island Jason would have enough intel to make his final decision soon.
Considering that the City Lord asked him to follow Jennifer, he would be much safer than going alone.
She was amongst the strongest individuals that were allowed to enter Kinra Island, after all.
Thus, his reluctance dwindled to a certain extent.
Nevertheless, Jason didn't forget the fact that he and Jennifer could get separated on the island.
'With enough time before and while being at Kinra island while cultivating with the Mythic Essence technique, I should be able to increase my strength to a certain extent.
My solidified prismarine crystals should also be stronger than commonly found ones. I use unique mana drops to solidify them, after all!'
His reasoning was logical and quite simple at that. As such, Jason knew that if he were to enter the Prismar stage, with a single solidified prismarine crystal, he would be able to reach a much higher combat prowess than anyone else.
Additionally, the faster he was able to cultivate, the more minor seals he would be able to break, which was quite advantageous.
In the end, he had already found his answer, but with the imminent dangers of having a majority of peak Prismar stage beings in a land where everyone wanted to obtain an Inheritance for themselves, Jason couldn't help but feel a little bit off.
Yet, just a moment later, Jason slapped his forehead as he called himself stupid.
'Since when did I start backing off in face of dangers...Aren't dangers the perfect place to overcome one's boundaries?'

chapters.title: Chapter 691 - Revealed
chapters.content:
The more Jason thought about refusing to enter Kinra Island, the less likely he was to overcome the dangers that were bound to occur at any moment.
It was because the lands of Inheritances was a great opportunity for him, and evidently also for others.
There were dangers on Kinra Island too, but that was only obvious because nobody would give up on their chance to enter the Inheritance sites, while it was likely to be even more difficult to overcome the trials to obtain an inheritance.
However, with the Mythic Essence cultivation technique, Jason knew that his combat prowess could increase tremendously, even if he wouldn't find or search for an inheritance.
With that in mind, he knew that it shouldn't be too much of a difficulty to cultivate while simultaneously walking around with Jennifer, who could protect him.
As such, rather than thinking about rejecting the City Lord's offer, Jason was slowly growing convinced that it was best to enter Kinra Island owing to the opportunities it presented, the fact that Jennifer would protect him, and that the Mythic Essence technique's worth was tremendous.
Without dangers, there wouldn't be benefits because nothing was given to someone without expecting something in return.
That was how a trade-off worked, and there were exceptions, but not many if one were to exclude master-disciple relationships where the master was nurturing the disciple without receiving anything particular in return.
There may be some advantages one could make use of by having a disciple, but in the end, it was more of a burden to teach a disciple than anything else.
Now, while staring straight into the City Lord's eyes, Jason felt that her earlier answer was genuine.
As such, given the information and the fact that he shouldn't back off from doing something he wanted to, just because there were some dangers involved, Jason agreed to the City Lord's proposal only to ask.
"You said, I have to answer one question if I want to use the Mythic Essence cultivation technique? Do you really think one question is worth lending me the strongest technique you have?"
Jason's agreement caused the City Lord to sigh in relief, which was odd to see, only for her to come back to her senses a moment later before simply stating,
"If it's possible for us to obtain an Immortal Eye, and for Jennifer to receive an Inheritance, everything is worth it.
I have already memorised everything about the Mythic Essence technique, so the manual itself doesn't hold the same importance to me as before.
As for the question I have in mind, consider it as a bonus to my request to obtain the Immortal eye, and the help you're supposed to provide Jennifer with!"
After saying this, the City Lord halted for a moment, only to finally ask the question she had on her mind for a long time.
"Before leaving to cultivate, please answer the following questions- I know you have the human race's bloodline within you, but what race does the other bloodline within you belong to?"
Hearing the question, Jason nodded his head.
He had expected to hear this question or a similar one with the same answer sooner or later.
As such, he was unfazed by the question and answered in all honesty.
"My second bloodline is that of the Celestia race!"
The moment he said this, Luna's eyes widened before they turned angry as she asked disbelievingly
"Don't joke with me! How is that possible?!"
This was a reaction he didn't expect.
Because of that, he could only look at the City Lord in confusion.
"It's true though."
He wanted to explain further, but before Jason could speak another word, the City Lord had already lifted her hand stopping him.
"Instead of lying, you can simply say that you don't want to reveal your secret.
I understand the dangers of unveiling the seemingly inconspicuous bloodline as it is the case for Jennifer, who also happens to be a halfling, but don't lie to me!
Do you even know what you are saying right now?? The Celestia race is not something you should mention so casually. You might think it is funny and just joke around right now, but if they were to hear what you were saying right now, your life would end faster than you think!!
If someone ever asks you what race you hail from, never say the same!
The Celestia race is known for their purity, and they would eliminate everyone who tarnished their reputation, purity, and so on.
A halfling of their race would be killed before he or she was even born!"
What the City Lord said caused goosebumps to erupt all over his body as he looked at her in doubt.
'If what the City Lord says is really the case, did my father try to protect me without letting even a single individual of the Celestia race know?
And...why did Wisse believe me when I said I'm a Celestia if the City Lord's words are really true?'
More and more confusion spread through Jason's mind as he subconsciously mumbled his next thought out loud.
"Just what is the Celestia race?... Will they really kill me once I encounter one of them?... And, can I even survive encountering them?"
Many thoughts rattled his brain as he began to ask himself about his heritage. The Celestia bloodline was extremely powerful, but it had created more problems for him than he could imagine.
At the same time, the thought of venturing into Kinra Island became more exciting by the moment as Jason realised that he had to become much stronger, the faster, the better.
While thousands of thoughts were flashing through Jason's mind, the City Lord looked at his expressions and his body language that depicted his confusion.
She was angered that he'd lied to her without batting an eye, but after looking at the young man in front of her for some time, she felt that his reaction to her words was shocking.
The way he reacted was not something one could easily face, even less because it seemed that Jason had no idea what or who the Celestia race truly was.
Because of that, she couldn't help but calm down as a single, seemingly impossible thought manifested in her mind.
'Is it possible...that he didn't lie?'
Only a moment after she thought this, Jason seemed to have regained his cool to some extent.
"I'm sorry to ask this, but where can I procure more information about the Celestia race? I encountered a few beings but their knowledge about this race was shallow, and nobody was able to tell me more about them.
What you said was the most I figured out until now, other than the fact that one can turn into an Infernal Celestia if the emotions within them take over the rational Celestia's mind, controlling them, and corroding their mind."
This question only caused Luna to be even more confused as she assumed that Jason never encountered his father.
'Maybe he really thinks that he is a Celestia, and doesn't know his real race?' That assumption was the most likely thing to have happened in Luna's opinion.
Thus, she took a deep breath before starting to explain to Jason everything she knew about the Celestia race.
It was not much, but Jason listened intently to every word Luna spoke.
She had calmed down and genuinely believed that Jason merely thought that he was a Celestia but in reality, he wasn't. As such, she just told him everything she had heard about them, a long time ago.
Less than 10 minutes passed before she was done because she didn't know much about them. But, Jason's expression had brightened as he mumbled.
"Shima again...just what kind of planet is that?"

chapters.title: Chapter 692 - Next Goal
chapters.content:
"Just what kind of planet is that?" He mumbled, only to hear the City Lord's prompt answer.
"Shima is an infinitely large planet that is said to have been birthed by devouring an entire universe! Don't ask me how that works, I don't know that either…"
After that she halted for a moment, only to say.
"I can tell that you want to find out more about the Celestia race, but that's not useful for now....cultivate and become strong enough to find out more about your true heritage.
If you have more questions about the Celestia race, look for someone who has researched races, or someone who might know them!"
Jason noticed the way the City Lord said 'true heritage' but he dropped the topic, not understanding why Luna didn't believe him.
Little did he know that it was a perfectly normal reaction of her to act as she did, and it was more of Jason's obliviousness that was the issue.
'If someone asks me about my heritage, should I name a different race for the time being?' He thus wondered, only to be unable to think of a race to mention.
At that moment, Jason truly realised that his knowledge was very shallow about many things and he still had a lot to learn.
However, without being able to fill the gaps in his knowledge right off the bat, Jason rather focused on increasing his strength.
That was the most important for now, followed by procuring knowledge.
Simultaneously, he would have to finish cleansing the dead mana vein in Spyro, preferably before it hatched.
However, that was not much of an issue, and rather easy in comparison to increasing his strength to the extent he wanted it to reach.
As such, he bid farewell to the City Lord, tightly grasping the Mythic Essence cultivation manual before leaving the main hall.
In the past hour or so, many things had occurred, and he had learned and obtained many things.
'So...Kinra Island is...my next goal!'
Jason was still oblivious to the City Lord's true goal, but instead of focusing on that, he decided to focus on himself, and the minuscule possibility that he might be able to procure an inheritance if he were to be extremely fortunate!
The chance was small, but even if he wouldn't be fortunate enough it didn't matter.
To put it simply, Jason was already satisfied with the Mythic Essence technique, and very excited about the chance to procure smaller rewards if he were to enter an Inheritance site with Jennifer, which would certainly happen.
Because of that, he had to increase his strength to the highest possible degree, using every single second to cultivate efficiently.
However, first of all, he had to fully memorise the first stage of the Mythic Essence technique.
This took almost two weeks, but at the same time, Jason was able to take care of Spyro's dead mana veins, which were now fully expelled.
As such, the Spiral Spirit was now using its fullest potential, even if its body had yet to recuperate from the damages it had obtained earlier.
With six weeks left before they would depart, Jason could finally start cultivating with the Mythic Essence technique.
Circulating a tremendous amount of mana through his mana vein as described, he started to cultivate and it felt as if they were on fire, but Jason endured everything without letting the slightest gasp escape his lips.
Meanwhile, Petri and Solaris were using their own means to cultivate, trying not to fall behind Jason, whose cultivation speed accelerated drastically.
Overcoming the pain, Jason's cultivation speed increased by more than four times, only for his proficiency in the first stage to increase slowly.
He was still far away from reaching the peak of the first stage, but the results he'd already obtained were more than satisfying.
As such, Jason grew immune to the pain as his mana core began to heat up owing to the rapid pace at which mana was circulated through his body.
His entire mana had been divided into six streams that had to be controlled at the same time, while more and more mana was absorbed from the surrounding.
With Petri, Solaris, and his own Stigma fully unleashed, their effects increased as they overlapped, only for the Celestia aura to merge with the Stigmas' capacities, further elevating the mana circulation speed.
Thus, Jason's cultivation speed was much higher compared to others at the same proficiency of the Mythic Essence technique.
Nevertheless, he never slacked off and was fully focused on cultivating as if his life was on the line.
That was, in fact, exactly the case because Jason knew that he had to reach the highest possible strength in order to survive on Kinra Island and not become a burden on Jennifer!
Because of that, he couldn't reveal his entire joy when he attained the peak of the Lique stage, liquefying the 10,000 highly compressed mana drops.
Jason was happy, but at the same time, he knew that he shouldn't compare his present achievement to the standards of Argos anymore.
Right now, he was on Manyr, and according to his age,, he should have reached the peak of the Prismar stage already if one were to consider the cultivation technique he used and his talent.
That was if he had been born on Manyr, which was, however, not the case.
Considering that it had been around a year since he arrived on Manyr, Jason felt that he had achieved a lot.
As such, there was no need for him to compare himself to others.
Everyone had their own talent and prowess that gave them specific advantages or disadvantages.
With that in mind, Jason focused solely on himself and his soulbonds that were working relentlessly, just like him.
Spyro had hatched shortly before Jason had been able to reach the peak of the Lique stage, which was great because the little Spiral Spirit could finally start absorbing spirit force without any issue, while simultaneously enhancing Jason's mind.
The amplification from a Spiral beast was different compared to the other two enhancements he received because only his brain and mind were affected.
His mind felt as if it was on fire and then beaten to a pulp, the first time he received Spyro's enhancement.
Afterward, the pain had drastically reduced, and it was negligible in face of the Mythic Essence cultivation technique's pain.
However, what was definitely not negligible was Spyro's form!
This was something that had overjoyed Jason because Spyro's true form was anything but a disadvantage, it was a formless Spirit!
As such, every form and shape could be used at any time, as if it was Spyro's true form.
Jason found this to be exceptional, and the only slight disadvantage was that Spyro's cultivation base had to be high enough for it to make complex shapes.
But that was only logical in Jason's opinion.
While Spyro had finally hatched, Artemis was still evolving, and Petri had increased its physical strength at a rapid pace.
Even if the basilisk was unable to use any technique, with enough pure and highly qualitative primordial energy around, it was impossible not to accelerate his cultivation speed.
Jason didn't have any cultivation stones left to use, but oddly enough, both Jennifer and the City Lord had offered some extremely high-quality cultivation stones in all three varieties to him.
Each was for one of his soulbonds, and Artemis was eager to devour the mana stones that could accelerate her evolution to a certain degree.
Despite that, it would still take a long time for the evolution to be completed.
Thus, Solaris was using the majority of mana stones, in order to accumulate enough mana to create the second solidified prismarine crystal.
This was easier said than done because one had to accumulate energy, liquefy mana once again and then start the compression process.
Despite the difficulties, nobody complained because the arduous part of cultivating would just start in the Prismar stage.
With every cultivation stage, the complexity of work and the efforts one had to put in increased, and Jason was already eager to see how his future path would be, and where it would lead him.
Two months had passed, and they were about to depart to Kinra Island, which made Jason clench his fists as he felt his strength, glad about having accepted the City Lord's offer.
'Let's go!'

chapters.title: Chapter 693 - Liveform
chapters.content:
Emerging from a gigantic portal, Jason and the others arrived in the center of a bustling city.
The smell of the ocean permeated the air, and Jason couldn't help but smile as he took in a deep breath.
After he, Jennifer, and the cadets had gathered in the main hall, on the day of their departure, Luna brought them to the portal hall, where they selected one of the public open portals.
As such, they emerged in the closest city to the area in which Kinra island had emerged.
Normally, the city wasn't as crowded as in recent days, which was all thanks to the news about the resurfaced lands of Inheritances that turned it into a sort of tourist attraction in a matter of days.
However, what Jason noticed almost immediately was the fact that there were not only Aeus, Devirs, and Manyrs, but also individuals from other races, and quite a few of them.
Unable to hold back all powerhouses of other races, the three races that reigned Julandra region came to the consensus that it was best to allow a specific number of Specta powerhouses to enter the region.
They were labeled Embassy, but in fact, their only task was to bring a few prodigies of their race to Kinra island.
In order to prevent a war from breaking out, this had been a necessity otherwise they would have faced a backlash and anger of more than ten races who would have voiced out their disappointment.
Due to the limited number of people allowed inside, Jason was not able to see many new races that were living on Manyr.
Upon investigating their cultivation base, their unique traits, and whether they even had the possibility to awaken more than one cultivation vein, he swiftly determined the race's strength.
It was just a rough guess about the entire race's strength, but he realised yet again that having more than one cultivation vein was rare.
This cemented his initial assumption of their might since he had encountered the three races of the Julandra region.
This was completely different to the Aeus, Devirs, and Manyrs all of which had two cultivation veins, even if it was normal to awaken only one of them.
As such, Jason could tell that the other races were taking these three races as a threat, even if the Manyrs were deemed as less significant than the Aeus and Devirs.
Nevertheless, there were more than enough human powerhouses on Manyr, and it was only the majority of Manyrs that were too weak.
At least, that was what they assumed to be, even if it was not the case.
Jason knew that the Manyrs were extremely strong as long as they would try to adjust to their uniqueness while also switching the techniques they used because the Devir and Aeus races' techniques were not quite suitable for humans.
Because of that, Jason thought that it might turn into an opportunity for the oppressed Manyrs to change their fate if they were to collide with other races from outside the Julandra region.
It was not unlikely and after giving it some more thought, Jason even felt that it had already happened.
With that possibility in mind, the attack on the manor made both more and less sense than before.
Jason was unable to comprehend the scheming behind the attack, but the same applied to what Luna was planning.
He had been unable to figure out the use of the Immortal eye in correlation with something that could help Luna achieve whatever she wanted to do with it.
Even if he knew the answer, it wouldn't help him procure an Immortal eye, because it was extremely difficult given his current strength.
As such, Jason had begun to create a small priority list in his mind that had their survival as the first and foremost priority.
This was only obvious, and the second was to remain unscathed.
Following that there were all kinds of things Jason wanted to achieve during the following months, but most of them were logical such as advancing to the Prismar stage.
He was not sure how long this would take with the Mythic Essence cultivation technique after it was enhanced with the usage of three Stigmas and his Celestia aura, but it shouldn't be too long.
If he were to solely focus on solidifying his first prismarine crystal, Jason assumed that it wouldn't even take an entire month.
However, given his situation, Jason would be happy if he were to advance to the Prismar stage in three months.
Nonetheless, their first task was now to leave the bustling city and travel through the ocean for several days straight.
This was not a problem for Prismar stage beings, let alone everyone with wings, but Artemis was evolving, and he had yet to procure the capabilities to learn flying without wings.
As such, he had to resort to using Solaris, with which Jason summoned seemingly ordinary wings.
The flames he manifested were rigid, unmoving and they looked exactly like black feathered wings.
Solaris' control over its flame had increased tremendously, and as long as the wings didn't have a specific purpose such as attaining the highest possible speed, excluding flying, the little black origin flame was able to do everything.
There were many things Jason would love to test out with Solaris, but as always, time was ticking, and he didn't have enough of it to do everything he wanted to.
As such, Jason remained silent as he focused on everything he could while following Luna, Jennifer and the other cadets through the air.
His flying speed was amongst the lowest, but Luna was not in a hurry.
Instead, she wanted everyone to continue to try comprehending more about the techniques they were learning before she would take them back.
This was not necessary for Jason because he had fully memorised the first stage of the Mythic Essence, and it would take him a long time to even come close to the second stage.
Thus, Jason decided to use the following days to study the files about Kinra Island, the inheritances on top of it, before passively cultivating while moving around.
Every cultivation technique could be utilised while being on the move, and in full concentration when one was seated on the ground.
As such, Jason had also learned to use the Mythic Essence cultivation technique while moving around.
This was a necessity, and extremely helpful to come one step closer to his target of advancing to the Prismar stage in a fully focused stage ignoring all the noises or movements that would unnecessarily distract him as he followed Luna, who had erected a protective dome around everyone.
The protection dome was a necessity because merely three days after they had departed from the bustling city, ravaging storms had begun to appear out of nowhere.
These storms were by no means something beings below the Ascendion stage would survive.
Even they would have difficulties in keeping themselves secure and not get torn apart, yet, Jason didn't notice any of that.
Only when they arrived in the center of all the storms, did he regain his senses when he bumped into Jennifer, who had halted in her tracks, the moment they arrived in the calm center of the storm.
Completing his cultivation, Jason rubbed his dry eyes before he began to look around, trying to evaluate the strength of the other beings that were filling the sky above Kinra Island.
There was nothing special about most powerhouses, and even the prodigies were just stronger than ordinary beings but didn't have any unique traits to differentiate them from the others.
At least Jason was unable to see them, but that was mostly the case owing to the concealment device they were using.
It was similar to the one Jennifer was also using, and only if he were to insert more mana into his eyes, or approach the prodigies, would he be able to figure out more about their secret.
However, he did no such thing because Jason was distracted the moment he looked at the ginormous island that was more like a small country.
Yet, the size was not what distracted Jason, but something completely different, and he could barely stop himself from shouting out loud.
'What the hell...is the island alive?!?'

chapters.title: Chapter 694 - Open
chapters.content:
Staring in confusion at the gigantic island, Jason couldn't believe what his Emperor Eyes were indicating to him.
Thinking that he was hallucinating, he rubbed them, expecting to see something different once he opened them once again.
However, that didn't happen, and everything was exactly the same which caused Jason to be utterly dumbfounded.
Because of that, he didn't even notice that Jennifer and the others had already moved ahead, increasing the gap between him and themselves.
Apparently, Kinra island's barrier was still fully activated, preventing entry to anybody who tried to venture inside it.
Thus, this time could be used to cultivate as one remained in the sky.
Without realising that the others had already gone farther ahead, Jason's entire mind was solely focused on the island as he subconsciously blurted out.
"Is that...a fucking Tortoise?"
Through the Emperor Eyes, Jason was able to see many things, including energy currents, and the island in front of him was overflowing with it.
However, this also included everything below the surface, which he was able to see clearly.
As such, he saw a ginormous head of a Tortoise more than a hundred meters below the water surface, cultivation veins, and a large vessel that was visible to no one else.
His accidental discovery caused Jason to be utterly dumbfounded, but before could continue looking at everything, he heard unfamiliar voices behind him.
Turning around, he saw that Jennifer and the rest were not there anymore.
Instead, there were powerhouses of a race he didn't know with their disciples that were talking to each other while throwing furtive glances at him once in a while.
Their eyes appeared to mock him, and it was not difficult for Jason to visualise what they had been talking about.
Nevertheless, he simply ignored it.
Rather than taking their provocation to heart, Jason searched for his group and joined them.
When Jennifer saw him, she couldn't help herself as she smiled lightly.
"If you don't like being with our group you can search for a new one!"
Her expression turned serious, but the tone suggested that she was teasing him.
As such, Jason could only sigh, not sure what she intended to say.
"Don't play around with me..."
After that, they continued to talk with each other, only for the cadets to join their conversation.
They were tense, and upon seeing that both Jason and Jennifer were extremely calm, they relaxed visibly.
None of them was sure how much time had passed, but it was nearing sunset when strong energy currents were released from Kinra Island.
Following that, the barrier, which one could see through a partially transparent glamor, began to shine brighter, which made the prodigies scamper to hastily enter Kinra Island as quickly as possible.
Jennifer and the other cadets were among them, and they began to approach the island the moment Luna wished them good luck, bidding them farewell.
At that moment, Jason was instinctively dragged by Jennifer, only for her to notice what she was doing.
Thus, she let go of his arm before acting as if nothing happened as she continued to walk towards the island.
However, Jason's mind was elsewhere and not focused on the land of the inheritances, but on the being that carried the entire, gigantic island on its back.
He was not even sure what kind of cultivation base the Tortoise had because it was not possible for him to peer inside its vessel.
Many things were concealed from him, including most of the things except the mammoth of the being he was diving towards.
In fact, he was not even able to see the entire Island because it was too gigantic, and it was fortunate that they had been in front of the unmoving Tortoise.
Jason was not sure whether it was hibernating, cultivating, or doing something else, but there should be a reason for it to emerge in the same area every few centuries.
At that moment, he noticed something, which caused him to halt in his tracks for a moment.
'Oh...I forgot to tell them that Kinra Island is a living being!' Jason thought when he noticed that he could have told Luna, or Jennifer about what he had figured out.
Unfortunately, it was already too late, but at the same time, it didn't make a huge difference whether someone knew about the identity of the island, or not to begin with.
As such, he could only shrug his shoulders before he followed Jennifer and the cadets towards the Island.
The barrier that had opened a small pathway was exactly located above the Tortoise's head.
It slowly opened up like curtains that parted aside, increasing the space for the masses of people to squeeze through.
However, that was exactly what caused the entire situation to become even more chaotic because everyone wanted to be the first to enter the Lands of inheritances.
He feared that a stampede would break out with the way people rushed forward thinking that they would be one step closer to procuring an Inheritance because of that.
Unfortunately, Jason knew better that it was not easy to procure an inheritance because he had studied the files he had received, to perfection.
As such, the moment he appeared next to Jennifer, he suggested,
"Once we're inside, let's spend a few days to figure out the location of all exposed Inheritance sites! It's useless to try entering just any of the structures without knowing whether the inheritance is suitable for us or not.
It doesn't make a difference whether we enter the Inheritance site earlier or later, to begin with. Everyone's starting point is the same."
While Jennifer nodded her head, calming down from her earlier excitement, the cadets' opinion was different.
They rushed inside the crowd of beings that wanted to enter Kinra Island quickly, ignoring Jason's comment.
Unbothered by this, Jason was glad that at least Jennifer listened to him because he would be forced to follow her, otherwise.
He wanted to ensure a certain degree of safety from being around her, after all!
In the end, he was still too weak, which was obvious because his cultivation base had yet to advance to the Prismar stage.
It wouldn't take long, and just several weeks but he had to patiently wait for it to happen.
However, even then, Jason knew that the average strength of those that entered Kinra Island was at the peak of the Prismar stage.
At the same time, it was the limit at which beings could enter the gigantic island
Nevertheless, owing to the dangers looming inside the island, in addition to the fact that others were likely to attack each other, Jason was in need of Jennifer.
At least for now, even if he didn't like it!
Suddenly, just as the first beings had entered Kinra Island, he heard a familiar voice from behind, calling out his name.
"Jason! You are here too?"
Turning around he saw a group of more than ten Manyrs, with Miranda, the young woman who had tricked him with the Aeus race's 21st Prince, standing in front of them, greeting him with a bright smile.
Even if Jason had already forgiven the two for their prank at the bi-annual auction event in Lanro, he didn't like the fact that Miranda and the Prince had tried to play around with him.
As such, he greeted her unwillingly before showing signs of turning back towards the island's entrance.
This was noticed by the Manrys behind Miranda, who couldn't help but feel offended because Jason didn't pay any attention to them, treating them as if they were worthless.
Because of that, one of the women amongst their group was about to lecture Jason, only to be held back by Miranda as she said,
"Don't even try...it would be quite embarrassing to report to your family how a being at the Peak Lique stage was able to kill you…"

chapters.title: Chapter 695 - Dangers
chapters.content:
"Don't even try...it would be quite embarrassing to report to your family of how a being at the Peak Lique stage was able to kill you…"
These words caused the woman to halt in her tracks as she stared at Miranda in confusion.
"My lady, please don't joke with me like that. His mana fluctuations may be a little bit stronger than a being at the Lique stage, but I'm at the Peak of the Prismar stage!
Please don't underestimate me…"
However, Miranda didn't seem bothered by that as she replied,
"I want to build a good relationship with him. I feel like he will be able to gain something huge inside the lands of Inheritances! If you attack him, don't even try to seek protection if he is more powerful than you imagine either.
Hearing the seriousness in Miranda's voice, even the others who were similarly annoyed by Jason's arrogance couldn't help but look at their leader in doubt.
'Why is she thinking so highly of him?' They wondered, not sure of what made Jason so unique.
His looks were leagues above their own, and his combat prowess seemed to be higher than his cultivation base.
Nevertheless, the only truly unique feature about the young man, whose back was facing them, was probably his golden eyes.
His stigma and aura could not be detected by them because the stigma was deactivated while the Celestia aura was retracted.
As such, Jason's true capabilities were hidden from oblivious beings, even if he didn't actively conceal his mana fluctuations.
Because of that, the other Manyrs were unable to understand why Miranda was exaggerating.
However, Jason, who had heard her, only nodded his head, which was noticed by Miranda, before he and Jennifer approached the entrance of the island.
They were flying slowly, without rushing to get inside.
Instead, they were already looking at the large building through the barrier, trying to figure out which inheritance site they could start searching.
Some buildings were just ruins without anything inside, while the Inheritance sites were clear for them to see.
At least, that was what everyone had initially thought.
Little did they know that the desolate and destroyed remains of the buildings that looked like ruins were Inheritance sites as well.
Yet, entering them wasn't as easy as it looked like and there were certain requirements one had to meet.
Other than those ruins that had specific criteria to make someone eligible to enter them, there were also places one could only enter with a specific personality, which was interesting.
At the same time, the latter requirement caused some beings to be enraged because there was a specific inheritance site that could only be entered by those who displayed chivalry.
Said inheritance site gave extraordinary rewards, even if one were to be unable to obtain the entire inheritance.
As such, everyone was eager to venture inside it, only to be unable to.
Despite that, there was something else Jason and Jennifer were looking for.
There were many unknown inheritances that had been untouched and hidden from the naked eye, but specific clues hinted at the requirements one had to meet.
Because of that, Jennifer hoped that there was an inheritance that allowed her to make use of the three cultivation energies within her body.
A specific inheritance site for beings that awoke all three cultivation paths would be the best, but neither Jason nor Jennifer had heard of such a place inside Kinra Island.
Meanwhile, Jason was trying to help Jennifer figure out which inheritance sites they could see.
However, he was distracted by the gigantic head of the Tortoise which made him look at it every now and then.
'When will I be able to bind a beast like that?' He could only ask himself, with a glint of excitement in his eyes.
Right now, Jason was not even able to figure out what kind of existence the Tortoise truly was, let alone its cultivation base.
Nevertheless, considering that not even the powerhouses at the Specta stage didn't know that Kinra island was, in fact, a living being, it had to be one of the strongest beings on Manyr.
At least, that was what Jason assumed because beings at the Specta stage were reigning small territories, while those ranked above, should reign the lands.
In the end, he could also be wrong, but that didn't really matter to Jason because his eyes were glued to the tremendous streams of mana that swept through the Tortoise.
It caused his entire body to be covered with goosebumps, which Jennifer noticed, only to follow his gaze.
"Why are you looking at the water? Is there something that excites you?" She asked innocently, only to feel astonished about the bright smile on his face.
Jason was visualising how it would be to bind the Gigantic Island Tortoise, but at the same time, he knew that his soul energy and soul crystal were too low, to even dream of something like that.
Furthermore, his body would be torn apart, the moment he bound a being such as the Tortoise below them.
Hearing Jennifer's question, Jason regained his senses to some extent which caused him to answer her honestly,
"It's the Tortoise."
His voice sounded exciting, but Jennifer couldn't help but be confused.
'Is he ill?' She asked herself, lifting her hand to touch his forehead, out of instinct.
This move caused both of them to stiffen for a moment as Jason looked at Jennifer.
The two couldn't help but stare into each other's eyes for a few moments before Jennifer retracted her hand quickly as she cleared her throat in embarrassment.
"We should enter Kinra Island now!"
She thus said before flying closer to the entrance, where the initial crowd of beings had thinned with the majority having entered the island.
Jason just nodded his head and followed Jennifer with emotions surging within him which he had never felt before.
'Am I becoming ill?'
After reaching the entrance, it took them only half an hour before they were able to pass through the barrier.
At that moment, dense energy currents swept through their body, invigorating them, and both couldn't help but feel excited.
'Even without focusing on cultivating, I can enter the Prismar stage in no time owing to the density and purity of mana!'
While Jason prepared himself to enter the Prismar stage, Jennifer wanted to complete the preparations to be ready to advance to the Ascendion stage at any moment.
She was unable to enter the Ascendion stage while being on Kinra Island, but it was still possible for her to prepare everything beforehand.
Afterward, the advancement procedure would be less burdensome for her.
As such, by simply entering Kinra Island, many things would become easier.
Owing to the excitement they felt just by sensing the energy waves, both forgot about the incident that had happened only half an hour before.
However, their excitement quickly evaporated because it was only two minutes later that they flew past the first inheritance site, which was in fact a large tower.
Jason recalled the tower from the file Luna had given him, but that was not what caused both Jennifer and Jason to grow serious.
In fact, what caused them to be alert was that they were able to see hundreds of Peak Prismar stage beings fighting against each other.
Not even an hour had passed since the barrier that led towards Kinra Island had opened, but the corpses of more than 10 beings were already lying on the ground.
This clearly showed how dangerous Kinra Island was, and that was not because of the inheritance site's dangers, but other beings' greed!

chapters.title: Chapter 696 - Pulled
chapters.content:
With dozens of beings fighting against each other right in front of the closest inheritance site, Jason couldn't help but shake his head.
There were multiple inheritance sites in the vicinity, and it was said that there were a total of more than 100 Inheritance sites in total.
As such, Jason had no clue why they were already fighting.
Instead of arguing and starting a blood bath, they could have just chosen a different Inheritance.
It was not even as if the tower was the only inheritance site on the entire island and there had to be many more extraordinary places waiting to be discovered.
"I guess that's the issue with inheritance sites that allow only a limited number of people inside…" Jennifer said before turning away from the tower, looking out for other structures.
Unfortunately, as expected, every inheritance site in the vicinity was besieged by dozens, if not more than a hundred beings that wanted to enter them.
This was perfectly normal in Jason's opinion, and Jennifer didn't seem to be shocked about it either.
However, Jason was now even happier to have entered the island with Jennifer because he could determine that most beings that had succumbed to their ill fate, were below the Peak Prismar stage, or simply unfortunate.
"Can we look for a suitable inheritance site for me for a while and enter a different one if we don't find one that is perfectly compatible with me?" Jennifer asked, to which Jason nodded.
It was not like he had a choice, to begin with, but at the same time, he wanted to find an inheritance that was suitable for him too.
From his understanding, the City Lord had received an inheritance, which had caused her eye color to change.
He was not sure what the use of this was because Jason was unable to perceive anything special about her eyes.
Nevertheless, he could tell that she had obtained the Mythic Essence technique from Kinra Island too.
At least, that was what Jason comprehended after everything he had heard from Luna, in addition to the information written in the two files about the island.
If that was not intriguing enough, Luna had also mentioned that she had been unable to procure an entire Inheritance and that what she had received was just a fraction of it.
As such, the rewards she had gained were not the best among the best!
With that in mind, it was difficult for Jason to not be excited.
Despite that, he tried to not be overly excited.
Instead, he and Jennifer flew through the sky, looking around for all kinds of buildings and structures before approaching them.
After that, they tried to figure out which inheritance it was and whether it was worth exploring further. Then they left quickly before anyone could follow and attack them.
Even if Jennifer was confident in her strength, it was not necessary to offend anyone, and fight every single person who tried to provoke them.
Instead, it was best to hold back their strength and reveal it only when necessary.
Through this, they had an additional surprise factor which was what they should make use of to avoid conflicts to the max.
Their well thought strategy seemed to work as more than three days passed without anything special happening.
While flying around, Jason focussed on absorbing pure mana, while compressing the first few drops of liquefied mana.
With a total of 10,000 drops of mana, the foundation to build the first solidified prismarine crystal was the most important.
As such, the small crystal he started to construct had to be perfect.
He didn't want to make a single mistake, which was the reason for him to take his time.
Even if it was important to improve his strength quickly, creating a flawed crystal would only make everything worse.
However, nothing would happen to his solidified prismarine crystal, because Jason was actively using his stigma, while summoning both Petri and Solaris, only to activate their stigma too.
This allowed him to control his mana to an even higher extent, giving him an additional boost in accuracy, only to intertwine the Celestia aura within the depths of the prismarine crystal.
Jason knew that this was not required, but his entire being told him that it would assist the creation process, further strengthening the degree to which the prismarine crystal would be solidified.
Furthermore, he hoped that there would be an additional supportive factor, but that was not something Jason could be sure about.
Due to the multiple supporting factors, Jason was able to prevent making rookie mistakes that were likely to happen during the solidification process.
Hence, he was considered to be extremely fast at creating the outlines of the prismarine crystal, despite it being his first time doing something so complex.
Yet, what Jason didn't realise was that the activated stigmas and his aura were influencing the solidified prismarine crystal.
While his liquefied mana was already much denser, and complex than ordinary mana, the influence of Jason's entire being that had an almost intractable sense of divinity was tremendous.
Jason knew that the three activated stigmas were extremely helpful, and thus, he was using his soulbonds to their fullest extent, even if that meant they had to be outside the soul world.
In his smallest form, Petri was still only three meters long and Solaris could take the size of his pinky fingertip.
Only Spyro was not summoned, but that was because the little spirit was cultivating inside the soul world that had further been customised.
At the same time, the Spiral Spirit didn't have a stigma, even if it looked like this would change soon.
Jason was not sure how exactly stigmas worked, let alone his aura, but after Spyro had formed a connection to his soul, it was slowly changing.
The provided soul energy and spirit force were merging together, changing something about the Spiral Spirit.
Because of that, Jason assumed that it was the creation process of its stigma.
Other than that, he was not sure what else was happening to Spyro right now.
Meanwhile, as Jason cultivated, oblivious to the change he caused in the foundation of the prismarine crystal, Jennifer was focused on their surroundings, taking a look at all kinds of inheritances around them.
Most of them were unknown to her, but before entering any of them, she wanted to figure out everything necessary about the Island.
This was because, entering them in most cases, would transport the entrant to a separate dimension where the trials would be held.
The number of beings that had entered Kinra Island was in thousands, and it was gradually increasing.
Now that three days had passed, the majority of beings had already entered their first inheritance site, but there were many like Jason and her, trying to find a perfect inheritance for their unique situation and constitution.
As such, they had often encountered others that were looking at them, or to be precise at Jason, because a black snake was coiled around his chest.
Simultaneously, the activated stigmas and the fully unleashed Celestia aura also attracted some attention before they left Jennifer and Jason on their own.
They might be interested in Jason, but that didn't mean that they would waste their precious time observing him.
Suddenly, she felt something weird around her, which caused Jennifer to slow down. Because of that, Jason bumped into her, only to lift his head, where he saw that she was looking straight in a specific direction as she mumbled,
"That way?"
She hadn't even realised that Jason had bumped into her, and began flying in the direction in which she sensed something.
It made her feel like she was pulled towards the direction of an invisible magnet, and another day passed before they had crossed a large distance.
Only then did Jennifer stop, looking at a small temple below them that looked like plants had overtaken it, sprouting through every nook and cranny, nearly making it invisible to be spotted from afar.
This caused Jason to look at the ruins, where he could see faint currents of all the cultivation energies.
Lifting his head, once again, he looked at Jennifer, whose eyes were glued to the temple as he mumbled.
"Is that it?"
