chapters.title: Chapter 797 - Playing To Get Stronger!
chapters.content:
Playing around with his soulbonds for the past few days released the entire tension that had accumulated within Jason.
Becoming stronger might be important, but what use did strength have if he couldn't enjoy his life even a little bit.
Solely pursuing strength had never been his goal, in the first place, and it was just a means to achieve what he wanted to do.
In the end, his priority had always been to protect those he loved and owing to unfortunate encounters he had been unable to do that in the past.
Thus, he was becoming stronger, using the vast majority of his time and focusing on this.
Other than protecting those he loved, Jason wanted to find out more about himself.
This included his heritage, what was the connection between his mother and the Chaos Emperor, who that truly was, and much more.
His father was still someone mysterious and unknown to him, but that was, even more, the case for his maternal grandparents, who he had never met.
This was something he also wanted to do, search and meet his grandparents, which meant that they had to be alive, which Jason was oddly certain to be the case.
All of this required strength, and even more so for something he was currently working on- taking revenge against those that were responsible for the death of Scorpio and his masters!
This meant that not only would he visit the Ifrytor race in the future, but also the My?ldra and Burane race because they were the main culprits of the entire mess they had turned his life into.
Being impatient, he wanted to exact revenge on the responsible authorities as quickly as possible which would certainly ease his mind.
This would give him the peace he required to search for the Chaos Emperor, who would hopefully give him some intel about his grandparents.
His father could wait for the time being and the same could be said about Wisse, the halfling dragon, who he had almost forgotten about.
Jason was not sure if it would be useful for him, but meeting up with Wisse's master might help him somehow.
As such, he tried to remember the dragon, even more so because Wisse's master seemed to know something about Chaos energy.
It might be advantageous if he were to be clueless about where to start searching for clues regarding the whereabouts of the Chaos Emperor!
With the realization of his priorities, strength might not be his main goal, but it was the means that allowed him to achieve all goals he had in mind.
Thus, paying attention to his advancement progress was important, but not in an obsessive manner.
For now, he decided to play with his soulbonds.
If one were to be observant, it wouldn't even be difficult to figure out that his bond with his soulbonds became much stronger, the more time he spent with them.
With that in mind, spending time with his soulbonds could also be counted as a means to become stronger!
It sounded ridiculous, but it was exactly what he meant.
The firmer his connection with all soulbonds became, the stronger he would become, including the wide range of means he could use to fight against opponents.
Being able to let each of his soulbonds occupy his mana core would be a good start, and the next task would be to be able to fuse with any of his soulbonds.
Unfortunately, the fusion process was not something all soulbonds could do with him just like that.
Solaris' soul connection with him was much firmer than his soul connection with Petri was.
Yet, Petri could fuse with him, but Solaris was unable to do so.
Jason was not sure why this was the case, and figuring it out would help him to establish a fortified soul conjunction and find the requirements for a fusion much faster.
While playing with his soulbonds, his mind was overflowing with tasks he had to pay attention to.
One of these things was to try his utmost efforts to attain the highest possible ranking in the Dungeon of the Primordial Descendant's trials.
That was what his gut feeling told him clearly, and even without his gut feeling, Jason was clearly aware of the opportunity the Dungeon of the Primordial Descendant had.
If it was truly created by Primordials, and he belonged to the Celestia race, not only was it likely for him to be able to procure extraordinary treasures but also to find out more about the Celestia race.
On the other hand, there were also other Primordials that should be like him, belonging to one of the most powerful existences.
However, in that sense, it might not even be the case that the Celestia race was one of the most powerful races as he had presumed earlier.
In the end, he didn't know much about the Celestia race, and everyone's fear and respect for them indicated to him that they were extremely powerful and amongst the strongest existing races!
Nevertheless, that might also be wrong, and Jason thought that he shouldn't be too focused on the strength of the Celestia race.
What he needed to work on was achieving a high completion rating so that he could receive the best possible rewards once he had passed all trials.
That was the most important right now, followed by his survival and that of his soulbonds.
Even if he were to fail, that wouldn't be problematic as long as all of them survived because in that case, he would be at least able to complain.
It was far better than being dead or tormented by the thought that he should have been stronger.
Shaking his head, Jason came to a conclusion, and entered the portal, once the gate had opened, emerging inside the fourth trial.
[Fourth trial will be initiated. 'Personality' has been chosen as the fourth trial. Write down your honest answers about the given questions!]
Just as he emerged on the other side of the portal, Jason was ready to fight possible opponents after having rested well. He was prepared to possibly even test his limits to strengthen himself, only to notice two things!
First, the trial's task was confusing because he had never expected that he would be requested to do such a mundane task as answering questions.
He assumed that the dungeon should have figured out everything when it had evaluated him.
Despite this, his confusion was even more apparent as he realized the second thing when he had utilized every means to strengthen himself to encounter possible dangers. In fact, he had sensed that his divine energy had already replenished to a certain extent!
Apparently, used up divine energy could slowly replenish, which was something Jason didn't expect because he was not even sure what this divine energy truly was or what it was made of.
However, sensing that it was possible, made him smile. He assumed that this was another difference between the limited chaos attribute and the divine energy that originated from his body.
'That's great!' he thought, only to be pulled towards a wooden desk where huge stashes of files were spread out, waiting for him to start working on!

chapters.title: Chapter 798 - Unique Questions
chapters.content:
Looking down at the desk that was filled with the overflowing stashes of files, Jason couldn't help but feel weird.
'So…I'm supposed to answer the questions in each of the files?' He wondered as he picked up the first file.
Turning over the first page, Jason began to read the questions, and the more he read, the deeper his confusion became.
'Those…are the questions I have to answer??'
Reading the entire file took him half an hour, and Jason had yet to think of an answer for even a single question that was written on it.
Taking a glance at the other files, he calculated that there were at least 20 files in total, which was quite a lot for a trial that was called 'Personality'.
Earlier, he believed that he would have to answer a few questions at most.
But, seeing that a total of 20 files were required to figure out his personality, he felt it was definitely too much.
Reading them would already take 10 hours, let alone thinking of an answer, or writing something on the files.
Despite that, Jason knew that he had to answer the questions in order to advance. This meant that he had no other choice than to cooperate and answer everything if he wanted to finish it quickly.
Thus picking up the pen that was lying on the desk, he couldn't help but sigh because there was one thing he had already figured out by reading the first file- the questions were extremely weird, and in some cases even ironic!
Jason had no idea if this had a deeper meaning or not,, but while reading through the first few questions that asked for his personal information, he simply answered them.
The Dungeon was probably better informed about the secrets of his body, but that didn't seem to include his mindset, personality traits, and so on.
As such, he answered all questions truthfully, only to come across the first sections of questions that asked him stuff that had nothing to do with his personal information.
Yet, the first question was also the one that he felt was truly ironic.
[Who should be hit by a shuttle given a choice between an elderly woman and a pregnant woman?]
First, Jason had assumed that he was requested to decide which one of them was supposed to be hit by the shuttle.
However, in that case, he would have to choose who was more important for society, without disregarding the fact that every life was equally important.
Despite this earlier thought, Jason soon realized that this question was nothing but a petty trick.
As such, he could only shake his head and write down the only suitable answer he could think of.
[The shuttle should hit the break!]
After he answered the first question of the new section, Jason felt that every following question had similar vibes, making him feel like they were testing him.
That not only included his ability to figure out whether the question was trying to find out a hidden answer but also to clearly determine how he was feeling every single second that he spent reading the questions.
Jason clearly sensed this owing to the unique energy currents that permeated the entire room.
It was almost as if they were analyzing everything inside the room, which was something Jason had never sensed or seen before.
Using his Emperor Eyes was also not very useful because he had no idea what exactly the energy in the room was.
In the end, he was only sure that it was neither Mana, Primordial energy, nor Spirit force!
However, after getting to know the Sacred Squirrel, Jason realized that there were more energies that were constructed with the help of more than one of the main cultivation energies.
That being said, he might not know the new, analytical type of energy, but it was crystal clear that his reaction to the questions was important.
Despite that, Jason didn't even think of altering his reaction just because he was being evaluated by the energy.
Instead, he had always been someone who couldn't hide his emotions.
No matter how much he tried to hide it, his Celestia aura was betraying him.
His emotions were connected to it, causing the aura to change accordingly.
Additionally, his expressions were also clearly showing how he was feeling.
Thus, he decided to stay true to himself, and not to disguise anything.
With that in mind, he continued to answer the questions that were more annoying and frustrating to read than anything else.
Finding a suitable answer took almost five minutes on average, while most of them took far longer.
As such, Jason couldn't help but feel that he might be forced to stay close to the desk, answering questions for more than a month!
This was much shorter than the second, let alone the first trial took him, and he had only finished the third trial quickly.
Nevertheless, the given task was completely different and a single hour of answering questions felt like a full day of the previous trials.
The only thing that allowed him to stay calm and not to despair in boredom, were his soulbonds, their cultivation progress, and the fact that he was able to passively cultivate too.
His mind had been strengthened to the extent at which he could cultivate without the need to neglect his train of thoughts upon encountering something complex.
As a matter of fact, the questions couldn't be counted as something complex, just a little bit intensive to think about.
Nevertheless, they were different from really complex things like the creation process of a world bridge, and so on.
In a way, they were simple but judged him on how he processed the questions and if he used his heart or mind to answer them.
Because of that, he could cultivate while answering the questions which was quite an advantage, allowing him to become stronger which he felt was required for the next trial!
Even though he had no idea about what would happen in the next trial, Jason felt that it was something grand, something that was completely different from the first four trials, something that would change the way he viewed the Primordials.
Owing to this premonition, Jason decided to focus on becoming stronger while telling his soulbonds to do the same.
He even forced the Sacred Squirrel to take the situation seriously, which the little girl decided to do.
Having spent a few days with the other soulbonds and Jason playing around, the Sacred Squirrel felt much more connected to all of them.
The soul connection was gradually becoming stronger with each passing day, even more so during the days they had played with each other.
Thus, he felt that it was only a matter of time before the fortified soul conjunction would be initiated with his newest soulbond.
Jason awaited the day of the Sacred Squirrel's fortified conjunction because he wanted to find out how exactly the other blessings worked.
One might think that they were useless, but that was not Jason's opinion.
According to him, every single blessing, and even curse had its own unique points, whether it was a strength or weakness.
With the soul conjunction of the Sacred Squirrel in mind, an entire month passed until he had finally answered the majority of questions present in all files.
They had become weirder the longer he looked at them, and Jason couldn't help but feel that his head was burning.
Having been forced to answer all kinds of seemingly stupid questions only to figure out that they were not even as stupid as he thought they were, Jason had begun to question himself about the answer he had given to every single question.
Thus, he had reviewed them once again, depriving him of sleep as his mind was working relentlessly.
Nevertheless, he was able to answer the questions after a month that felt like an eternity!

chapters.title: Chapter 799 - Puppet Fight
chapters.content:
Stretching his body, Jason felt his entire back was hurting.
He had been seated on the wooden chair for almost an entire month, with only a few breaks to eat something and to move around.
After being stuck with answering questions that felt like an eternity, he had the urge to fight, move around, and do something other than sit.
Knowing that his body wanted to move but that it was unable to do so if he wanted to pass the trial at the quickest pace was horrific and so he hurried up and began to rush the answers.
Yet, before he knew it, Jason found himself reviewing and modifying the hastily scribbled answers while cursing himself.
In the end, he wanted to receive the best possible score and highest amount of merit points. This meant that he had to finish the trial quickly, but also with thorough answers.
Because of that, he was unable to randomly scribble anything if he didn't believe in the answer. His honesty was being tested, as well as his personality.
As such, rushing things, while answering without having thought about the answer was not helpful, and might as well lead to him failing the trial.
With that in mind, he had finished answering every single question thoroughly.
After that, he decided to circulate mana through his body while exerting the FLoating sky technique to move around, releasing the tension in his body.
He even ignored the notification of the artificial intelligence as he began to imagine an opponent, and started fighting him.
Shadow fighting was useful in specific circumstances, and Jason's situation was the prime example of releasing his tension by imagining an overly powerful opponent who could overwhelm him.
Despite that, not much time passed before he was finally able to calm down as his tensed body was finally freed. This allowed him to finally hear the notification of the artificial intelligence that repeated the same message over and over again.
[Congratulations! The fourth Trial has been passed successfully! Time required [39D:23H:59M:01S] , 'Void' difficulty, Extraordinary achievement!]
[97% Honest answers, authentic reactions, no secrets, attempted to satisfy his desire to save as many individuals as possible through his succinct answers.]
Somehow, Jason liked the second message the most because he felt as if his personality was rewarded with an extraordinary passing score. This made him feel reassured that his mindset was correct and that there was nothing wrong with it.
With that in mind, he couldn't hide his smile anymore as he turned towards the opened gate that revealed the portal towards the fifth trial.
Taking a deep breath, he approached the gate without any hesitation as Byakur manifested in his hand.
Emerging through it, he revealed his strongest combat prowess, excluding his fusion with any soulbond.
Nonetheless, he was ready to allow Petri to occupy his body, and fuse with him at any moment. Thus, he was fully prepared for a sudden attack that he would try to evade, block, or accept with Petri's scale armour.
Yet, instead of being forced to fight, he emerged in a seemingly inconspicuous room. It looked just like a large combat arena that had a vibe similar to the Colosseum on Argos.
Because of that, Jason understood that he would have to fight once again, which was reassuring.
Everything other than answering questions while being forced to sit on a chair for almost 40 days was great.
With that in mind, he tried to see if there were any opponents nearby but was forced to wait for the artificial intelligence to report to him.
[Fifth trial will be initiated! 'Puppet fight' has been chosen. Fight against one puppet using everything! After 180 days the fight will be repeated, and the progress evaluated!]
[Remark: Not giving everything in the first fight will decrease the possible rewards and completion score of the trial, and every previous trial the challenger has already completed!]
Listening to the artificial voice, Jason just nodded his head and accepted his mission. The remark might be annoying for some, but it was obvious that one would be punished if they were to try finding a loophole and exploiting it.
With that in mind, Jason wanted to start, eager to figure out what exactly made the puppet so special.
Yet, contrary to his expectations of finding just one puppet, he found himself staring at five puppets.
Each of these was made of silver-colored material and emerged out of the five portals that appeared out of nowhere.
Their appearance was exactly the same, but it didn't take much for Jason to realize that each of the puppets was completely different.
If Jason had to describe the five puppets in extremely simple terms, he would describe them as extremely terrifying.
Their cultivation base was exactly the same as his, which was probably supposed to be the case owing to the dungeon's regulations.
However, Jason quickly realized that their aura, energy fluctuations, and every other possible characteristic were on par with his, or even higher.
This caused him to become nervous because there was one particular puppet that had the same aura as him, just that it was several times more distinct.
It was similar to his Celestia aura, but there was not even the need to compare the two because the answer to which one was stronger was obvious.
Meanwhile, the auras of the other four puppets were equally terrifying, suppressing Jason just by being released.
He was not sure if that was something the puppets were ought to do in order to intimidate him, but it was not working.
Instead, Jason's heart was thumping wildly, excited about the possibility of figuring out the combat prowess of a puppet.
Even though it was not a real person made of blood and flesh, it was probably constructed after the model of a true Celestia being, and adjusted to his cultivation base!
That might as well be wrong, but it didn't matter because Jason knew that each of the five puppets was much stronger than him, while having the exact same cultivation base!
With that in mind, he took a proper look at them, trying to figure out their strongest and weakest characteristics, when suddenly he heard the artificial voice resounding in his mind.
[Please challenge one of the puppets. After the fight is over, the challenger is allowed to continue to challenge the other puppets. Once the challenger is assumed to have reached the highest possible combat prowess in a fight against one of the puppets, please report so after the fight is concluded.
The cultivation environment will then open, allowing the challenger to gain the dungeon's best environment.
He will have the opportunity to become stronger for the next 180 days before the fight against one, or possibly, multiple puppets will be repeated!
Good luck!]
Jason felt odd because the artificial intelligence's message was extremely long, and the way it was conveyed sounded less robotic and more humane than before.
This was weird, but instead of minding it too much, he repeated the message in his mind.
In the end, the entire message he had received allowed him to know what exactly he was supposed to do. There was nothing he could misunderstand, and everything was clear to his mind.
Because of that, he averted his attention from the message to the puppets as he investigated them once again.
They were extremely interesting to inspect, and there was no need to hide his interest in them.
Yet, what astonished Jason the most was the fact that the puppet he presumed to have been fashioned after a model of a being of the Celestia race, was not the most intriguing to him.
Instead, the puppet that was on the far right was the most intriguing, while the remaining four puppets seemed to be oddly similar, yet completely different.
This intrigued him, and he began to note down the characteristics of every single puppet.

chapters.title: Chapter 800 - True Dragon Soul
chapters.content:
While there was one puppet that possessed all three cultivation veins that were intertwined with each other,, the other four puppets were not less impressive.
The first puppet's cultivation veins were strengthening each other, becoming overly powerful, which Jason could clearly feel according to the released energy.
Three of the remaining four puppets seemed to have the supremacy of one cultivation vein each, such as the Celestia puppet being the strongest in the path of Maest.
It was intriguing, and even more so because the three puppets seemed to have more than one cultivation vein, at least some of them.
For example, there was the puppet that had supremacy over the Pryr path.
Yet it also had a mana core and Maest cultivation vein in order to control the flame that was also responsible for its fiery aura..or so Jason assumed.
In the end, the four puppets he had just inspected were extremely interesting.
Three of them had the strongest cultivation vein in one of the main cultivation paths, with the Celestia being the strongest in the path of Maest.
Meanwhile, the fourth puppet had all three cultivation veins, which were extremely powerful, but weaker than that of the three other puppets.
As such, the fifth puppet ought to be something special too.
But, he was stumped to see that the fifth puppet had all three cultivation veins, but also none.
In fact, it had one cultivation vein that felt like all three veins had been combined into it.
Yet, the energy it radiated was something Jason had never felt before.
Because of that, he was oblivious to what kind of existence the fifth Primordial was, yet it felt as if he should know it.
This was weird, and even after he thought about it really hard, Jason was unable to find an answer to the mystery of the fifth puppet.
Owing to that, he couldn't help but feel that he should challenge this puppet first, even if he had planned to challenge the Celestia puppet first earlier.
Driven by curiosity, he approached the mysterious puppet first before issuing a simple challenge.
"I want to fight you first!"
After he said this, the puppet seemed to transform as eyes manifested on its head, only to make its first move.
Smoothly approaching the combat arena that was not far away, the mysterious puppet stood on one side, while Jason was requested to stand opposite it.
Meanwhile, the remaining four puppets continued to reveal their energy fluctuation and aura, standing where they were like unmoving statues.
However, before Jason was able to avert his attention, he was distracted by the sudden interference of a robotic voice that initiated the countdown from three.
"3…2…1…Fight!"
The moment the robotic voice initiated the fight, Jason charged towards the mysterious puppet, allowing Petri to occupy his mana core and fuse with him.
At the same time, he circulated mana through his body and exerted the Floating Sky movement technique.
Additionally, he also fully unleashed the two stigmas that were above his right eye, and the Celestia aura that was transforming, owing to Petri's fusion.
Right now, he didn't use his Emperor Eyes' abyssal effect or Petri's curses because he wanted to wait for the perfect timing.
As such, he shot towards the mysterious puppet with excitement gleaming in his golden eyes.
As he neared it, he saw something dumbfounding just as Petri's scales began to grow out of his body.
While he had been moving with his fastest pace, the mysterious puppet didn't even move for the first second.
Instead, it gathered energy inside its body, only to release everything at once.
However, this didn't mean that it lost control over the mana, which was everything but the truth.
As he watched with wide eyes, the ginormous shape of a dragon emerged out of the puppet's body, roaring towards Jason.
Except for Wisse, he had never seen a true dragon in his life.
Furthermore, Wisse was a halfling, yet the dragon shape that emerged in front of him shook the entire colosseum, followed by his entire being, forcefully halting his mana circulation that was momentarily sealed.
This seal broke a second later, but at that moment, the mysterious puppet had already emerged out of the dragon's cover.
Meanwhile, the dragon returned to the puppet's interior.
Because of that, the puppet was able to use the energy that should have been used to manifest the dragon and attack Jason mercilessly instead, which just happened.
Having been rendered incapable of using his mana, his speed decreased drastically. Even his fusion with Petri didn't allow him to evade the high-velocity punch of the puppet that suddenly emerged in front of him as if it had teleported itself.
As such, the moment the punch hit him, Jason felt some of his ribs crack at the impact.
A terrifying realization hit him which he had only been able to figure out owing to his Emperor Eyes' and the foresight blessing.
'The Dragon it manifested…is an independent individual, and not something the puppet created?!?'
Just as he realized this, his body was flung several dozen meters into the air, before he crashed into the ground.
The spot that took the impact was where Petri's scales were torn apart as if he was hit by a rocket launcher.
Yet, he had no time to mind this or the terrifying pain that coursed through his entire body like a shockwave. Jason's mind was somewhere completely else, thinking about what he had just seen.
Thus, lying on the ground, while barely being able to breathe, he dissolved his fusion with Petri.
The moonlight affinity enveloped his entire body as he processed what his Emperor Eyes had just seen.
'That…was the soul of a deceased true dragon…wasn't it?'
Even if he gave the best effort to make sense of the situation, Jason was unable to do so. This was because he had clearly seen that the true dragon's energy fluctuations were different from that of the puppet.
Yet, at the same time, they seemed to have been altered, adjusted to each other in order to allow the puppet to make use of the dragon without wasting any mana.
However, in that case, it made no sense how the soul of a true dragon was stored within the puppet.
'Is…it is able to store souls of deceased beings, and use them?' Jason suddenly wondered.
He got busy trying to figure out the innate trait of the fifth puppet that was the replica of a race just like the Celestia puppet and the other three puppets.
Right now, Jason was a little bit annoyed because he had been defeated so easily, without being able to put up a defense let alone launch an attack.
But at the same time, it was not like he had used every single bit of his strength to fight against the puppet.
Nevertheless, the dragon's ability to momentarily block his mana circulation was fearsome, and Jason couldn't help but feel a little bit…refreshed!
Until now, he had overcome numerous challenges, but that didn't include having to fight against five puppets that replicated the model of five Primordial races.
Owing to that, the true dragon's roar should be the tip of the iceberg of the mysterious puppet's combat prowess. It had yet to unleash a single martial art technique, its aura, or some sort of stigma it might possess owing to it being a replica of an overly powerful race!
However, the same could also be said about the other puppets, whose combat prowess should at least be on par with the mysterious puppet's, otherwise, the trial as a whole wouldn't make any sense.
How could Jason know that the puppets in their entirety were just the tip of the iceberg of the true strength the beings he called Primordial gained once they reached the 2nd threshold of the Prismar stage?

chapters.title: Chapter 801 - Analyzed
chapters.content:
Staring at the other puppets, Jason tried to figure out which one he should fight now.
However, after thinking about it for a moment, he realized that the choice wasn't so complicated after all, to begin with.
It would be the most logical for him to fight all of the puppets one after another.
That way he could figure out how strong they were before deciding which of them he could fight a second time in the easiest manner in order to reveal his whole combat prowess.
The five puppets couldn't have the same combat prowess, and the difference in the main cultivation paths, as well as their uniqueness, was both an advantage and a disadvantage.
It made them stronger to fight against specific opponents, but also weaker against some other opponents.
With that in mind, Jason fought the remaining four puppets but was defeated in no time as he was blasted outside the combat arena.
In the end, he had only used Petri's fusion to grow the Cursed Basilisk's scales, and not to utilize his curses and the Emperor Eyes' abyssal effect.
Other than that, he didn't use his affinities to attack, further decreasing his strength.
As such, Jason was far from exposing his true combat prowess, which was something he was fully aware of.
Nonetheless, he showed the same combat prowess to each of the five puppets that used all kinds of different means in order to defeat him.
The Celestia puppet had simply overwhelmed him with its aura, before using mana in order to create a neutral mana blast. Jason had no other option than to simply accept this while noting down that the Celestia race's aura seemed to cause most restrictions.
Meanwhile, the puppet with the fiery aura and the supremacy of the Pryr path enveloped itself with the fire affinity it had before executing a unique type of affinity.
Through this, the fire affinity's characteristics changed slightly as the flame turned into a ginormous warrior that seemed to be hovering behind the puppet.
This particular puppet wanted to leave no stone unturned in order to overwhelm Jason. Hence, just a moment later, it exerted another technique at the same time, as it appeared in front of Jason.
Wasting no time, it initiated an onslaught of punches, while the ginormous warrior slashed at him with the long broadsword it simply manifested in its hand.
To his fortune, the sword of fire didn't cut through him and simply disappeared when it was about to hit him.
Nevertheless, it was shocking for Jason to realize that he had been unable to evade the fiery aura puppet's attack.
But the truly unnerving fact was that the flames were burning through his mana, showing the same energy burning characteristic Solaris had.
This happened solely because the puppet had used its entire mana core to exert the flame transformation technique, a name Jason gave it, after allowing the flame to envelop its body.
The technique might not leave the flame with any mana later, but that didn't matter.
The sole use of mana for the fiery aura puppet was exactly that, using its flame affinity.
Other than that, it could easily exceed Jason's speed, strength and endurance by simply attacking him as if he was an amateur fighter.
However, the fiery aura puppet was not yet the worst opponent he had encountered.
He still had to fight the Spiral path puppet that revealed its strength not only to Jason but also to Spyro, who saw everything Jason could see.
First, the Spiral path puppet used some of its spirit force in order to envelop its body.
Then it cranked up the consumption as it began to duplicate itself at an alarming pace.
This wouldn't have been a problem if the duplication process had some flaws, which he would certainly be able to see owing to his Emperor Eyes.
Yet, shockingly enough, there was nothing for him to help him differentiate between the two.
The puppet had created a spitting image of itself, whether it was from the inside or outside!
If something had even the faintest energy streams, Jason was always able to figure out what the issues were.
His Emperor Eyes were strong enough to do so, but right now they were failing him.
In the end, this was the most shocking discovery for him and while he was trying to digest the revelation, he was simultaneously forced to endure the attack of more than a dozen Spiral path puppets.
The main body was somewhere within, and it was barely when he endured the attack of 8 doppelgangers that Jason noticed something very subtly.
'The more the puppet duplicates, the weaker the subsequent duplicate will be?'
He was not sure if that was correct, but in comparison to fighting the other three puppets, the Spiral path puppet seemed to be holding back the most. It was barely using the duplication in order to defeat him using a numerical advantage.
Against his current combat prowess, the tricks used by the puppet were more than sufficient.
And, there was no problem owing to the fact that the duplicate's strength was on par with his own.
And that was after considering that the duplicates were not as strong as the main body!
Taking everything into account, Jason felt that the Spiral path puppet might be the easiest to fight, but at the same time, he got a bad feeling about it.
Because of that, he tried to use his Emperor Eyes to memorize the way in which the Spiral path puppet was utilizing its spirit force. It was attempting to help Spyro, the Spiral Spirit, to learn how to make use of its spirit force.
In fact, Spyro had already created a fortified soul conjunction with him, and it was only a matter of time before they would be able to fuse.
Once that was possible, Jason wanted to be able to duplicate his body, or do something similar that allowed his combat prowess to skyrocket.
Unfortunately, the Spiral path puppet's spirit force circulation was too complex to memorize after only seeing it once.
Thus, he decided to fight it a few more times to understand better.
However, before doing so, Jason first had to finish his preliminary analysis by fighting against the last puppet. It possessed all cultivation paths that were only slightly weaker than the other puppets!
Nevertheless, the cultivation veins were intertwined with each other and naturally released the fused energy. This was a sharp contrast to others that possessed all the cultivation veins but had to actively release the fused energy.
Owing to that, the last puppet's strength was not to be underestimated, and Jason knew that he couldn't afford to be distracted.? If he wanted to find a way to allow Spyro to use its cultivation path in a different way, this was his best chance.
If he succeeded, he could help Spyro to solely amplify his brain's functions owing to the soul amplification.
As such, he faced the Three paths puppet that didn't hesitate to envelop itself with its intertwined energy before he created more than a thousand tiny needles composed out of the same energy.
Rotating at a rapid pace, the needles turned into small drills, before they were shot in large batches at Jason.
Yet, instead of hitting Jason directly, the intertwined energy accurately controlled the rotating needles.
These needles also had the traits of spirit force within, which allowed them to surround Jason, who was more than 100 meters away from the Three paths puppet.
Thus, before he was even able to attack, thousands of needles shot towards him, advancing towards him from every possible direction except the ground!
Force to coil up with Petri's scaled armor, Jason was able to protect himself to some extent.
Unfortunately, the rotating needles drilled into his scales, and flesh before they stopped their attack, ending the fight before something worse could happen.
After the fight was over the Three path puppet returned to the other four puppets that were unmoving, as Jason was left alone, defeated by mere puppets.
As he sighed deeply, a plan formed in his mind.
'If I cannot defeat them now, I shall learn from them!"
With that in mind, he shot up from the ground, ignoring the pain that was coursing through his body. He was bruised and injured but he merely circulated mana through his body to stop the bleeding.
"Let's try copying the Spiral path puppet's techniques!"

chapters.title: Chapter 802 - Learning
chapters.content:
Even though Jason said that he wanted to copy the Spiral path puppet's techniques, this was easier said than done.
Not only was the way in which it used its spirit force extremely accurate, and in a detailed manner, but it was far more complex and also quickly utilized.
Through the speed with which the puppet circulated spirit force through its body, it did something complex, and overlapped it with more spirit force, before multiple more layers followed suit.
Meanwhile, the old layers of its circulation were replaced, creating something within the puppet's body that Jason could only describe as chaos.
But at the same time, Jason realized that each layer of the spirit force it used turned into an exquisite piece of art that was required to complete the exerted technique.
Because he understood this quite fast, both Jason and Spyro were trying to figure out a starting point, from which they would be able to start copying the technique.
Once they were to start, and slowly get the hang of everything, it was only a matter of time before he would be able to adjust the copied technique in order to move freely.
Every single movement led to enormous changes inside the body, which was also something Jason knew owing to his perfect mastery over the Floating Sky movement technique.
Under normal circumstances, he could start altering the Floating Sky movement technique, but in order to achieve this, it was necessary to know his body perfectly.
This included the necessary changes in his mana circulation once he made a particular move.
It was not impossible for him to alter a movement technique after having used it for several years.
But Jason found it a waste of time to alter the Floating Sky movement technique and it was more convenient and hassle-free to replace it with a different technique once he found one.
In the end, it was just a Terra ranked technique, and even with alterations, it was unlikely for this technique to reach the standards of a Heaven ranked technique.
Testing its potential for months would thus be useless for him.
However, that couldn't be said for Spyro, who was currently solely focused on cultivating and did nothing else.
This was boring, and once cultivating lost its appeal, one's concentration decreased drastically.
Because of that, Jason had always tried to switch between cultivating for a few months and fighting.
Sometimes he was both impatient, yet at the same time patient, and his mindset was difficult to explain to others.
In the past, he thought that his soulbonds were the cause for his mindset to be like that.
To some extent, it might not even be wrong, but Jason was not bothered by that.
Instead, it allowed him to be closer to his soulbonds, which was quite advantageous.
Nevertheless, Jason didn't even realize how time flew by while he focussed on the Spiral path puppet's spirit force circulation, while it duplicated its body.
The puppet kept charging towards him, and beating Jason up, before returning to stand beside the other puppets.
Beaten and bruised, Jason would approach it repeatedly, requesting a new spar.
As this endless cycle continued…hours….days…..and weeks flew by.
After almost four weeks, Spyro and Jason were finally able to memorize the most basic way in which the Spiral path puppet duplicated its body.
Happy to have finally found the method, Spyro repeated that process, and its entire spirit force was immediately used up.
As the two watched in awe, an unmoving Spiral Spirit appeared next to it.
Despite the fact that the seemingly useless Spiral Spirit duplicate was unable to move, both Jason and Spyro were exhilarated.
All their efforts had finally bore fruit as they finally achieved something they had hoped for. Spyro learned his first technique which he could continue learning and improving in order for Jason to reconsider using it in fights.
This made the two of them happy, and even the other soulbonds were overjoyed, thinking that an advancement in Jason's strength would be a great reinforcement.
Yet, before Spyro would be able to make proper use of the technique, it first had to learn how to move and control its duplicates, which was not easy.
There were all kinds of tricks it could make use of, and without hesitation, Spyro returned to the soul world.
It started to train relentlessly, owing to the next goal it aimed to fulfill- learning the technique as quickly as possible without neglecting its cultivation.
This was probably impossible to do because the cultivation progress would decrease, but that was fine with Jason as long as his soulbond learned a great technique that it could use to make him stronger.
At the same time, Jason began to wonder if Artemis or Petri could also learn some sort of technique.
Solaris had already been testing and experimenting to increase its strength since his days on Argos, and the black Dragon flame, as well as the Frozen moonlight flame of the Glacier Dragon were the results provided by the black origin flame.
Meanwhile, Petri had never even tried to learn any kind of technique because it was a physically attributed beast with curses.
Yet, those curses could probably be enhanced in a way Jason enhanced them using his mana to crudely increase their strength.
It should definitely be possible to find a more exquisite, detailed, and less energy-consuming way to enhance the curses.
Thus, he and Petri, both had been racking their brains to figure it out.
As for Artemis, she was by far his strongest soulbond, but since her evolution, she hadn't even bothered to think about comprehending the true use of the moonlight affinity.
Additionally, she had also ignored it to further improve her understanding of the ice affinity.
She was only focusing on strengthening everything innately in order to achieve the highest possible strength without the necessity to reinforce her affinities' potential.
Thus, she completely ignored trying to figure out a way to enhance the freezing property of her ice, or how to use her affinities.
Jason had been bothered about this a lot, but he had refrained from saying anything to her.
He knew that Artemis was focusing on cultivating in order to strengthen him, which was why he remained silent.
However, now that he witnessed how powerful those at the same cultivation base as him could be, his mindset was slowly changing.
But that wasn't the case with Artemis who was completely unbothered.
She had simply cultivated for the entire time, focusing on the creation of her third large rotating crystal before she continued to accumulate the necessary mana in order to create the dome crystal.
Yet, in order to reach the necessary number of accumulating a million liquefied mana drops, Artemis would require at least two years, which was already extremely fast.
Unfortunately, she stubbornly continued to cultivate without trying to improve her control over her affinities or create new attacks that would allow him to reach a higher combat prowess.
Thus, Jason decided to focus on Petri for the moment and tried to increase his prowess along with his own.
There was no need for him to waste any time doing all of this because he just had to show his current highest combat prowess.
Nevertheless, before the cultivation environment would be unlocked to him, Jason felt that using the five puppets to increase his own strength and that of his soulbonds was the best he could do.
Even if it was not the best to finish the trials soon, did it really matter? He had entered the dungeon to increase his strength, and the five puppets were by far, the best teachers he had come across in the dungeon.
They were the strongest opponents he had fought until now, and their cultivation base was on par with his own.
In fact, their liquefied mana was probably even stronger than his, while the same could be said about their crystals.
If that wasn't the case, it would make no sense for the puppets to be innately stronger than he was, even after his soulbonds enhanced his strength.
However, what Jason didn't know was that their cultivation was exactly the same as Jason's.
Their liquefied energy was compressed with three times more energy than one would usually require, while one of their prismarine crystals had the same potency as four common prismarine crystals!
Yet, there were not only cultivation techniques, but also other means to strengthen one's entire being, which was something Jason had yet to recall and make use of once again!

chapters.title: Chapter 803 - Still?
chapters.content:
Spending a few more weeks while fighting the other puppets, Jason tried to analyze their fighting style in-depth without releasing his entire combat prowess.
He simply increased the amount of effort, and strength he utilized in each new round while trying to fight against the puppets head-on.
Unfortunately, this was easier said than done, which Jason realized painfully.
He got injured a lot but using the moonlight affinity, everything was rather easily solved because he was never severely injured.
As such, he fought against each puppet several times a day, closing the gap between them as his combat awareness was gradually increasing.
At the same time, Petri seemed to have been trying to study his curses, wondering about ways of enhancing them.
Ever since he had seen Spyro's relentless efforts to learn the duplication technique Jason liked to call [Mirrored Image] technique, Petri wanted to make Jason proud too.
It was a pain not knowing where to start, or what to do, and Petri had to start from scrap which was different from Spyro, who just copied the mirrored image technique.
Jason wanted to help the Cursed Basilisk, but he was as clueless as to his soulbond on where to start.
Because of that, he allowed Petri to find his own way to improve.
As such, it was only after a total of eight weeks had passed since the start of the fifth trial that he recalled something.
'Wasn't it my plan to leave the dungeon soon? It's not even a task to improve my strength right now..the dungeon only expects me to show the highest level of combat prowess that I can reach…'
This was his task, but he hadn't bothered about it, and it was only after eight weeks that he felt it was time to start sparring with one of the puppets, revealing his highest combat prowess.
Despite that, he didn't plan on using Artemis because she ignored his well-meant advice to stop cultivating and start trying to learn how to use her affinities and racial traits in a better way.
Instead, Jason wanted to fuse with Petri owing to the fact that he was working hard and that he was the only other soulbond he could fuse with.
With that in mind, he decided to allow Petri, who was about to solidify his second large rotating crystal, to occupy his mana core.
During the last few weeks, his combat prowess was slowly increasing and nearing that of the five puppets.
But, he couldn't take the sole credit of the increase because his soul bonds were also becoming stronger, and not just him.
His cultivation was slowed down by the constant battles, while his soulbonds switched between actively cultivating and learning new techniques.
Thus, with his enhanced strength, he seemed to be slowly closing the gap between their physical strength and the strength of their cultivation energy.
Because of that, only their technique, the distinct auras, special traits, combat awareness, talent, and the endless will to emerge victorious were deciding factors, and not that one party was stronger in terms of cultivated energy.
With that in mind, Jason chose the opponent he was the most confident in defeating, after carefully analyzing its basic tactic which he had seen hundreds of times.
As such, his final opponent would be the Spiral path puppet, which he assumed to be the weakest amongst the five puppets.
Or at least its duplication technique was utilized in a way that allowed Jason to understand that the Spiral path puppet wanted to defeat him as harshly as possible.
Following that, it had always summoned 12 duplicates with which it attacked, utilizing a tremendous amount of spirit force, with an additional supply in order to maintain the solid shape of its duplicates.
That was something Jason had figured out owing to Spyro's comprehension which was quite helpful, even more so because he wanted to defeat the Spiral path puppet.
Showing his strongest prowess was not enough, and he became ambitious, thinking that he had to defeat one of the puppets to clearly tell the dungeon that he was not to be taken lightly!
With the intent to win the fight, Jason entered the combat arena, where the Spiral path puppet was already waiting for him.
As always, a huge stream of spirit force enveloped the Spiral path puppet before a total of 12 duplicates manifested around it.
Each of them was weaker than the one before, and the last few were certainly too weak to defeat Jason, even if they were to fight together.
Jason believed that his current state was a major improvement over his strength at the start of the trial.
After all, he had attained it after working relentlessly on improving his combat strength, while learning more about the five mysterious puppets.
While the Spiral path puppet had manifested its duplicates, Jason didn't remain idle.
Instead, Jason had already fused with Petri, manifesting his tail that grew out of his coccyx, followed by his entire body that was enveloped by Scales.
After that, Jason's eyes turned into reptilian slits, while his aura turned wild. Unleashing it to the fullest, the wild, ferocious aura swept through the combat arena, only to face off the Spiral path puppet's aura that? Jason was clueless about.
Following that, Jason's aura was pushed back, but it was just a fraction of a second later that the two stigmas above Jason's right eye began to shine brightly.
They were fully utilized, and reinforced the aura, along with his mana circulation.
Through this, his aura was finally on par with that of the Spiral path puppet's, which meant that neither party had an advantage by utilizing their aura.
This was great, but not yet everything Jason had to use.
Instead, he manifested Byakur which he enveloped with a thin layer of Solaris' flames before traces of mana were inserted into Byakur itself.
In the end, this strengthened his soul weapon to the extent that he could defeat all duplicates and even the main body of the Spiral path puppet without an issue.
As such, he advanced towards the closest duplicate that reached him, before unleashing his petrification and race specific weakening curse followed by the abyssal effect.
This decreased the duplicate's strength tremendously as it was defenseless against the slew of attacks.
By fully facing the decrease duplicates, Jason was able to make use of the Emperor Eyes and foresight blessing in order to predict the duplicate's movement.
Instead of being predictable, he reacted in an unexpected and directly opposite way.
In a single swipe, he cut through the duplicate's arm, only to split a part of Solaris' flame that continued to burn through his opponent's body.
Without another backward glance at his defeated opponent, Jason focused on his front because there were 11 more duplicates which he had to defeat.
Leaving no stone unturned, he creatively utilized his tail to make the weakest duplicate trip.
Seizing his chance, Jason cut through it, while evading the attack of another duplicate.
Several minutes passed, and finally, he had defeated all 12 duplicates, only to notice that the main body was still standing at the exact same position as before.
Yet, it had been far from idle.? The Spiral path puppet had accumulated its entire energy in the center of its forehead, only to release it at once, shooting towards Jason in the form of a beam.
At that moment, Jason noticed that he had made a big mistake. He had allowed the duplicates to keep him occupied so that the main body could do whatever it wanted.
"Fuck!"? Jason cursed as he suddenly felt dizzy, followed by him being forced to face a world that was literally turned upside down.
However, that was not even the worst because his Emperor Eyes began to glow brightly.
His eyes were trying to dispel the illusion that corroded his mind, only for Jason to realize that it was impossible for his Emperor Eyes to do so.
They had just gotten a taste of failure in a very long time, and it was only a moment later that the main body of the Spiral path puppet emerged in front of him.
He was blasted out of the combat arena with a seemingly simple punch that reverberated through his entire being, shaking his insides.
'I…still lost?' He thought before losing his consciousness.

chapters.title: Chapter 804 - Mysterious Puppet
chapters.content:
While lying on the ground, Jason couldn't help but smile lightly.
He realized that he had lost miserably.
In fact, the Spiral path puppet hadn't even moved to defeat him!
This caused Jason to feel embarrassed because he had been confident in defeating the puppet, but instead had to taste failure.
Sighing deeply, he lifted his upper body, while remaining seated on the ground.
Staring at the Spiral path puppet that walked away from him effortlessly, he scratched the back of his head. Jason was unsure of what he should do right now.
Petri's fusion was already terminated, and he began to estimate how much of his combat prowess he had been able to display.
In order to achieve the best results, he had to show how strong he was in his best condition.
As such, the last fight was not exactly something he was supposed to choose in order to demonstrate how strong he was.
With that in mind, he sighed deeply before trying to think of a solution on how he could show his combat prowess.
Defeating a total of 12 duplicates was not feasible while simultaneously paying constant attention to the main body.
Thus, Jason began to think that it may be better to change his target.
'Even if I were to be defeated, showing my combat prowess will be enough to allow me to get the highest possible ranking.
Because this was more important than before owing to the fifth trial's remark, Jason had to be careful. Otherwise, his efforts of the last three years would be quickly destroyed.
And that was not something Jason wanted to face.
With that in mind, he thought of something before choosing his next opponent to fight.
By deciding to fight the puppet that had defeated him with the use of the true dragon roar, Jason was confident that he had found a way to counter this attack.
Afterward, he should be able to at least reach the puppet. Trying to defeat the puppet might be unreasonable, but that didn't mean he shouldn't attempt to reach and clash with it!
Taking this into consideration, Jason was confident of fighting.
Thus, once his short break was over, and his mana core refilled, he challenged the mysterious puppet to a spar.
Standing opposite each other at a distance of more than one hundred meters, both parties were ready to fight. Hence, the moment the artificial intelligence counted down from three, initiating the start of the battle, they began to move.
While Jason grew a little nervous, the mysterious puppet moved slowly and appeared to be unbothered at the prospect of facing Jason.
It circulated the mysterious energy through its body, while Jason's entire appearance changed once again, as soon as he fused with Petri.
By activating the stigmas, the wild and ferocious aura was fully unleashed, as Jason circulated the moonlight transmuted mana through his body.
Additionally, he also used it to exert the Floating Sky movement technique.
It took only a moment for Byakur to manifest in his hand, and at the same time, Petri's scale grew out of Jason's body, while his pupils were turned into reptilian slits.
Without wasting a fraction of a second to hesitate, Jason immediately initiated the race specific weakening curse.
It was followed by the petrification curse that were both strengthened by the fusion, the ferocious aura, and the stigmas.
This forced the mysterious puppet to slow down its circulation tremendously.
On the other hand, Jason used his Emperor Eyes' abyssal effect in order to further decrease his opponent's speed.
He left no stone unturned to prevent the mysterious puppet from summoning the soul of the true dragon, but Jason realized only a second later that this was simply not possible.
Even without the use of the mysterious puppet's energy, the soul of the true dragon was able to emerge from its body.
A mighty roar escaped its mouth that shook the entire arena once again, almost throwing Jason off his balance.
Yet, just at this moment, Jason couldn't help but smile because he realized two things that were closely tied to each other.
First- without the unique energy the true dragon's roar was much weaker than before, and it wouldn't have affected him as much as it had in their first battle.
Nevertheless, using the ferocious aura to tightly envelop his body followed by a thick layer of Solaris' flames was enough to block the attack initiated by the dragon roar.
Jason hoped to burn the mysterious energy using Solaris' flames.
It was still strong enough to blast Jason a meter away owing to the shockwave the roar created, but that didn't deter Jason.
He used his entire strength to appear right in front of the mysterious puppet. Byakur had already appeared in his hand and Jason looked at his opponent with a bright smile on his face.
He felt exhilarated that everything had worked according to his plan.
Now wasn't the time to back off, and Jason knew that he just had this last chance to make his efforts count. His entire body was already screaming, begging him to leave his current position as quickly as possible.
This was caused by the fact that the true dragon had simply dispersed, returning to the mysterious puppet in a completely different way than it had done in the fights before.
Following that the puppet had already gathered some of its mysterious energy within its body, and was ready to release it.
Noticing this, Jason sensed that something was off.
Thus, he immediately released his entire divine energy, circulating the purest form of energy he had in his body through it.
This caused his mana veins to make faint cracking sounds as they were being strained.
Unbearable pain coursed through every single cell of his body that groaned under the pressure it felt as the pure divine energy circulated through them.
In the end, the divine energy in its purest form was not something Jason could simply circulate through his body.
He had ordinary mana veins, and even if the Celestia race should be able to use divine energy, he was severely restricted in this aspect.
As such, while enduring the pain caused by the purest divine energy that was not even intertwined with mana to make circulating it easier, Jason's entire being seemed to enlarge.
His aura became several times denser all of a sudden, followed by his glowing stigmas.
A golden light surrounded his entire head like a halo making him look like an otherworldly being.
Following that, his strength and speed increased too. Yet, instead of allowing the mysterious puppet to retaliate, Jason used the seven-meter-long tail that had grown out of his coccyx in order to pull the puppet's leg away.
Through this sudden attack, the puppet was pulled to the ground, and Jason was just about to cut it in half, by swinging Byakur as something unimaginable happened.
"Fuck!" Jason suddenly cursed out, dragging himself backward.
He was forced to change his direction midway which caused the bones in his ankles to crack faintly.
This caused Jason to frown, but he couldn't pay any attention to this.
His eyes were trained on the mysterious puppet that was lying on the ground.
With wide eyes he saw its appearance drastically change.
Yet, instead of moving, it simply remained on the ground, barely lifting its hand in the air where a small dot manifested.
Increasing in size, the black dot turned into a ginormous black mass.
It resembled a black hole but had a completely different task at hand.
Instead of pulling everything into it, an enormous black tortoise manifested from within, that had a lengthy tail with a snakehead at its tip.
Roaring out, both the tortoise head and that of the snake manifested pitch-black balls of energy which they threw towards Jason showing no signs of hesitation.
At this moment, Jason realized that they were ready to kill him.
While he was distracted in evading the attacks, the mysterious puppet that had been lying on the ground just a moment ago, appeared right next to him, as if it had materialized out of thin air.
This caused Jason's eyes to widen, only for a high-velocity punch to hit him at the exact same spot as it was the case two months ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 805 - Loyal
chapters.content:
Seeing himself lying on the ground again, Jason felt the desire to punch someone igniting within him.
It was extremely annoying to be defeated over and over for the past two months, and Jason couldn't help but clench his fists.
He had given his utmost efforts to defeat his opponent in the last battle with the mysterious puppet, but it looked like his instincts had just saved his life.
Even though the black mass out of which the black tortoise with a snake for a tail had emerged seemed harmless, Jason knew that it would have disintegrated his body in no time.
This might sound like an exaggeration, but Jason was sure that he wouldn't have retreated.
With that in mind, his body staggered once, before he raised his head to take another look at the black tortoise that left through the portal as if nothing had happened.
Thinking about it, Jason realized that he might have made a big mistake! He could have inflicted a light cut into the mysterious puppet, transferring Solaris' flame into it, before tactically retreating.
This would have saved him from exerting efforts and energy as the flames would have done their job.
Unfortunately, his mind had blanked out the moment his entire being sensed that something had gone wrong.
Because of that, he couldn't help but sigh, thinking that he should have kept his calm.
But there was use crying over spilled milk so he had to accept his failure and move on.
On the positive side, Jason felt that he had revealed his entire combat prowess in the current fight.
This meant that he had solved the task he had been given, even if he made a tiny mistake at the end of the battle.
Owing to his assumptions, he was just about to announce that he had finished his spars, and notify the artificial intelligence that he was finally done, when a jolt of realization hit him.
For a second, he just couldn't understand how he had missed noticing it earlier.
"Wait!... Did the mysterious puppet just summon a living beast? And it certainly obeyed the puppet as if it was the beast's master!"
Somehow, Jason felt that this was oddly similar to something he was familiar with, but at the same time, it was completely different.
He was not sure what to make of it, and in the end, he simply gave up.
There was still a huge difference between the soul awakening of humans on Argos and the mysterious puppet's traits.
On one hand, it looked like the mysterious puppet was much stronger owing to a true dragon's soul being bound to it. But on the other hand, the time it took to manifest the portal and allow a living being to emerge near it was extremely long.
That was the case if one were to compare it to the time it took to manifest a soulbond.
Yet, the more he thought about it, the weirder it became.
Confused about what was going on, Jason couldn't help but halt in his tracks, trying to process this information before summoning the artificial intelligence.
'Even if their abilities are not the same, they're oddly similar… Still, the mysterious puppet's abilities are stronger even if it took longer to manifest the snaketail tortoise, or whatever it is called…'
Despite believing so, Jason felt that the puppet required a fairly large amount of time to manifest the tortoise due to multiple reasons.
One such reason was that he was fighting a puppet and not a living being which the tortoise could truly be bound with.
This was truly odd, and the more Jason thought about it, the more confusing the entire scenario became.
It made him feel uncomfortable, and to prevent being dragged deeper into a jumbled tangle of thoughts, Jason couldn't help but slap his own cheeks.
His body shook once, and he had to instruct Solaris to spread its flames through his body.
He had to calm himself because it felt like he had made an accidental discovery just now.
Nevertheless, his assumption made no sense because there were too many things that didn't add up, which caused Jason to convince himself with some simple words.
"The humans on Argos must have undergone an advantageous evolution to gain their soul awakening ability…"
Shaking his head once again, he entered his soul world through his conscience and gave a fleeting glance to his soulbonds before he averted his attention back to reality.
"I'm done with the first phase of the trial, and also displayed my highest combat prowess. Please open the cultivation environment for me!"
Without directing his voice to anyone in particular, Jason announced in a loud and clear voice.
His words resounded through the entire colosseum, but nothing happened for the first few seconds.
This was more than enough for his train of thoughts to revert back to all kinds of possibilities that the fight against the mysterious puppet had planted in his mind!
Fortunately, it didn't take long for the artificial intelligence to respond as several portals manifested inside the colosseum.
They emerged behind the puppets, with each portal radiating the respective energy and presence of the puppet's cultivation paths.
This confused Jason at first, but sensing the portal behind the Celestia puppet, Jason clearly understood that all of the portals had different targets to cultivate.
As such, the portal behind the Celestia puppet released the strongest mana currents, but only a fraction of the other cultivation energies.
Meanwhile, the fiery aura puppet had a portal behind it that released the strongest primordial energy currents, while the same applied to the spiral path puppet that had a? portal behind it, releasing spirit force.
On the contrary, there were two seemingly similar, yet slightly different portals behind the Three paths puppet and the mysterious puppet.
But they were less interesting for Jason because he had already come up with a great plan.
Summoning all of his soulbonds at once, he smiled lightly as he asked them,
"How about you guys enter the portal that suits you the most? Didn't you guys want to start a competition, to begin with? All of you wanted to know who is the strongest in cultivation, and who is the most beneficial to fuse with me, and so on, right?
I noticed what you guys were scheming, and now I'm giving all of you the opportunity to show who the fastest in cultivating, and learning new techniques is!
But…are you guys willing to leave my side to cultivate and show each other who is the strongest amongst you all?"
With the way he asked the question, Jason wanted to figure out how determined his soulbonds were to become stronger.
It would be best if their determination would allow them to leave his side for half a year, but at the same time, Jason wanted to witness what would they choose between him and growing stronger. if they were to be torn apart between staying by his side to show their loyalty, or if their desire to become stronger, and more useful to him, in the long run, would overwhelm them.
This was something he was extremely interested in finding out, but what happened only a moment later caused him to feel a little bit dumbfounded.
Just as he finished speaking, his soulbonds began to move, occupying his entire body in the same arrangement as weeks before.
They didn't even have to think about what they should do because their mind was already set in stone.
Staying by Jason's side was the best option according to them, and he could only scratch the back of his head, thinking that this was quite disadvantageous.
However, it was just at this moment that he sensed something that made him change his mind entirely.
'With mine…I can sense six stigmas…if they're all activated, will that mean…?'

chapters.title: Chapter 806 - Cultivation Environment
chapters.content:
When realization struck him, a bright smile emerged on his face.
Jason felt like he should take a small risk that could lead to a minor loss or tremendous benefits.
With that in mind and the gut feeling he had, Jason chose the portal that was located behind the Three paths puppet, without the slightest hesitation left in his movements.
Instead, he was confident that a great opportunity was laid out in front of him.
Thus, emerging on the other side of the portal, without another backward glance, Jason was ready to give his utmost efforts in order to become stronger.
However, this not only included his cultivation but also his combat prowess because the five puppets were stronger than him despite being at the same cultivation base.
Yet, Jason had also realized that their bloodline should be much more distinct than it was the case with him owing to the fact that he was not a pure-blooded Celestia.
Despite that, he had other advantages than the distinctly strengthened mana or pure aura.
But, his biggest advantage had always been the combination of his soul world and his Celestia bloodline.
With that in mind, Jason wanted to strengthen both aspects; enhancing his human bloodline's traits as well as his Celestia bloodline.
And what other way could he use than unleashing more seals that had been laid upon his Celestia bloodline?
Under normal circumstances, he would calmly wait for multiple seals to be ready to be unleashed in order to use the released energy and chaos attribute to defeat his opponents quickly.
However, right now, the five puppets were annoying him, and once he unsealed his bloodline, his cultivation speed would accelerate.
This would allow him to unleash more seals that would simultaneously strengthen his entire body, provide him with divine energy, and most importantly with a strengthened aura and stigma.
With that in mind, Jason was ready to go all-in and fully prepared to feel the endless pain of almost breaking his vessel.
He knew that his body was still too weak to accept the enormous strength and overcome every challenge that was unveiled in front of him.
After stepping outside the portal, with his five soulbonds tightly clinging to him, Jason wanted to take a deep breath.
Yet, before he could do so, he and his soulbonds were overwhelmed by a unique fragrance.
This caused the pores all over his body to open, allowing tremendous amounts of mana to enter his body.
Only a moment later, when mana entered his body, he felt that something was weird about it.
A bright smile appeared on his face as he mumbled.
"So…that was what they meant with the most suitable cultivation environment?"
Just at that moment, he felt his mana veins pulsating as it felt like they had been strengthened.
Owing to an increased potency, the mana veins were able to circulate more mana through his body, and at a much faster speed than before.
Through this, his cultivation speed could accelerate by at least three times.
However, that was not everything because his soulbonds felt the exact same way about their cultivation speed.
Even the Sacred Squirrel had decided to stay awake and focus on cultivating and strengthening its blessings.
Yet, before any of his five soulbonds could start cultivating, Jason told them to stay by his side.
Staring at the Sacred Squirrel, he looked at its golden stigma.
He smiled to realize that it had emerged not long ago, and asked curiously,
"Can you try to activate your search blessing to find the best possible place to cultivate?"
Jason was not sure how exactly the blessings of the Sacred Squirrel worked because even the foresight ability felt somewhat weird to him.
Despite that, the Sacred Squirrel should be able to know what they could do, and how exactly they worked.
Thus, he wanted to figure out if his assumption was correct, and if he could find what he was asking for.
Nodding its head, the Sacred Squirrel jumped on the open palm of Jason's hand before it began to release its blessing.
This caused the Sacred Squirrel to shine in a bright glow before it looked in a particular direction.
Following this, Jason walked into the direction he was told to, adjusting himself every single time his youngest soulbond was turning her head in a particular direction.
Several hours passed by, and Jason couldn't help but feel that the space they had entered was much bigger than initially expected.
There were no beasts or anything like that around, yet, the flourishing nature that surrounded him could be described as dense and thriving.
In the end, there was not even a single sign of a beast quarrel or anything to denote the influence of artificial interjection. Everything was the same as nature had created it.
At least that was the case until Jason emerged inside the densely packed forest.
Using Byakur to move forward, he cut through branches, paving his way in the direction the Sacred Squirrel told him.
After walking for a while, he finally found the desired place he wanted to reach.
Thus, he cast a good look around while retracting Byakur back into the soul world.
After that was done, Jason's eyes began to gleam brightly, feeling the effect of the surrounding scent and environment.
'That is how it should be!' He could only think knowing that his cultivation speed would be around five times higher than usual.
And that was solely due to the cultivation environment the dungeon provided him!
It neither included his Celestia aura and stigma, nor the overlapping effect of multiple stigmas that were utilized at the same time.
However, even then, Jason knew that unleashing his bloodline's seals would allow him to further increase his cultivation speed. This realization caused his eyes to brighten up even further as the determination to make the best use of the next 6 months could be seen within them.
His mind was set in stone, as he sat down before telling his soulbonds to take the most comfortable shape and position.
Thus, Petri and Artemis reverted to their original size, bulldozing trees and bushes freely, while Spyro turned into a small human-like being.
Afterward, it sat down on the ground, right next to Solaris who took the shape of a miniature-sized black dragon with golden eyes.
Meanwhile, only the Sacred Squirrel didn't change anything about her shape, and she simply jumped into Artemis' plumage.
Once his soulbonds found a comfortable position to cultivate, Jason closed his eyes. before completely releasing his Celestia aura, post which he activated the stigma above his right eye.
Following that, his soulbonds activated their stigma too, filling the entire surrounding with a bright golden light that merged with the Celestia aura.
At that moment, endless streams of the three cultivation energies began to flood the group of six, and Jason couldn't help but smile brightly as he mumbled,
"Now…give me another boost!"
That being said, he unleashed several seals that were put on his Celestia bloodline, forcing his body to stiffen.
A torrent of tremendous energy waves flooded his body that was already filled with mana.
Yet, instead of backing away from the chaos inside his body, Jason used the fact that six stigmas were overlapping each other.
They were amplifying his Celestia aura that forcefully suppressed the raw energy inside his body from going wild.
Thus, he was finally able to cultivate to his heart's content, which Jason did for the following six months, increasing his strength by leaps and bounds!
