chapters.title: Chapter 827 - Foretelling
chapters.content:
Exerting the Kanadi of a Primordial technique caused Jason to feel a little bit dissatisfied.
Not only were the costs of a single practice extremely high, but the gains he received were not as per his expectations.
Instead, given his current situation, Jason knew that his strength had to increase as quickly as possible.
Because of that, he switched from practicing the Kanadi of a Primordial that was a technique with long-term gains to the new cultivation technique he had procured.
After understanding the first stage of the technique without too many difficulties, Jason could start practicing it.
He didn't waste any time and used his brain that had been refined and enhanced over and over again in order to gain the most benefits.
Having a refined and enhanced brain helped him easily cultivate for an entire week. He was slowly getting more comfortable in the way the technique demanded him to circulate the mana inside his body.
He was still far away from perfection and his movements were still crude, which was something Jason found to be ridiculous considering that he had always been good at controlling mana.
However, with the new cultivation technique, he had to control more than 20 different streams of mana inside his body that had to be circulated through him with extreme precision.
As if that wasn't a daunting task, the technique presented another hurdle in front of him by requiring the amount of mana to be exactly the same in every single mana stream.
Through this, the more mana he absorbed the more his cultivation accelerated, moving it through his body.
Unfortunately, the speed at which he could cultivate for now was little in comparison to the maximum limit of the Divine Maestra technique's first stage.
Despite that, Jason could increase his cultivation pace exponentially as long as he remained fully focused.
As such, at the end of the week, he had almost reached half of the required liquefied mana drops he needed in order to start compressing the dome crystal. Once that was done, it would allow him to be at the Peak of the Prismar stage, solely based on his cultivation base!
His strength was much higher than his cultivation base, but Jason knew that both could have been much higher if he were to stop bothering about maintaining a high weaponry, and martial art, or affinity proficiency.
But that was important because he had to make use of his strength with proper techniques. Otherwise, his cultivation base and brute strength could be high, but his true strength would reduce drastically over time.
With that in mind, Jason stopped cultivating after a week because he sensed that his soulbonds were finally waking up after almost a month had passed.
Their hibernation was over and they had finally adjusted to the enhancements they had undergone.
In the end, every single trait of their entire being had been enhanced, whether it were their cultivation veins, their vessel, their physique, and much more.
Thus, Jason was excited to see them once again, which made him instinctively open his soul world to the outside.
It was only a few moments later that Sira, Spyro and Solaris emerged from the soul world, before they clung to Jason, claiming their usual spots as before.
Following that Artemis and Petri followed suit in their smallest form and they moved towards their old, familiar position like usual.
In the beginning, Jason didn't notice much of a difference because Spyro and Solaris could change their form whenever they wanted.
However, in the case of Artemis and Petri, their appearance looked much more refined, sharp, and deadlier than before. Meanwhile, Sira's silver emblems with golden outlines on the back had grown a little bit, looking as if it was attached to her Stigma.
Despite their outer appearance having changed only a little bit, the outer side of his soulbonds was not as important as their inside!
Jason felt tremendous changes within his soulbonds, which made him smile at them proudly.
As such, he spent some time with them inside the small room he had lodged before he began to distribute the techniques he had purchased.
It was not easy to make his soulbonds read, but he wanted them to use their improved intelligence in order to do something useful with it.
He had successfully distracted Artemis with a technique about the ice affinity, and how it could be used properly, keeping her occupied for hours.
Meanwhile, Spyro received a few more techniques the Spiral path used, followed by Solaris receiving a fire affinity-based technique that was similar to the Dragon fire, yet more versatile.
On the other hand, Petri received a technique that was based on the enhancement of curses which was something that interested Jason too.
Only Sira didn't receive a single technique because techniques with blessings were rare to find, and not that useful for the Sacred Squirrel's specific blessings.
But she wasn't going to sit idle as Jason had thought of something he wanted her to do.
As such, by allowing Sira to enter his mana core for the first time, he wanted to use her blessed energy to activate the foretelling blessing, which worked rather easily.
Instead of causing any trouble, the blessed energy was smoothly transferred from the Sacred Squirrel inside his body, before it was used to activate the foretelling blessing.
Afterward, he used a single thought to let the foretelling blessing know what he was eager to find out.
[Where is Jennifer?]
His question was crystal clear, and after a large amount of blessed energy was used up, Jason's eyes turned milky. Numerous pictures flashed through his mind of something that would occur in the future.
The blessing was unable to tell him what was happening right now, which Jason noticed too late. But it was not problematic because he was able to figure out where she was.
And oddly enough it was not even that far away!
In fact, he knew the place she was hiding in, which confused him a little bit because he didn't recall telling her where exactly it was located.
It was the elemental crystal cave in which he had been teleported when he had emerged on Manyr. According to the foretelling blessing, she was being hunted by strong beings at the Ascendion stage that had found clues of her being near the area.
Thus, Jason couldn't help but feel a little bit helpless about the situation. Only now did he notice something specific about the foretelling blessing he hadn't known beforehand.
It might also be a coincidence, but it would be an extremely rare one because the pictures that flashed through Jason's mind were from the next full moon!
This felt weird because the next full moon was still three weeks away, and if he was fast enough, it might even be possible for him to reach the location during that period.
However, in order to achieve this, he had to start moving.
With that in mind, he retracted his soulbonds into his soul world who were intrigued about the techniques they had begun to read, only to be pulled away by Jason.
This annoyed them, but instead of being disgruntled, they sensed how serious he was.
Thus, they remained quiet, and Sira returned to the soul world.
Normally Jason would allow Artemis to enter his mana core now because he would be able to fly much faster using her wings.
But instead of doing so, he told her to cultivate as much as possible, knowing that a big battle was going to start in three months. Thus, it would be best if she were to reach the highest possible combat prowess before that.
Meanwhile, he told his other soulbonds to do the same, before he left the city. Simultaneously, he kept practicing the movement sequences of the [Hermes Celeration] technique that allowed him to increase his speed by manifold once he mastered it.
'I will be fast enough!!' He could only think, hoping for the best as he rushed in the direction of the elemental cave!

chapters.title: Chapter 828 - Found Her!
chapters.content:
Flying with the fastest pace Jason could achieve, he reached the area around the elemental crystal cave only three weeks later.
It was not yet a full moon, but there was not much time left.
He was already close to the spot he had seen in the pictures that had flashed through his mind due to the foretelling ability.
Because of that, Jason was still relatively calm, even more so because his proficiency in the Hermes Celeration movement technique had improved quickly.
It had yet to reach the basic mastery, and Jason knew that he was quite far away from reaching that level.
But that was not important because the speed enhancement he received was already much higher than had been the case with the Floating Sky movement technique.
Because of that, Jason had no reason to complain.
Rather, he felt that he was doing quite fine. Now, the only issue he was currently facing was the question of whether he would be strong enough to defeat someone at the Ascendion stage.
He had never fought someone at the Ascendion stage, but the fact didn't make him nervous.
If he were, to be honest, his enhancements were more than enough to put him on a pedestal, increasing his strength to an extent that was much higher than anyone else could reach.
In fact, when he was still inside the Dungeon of the Primordial Descendant, Jason had been able to procure information about the unique state of his mana.
It required much more mana than one would usually need to liquefy a single drop of mana.
In the end, the answer to this was quite simple.
It was a racial trait that made him require more mana than others for every single advancement after crossing the Mortal stage.
This was quite interesting, but he also got to know that one could imitate this unique trait by using special cultivation techniques.
Jason had come across a few of those special cultivation techniques when he had been looking for the Divine Maestra technique, and the finds he made had been quite interesting.
Astonishingly, there were even techniques that could create high-quality mana drops from the purest essence of transmuted mana.
Through this, one's affinity would become much stronger, which was quite interesting to know. Jason believed that he would meet much stronger opponents in the future that used similar techniques.
Hence, he was hoping to find and practice with some of them.
It might not be something that he would encounter on Manyr, but that was perfectly fine with him.
He still had a long way to go and his path ahead was riddled with tasks he had yet to accomplish.
As such, he calmed down his excitement to fight many opponents with unique cultivation, martial art, movement, and other techniques, while continuing to wait for them in the future.
There was less than one day left before the full moon would shine on the barren lands, turning it into a land filled with brightness for one, single night.
With a calm mind, Jason waited for time to pass, while flying in the sky at a high altitude.
He kept his eyes trained on the landscape below, ready to dive the moment he spotted Jennifer.
He was being restless because he believed that the pictures he had seen thanks to the foretelling blessing showed her injured!
Even though Jennifer's appearance had changed a lot if he recalled the pictures correctly, the injuries she had sustained over the course of time were worsening her situation.
Based on the picture, she appeared to be more refined, beautiful, and full of vigor. Despite that, the exhaustion, and the fear of the unknown seemed to be overwhelming her.
Jason believed that Jennifer was extremely strong, but he didn't know the entire truth of the situation she was in.
In fact, what he knew were just rumors out of which he created his own theory.
As such, he was not sure since how long she had been hiding,? how many beings were truly looking out for her, let alone how strong the beings that wanted to find her truly were.
With that in mind, Jason figured that he would be dragged into Jennifer's mess the moment he helped her.
Yet, that didn't deter him because he already knew it beforehand.
And it was perfectly fine because he would never allow someone he liked to be kidnapped, injured, or possibly even killed, not as long as he was still alive.
He had too many regrets about the past and what he could have done.
Thus, giving his all to protect Jennifer, who was the only person he truly liked on Manyr, was the bare minimum he could do.
Otherwise, what kind of friend would he be?
Thinking about being friends with Jennifer made Jason suddenly feel odd because he was not sure how true that was.
Were they truly friends, or had there been more when they were together?
Jason believed that there had been more to their relationship than friendship, but they had never received a chance to have a talk.
It was always a rather serious topic to talk about one's relationship, even more so as Cultivator.
In the end, their schedule was messed up, and the moment he entered the Chaos Obelisk, it had been over either way.
Three years had passed, and Jason was not even sure how he felt about anything anymore. He just wanted to help Jennifer, because he believed that she was important enough to be saved from severe injury.
Yet, at the same time, Jason clearly felt that he wouldn't sacrifice his life for her because his soulbonds would die with him.
Even if Jennifer was important, his soulbonds were his family, and he would sacrifice himself for their survival if necessary, and possible.
As such, Jason knew that his soulbonds were more important to him than Jennifer.
And even if he would ever like her more than his soulbonds, which was impossible to ever happen because his soul was not connected to them in a literal sense, he didn't know what Jennifer thought about him, to begin with.
With that in mind, he shook his head, averting his attention to properly observe his surroundings.
He was trying to find Jennifer and the beings that pursued her.
His previous uncertainty about the question of whether he was able to defeat beings at the Ascendion stage was washed away as if it had never existed.
This was the case because he sensed unique changes about Artemis.
She seemed to have continued digesting the enhancements the Runic circle of Unlimited enhancements gave her after she had liquefied one million drops of mana.
It would take a few months at the bare minimum until the dome crystal would be solidified, and that was more than fine with Jason.
Rather, Artemis was exceeding his expectations once again because her cultivation speed had further accelerated.
However, that was not only the case with Artemis because his other soulbonds were the same.
Like her, they were accelerating their cultivation speed by fully digesting the enhancement the inheritance of the Dungeon of the Primordial Descendant brought forth!
This made Jason happy because he knew just how mighty the enhancements he had received were.
Knowing that his soulbonds received the same enhancements was something he would never complain about.
Thus, only when he saw slightly familiar energy fluctuations even if they had changed a lot shooting over the barren lands with a rapid speed, did he avert his attention.
Those fluctuations were being followed by more than 10 beings at the Ascendion stage and he shot at them after taking a deep breath.
While looking into the sky for a mere moment, he saw the bright full moon.
Despite the fact that he would join the fray, Jason was unable to stop himself from smiling as he mumbled.
"Artemis, it's time, let's clean up a little mess!"

chapters.title: Chapter 829 - Rescue
chapters.content:
Initiating the fusion with Artemis, he dove towards Jennifer and the ten beings that pursued her.
Without too much of a hassle, he figured out that Jennifer had yet to reach the Ascendion stage.
Yet, her speed was on par with the beings at the Initial phase of the Ascendion stage, indicating that they had reached it not long ago.
It looked like their souls were not fully fused with their vessel.
This was quite an advantage for both Artemis and Jason because it meant that their final strength would be much lower than that of a proper Ascendion stage cultivator.
In fact, it might be close to that, but Jason's worry was fueled by the appearance of a Mid rank Ascendion stage cultivator, or even someone stronger.
It was clear that the Aeus and Devir race didn't think too highly of Jennifer, which was great.
Jason was glad that the two races hadn't sent out stronger Cultivators to finish off Jennifer.
It was most likely owing to the fact that the Aeus and Devir race including the Manyrs were too focused on fighting against the other races that were infiltrating the Julandra region.
Jason didn't care about that, even a tiny bit, and the races could attack whoever they wanted.
He was only interested in figuring out what happened to Jennifer and Luna, followed by one particular race he was eager to find out more about- the Shadow Walkers!
The fact that they were on Manyr revealed two possibilities that Jason hadn't thought of before.
First, the Shadow walkers could have entered Argos knowing that there were humans with the Maest cultivation path.
They could have a plan of using humans in order to do something on Manyr which might be their home planet.
Or, the second possibility was that the Shadow walkers had simply expanded their reach.
After they found the human race on Argos, they could have made use of the soul world, and soul awakening, allowing them to become stronger.
In the latter possibility, the Shadow Walkers wouldn't have been on Manyr for a long time, but that was the less likely possibility if Jason were to be honest.
Thus, he simply didn't mind it for now, and he just hoped to encounter Lux, who might be somewhere close…closer than Jason might think!
Yet, for now, something else was much more important. This caused Jason to use the strengthened moonlight affinity to strengthen his mana tremendously.
By circulating the strengthened moonlight transmuted mana through his body, he exerted the Hermes Celeration movement technique, increasing his strength tremendously.
He was still flying towards Jennifer and the beings at the Ascendion stage, but despite the strong mana currents he released nobody had noticed him yet.
That was owing to the fact that he had been at a comparatively high altitude enabling him to see everyone entering the range of his sight instantaneously.
Using his great eyesight that had been further enhanced through the Runic circle of Unlimited enhancements, Jason was able to see everything down to the finest detail.
Owing to the long way he had to take in order to arrive near Jennifer, the fusion with Artemis was already completed before he reached them.
As such, his Arctic aura along with the two Stigmas on his forehead were fully released, and everything was intertwined in the moonlight affinity.
Thus, his overall strength increased by around 70%, making him extremely powerful.
However, that was not everything he was using. Instead, it was just the beginning!
Releasing the divine energy that had also been strengthened by the dungeon's inheritance, he intertwined it with his aura and the mana which he circulated through his body.
Owing to that, his strength increased further, allowing him to reach a breathtaking speed, making it seem like a sky blueish- silver star was shooting through the cloudless sky.
In the end, it was just Jason, but it didn't take Jennifer and her pursuers a long time to notice him.
In fact, the moment he released his divine energy, everything changed because his Arctic aura enlarged several times over, filling a part of the sky.
Despite realizing that something was approaching them with a shocking velocity, the beings at the Ascendion stage ignored it. They believed that it was simply an attack shot by a being at the Mid Ascendion stage just because it was boring.
Yet, it was only when it was already too late that they were able to perceive that something was wrong, that something in the ginormous hue was moving.
There was no attack of a Mid Ascendion stage beast, but only Jason, who reached the Ascendion stage,? was the closest to Jennifer.
It had almost reached the overly exhausted halfling, but it was just at that moment, when the Ascendion stage being was certain that it had caught Jennifer, that the remaining air left its lungs.
Following that, it heard loud cracks, only to realize that it was, in fact, its spine that had issued these sounds.
Only a moment later, it was catapulted to the ground due to the impact of Jason's dive that had attained a terrifying pace. It was halted on the back of the being at the Ascendion stage.
After its back or more specifically, its spine was broken, Jason's dive was halted. But his Arctic aura had yet to cause any effects, which it did without any delay as it spread through the surroundings. The aura reached Jennifer and the 10 beings at the Ascendion stage.
They wanted to release their own aura in order to block off Jason's, but with a shocked expression they realized that this was not possible.
Their aura was inferior in front of Jason's arctic aura that broke their aura apart, before freezing the clothes of the Ascendion stage beings.
Following that, it seeped inside their body, freezing the hair, nails, feathers, and skin of the Ascendion stage cultivators.
Every cell of the beings was affected by the Arctic aura that restricted their movements instantaneously making them go rigid.
Through this, Jason's speed, which was already higher than that of the beings at the Ascendion stage, received an additional boost, increasing his chances of victory by a huge margin.
However, that was not something he required, to begin with.
Both the divine energy and moonlight affinity were enhancing Jason to the extent at which the being at the Initial phase of the Ascendion stage could only plead with him to let it survive.
In fact, Cultivators, at the Initial phase of the Ascendion stage would be powerful enough to fight hundreds of beings that were at a slightly lower cultivation base.
But in the end, their raw strength was 'only' three times higher than that of beings at the Peak Prismar stage.
This was owed to the fact that one's vessel and soul hadn't been fully fused yet, which would take some time for both sides to adjust to each other and become more compatible.
Thus, Jason didn't fear fighting against the Ascendion stage beings in front of him, as their strength was only three times higher than that of a being at the Peak Prismar stage.
And, in the end, they didn't look extremely powerful either, based on the expressions they showcased the moment Jason arrived in the middle of their high-speed chase!
Dumbfounded by Jason's combat prowess whose cultivation base was only between the Mid and Late Prismar stage, they didn't even realize the vibrant smile that emerged on Jennifer's dead-tired face the moment she understood who had come to her rescue.
'He… is still alive!!'

chapters.title: Chapter 830 - Welcome Back
chapters.content:
After releasing Byakur, Jason didn't even take a single glance at the being whose spine he had just broken.
Instead, he exerted the Hermes Celeration technique with moonlight transmuted mana and the divine energy that was merged within.
The combined force allowed him to catapult himself right in front of the closest Ascendion stage cultivator that was in fact an Aeus, whose wings were already about to freeze.
Jason's appearance was similar to that of an Aeus, yet, completely different, which was confusing.
Yet, instead of worrying about this, the Aeus lifted the spear it was holding in an attempt to deflect Jason's attack.
It was only then that it noticed that Byakur started to shrink the moment it was supposed to collide with the spear.
It was barely a fraction of a second later that Jason thrust out with Byakur that enlarged once again, reaching the size of a normal short sword.
Piercing through the neck of the astonished Aeus, Byakur finished it off.
The Aeus took its last breath without knowing what or how Jason was able to avoid the spear that was ought to block his attack.
Without looking back, Jason simply grasped the dying Aeus before he threw it in the direction of the biggest group of Cultivators that was about to attack him.
This allowed him to distract them for a fraction of a second. It was more than enough to enlarge Byakur while manifesting several hundreds of icicles in a radius through which his Arctic aura permeated the surroundings.
Following that, the icicles that had been manifested out of divine energy had merged with the moonlight transmuted mana. The use of the drastically enhanced ice affinity of Artemis, pointed towards the group before they were shot out.
It was just a moment later that Jason heard several painful cries, only for his eyes that had turned sky blue to perceive something from his right.
The foresight blessing that had also received severe enhancements owing to Sira's cultivation process and the Runic circle's enhancements allowed him to perceive an attack from his right.
Thus, he didn't pay any more attention to the group of Cultivators he had just attacked with the icicles.
Instead, he manifested a sky blueish-silver wall of flames in that direction before he shot upwards into the sky.
Afterward, dozens of fireballs of the same color manifested around him before they were thrown in that direction.
At the same time, a fireball exploded behind him pushing Jason in the direction of the attack.
Flapping his wings to maintain his balance, he smiled lighty.
He felt exhilarated at finally being able to control his body and affinities almost perfectly, while he inserted more mana in Byakur simultaneously.
Through this, the longsword began to vibrate lightly as he slashed out at the Devir, who had attempted to attack him backhandedly, using his entire strength.
With enough mana that was strengthened by divine energy and the moonlight affinity circulating through Byakur, in addition to the extraordinary physical strength of Jason, he was able to overwhelm the Devir when they first clashed upon each other.
Forcing the Devir to retreat, Jason's eyes began to gleam brightly.
He instinctively exerted the strengthened version of the petrification curse, which was more than enough to restrict the Devir for a short moment.
After all, the curses he harbored had also been enhanced through the customized Inheritance he had received inside the dungeon!
Using this momentum to lean his body forward, he thrust Byakur into the Devir's abdomen, who could only gasp in shock. Simultaneously, he also released the sky blueish-silver flame that began to suddenly envelop its blade.
Owing to that, it was only a moment later that the Devir was on the brink of death.
As it took its last breaths, the number of opponents Jason had to defeat had decreased by one.
However, the fight was far from over, and the opponents that had been hit by the icicles might be injured, but this didn'T mean they were dead.
They were visibly affected by the freezing property of his ice affinity that had undergone several amplifications, yet that didn't mean Jason could lower his guard.
Yet, he kept his cool and used a fraction of a second to fill the entire area with his Arctic aura. He enclosed it with icicles and sky blueish-silver fireballs before he shot them out towards the remaining opponents.
A moment later, he turned his head to take a quick glance at Jennifer to see how she was faring.
Seeing that she was fine, he smiled lightly before he returned his attention to the fight.
He might be overwhelming his opponents right now, but Jason knew that he should never underestimate his opponents. There might be existences similar to the Primordial races, whose imitations aka the lesser puppets, had already been more powerful than him!
Thus, Jason remained vigilant even after his Emperor Eyes had swept through his opponents.
He noticed that not a single sign inside their body indicated that they were powerful, let alone that they possessed any kind of unique cultivation technique.
As such, they were just normal cultivators, without anything special about them.
Because of that, Jason felt that the fight was not as intense as he had initially presumed it to be.
However, that was just another sign that clearly indicated to him how powerful he had become throughout the last three years he spent in the dungeon.
Knowing that he didn't waste his time was great, and even more so was figuring out that he was already able to defeat someone at the Ascendion stage.
According to his cultivation base, he should be quite far from reaching that stage after all!
Thus, he was overjoyed about his current combat prowess, and couldn't hold back his excitement anymore. It was clearly visible in the Arctic aura that became even stronger due to his emotions just like it was the case for normal Celestias!
Through this, his control of everything that had to do even remotely with the ice affinity became much easier. It allowed Jason to control even more icicles and fireballs with which he attacked the remaining beings at the Ascendion stage.
After throwing the icicles and fireballs at his opponents, he heard their pained cries reverberating through the surrounding, but Jason didn't show any mercy.
Instead, he continued to manifest more batches of icicles and fireballs which he once again flung at his opponents.
Owing to Artemis' trait to convert moonlight in mana…or what Jason presumed it to be, he could continue to use up tremendous amounts of mana until the full moon would be over, but that was not what he did.
Instead, he threw only a few batches of hundreds of icicles and fireballs at his opponents before he began to exert the Hermes Celeration technique.
Finishing off the remaining opponents one after another, Jason simultaneously picked up their spatial rings before appearing in front of Jennifer just a moment later.
With a bright smile on his face, Jason slowly terminated the fusion he had with Artemis, reverting to his original appearance as his golden eyes stared straight at Jennifer.
Unbeknownst to Jennifer, the seemingly simple eye contact she made with Jason brought back vivid memories of her recent horrific past.
Every single horrifying incident she had witnessed or been a part of was etched into her memory.
Despite that, somehow after seeing Jason, the intensity of those memories visibly decreased.
She was not scared of them, not anymore.
Instead, Jennifer felt oddly reassured as she returned Jason's smile, a single tear trickling down her cheek as she said.
"Welcome back…dummy!"

chapters.title: Chapter 831 - Crumbling
chapters.content:
It was as if he and Jennifer had never been separated because they greeted each other like old friends.
There was no awkwardness, or discomfort which was a great advantage because both of them had lots of things to say.
More than three years had passed since their last meeting, after all!
In fact, being able to speak to each other as if they had never separated showed how comfortable the two of them were with each other.
As such, Jennifer began to tell Jason what had happened after her Legacy trial had concluded.
She had received an Inheritance that was in the form of a cultivation manual for all three cultivation energies followed by her three energies being naturally merged together.
This meant that her body's constitution was altered and modified.
It had been tweaked to make it similar to the Three paths puppet Jason had encountered and fought before.
To be precise, Jason felt that the merging process of her energies allowed Jennifer to exert much more strength than before. Meanwhile, the cultivation technique she received was at the Initial Luna rank too!
This was exceptional considering that her technique did not belong to the Primordial race, but the Preactor race's traitor.
They were a Grand race which indicated that the Luna ranked cultivation technique was the strongest technique they possessed.
With that in mind, it was quite obvious why the Preactors wanted to retrieve the Inheritance!
Jason was glad that Jennifer had received the cultivation technique and the other part of the Inheritance, but what followed after she left Kinra Island was rather disastrous.
In the end, everything was more or less the same as what he had got to know from rumors.
By the time Jennifer returned, her master had already received an Immortal eye. One of the other cadets who had been sent out to procure one had successfully done so.
This meant that this one cadet was extremely powerful, to the extent that he had passed all trails without too much of a hassle.
It was exceptional, but it would have been better if the cadet had never kept his promise of procuring an Immortal Eye.
When Jennifer returned from Kinra Island, Luna brought all of them back.
She had completely ignored Jason as her objectives were fulfilled.
Thus, she had taken the rest of them back home without bothering to wait for Jason, even if it would have been only a few days of wait.
Instead, after she had obtained the Immortal Eye, she shut herself in the Auxiliary tower and started to work on something.
During the few moments that passed while she was confined to the Auxiliary tower, the races of the adjacent areas had attacked the Julandra region, trying to claim it for themselves.
This was not that difficult because the Aeus and Devir race had not joined forces at that time.
Only when they created an alliance were they able to prevent the races from continuing with their advance.
They had started to hold grand meetings in which they gathered all important individuals that had enough power in their race to change something.
And it looked like they had charged straight at Luna's mansion.
Meanwhile, Luna returned from the tower, with a crazed expression, which had already caused a premonition in Jennifer's mind.
In the end, Jason knew the rest of the details- Luna had planned a terror act, killing hundreds of the strongest powerhouses of the Devir and Aeus race.
She had made use of a bomb that had been created by using the Immortal Eye as the main ingredient.
This type of bomb didn't radiate any energy fluctuations that would alert people.
Only when it exploded would the victims realize that something was wrong, but it would be too late to do anything.
As such, it was more like a silent killer that stored enough compressed energy, equivalent to the force of several hundred Peak stage powerhouses!
Thus, none of the individuals that had gathered were able to protect themselves.
Their chances of survival further deteriorated owing to the unique type of energy Luna had used in order to pierce through her opponents' energy membranes.
Not much time had passed until Luna was found as the culprit, but even then nobody had ever seen her again.
Yet, the same couldn't be said about her disciple, Jennifer.
Almost everybody knew that Jennifer was next in command after Luna.
This turned her into the second most important target followed by the other subordinates of the City Lord.
As such, she was hunted for the last one and a half years, preventing her from advancing in her cultivation as she would have loved to.
Other than that many things had happened in the Julandra region in his absence but that was not important to Jason.
He only kept listening to Jennifer intently, who couldn't stop herself from sharing every little detail.
Unsure of how much time passed, Jason could only assume that Jennifer was on her own since she was being hunted. It was possible that she was too scared to enter even the smallest cities.
If that were to be the case, it would mean that she had no contact with anyone while being on a constant run, scared that someone might find and kill her.
Because of that, she was lonely and in a dire need of someone, she could talk to.
Hence, upon finding Jason, who was one of the few beings she still trusted, she was beyond relieved.
In fact, had Jennifer not known that some of Luna's subordinates were clueless about her schemings, she would have even doubted them.
However, the hardest she had been hit with was certainly by her master, who had simply left her all alone, without saying anything.
It was almost as if she was just some toy Luna had played with to waste some time and discarded her when she was of no use.
Jennifer couldn't believe that this was possible. But even if it wasn't, she had no idea what exactly had truly happened, or if she had done something to betray her master's trust.
Because of that, she was unable to hold back her emotions as her eyes turned moist the more she spoke about the last few years.
Unsure what he was supposed to do, Jason followed his instincts as he embraced her, trying to reassure her that everything was fine.
Before, he had been worried that he and Jennifer wouldn't be able to speak comfortably with each other after the huge gap.
Many many things could happen in a span of more than three years.
However, right now, he felt foolish for this though because in most cases, he had only been wondering if they would be able to return to their younger self and behave like that.
While mentally scolding himself for feeling like that, Jason didn't even notice that Jennifer returned the hug as she began to cry.
Her legs gave in owing to the exhaustion of the last years of fighting all alone.
Now, she knew that she didn't have to hold back her emotions anymore, which made her cry until her tears stopped flowing.
Even though her tears had dried, she continued to sob while clinging to his shirt which was now soaked wet. Jason couldn't believe that the powerful woman he had encountered more than four years ago was crumbling right in front of him.
Jennifer was done with braving the dangers all alone and trying to hold herself together as the person she trusted the most had betrayed her, followed by a long time of anxiousness of getting caught and killed.
Jason might not know much about Jennifer's past, but he knew that Luna had raised her, which spoke volumes about their relationship.
Because of that, even Jason had difficulties believing that Luna would abandon Jennifer. From what he assumed, she must have been like a mother to Jennifer, hence the betrayal stung even more
Everything was a little complicated, and Jason couldn't help but feel odd. But, in an effort to distract Jennifer, he attempted to tell her his story, and what had happened to him.
However, that had to wait until Jennifer was done crying.

chapters.title: Chapter 832 - Creating False Evidence
chapters.content:
In the end, Jason didn't have much to tell her.
He simply shared the truth with her that he was pulled towards a specific dungeon, in which he had solved various trials before he received an inheritance and many great rewards.
However, the more he spoke about the content of the trials, and what kind of passing score he received for the things he did, the more serious Jennifer's expression became.
Once he concluded his story, she was staring at him in doubt, not sure what to say anymore.
She was already doubtful when Jason spoke about the city-like treasury, but the moment he said that there were several [Sun] ranked techniques out of which he had chosen one, Jennifer was utterly dumbfounded.
But, her confusion only increased when Jason said that he didn't take any of such techniques because he was interested in a gradeless technique instead!
The moment Jason said this, she felt like punching him, momentarily forgetting that she had cried just a few minutes earlier.
Because he noticed that, Jason handed over the Kanadi of a Primordial technique to her without bothering to conceal the truth.
He had already told her that he was a Celestia Halfling, but until now, neither Luna nor Jennifer had believed him.
As for Luna's disbelief, Jason couldn't help but be glad because she wouldn't be able to tell anyone about him if she didn't believe in his lineage.
Thus, only Jennifer had to believe him, but even that was something Jason had decided not to try anymore- convincing anyone about his origin.
Either they believed him when he decided to trust them enough to share the truth, or they could choose to believe that he was lying.
It was their free will, and nothing he had to force on someone.
Despite not believing Jason beforehand, everything he had said so far made more and more sense.
This included how his combat prowess had suddenly increased to the extent that he was able to defeat ten beings at the Ascendion stage while being at the Mid-Late Prismar stage himself.
Jennifer had also been able to perceive Jason's aura several times over and over again.
As such, she began to believe him the moment she had read through the introductory part of the Kanadi of a Primordial technique.
At first glance, the technique seemed simple, but after reading a few pages, Jennifer realized that one's full potential was the most important to practice this technique.
This included both the released and the potential that was still hidden
Thus, Jason had to believe in his potential enough to choose the Kanadi of a Primordial technique over [Sun] ranked techniques!
With that in mind, Jennifer forgot all about her worries and was mindlessly staring at Jason, who was staring at the corpses of the Ascendion stage beings.
"Do you think they have a device to locate each other? So that one would find them if they were to die or get lost?"
With an unsure expression, Jason continued to observe them, only to turn his head towards Jennifer, who was not sure herself.
"Just take a look at their spatial rings. If there is something like a tracking device inside, just destroy it or whatever."
Nodding his head, Jason did as she said, and as he had presumed there was one tracking device in each of the spatial rings.
However, before destroying them, he got an idea as he looked at the elemental crystal cave.
"By the way, how about you use your affinities to dig out some elemental crystal and the elemental ore?"
This question caused Jennifer to look at him in doubt.
However, upon seeing his expression, she quickly figured out that he was teasing her.
"That was a joke. Just rest inside the elemental cave. Enter the entrance and descend the vertical tunnel. Afterward, you will enter a small hall. There shouldn't be any beasts in it."
While she continued to look at Jason in doubt, Jennifer's first thought was that he wanted to abandon her too.
But then she realized that Jason wouldn't tell her if he were to leave her behind which caused her to ask,
"And...what are you going to do in the meantime?"
Jason had already thought of a plan but before they would be able to do anything, he had to distract the Devir and Aeus.
Thus he pointed at the corpses of the few Ascendion stage Cultivators before answering her.
"I'll dispose of them, destroy their tracking devices far from here before returning. After that we will create a proper plan about what we want to do and then… we just act accordingly.
And we are mining some of the elemental ore and elemental crystals so we have sufficient funds wherever we want to go!"
With that being said, Jason stored away the corpses before he manifested Artemis' wings.
"I'll be back in three days, and if I don't find you sound asleep when I return, I'm gonna scold you!"
He was still teasing her, and Jason felt that it was easing Jennifer's tension, which was why he began to tease her, to begin with.
After taking her to the entrance of the vertical tunnel that was hidden quite well, Jason bid her farewell.
He then exerted the Hermes Celeration technique with some of his divine energy in order to reach a terrifying speed.
A total of three days passed in which he spent one and a half days flying in a zig-zag way while trying to throw the corpses as far as possible.
However, instead of breaking the tracking devices he laid them down, only to turn the surroundings into a battlefield, and completely destroy it.
Afterward, he worsened the wounds on the Ascendion stage beings, using the claws of Artemis which he manifested.
It was annoying to do so, but Jason had to give his best to make others believe that a huge battle had happened here, and not that the true crime scene was somewhere else.
With that in mind, he spent almost two hours making it as believable as possible before he left the place for good.
In the end, it would take a few days until someone noticed that the tracking devices remained on the same spot for days.
By then, he would have long since returned to the elemental cave, where he wanted to spend enough time to liquefy sufficient mana drops and solidify the dome crystal, which he also wanted to finish before leaving.
As such, when he returned to Jennifer, who was still sleeping, nobody had figured out that Jennifer's pursuers were already dead.
Thus, instead of bothering Jennifer, Jason began to cultivate the Divine Maestra technique.
With each day that passed, he was able to improve the speed at which he cultivated. But right now, this was accelerated further because he didn't have to worry about Jennifer anymore.
She was right by his side, and mostly unscathed, which was great.
Only her mental state was something he was a little bit bothered about, but other than that, Jason had nothing left to complain about.
Thus, a week passed before she woke up, and they began to devise a plan about what they were supposed to do next.
In the end, they came to a consensus as Jason got to know something astonishing.
"Your…parents are still alive?! I thought they were…dead!"

chapters.title: Chapter 833 - Together
chapters.content:
Initially, Jason's plan had been simple.
He wanted to enter the peak of the Prismar stage before initiating the plan he and Jennifer had set up.
At the same time, Jennifer wanted to enter the Initial phase of the Ascendion stage by starting the fusion process of her soul with the three vessels she owned.
However, both tasks were something that required much more time than they had initially assumed, even after using Luna ranked techniques.
Because of that, they spent an entire year inside the elemental crystal cave, which allowed Jason to solidify the dome crystal. Meanwhile, Jennifer had been able to connect her soul to her vessel and enter the Ascendion stage.
This process took her extremely long, and Jason knew that he would require some time to reach that rank too. This was even more evident because his secondary Celestia bloodline awakening would happen.
That was something Jason could clearly sense because there was only one seal of the Chaos Emperor on his bloodline left before the second awakening could be initiated.
With that in mind, Jason was worried about possible mistakes that could happen. But at the same time, he was excited because he wanted the secondary bloodline awakening to happen as quickly as possible.
There was no need to waste any time, after all!
Unfortunately, this was easier said than done, before Jason realized that he somehow had to connect his soul world's core with his mana core.
In fact, it was necessary for him to create a thick thread of mana that would be connected to a soul thread before they would slowly come into contact with each other.
Because of that, Jason was required to liquefy mana once again.
He had hoped that the arduous process of liquefying mana was over, but that was not the case.
Rather, he required more and more, which was quite annoying.
However, his soulbonds had to do a similar process, but only Artemis and Solaris had created their dome crystal, to begin with.
As such, it would take a while before Petri, Spyro, and Sira would reach a state in which they had to connect their soul and vessel.
Jason was not sure if the connection he had with his soulbonds would cause any problems in their progress to the Ascendion stage, but he simply hoped that this would not be the case.
Otherwise, he might face quite a few issues to which he had no answers.
Yet, after considering that the soul connection he had with his soulbonds had never been an issue, Jason was able to keep his calm.
While it was important for them to cultivate, Jennifer and Jason never stopped sparring with each other.
The two of them had to practice martial art techniques, and cultivating for a year nonstop was not something for them because they didn't want their muscles to grow numb or rust.
Other than that, they had to be in their best form if a monster or other beings were to find them.
They might be attacked, which would be annoying, but at least, they would be able to protect themselves.
That was even more so the case when Jason broke into the peak of the Prismar stage because his dome crystals were four times stronger than that of the others.
Thus, even without his soulbonds' amplification, he would be strong enough to defeat someone at the Initial phase of the Ascendion stage.
With that in mind, Jason had no complaints. Now, his brute strength was greater than Jennifer's which annoyed her because she had three awakened cultivation veins, while Jason had only one.
She was supposed to be stronger, but in the end, this was not the case, and made her feel useless and weak.
Obviously, she was not weak, and by no means useless, and it was just Jason who was a cut above the rest.
However, that was not the case either, because Jason was not simply an exception.
He could be called an anomaly, while Jennifer was close behind, in face of the perception of ordinary cultivators at the Ascendion stage!
After all, Jennifer could be considered to have entered the Initial phase of the Ascendion stage not once but thrice as she cultivated in all three cultivation paths!
Her combat prowess was by no means comparable to a normal Cultivator at the Initial phase of the Ascendion stage, and Jason was fully aware of this.
Despite that, his last few years were filled with intense fights that advanced his combat awareness, overall proficiency in fighting, and an acute sense of perceiving his opponents much better.
Furthermore, he was able to see Jennifer's attacks before they even happened with the use of his blessing, and by using his curses, and Emperor Eyes, he easily defeated Jennifer.
Because of that, she felt weak, and useless, but at the same time, Jason was relentless and never stopped giving his all to fight her.
Rather, he restricted his strength in certain ways, such as not using his Emperor Eyes and curses, or deactivating the foresight blessing, while using everything else to the limit.
All of this was possible, and it was also important because he required the necessary pressure to comprehend more of the Bladed Ruyi Bang martial art technique.
At the same time, he had to figure out more about the enhancements all of his soulbonds had received in order to know their capabilities down to the finest detail.
Following that, Jason tested the enhancements and the fusion to figure out how strong he was.
However, during these times he defeated Jennifer rather easily which frustrated her more than anything.
And in the end, even if it looked like Jason used every means to strengthen himself, some might feel as if he was still holding back.
This caused her to feel depressed, and Jason was not sure what he was supposed to do about it. But then it was useless if he and Jennifer were to fight, and neither would feel a sense of pressure.
By sparring with Jennifer, he was always taking her seriously, even if it looked like he was holding back, which was not the case.
Otherwise, how were they supposed to fulfill the mission they had wanted to achieve?
In the end, there were many things they wanted to accomplish, but only a handful had to do with the Julandral region, let alone the Aeus and Devir race.
In fact, only Jennifer had some connection to both races because her parents who were still alive hailed from these two races.
Her current appearance might not look like that of a halfling, but that didn't mean she had no family.
She looked like a completely different individual owing to the Inheritance that had properly merged her constitution, leaving no space for repulsive acts of her two bloodlines.
Rather from what Jason understood, her father, a Devir that looked more like a human than some Manyrs, was a high noble of the Devir race.
Meanwhile, her mother had been a commoner born with three pairs of wings, turning her into someone with the looks, and also the talent of the Aeus race's strongest forces.
In fact, there seemed to be something unique about the fact that Jennifer's mother had six wings. And considering that she had only seen Aeus with two pairs of wings, except her own mother who had three, spoke volumes of her mother's uniqueness.
Despite that, she knew nothing, and it was only when her parents were found out to be together that Jennifer was brought to Luna, one of their closest friends.
When Jason heard this, he felt that it was even more unlikely for Luna to simply abandon Jennifer.
'Maybe…Luna thought that she could prevent Jennifer from being dragged into her mess? But…then that doesn't really make sense either…'
Because of that, he couldn't help but feel that they had to stay a little bit longer in the Julandra region, even if their plans were not restricted to this region.
They had more than enough plans for accomplishing all kinds of things, and even if the Julandra region was not the only important factor, they had also come up with things they could do afterward as long as they stayed together.
The two of them didn't believe that they would separate from each other again, and they didn't even question this.
This was something that spoke volumes about their deepest emotions that had only increased in the time they were separated.
However, now that they had spent a year together, even if they focused on cultivating and sparring, it was a happy time, and both were unwilling to let it end.

chapters.title: Chapter 834 - Face
chapters.content:
With many plans in mind, the two of them were almost ready to depart, and there was not much for them to do inside the elemental cave.
In fact, they had already mined the elemental crystal and Tanadan ore from all of the elemental caves which was more than enough to act as their fortune.
Having amassed enough wealth they could almost see through most of their plans.
After sweeping the cave clean, the only thing they could do in the elemental cave was to cultivate.
At least, that was what Jennifer thought.
She was still unsure of how to feel as she had revealed everything about her family to him.
Jason had been the first one she trusted enough to tell everything about her past.
But, she had simply poured out her emotions in one go so the content of Jennifer's words was more than a little bit confusing to him.
There was much more to her family than he first imagined. Jennifer's mother was already more than a little bit unique as per her words.
However, adding that her father was a noble was not exactly helpful because it only showed that both of Jennifer's parents belonged to a unique family.
They both seemed to be extremely powerful, and more than enough to make her into a fearsome powerhouse.
And now she had inherited an Inheritance from a Grand race, that caused her three awoken cultivation veins to merge together.
This had strengthened her drastically and Jennifer had even received a Luna ranked cultivation technique that was perfectly suitable for her.
This was simply too advantageous for her, and she knew that if she were to cultivate for a few years, her strength would be even higher.
Unfortunately, she was not sure if it would be rational to use these few years to do everything she wanted to.
In fact, Jennifer had planned to meet her parents at least once more before asking them why they had given her to Luna.
Somehow, Jason had a bad feeling about Jennifer's plan.
Nonetheless, he decided to go with her which was something he had planned to do either way.
Both didn't want to separate from each other for whatever reason the two of them had yet to fully grasp. Thus, they had decided to travel together and solve their problems in the same way- with each other's help.
Jason thought he knew what he was feeling, but he was not sure about Jennifer.
Unlike him, she had been extremely lonely, only to add on to her hurt that everyone near and dear seemed to have betrayed her. A
And, somehow he came to her rescue at the perfect moment.
With that in mind, Jason didn't think it was the right time to talk about their feelings for each other.
Other than that, he had to understand himself first to know what exactly he wanted to do in the future.
He was unsure if he would change his future plans for someone, or to be more precise, Jennifer.
These thoughts had coursed through Jason's mind for quite some time, but they didn't make a difference to their current plan.
For now, they wished to leave the elemental cave and travel towards a specific location- the place where Jennifer's parents were ought to be.
Jason was not sure how Jennifer knew about her parents' location, but he simply accepted it, thinking that it might be something Luna told her.
However, this meant that it was not to be blindly trusted with.
With that in mind, Jason had chosen to do something he recalled just a few moments before.
"Jennifer, if you don't like your old face that much, why don't you let me change it?" Jason asked with a scheming smile.
This caused Jennifer to look at him in dumbfoundment.
But without hesitating a single second, Jason had already summoned a black flame inside his hand.
The moment she saw this, Jennifer stepped back and shook her head.
She certainly didn't want her face to be burned just to be able to travel around in disguise and without people trying to kill her.
Yet, when Jason saw her reaction, he couldn't help but laugh for a moment before he explained Solaris' abilities, and what would happen to her face when he said 'change'.
Using Solaris' ability to change one's facial features to a certain extent, he could change Jennifer's facial features to make her look more ordinary.
This was something the black origin flame had procured after devouring the Silver origin flame of his late master.
This was not a permanent solution, but if she were to wear clothes that were different than what she normally wore, and dyed her hair without relying on the concealment device she owed, it would be harder to spot her.
With more ordinary facial features, it would also be easier to walk past Cultivators who would normally be bewitched by Jennifer's appearance otherwise.
There were more than enough Cultivators who were too horny to think straight ahead when they encountered someone as beautiful as Jennifer.
As such, she had faced quite a few issues during the last years in which her master's protection was not there anymore to save her from vile men.
Jason had heard more than enough stories from her to make this statement believable, and he didn't even want to know how disgusting some Cultivators truly were.
Fortunately, nothing had happened to Jennifer in these three years.
And when she figured that her face wouldn't be burned but that her facial features would temporarily be changed, she was eager to start with the procedure right off the bat.
With that being said, Jason did as Jennifer requested.
He slowly released Solaris towards her, who covered her whole face.
Afterward, she underwent several minutes of light itches as his soulbond did its work.
Thus, when the black origin flame was retracted, Jason took a look at her, only to stare at her for a few minutes.
In the end, he had never really looked at Jennifer intently, because he knew that her appearance would distract him a lot.
That was not just because she was beautiful to the extent that nobody he had ever encountered looked similar.
Rather, it was because when he looked at her before, Jason had been able to see himself in her.
Like him, even she gave her whole attention to the individuals she was with at that time.
The way she spoke, listened and even walked… everything in her body language always pointed out that she gave her whole attention if she wanted to stay by someone's side.
Initially, he had felt like a weirdo thinking that this was the reason for him to be so attracted to her.
But it didn't take long before Jason realized that everyone wanted someone who would give them their undivided attention.
Because of that, Jason felt that he should take a proper look at her right now, which was exactly what he did.
However, what he saw astonished him greatly and when Jennifer saw his gaze, she couldn't help but take out her weapon.
She hoped to catch a glimpse of herself in the weapon's blade.
Yet, what she saw caused her to wonder why Jason was staring at her like that.
According to her, she looked quite ordinary which was both great and advantageous for their journey!
Despite her seemingly ordinary appearance, Jason couldn't help himself but stare at Jennifer.
A simple smile blossomed on his face as he remarked,
"You look beautiful!"

chapters.title: Chapter 835 - City
chapters.content:
After using Solaris to drastically change their facial features, there was not much for them to do anymore.
However, Jason didn't even think of camouflaging his stigma because it was more than enough to not activate it.
Meanwhile, his aura was retracted, yet ready to be fully unleashed at a moment's notice.
This could be compared to a mental attack if used properly.
So, Jason was quite intrigued if it would work as he assumed.
Jennifer also did her part to ensure that she looked nothing like her usual self.
She had even dyed her hair as per Jason's advice.
Thus, she was now black-haired as he was, with quite ordinary facial features.
Both of them chose ordinary features so as to not stand apart from the rest.
But, Jason had to change his facial feature once again because his golden eyes became too much of a highlight if his other facial features were not equally striking.
As such, he didn't change his original features drastically, but only a little.
Meanwhile, Jennifer's eye color was quite a mystery to Jason from the beginning.
Sometimes she had silver pupils with crimson outlines, but other times she was able to change her eye color to a dark brown, just as she had right now.
He believed that she was unable to wear contact lenses as her eye color would shine through them, just like the case with him.
However, oddly enough, everything seemed to be totally fine with her, and Jason simply accepted it.
After all of their changes were finally completed, the two of them left the elemental cave, before traveling towards their first destination.
This first destination of theirs was, in fact, the city that had once been governed by Luna.
Jennifer was well known inside the small city, even before the incident with her master.
Thus, disguising herself was a prerequisite to enter the city and walk through it freely.
It also served as a small test. If nobody would be able to identify her, most probably, she could safely travel outside the city as well.
With that in mind, they solved two tasks at once. The first was to figure out if someone would be able to identify Jennifer, while the second was to procure all kinds of resources they required.
They weren't in a dire need of cultivation stones or anything like that in order to cultivate.
Their goal was to help Jason practice the Kanadi of a Primordial technique for which he not only required high-grade mana stones but also the best possible nutrition solutions.
All of this was expensive, and the first thing Jason did was to approach an auction house.
He wanted to earn some easy money by selling four of the exotic terra ranked techniques he still had in his spatial ring.
By selling them at the next auction that was scheduled to be held at the same evening, they would be able to make the most out of the things they sold.
Simultaneously, they would also be able to walk through the city as if everything was perfectly fine.
Through this, they were able to procure quite a lot of information.
Relieved that they were not under the threat of being identified they roamed around much more effortlessly.
Their current location was not that far from the areas where the infiltrating races fought against the Aeus, Devir, and Manyr races' armies.
In fact, even the beasts that were in control of the areas that were used as their battlefield, joined the attacks followed by the adjacent areas' beasts.
They knew that the Aeus and Devir race had given them free rein as long as they steered clear of their cities.
But, this was something they couldn't be sure about with the infiltrating races.
Thus, as they were unsure about their future, they would rather side with someone they knew was relatively safe to fight alongside than to regret anything later.
Jason found this to be quite interesting but it was perfectly normal for beasts that had attained intelligence to think and make choices for themselves.
Having tasted freedom, their first thought was to protect this freedom, which was the reason they chose the Aeus and Devir's side.
This was the only logical solution, and Jason knew that this was the correct one, but he couldn't help but feel bothered about something.
"Aren't the citizens way…too relaxed? It is almost as if they could never imagine that they are safe from the warzone….that they would never feel the heat of the war!"
His confused voice reached Jennifer, who was walking right next to him, their shoulders bumping into each other, once in a while.
And when she heard his voice that was directed towards her, Jennifer turned towards him.
She stared straight into his eyes that were filled with confusion.
At this moment, all kinds of thoughts surfaced in her mind, but none of them was anywhere close to being suitable to relieve Jason of his doubts.
As such, she shook her head, trying to shake off the sense of bewitchment every time she looked into Jason's eyes.
Trying to clear her mind, she thought of a solution to wipe away his doubts.
"If I remember correctly, there had been quite a few invasions before the time…around 500 years ago, I think. Before that time, none of the races was able to claim the Julandra region for themselves, except the Aeus and Devir race that brought the Manyrs with them.
I don't know what exactly changed 500 years ago, but since then there hasn't been a single invasion.
It was also around that time that people began to believe that nothing will happen to the Julandra region. Soo…there has to be something that made other races believe it wouldn't be worth the risk of infiltrating the Julandra region.
They must have feared having too many casualties, or there might be another reason.
However, that is not something I can tell you for sure, because I am not certain about it either…I was not even born at that time after all!"
Jason nodded his head when Jennifer finished her short speech, understanding what she wanted to say.
Even if there was no proper evidence for anything she said, he knew she was not lying, unless she was lied to first.
'So something changed 500 years ago that made everyone confident in the defense of the Julandra region…alright…'
With that in mind, Jason decided to end the discussion of the topic about the nonchalant behavior of the citizens. Instead of bothering about this, he switched to procuring more information.
At the same time, they went to grab a quick meal and entered the auction house once it was time for the auction to begin.
There, the two of them met people they were already familiar with.
However, oddly enough none of them seemed to recall their energy fluctuations that were the biggest hint to their true identity.
In the end, their energy fluctuations had changed four years ago, but that didn't mean that there were no signs of their old self anymore.
Because of that, Jason and Jennifer had been worried a little bit, but that seemed to have been totally unfounded.
As such, once the auction was over, Jason received the profit.
They immediately purchased the goods he required to practice the Kanadi of a Primordial technique before he suddenly got an idea.
"Why don't you try practicing the technique too?"
Jennifer was astonished about this sudden offer, and she looked weirdly at him, only to see that he was serious.
"Do you really think this will be more useful for me than the body refining technique I use?" She thus asked, but Jason merely shrugged his shoulders as he countered.
"I have no idea, but you should give it a try to figure out if it's better or not, right?"
Smiling at Jennifer, he made her doubts disappear in an instant. She nodded her head without realizing before she answered,
"Alright"

chapters.title: Chapter 836 - Potential Of An All Refining Technique
chapters.content:
Before leaving the city, they spent a few more days in it so that Jennifer could learn the first phase of the Kanadi of a Primordial technique.
Meanwhile, Jason had already practiced it several times, and each time, he noticed an almost untraceable difference to the day before.
He was not quite sure if it was truly better than a body refinement technique, or if it would be more efficient to simply cultivate, but without giving it a proper try there was no way of finding out.
And, in fact, just a few sessions of practice was not worth being called 'giving it a try.' A single session took only a few hours each, and the life of a cultivator was extremely long.
However, even if Jason had only practiced the Kanadi of a Primordial a few times, he was already sure that his entire being was strengthened.
This meant that the tiny changes he received were doing something.
After giving it some thought, he realized that there was something he had disregarded before.
'What if the Kanadi of a Primordial technique is not laid out to be 'powerful' in its essence? Instead, what if it is supposed to cause an exponential increase in one's cultivation, combat prowess, innate talent, and so on?
The more often I practice the Kanadi of a Primordial technique, the faster I will be able to cultivate, and the stronger I can become.
If my current cultivation speed is at 1 unit, through the Kanadi of a Primordial technique it is 1.00001. That means, it's not noteworthy right now, but in the future, the longer I cultivate, the more obvious the effects will be!
And this will only increase if I practice the all-refining technique more often!'
Jason was slowly beginning to understand that the Kanadi of a Primordial technique had to be practiced over a long period of time.
An even longer time would be required to show results in terms of an increased cultivation speed, or combat prowess owing to higher comprehension.
It was only now that Jason believed he realized the true meaning behind the importance of a higher heritage using this technique.
It was just a thought, but he couldn't help but assume that it was likely for a lower heritage to provide a small increase in the entire being as it was the case with someone having a higher heritage.
Thus, the effect of one practice session of the Kanadi of a Primordial could possibly have a huge difference according to one's heritage.
With that in mind, Jason wondered how strong the heritage of halflings would be considered because he didn't have anyone to compare himself to.
Even after Jennifer started to practice the Kanadi of a Primordial technique, he didn't really have a comparison. Though both of them were halflings, they had no idea how much of an enhancement they received from a single practice session.
Because of that, Jason believed that the second stage of the technique would allow them to figure out more.
But for that to happen, considerable time would pass before the two of them would be able to attain that stage.
After all, they had to build up a foundation with the Kanadi of a Primordial technique, which could take extremely long.
With that in mind, the two of them simply shared their experience before doing whatever they pleased.
In fact, they were both oddly confident that the technique was extraordinarily powerful, which was saying something.
Both Jennifer and Jason were known for being picky with the technique they practiced.
After all, they didn't want to waste their precious time doing something that was useless.
Wasting time was a big no for them, and for both to believe that the technique was worth their time indicated a lot.
Yet, even after they practiced the technique, they knew that they had to leave the city.
Prolonging their stay would make them lose sight of their goals, and focus on practicing the Kanadi of a Primordial even more.
However, that was not something they would do right now.
The chances decreased even more after they heard the news of another large-scale attack.
This was a coordinated act of a few races that seemed to have established an alliance to overwhelm the three races that tried to defend the Julandra region.
The Shadow walker race was also in the alliance of races, which was something Jason found quite ridiculous.
It seemed like the Shadow walkers create more alliances than actually fighting, which was completely different to how he recalled his first encounter with a Shadow walker.
It had been a few years, but his first encounter with a Shadow walker had made him feel that they were more like cowards, clouded in darkness than anything else.
Thus, Jason couldn't help but shake his head with a dry smile on his face when he figured out that their second destination was located at the borders of the Shadow walkers' territory.
This was quite funny in Jason's opinion, even more so because the small territory the Shadow walkers had, was not worth mentioning.
However, this was also a clear sign that the Shadow walkers were either weaker than he expected, or that their territory on Manyr was only a small branch of their actual home which was elsewhere.
Yet, after thinking about it for a while, he realized that it didn't really matter to Jason, to begin with.
The only thing he was truly interested in the Shadow walkers was Lux!
He couldn't care less about the others, but Lux was the first person who had betrayed him, so it was only fitting for his revenge outside Argos to start right there.
Having seen the woman who was with Yan when the Shadow walker had brought them from Cyro City a few years ago, Jason was certain that he would soon meet Lux.
The best way to do that was to stir trouble at the borders, or possibly even inside the Shadow walker's territory.
Unfortunately, before he could start enacting the satisfactory part of their plans, they had to travel towards a particular city, where Jennifer's father was supposedly residing.
Yet, this caused the premonition in Jason's heart to deepen, and he believed that Jennifer would see something she wouldn't like at all.
Jason couldn't be sure of that, and he didn't say anything about his growing unease either as he was not able to clearly tell what would happen.
Despite that, he didn't feel desperation coursing through his body as it had been the case in two of the past incidents when he had lost his loved ones.
One was when he had a bad feeling about the cave where Scorpio had sacrificed himself to allow him to survive, and the other was the time his late masters had been assassinated.
As such, it couldn't be a matter of life-and-death, but his mind was still thinking about the things that may happen.
With that in mind, they left the city and were on their way towards the second destination that was a trip of more than two months.
On their way, they encountered many gruesome things and witnessed the reality about the 'nonchalant' way that many citizens of the Julandra region had previously acted, including just how wrong their behavior seemed to have been.
That was because the Xytra, the city that was, in fact, their destination was currently under the attack of the alliance including the Shadow walkers.
Their main force were tens of thousand of beings at the Ascendion stage, attacking the city that was struggling to defend itself.
And Jason clearly saw why this was the case- the city's number of defenders was much smaller than the attacking force…
"They're doomed!"
