chapters.title: Chapter 837 - Xytra
chapters.content:
Looking at the situation of the city that was attacked by numerous opponents, Jason couldn't help but feel a little bit conflicted.
Their current location was quite far away from Xytra and nobody would be able to sense them.
Despite that, seeing the masses of beings that belonged to the Shadow walker alliance didn't really make him feel all that good.
They had wanted to find Jennifer's father in Xytra, after all.
Because of that, Jennifer wanted to rush towards the army that was attacking the city, the moment she saw what was going on.
Fortunately, she was unable to take another step because Jason held on to her wrist with a firm grip.
"Are you insane? Why would you enter the fray, right now? Get your act together!" Jason admonished her with a deep frown on his face, staring straight into Jennifer's eyes.
If he were to evaluate the situation Xytra was in, Jason would most likely give the city a 0.1% chance to overcome the threat.
After all, he was able to see the cultivation base and mana fluctuations of every single being. This made it easier for him to assess the attacking side's combat force while the same applied to the defenders of Xytra.
With that in mind, he knew that not only the number of Prismar and Ascendion stage Cultivators was much higher on the attacking side, but the number of Specta stage beings was not less either.
There were a total of 10 Specta stage cultivators, and from the looks of it, only four with the same cultivation base were present in the entire city.
If these four could not simultaneously fight against two or three beings at the same cultivation stage, Jason didn't know who could defend the city.
Instead, they would have to protect their own lives first before extending a helping hand.
Fortunately, Jennifer calmed down, realizing that she had been too impulsive.
This caused her to take a few deep breaths before she hovered backward, stopping next to Jason.
Meanwhile, Jason didn't let go of Jennifer's hand, which allowed him to react quickly if she were to act too impulsively once again.
Furthermore, Jennifer was much calmer, when he held her.
He could feel her pulse that had returned to normal which was another reason for not letting go of her.
Yet, instead of focussing too much on the moment, Jason continued to analyze the situation with a more precise assessment.
If he was only looking at the cultivation base of everyone before, he wanted to figure out the exact rank in addition to the cultivation stage of his opponents now.
That was the bare minimum he could do, given the presence of Specta stage cultivators on both sides.
Doing this allowed him to see that the defending side had a higher cultivation base owing to their ranking.
Adding this to the fact that the defenders were unable to see any special traits of the attacking side, they presumed that their chances to win were much higher than initially presumed.
This was great, but even better was the sudden commotion that ensued behind the attackers.
Out of nowhere, several hundred beasts had emerged from the ground, crawling out of the mud and soil.
These creatures wreaked havoc as they threw themselves on the Shadow Walkers and other races that attacked the city.
First, Jason thought that he was seeing something wrong, but his Emperor Eyes didn't betray him.
Instead, the beasts he saw had tightly concealed cultivation bases, which made it difficult to perceive the beasts underground. This had given them the chance to surprise attack their opponents at the surface.
In fact, the enormous Earthworms that were enclosed in a thick layer of mud, made it seem as if they were wearing strong armors that would protect them from most attacks.
Thus, it was no wonder how the earthworms had terrified the Shadow walkers, turning the game upside down.
They were each more than a hundred meters long followed by a gigantic mouth at the tip of their body, looking like a giant mass of flesh with several hundreds of lengthy needle-like teeth.
With a single attack, they killed more than a dozen opponents, leaving behind nothing but droplets of blood that gushed out of the Earthworms' mouth the moment it closed it.
This made it seem as if the devoured opponents were killed in a manner similar to how an iron maiden functioned.
The only difference Jason perceived was that dying due to the Earthworm should be even more painful, which caused him to flinch involuntarily.
However, instead of averting his attention, he stared at the battlefield.
It was then that he spotted one of the enormous Earthworms which was much larger and broader than the rest.
It attacked one of the Specta stage powerhouses that was busy fighting one of the Xytra city defenders at the same cultivation base.
Yet, while the Devir noticed the attack, allowing him to step back in the last moment, the Shadow Walker at the Specta stage realized this too late, as his entire body had already entered the gigantic mouth of the Earthworm.
Only a moment later he released his entire mana, but everything was useless.
The Earthworm's mouth closed, and its teeth punctured the Shadow walker's body, whose mana had been partially nullified.
When Jason saw this, he couldn't help but feel a little bit disgusted, but instead of holding Jennifer back from attacking, he forced her to regain her senses as he pulled at her.
This forced her out of her own train of thought. Looking into her eyes, Jason only offered a simple piece of advice.
"Don't fly too low, otherwise the Earthworms might reach you!"
Jason had already figured that the Earthworms were supposed to help Xytra but that didn't change the fact that they were beasts.
Thus, they wouldn't care if a few allies would be eaten or get buried under their heavy bodies.
At least Jason assumed so which made him warn Jennifer before he allowed Solaris to enter his body.
Through this, their mana was shared, and the mana consumption while using his fire affinity was much lower.
Jason presumed this to be the best way in order to defeat the opponents he had chosen to fight.
However, before he could even move, Jennifer had already released her three merged energies as she shot towards the battlefield with a serious expression on her face.
Even if she hadn't seen her father in a very long time, there were too many things she wanted to ask him and talk about.
As such, Jennifer would never accept if anything were to happen to him, not until she found the answers to the questions she had.
With that in mind, she exerted her movement technique, while releasing her aura that was slowly starting to be constructed. It was composed of her energies and everything she had learned during the last few years.
Through this, Jennifer quickly attracted the attention of the attacking force, and a grand battle ensued.
The defending side began to initiate a counterattack, revealing themselves by stepping out of the cover provided by the city walls.
Seeing this, Jason couldn't help but smile dryly as he exerted the Hermes Celeration movement technique T the basic mastery.
However, that was more than enough to exceed his capabilities of the Floating Sky movement technique at the perfect mastery.
Wasting no time, he catapulted himself towards the biggest crowd of Prismar and Initial phase Ascendion stage beings.
They were Jason's target, and the perfect choice to fight for someone like him, whose cultivation base was at the Peak of the Prismar stage, while his true combat prowess was much higher!

chapters.title: Chapter 838 - Inconspicious
chapters.content:
Excluding the amplification of his soulbonds' strength, he was already much stronger than someone at the Initial phase of the Ascendion stage.
In fact, if he were to include the amplifications received, he was almost at the same level as someone at the Low Ascendion stage.
And if he were to further add the other means at his disposal to increase his strength, Jason was confident in achieving everything he wanted to.
This might be a little bit exaggerated, but with Solaris by his side, Jason felt unparalleled.
Despite being on the battlefield surrounded by the Prismar stage beings that had many individuals at the Initial phase of the Ascendion stage, Jason was calm.
Right now, he was relatively safe as he was still unnoticed by stronger individuals.
But this would change the moment he revealed his entire strength.
As such, Jason held back from manifesting more than a thousand black fireballs which he would want to throw towards the crowd of Prismar stage beings.
In fact, he would be able to overwhelm the entire army of Prismar and Initial Ascendion stage beings as long as he was safe from the attack of stronger opponents.
Unfortunately, protection was a luxury he could not afford because everyone was struggling.
With that in mind, he adjusted his strength by manifesting Byakur in his hand before enveloping it in a thin layer of Solaris' flames.
Afterward, he geared up to enter the fray which he did by mercilessly charging at the biggest crowd of Prismar stage beings he could find.
Before averting his attention to the Ascendion stage beings, Jason wanted to have as many backup plans as possible.
With that in mind, he severely injured his opponents while transferring a fraction of Solaris' flame into each of their bodies.
Once they were inside the body of his living opponents, Solaris' flames would be nurtured.
They would absorb all of their cultivation energies, and life force, sucking them dry.
This was extremely helpful in the worst-case scenario of his mana being drained completely as he would be able to recharge real quick.
Jason had utilized this tactic quite often already, and right now it was even more important to be vigilant of his surroundings.
Not only the Shadow Walkers were his opponents but the city he wanted to protect owing to Jennifer, might also be considered their opponent!
It was weird to protect a place that could become one's foe, but Jason didn't care about such trivial things.
He was only respecting Jennifer's wish to speak to her parents, at least once.
She hoped to see her parents together, living a good life, but Jason was sure that this was not as easy as Jennifer presumed.
Otherwise, if her parents were truly living together, there wouldn't be a reason to give her away in the first place.
Because of that, Jason presumed that Jennifer wouldn't be able to have a great time in Xytra.
But if that allowed her to move on, she should at least get a chance to meet her father, and get to know more about her mother.
In this case, the least Jason could do was to help Jennifer meet her father.
When she reunited with her family, he would take a backseat.
He would only act as her shadow, not bothering her, and only stay by her side when she needed him.
There were certain things one had to overcome on their own.
The people around them would only serve as a broad shoulder to lean on and cry to their heart's content.
However, the thing they had to do first was to overcome the attack of the alliance of the Shadow Walkers.
He wasn't sure if the alliance even had a name, to begin with.
Meanwhile, after surviving the attack the most important task was to prevent the walls from crumbling down.
If that wasn't taken care of, a new attack might follow soon.
With that in mind, Jason intertwined traces of his divine energy into his mana, while keeping his aura and stigma hidden.
Through the divine energy, his movement speed increased drastically.
By adding the moonlight affinity to the mix, his divine moonlight transmuted mana was enough to double his speed.
This sudden boost shocked the Prismar stage opponents that were already overwhelmed by the sheer brute force Jason was able to exert at his cultivation base.
Not just his strength but his shocking speed was even more fearsome, causing despair in the ranks of the Shadow walker alliance.
In fact, Jason had considerably slimmed the size of Byakur, so its current appearance was more of a dagger.
Picking up another dagger, he enveloped it with Solaris' flames, increasing his combat prowess by a large margin.
Armed with two daggers, he moved forward while merely inflicting injuries that were not even supposed to kill his opponents.
Thus, he didn't even have to fight with precision because sheer power and speed were more than enough to sweep through the battlefield.
Shooting through the rows of foes, Jason left behind nothing but faint injuries. However, these injuries led to a death that slowly crept up to them, devouring the injured foes from the inside out.
Almost half an hour passed, in which he was able to stay unscathed and mostly unnoticed by the stronger individuals.
There were only a few who noticed his speed, astonishing them greatly.
But after seeing him deliver nothing but shallow cuts, they presumed that he wasn't worth paying any attention to.
They believed that he could only move with a high speed but he had no real combat experience or strength.
Unfortunately, it was this assumption that caused the death of more than a thousand opponents that were slowly burned from the inside, deprived of their energy, life force, and even the nutrition in their bodies.
Devouring the nutrition was something Solaris had only started to do since its entire being had been enhanced by the runic circle.
During the three months in which it had been enhanced, Solaris had undergone a drastic change.
Not only had every single trait of its flames, and abilities become stronger, but new functions of the already existing abilities were revealed.
This also included the nutrition devouring trait that belonged to the life force draining ability!
Small droplets of the various nutritions' essences were created inside its mana core, and Jason knew that he could make use of them in order to practice the Kanadi of a Primordial technique.
Because of that, he was quite satisfied with the new function Solaris had acquired.
However, Solaris could do little to overcome the newly emerging problems in front of Jason.
The first foes he had injured were succumbing to their injuries and dying.
One after another, the opponents he had inflicted with injuries were collapsing to the ground and dying.
It didn't take too long for the Ascendion stage beings to connect the dots and understand what was going on.
Jason was not weak, or an inexperienced combatant, but he had clearly outwitted them.
Their overconfidence and wrong judgment had allowed the seemingly inconspicuous, but fast man to kill many of their good warriors!
Thus, it was only obvious for the Ascendion stage beings to be enraged.
Fueled by anger, the first few that were able to leave their current position, shot towards Jason, ready to attack him without any mercy.
However, was Jason truly someone they could face, just like that?
That was of course not the case because Jason had yet to reveal his true combat prowess.
As such, after seeing the bunch of beings at the Initial phase of the Ascendion stage that shot towards him with great velocity, he couldn't hide his smile anymore.
Despite the opponents charging at him, Jason remained calm.
After enveloping his entire body with Solaris' flames, only his golden eyes pierced through the layer of black flames.
Meanwhile, his smile of excitement was hidden from the eyes of the foes that initiated their attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 839 - Burn To Ashes
chapters.content:
Jason's defenses increased by a large margin after being enveloped by Solaris' flames.
It was not comparable to Petri's scales, but more than enough to block most elemental attacks that reached him.
The elemental attacks that were too strong were simply cut through by the daggers he wielded smoothly.
While he was busy hacking and cleaving through the attacks, the remaining Initial phase Ascendion stage beings had arrived in front of him and began attacking him.
There were three Shadow walkers that tried to subdue him with the darkness their body suddenly released.
Meanwhile, the other races were attacking with their physical strength and the techniques they had learned to use their spirit force with.
As such, any other being would have been severely restricted.
But, not Jason.
He was unruffled by their attacks and simply released his Celestia aura and Stigma at once.
Following that, he used his fire affinity with the additional enhancements of his moonlight affinity and traces of his divine energy.
Owing to this, his black flames were intertwined by silver strands.
Some of the strands were glowing brightly followed by enlarging in size.
From the outside, it almost looked like Jason's body was enlarging, but in the end, it was only the flames enveloping him that flared up.
They were thickening before they destroyed the energies that reached them burning through all of it before devouring the remnants.
Sensing this, Jason couldn't help but smile, but instead of remaining idle, or decreasing his pace, he did the opposite.
He was still exerting the Hermes Celeration movement technique, allowing him to move much faster than his attacker.
If Jason wanted, he would have been able to deflect his opponents' attack in the first instance.
But instead of doing so, he had tested Solaris' enhanced capabilities after it was enhanced by the moonlight affinity and divine energy.
Following that, he deflected the attacks Solaris' flames couldn't block off before swiftly moving his daggers, inflicting injuries to the opponents that were too close to him.
This allowed him to transfer a fraction of Solaris towards his opponents' bodies.
Some of the beings at the Ascendion stage noticed this immediately.
But, before the flames could do their trick, they swiftly expelled the flame, overwhelming it with their affinities and cultivation energy.
Too weak to counter this, the tiny flames were extinguished or simply expelled from the body of the Ascendion stage Cultivators.
It was one of the first few times that his trick had failed him.
Thus, Jason quickly realized that using Solaris' flames to inflict an injury before waiting until his opponents were to die wouldn't work anymore.
At least not with beings at the Ascendion stage, who noticed if something were to enter their body well before it could cause any real damage.
As such, Jason knew that he had to change his tactic, but that was no problem because he was still faster than the others.
Meanwhile, his physical strength was on par, if not higher than the Ascendion stage cultivators.
And that didn't include the enhancements his moonlight transmuted mana that was intertwined with traces of divine energy caused.
With that in mind, Jason had no problems fighting against several opponents at the Initial Ascendion stage, at the same time.
He fought them in a much calmer manner than it had been a year ago when he had rescued Jennifer.
In fact, even Jennifer would be able to easily defeat the few opponents he was fighting.
But those opponents weren't worth mentioning because most of the opponents he fought were barely considered talented if that was not exaggerated either.
At most, their talent came from the races they belonged to, but that was all.
As such, Jason felt that the fight against the opponents without the true talent to be considered fighters, or highly proficient in any kind of martial art technique, was but a facade.
Right now, he was simply awaiting that stronger opponents would come over to fight him.
However, at the same time, he had to ensure that certain individuals that were too strong for him to handle, wouldn't see him as a big threat.
With that in mind, he was forced to adjust his fighting style once again, revealing how combat afine he was.
Through that, Jason didn't show any mercy as he killed the opponents around him before entering the fray of opponents once again.
It was only at this moment that he was finally able to evaluate the current situation of the entire battlefield.
In the end, the situation was neither great nor bad either.
There were quite a few defenders that were strong enough to face multiple opponents.
Furthermore, there were the Earthworms that shot out of the ground, devouring more than a dozen opponents before disappearing.
They emerged and left whenever they wanted, throwing the Shadow Walker alliance into a frenzy.
This was more than enough for the defenders to make use of it, attacking the distracted opponents with all kinds of methods.
Some of the defenders were even using ballistae to launch long-range attacks. This was something that caused Jason to smile dryly because he recalled something that was quite off.
'In terms of technological advancement, we were far ahead on Argos than it is the case on Manyr…is that simply because nobody bothers to keep advancing their technological standard as they have cultivation energies, or is it something else?'
As he was not sure about the answer, Jason could only continue wondering as he slashed through numerous opponents, increasing the death toll as he mercilessly killed them.
However, at this moment, the first being at the Low Ascendion stage emerged in front of him who had received an order to kill Jason.
Yet, instead of retreating in fear, Jason assumed that it was finally time for him to reveal his entire strength.
With that in mind, he didn't think of replacing Solaris with Artemis or Petri. Instead, he chose to fuse with Solaris for the first time in his life.
Since the day Solaris had devoured some of the fiery aura of the Lesser puppet that was nothing but a poorly built replica of a Primordial race, it was possible for the black origin flame to fuse with him.
That was at least what both Jason and Solaris had presumed to be the case.
After attempting to fuse a few times, they realized that it was more difficult than expected.
However, right now, with their mindset focused on the exact same thing, they could work in sync.
Both of them wanted to defeat their opponents and burn them to ashes.
Their minds were in unison, allowing them to meet the final requirement to start the fusion process.
That being said, the mantle of Solaris' flames disappeared as black flames sprouted out of Jason's body.
Meanwhile, his hair released additional flames, turning them a shade darker than they already were.
A moment later, the flames flared up, and Jason noticed how the Celestia aura within him was slowly transmuting.
His aura wanted to be fully unleashed, and Jason fulfilled its request by not holding back anymore.
After unleashing both the two Stigmas above his right eye and the transmuted aura that heated up the surrounding, Jason roared out.
The dry and trampled grass began to burn, causing the flames around him to explode that tripled his size for a moment.
When Jason roared out, something in the depth of his body was churning, but he didn't notice anything at all.
His mind was too occupied with the growing urge to burn everything around him, including his opponents.
The flames were flaring but they were all under the control of Jason.
He could command them with a simple thought of his mind.
Hearing Jason's powerful roar made Jennifer, and many other beings turn towards Jason's direction in shock.
The moment they saw Jason's brightly glowing eyes pierce through the thick black flames, which enveloped him like impenetrable armor, they couldn't help but gulp nervously.
"Is…that really Jason?" Jennifer wondered, staring into the depth of Jason's crimson-colored eyes. Thousands of black flame spears manifested around him making him look like the Grim Reaper. His desire to kill was clearly perceptible and Jennifer could only pity his opponents.

chapters.title: Chapter 840 - Aura Of Hell
chapters.content:
Staring at the Low Ascendion stage Shadow walker, who was only a few dozen meters away from him, Jason made no efforts to hide his smile.
He shot more than a hundred black flame spears towards the Shadow walker.
By fusing with Solaris, their respective strength turned into one and was reinforced.
His special traits, that is the moonlight affinity and divine energy further enhanced it.
Owing to that, Jason didn't have to hesitate in order to attack and kill his opponent who was paralyzed with fear, too afraid to even move.
The Shadow walker's entire body had stiffened, including the darkness that enveloped him like a snake's coiled body.
This was owing to the petrification curse Jason had activated on the Cultivator.
Because of that, the black flame spears punctured the Shadow walker, killing him in seconds.
His body was covered in spikes similar to that of a porcupine…just a dead one!
Afterward, Jason felt a weird feeling surging up within him. As he turned around, he was able to see everyone staring at him with uncertainty and fear, unsure of who, or even what he was.
This and the sensation that suddenly overwhelmed him, made an extremely distinct feeling of greed ignite within him.
However, this greed was not directed at gaining more strength, a fortune, or procuring anything.
Instead, it was his greed to kill every single opponent!
Consumed by this thought, Jason shot out the thousands of black flame spears without any hesitation.
Following that, Jason didn't even wait to see if he hit someone and manifested another batch of thousands of black flame spears. Like before, he shot them out, killing hundreds of opponents at once.
This process repeated itself more than ten times before Jason felt that his mana was a little bit drained.
In fact, while being fused with Solaris, the black flame affinity's mana consumption was negligible. It was almost impossible for him to use enough mana to outweigh the passive mana gathering even if he would transform his entire aura into an Inferno.
While attacking recklessly, Jason didn't even pay attention if he was hurting or even killing the defenders of Xytra.
However, that was not necessary, to begin with, because the defenders of the city were not hurt by any of Jason's attacks.
Having been summoned, and shot out within his aura that enveloped a huge area, Jason's black flame spears were precisely controlled to disintegrate if they came too close to an ally.
This was something that was extremely complex and it was difficult to control, but it worked rather easily owing to the emotional range of the beings all around him.
Those who were pleased by the change brought forth in the battle by Jason felt great, overjoyed, and maybe a little bit of fear. But, it was completely different from the Cultivators belonging to the Shadow walker alliance.
In fact, they felt like tearing him apart, along with a surge of hatred, anger, but also extreme fear, and anxiety within them.
Considering these emotions as something only a foe would think of him, the black spear attacks he created would continue their advance. They would kill these opponents as long as they were unable to face his attacks head-on.
And that was necessary because evading the volleys of black flame spears was much more difficult than one might believe.
Owing to his several volleys of attack, he gathered the vast majority of attention on the entire battlefield.
This included the Cultivators with a higher cultivation base, from the Mid Ascendion stage right up to the Specta stage.
In the end, this was rather disadvantageous, but Jason was fully aware of what he was doing.
It didn't take the defending side long to understand that Jason was a force to reckon with.
Thus protecting him became a high priority and letting him do their work seemed far less risky too. After all, he was able to kill more than ten thousand foes in a matter of seconds. Hence, they had to protect him in order to slim down the number of their own casualties.
Because of that, a Specta stage Devir that looked eerily human, and an Aeus with two pairs of wings appeared in front of him before they asked him to continue with whatever he was doing.
By only taking a short glance at the two Specta stage beings, Jason didn't take long to realize that the Devir was the one Jennifer was searching for, while the other Aeus was someone he didn't know.
But it was definitely not Jennifer's mother!
However, instead of making a fuss out of the given situation, Jason simply smiled, glad about the protection he had received out of nowhere.
He was ready to initiate another attack, but it was at this moment that the ground several dozen meters below him burst open. An enormous Earthworm emerged from it, making a high-pitched weird sound.
Yet, contrary to everyone's expectation of the beast suddenly attacking him, it remained at its position.
Instead of labeling him as an extremely dangerous foe, it stood behind him, acting as the third protector of Jason.
This dumbfounded everyone who looked at Jason, whose entire body was clad in an armor of flames that made him look majestic.
But at the exact same time, he was someone most beings on the battlefield were afraid of. His eyes that had turned crimson released the purest desire to kill, which many people had never sensed in their entire life.
And that was even the case for those Ascendion stage beings that were hundreds of years old!
Despite sensing this, Jason couldn't care less about the feelings others had about him. Currently, he was distracted by a sudden desire Solaris was voicing out, and he almost willingly gave in.
But, he held back from the urge to destroy and kill everything around him at the last moment when he realized what exactly Solaris wanted from him.
'You…want to manifest the gate? The same one from years ago?? Why would you want to do that, Solaris?'
Several years ago, in a fit of rage, and the desire to kill everyone who had taken something from him, he had manifested the Replicas of the Gates of Hell…or at least that was what the Embassy of the Elvir race had said.
They had also warned him that the Gates of Hell were extremely dangerous and that he should never summon them intentionally.
However, that was something Jason could clearly tell too. It was not exactly difficult because he was able to sense that Solaris' range of emotions was a chaotic mess.
Whether this was because the black origin flame was sensing his emotions for the first time, or something else didn't matter.
He knew that the fusion might be a little bit overwhelming for Solaris.
Jason just knew that he shouldn't manifest the gates as Solaris wanted.
Rather, Jason manifested more and more black flame spears and exceeded his limitations.
Meanwhile, the Aura of Hell, which was the name Jason gave the transmuted aura, Solaris' transmutation was causing to his Celestia aura, enlarged further.
Through this, his range of attack became bigger too, but instead of staying at the same spot as before, Jason began to move around.
He launched a killing spree all over the battlefield, while his three protectors remained by his side, shielding him from all kinds of attacks that were desperately fired at him.
Even the Specta stage powerhouses of the Shadow walkers launched an attack, but when they noticed that the protective shield around Jason was close to impregnable, they issued the command to retreat.
Owing to this, the defenders of Xytra were able to overcome the numerical disadvantage.
They fiercely defended against the Shadow walker alliance and emerged victorious with only a fraction of the casualties they had feared to have.
And all of this was thanks to one particular individual- Jason!

chapters.title: Chapter 841 - Father Daughter
chapters.content:
"Welcome to our small city, Xytra. I'm sorry this is not how we usually welcome our guests.
But, I hope Sir can understand our circumstances…there are many things we have to pay attention to, and even more we have to repair."
A young man said to Jason in an apologetic voice while bowing deeply.
Even after the Shadow walker alliance had retreated, Jason's entire being was struggling to get a grip over himself.
He and Solaris seemed to have different opinions of what they were supposed to do.
Solaris wanted to pursue and kill every single Cultivator of the Shadow walker alliance.
Jason, on the other hand, didn't want to needlessly pursue them after they fled.
All his attention was on how his entire body was out of control.
In fact, it was not his body that had a problem, but their fusion which was still incomplete.
Jason's body had begun adjusting to the heat of Solaris' flames that had fused with every single cell of his body.
It was already a wonder that he was still alive considering that his cells must have been damaged or burned.
However that was not the case, and it was more likely for the fusion to have prevented these kinds of injuries.
Despite that, his mana core and mana veins felt extremely hot which was rather inconvenient in the current circumstances.
He was struggling to control the mana that circulated through his body for the first time in decades.
Only by averting his focus to the mana circulation process was it possible for his mana fluctuations to come under control.
It took him quite a while to do so because the mana circulating through his body uncontrollably had caused them to fluctuate wildly.
Because of that, Jason hadn't even noticed that the Specta stage powerhouses had left his side once the battle ended.
They had returned to complete their respective tasks.
Meanwhile, the young man, whom one of them had just welcomed, had arrived in front of him.
A moment later Jennifer appeared by Jason's side, instinctively grasping his shoulder, worried whether he was fine or not.
Yet, she quickly retracted her hand as Jason's entire body was releasing an unbearable heat even after his fusion with Solaris was dissolved.
"Are you fine, Jason??" She asked worriedly, only to see him give her a light smile.
By transmuting the mana that circulated through his body with the moonlight affinity, he was regulating his body temperature. H
His body was slowly cooling down, and any kind of injury he might have received was healing simultaneously.
However, there were no injuries, to begin with, and Jason simply smiled at Jennifer before telling her that he was fine.
Afterward, he turned towards the young man, who was eyeing the two of them.
Looking at him, Jason asked the most important question he had on his mind.
"I don't need any kind of grand welcome. Instead, can you tell me where I can find Inadan Sadon?"
The question itself had caused Jennifer to stiffen for a moment before she looked at Jason, worry in her eyes.
The young man repeated the same movements of Jennifer, only to be confused as he looked at Jason with a question mark seemingly materializing in front of him
"Oh…Sir, do you know Lord Sadon personally?"? He asked, but it was barely a moment later that he saw Jason shaking his head.
"I don't know Lord Sadon, but it would be great if we can meet him once!"
This caused the young man to furrow his eyebrows as he blurted out,
"Sir, you fought alongside Lord Sadon, and I do not know where he is… he is probably busy taking care of the city…I do not know when he'll have time."
The answer of the young man proved Jason's earlier assumption to be correct, and after thinking about it for a moment he turned towards Jennifer.
"I guess we'll stay here for a few days. You don't need to rush anything, alright?" Jason calmly spoke to Jennifer, who had planned to leave as soon as possible. She had hoped to spend at most one day in Xytra to meet her father, and try to figure out the truth before leaving.
She didn't want to stay long in Xytra, and neither did she ever want to return.
As such, Jennifer was biting on her lower lip, only to nod her head.
She reluctantly accepted that they couldn't do anything else right now.
Jason and Jennifer simply told the young man that he should inform someone, who could get in touch with Lord Sadon.
They also asked him to state that someone who was well acquainted with Luna, and Jules wanted to speak with him.
Both names didn't ring any bells to the young man, who was slightly confused but he simply nodded his head, accepting the task he had been given by the man who had played a major role in protecting the city.
However, before leaving to pursue the given task, he told Jason and Jennifer that a room had been prepared for them and that they could ask for anything they wanted.
That was the least the city could provide them with because they didn't even live in the city, and still, they had fought to protect it.
In fact, many people were staring at both Jason and Jennifer with jealousy and wide eyes, unable to grasp how these young people were so powerful.
In the end, Jennifer was barely at the Ascendion stage but she was strong enough to fight more than a dozen Initial Ascendion stage powerhouses.
And this included talented individuals too.
Meanwhile, Jason was on an even more monstrous level because he didn't enter the Ascendion stage yet, but his combat prowess was fearsome.
Nobody was truly able to grasp how powerful he was, but it was definitely worth filling them with dread and apprehension of being on his hit list.
Like Jason, even Jennifer had not revealed her entire combat prowess because she was hiding her true appearance with which she could increase her strength even further.
It was similar to a button she could press in order to transform to her true form that would allow her to fight mightier opponents.
Unfortunately, she had to hold back, otherwise, the elaborate plan she and Jason had come up with would shatter before anything could even start!
To Jason, it didn't matter if someone else was thinking highly of him, or if he was looked at with jealousy.
What truly mattered was seeing their plan work and Jennifer meeting her father, even if it was only for a few minutes and the end result to be different than what Jennifer hoped for.
Jason didn't have high hopes about this talk, but he didn't say anything to Jennifer.
Instead, he decided to stay by her side and if it was necessary, he would console her whenever she needed.
Through this, she would know that she was not alone.
This was the least he could do for her which was better than facing her father while being alone.
Yet, to their misfortune, Jennifer was the only one who was invited to the chamber of Lord Sadon, a few days after the attack on Xytra had passed.
Jason wanted to disregard this and go with her, but she said that it was fine for her to meet her father alone.
As such, she left to talk with her father, and Jason couldn't help but feel bad about this.
It made him nervous, and it was only after several hours passed that Jennifer returned to their room.
Her expression seemed oddly fine, and a trace of hope emerged within Jason.
But then he frowned to see the complex set of emotional hues that enveloped her tightly.
Thus, he stood up to ask how she felt, but before he could even ask she forced a smile on her face as she said,
"He told me that he acknowledged me as his daughter…only for today…so…It looks like I don't even exist in his world."
Afterward, she bit on her lower lip, and without holding back, she approached Jason to hug him tightly, hiding the tears that trickled down her cheeks.

chapters.title: Chapter 842 - You Are Not Alone
chapters.content:
Jason was not sure if he understood everything correctly because Jennifer was struggling to speak without letting him know that she was crying bitterly.
However, from what he was able to understand, the discussion with her father didn't seem to go as well as he previously thought.
If he were to take a rational look at the situation, Jennifer was a halfling between a noble of the Devir race and an extremely unique commoner of the Aeus race.
First of all, even if they belonged to the same race, if a noble married a commoner, they would lose their nobility.
That was something the laws of both races stated which was rather idiotic in Jason's opinion.
However, that was only the beginning of a weird story because both Jennifer's mother and father seemed to have been initially betrothed to someone else.
Because Jennifer's mother was unique in all possible ways, one of the princes of the Aeus race was willing to give up every single right.
He wanted to marry her by hook or crook, which was what was ought to happen.
Yet, instead of accepting the prince, Jennifer's mother aka Jules, fled from the prince, and while she was on the run, she encountered the Lord of Xytra aka Jennifer's father!
Lord Sadon was already married, but neither did he love his wife, nor had he willingly accepted the marriage.
Instead, he had been forced to marry her in order to protect the rest of his family that had been threatened to be killed.
To prevent this, he had reluctantly married the young Duchess, but the moment he encountered Jules, everything changed.
He decided to elope with her, and they spent a few years together.
It was during this time that they met Luna, and in which Jennifer was born.
To their misfortune, their happy days seemed to meet an end when the envoys of the Devir and Aeus race found clues of Jules and Lord Sadon' whereabouts.
When the two were finally found, a war was about to break out.
Jason had no idea what exactly had happened, but from the looks of it, Jennifer's parents decided to hand over the baby to Luna to allow her to grow up into the fine woman she had become.
Lord Sadon was not sure what exactly Luna had planned with the terror act, but it was definitely not something he had expected to occur.
Despite that, he would never accept Jennifer as his daughter because the Devir Jules had married was already fed up the moment he fled.
She had barely held back from killing Lord Sadon's family because she had fallen in love with everything that belonged to the Lord.
Jason considered the Duchess to be some sort of psycho, but in the end, this didn't matter because it was irrelevant.
The most important point was that Jennifer's mother had been turned into nobility, forced to marry the prince without him losing his rights.
Now, both of them were living their own life, forced into a marriage they had never wanted with children they were never supposed to get.
Only Jennifer could be said to be a lovechild, but even the little halfling was disowned by her parents.
Even if she were to meet her mother, what use would it have if she wasn't acknowledged, or couldn't even speak with her mother the way she wanted.
As such her existence was denied by her own blood, and Jason had to try very hard to console her, but it was quite difficult to do so.
Initially, he had assumed that his situation was similar to Jennifer's but that was not the case.
His mother had raised him for a few years before she was killed, while his father hadn't even known about his existence until a few years ago.
And even after he found out about his existence, he didn't try to push him away.
Instead, he had expressed his desire to meet Jason even if it was not possible for him to expose the existence of a halfling of a Primordial race.
This was not possible right now because of many complications, but Celestia Yadras was trying to pave a way for Jason to be accepted even if it was not easy.
Thus, Jason knew that his situation was different from Jennifer's, and all he could do was to stay by her side, embrace her, and give her some much-needed comfort.
He was not sure how much time had passed, but their hug lasted much longer than he expected.
By the time she had finally stopped speaking and crying, the only thing Jason noticed was that she had fallen asleep, right in his arms.
Yet, her grasp on his clothes was still tight, and without using force it would be impossible to get Jennifer off him.
As such, he lifted her up before moving towards the bed, where he attempted to lay her down while gently loosening her grasp.
However, just when he thought that her hands would finally loosen the grasp on his clothes, Jennifer moved.
She clung harder to him, her legs coiling around his waist.
Jason was locked in her embrace as a single tear trickled down her cheeks before she mumbled,
"Please…don't leave me…"
Jason knew that Jennifer was rambling in her sleep, and she was hurt but he couldn't help but swallow nervously as his thoughts began to riot.
Shaking his head, he tried to keep calm, telling himself that everything was just happening because Jennifer was emotionally disturbed and that she didn't want to be alone.
But…was that really everything?
Yet, even if Jason believed that there was more between them than being just friends, or whatever they were right now, he couldn't take advantage of the situation.
There was no need to be impatient or anything like that.
Instead, rather than focusing on his hormones that were wreaking havoc in his body, it was more important for him that Jennifer felt comfortable and reassured.
This was everything that mattered right now.
Thus, Jason forcefully suppressed his emotions and the desires that erupted from the depths of his conscience. Slowly, he laid down on the bed, doing nothing but staying by Jennifer's side as she continued to cling onto him, fearing that he might leave.
He continued to lightly caress her hair, unsure of what he should think of Jennifer's current state.
Since more than three years had passed in which they were separated, many things had changed.
Jason felt that he was still the same, but the same couldn't be said about Jennifer.
The confident woman he had met earlier had grown much stronger in a physical sense, while her mental state was extremely fragile.
Having been betrayed, abandoned, and disowned by her parents, it was only obvious for her to feel as if her world was breaking apart.
And Jason was not sure if Jennifer would be able to overcome all of it.
At least that was if she were to be alone.
With that in mind, his support became more and more important, but even then Jason couldn't be certain about the outcome.
In the end, Jennifer had to get her act together and understand that no matter how dark the night, the sun always came up in the morning.
Life was not only black and white but sorrow and happiness went hand in hand. You wouldn't feel the importance of happiness without sorrow and vice versa.
One's mindset was the most important to overcome hurdles in order to avoid a mental breakdown.
Thus, Jason could only caress her hair as he whispered,
"You are not alone, don't forget that!"

chapters.title: Chapter 843 - Leaving Behind
chapters.content:
Jason was not sure when, but even he fell into a deep slumber with Jennifer in his arms after noticing that her tears had ceased.
A long time had passed, but when he woke up, Jason noticed that Jennifer was still clinging to him.
Her grasp had loosened, but instead of wriggling himself out of her embrace, he thought that he could stay like this for a little bit longer.
Focusing on nothing in particular, Jason was just lying in the bed with Jennifer by his side.
His body had finally recuperated from the exhausting battle against the Shadow walker alliance and it was soon time for them to leave.
Not wanting to postpone their task any longer, Jason was already prepared to leave, and now, only Jennifer would have to wake up.
Thus, while he waited for her to wake up, thoughts about all kinds of things began to flash through his mind.
There were quite a few things he had to do, but not many of them were something Jason would be able to attain on Manyr.
As such, Jason believed that it was soon time for him to leave the large planet, hopefully along with Jennifer and not alone!
With that in mind, he took one of the many books he had chosen as his reward from the Primordial races' treasury.
Opening the first page, he started to read it and was quickly immersed into it.
He didn't even realize how much time had passed as the information about advanced forging was simply too interesting for him.
Because of that, it took Jason a while before he noticed that Jennifer was stirring.
On noticing him by her side, she pulled her legs back followed by her arms that were slowly moving away from him.
When she woke up, Jenifer almost screamed out in shock, only to faintly recall what she had done while being half asleep.
As such, she tried her best to regain control over her senses before retreating slowly.
Afterward, she continued to lay on the bed because Jason had still not shown any signs of noticing her move, giving her the time to calm down before finally getting up.
Thus, the moment she got up from the ground, Jason looked at her.
Closing the book he had been reading, he smiled at her before he enquired.
"Good Morning! How are you feeling?"
Nodding her head in embarrassment, she studied the ground which made Jason's smile widen before he added.
"Shall we depart?"
Jennifer had assumed that Jason wanted to cultivate for a few more days while recuperating from his earlier state in which he had felt weaker.
However, that didn't seem to be necessary as Jason's mana fluctuations were as strong as ever.
As such, she nodded her head before adding,
"Just…let me freshen up!"
Even Jason felt that a hot shower would do wonders to his soar body and relax his muscles.
Thus, they occupied the bathroom one after another and changed into fresh clothes.
It was only half an hour later before the two of them were fully prepared, and ready to leave Xytra.
Jennifer never wanted to return, ever again, and Jason had no attachment to the entire Julandra region to begin with.
As such, there was no need for him to even consider staying.
Instead, he wanted to travel towards the borders of the Shadow walkers' land because he wanted to find Lux.
Ever since Jason had seen the woman leave with the Shadow walker who had also taken Lux with him several years ago, his mind had been urging him to take revenge.
As such, their next destination were the borders of the Julandra region, where Jason wanted to create chaos.
He planned to do so by trying to threaten a few Shadow walkers to the extent that they would expose the location of Lux or others who might know more about his whereabouts.
In the end, Lux's soul world was quite unique, and it was not unlikely for him to have reached a high combat prowess during the last few years.
After all, he must have been nurtured well, and receiving a cultivation manual was just the tip of the iceberg.
In fact, Jason presumed that the majority of humans who were kidnapped, or those who left voluntarily were mostly nurturing their soul world.
This was the most logical way to approach the soul-awakened soul world, after all.
If Lux were to reach the limit of his vessel, followed by a great environment and a cultivation technique, it was not unlikely for Lux to have reached a combat prowess similar to Jason.
Or at least that was what Jason presumed, considering that more than 10 years had passed since they had last seen each other.
With that in mind, he had to try suppressing his excitement to take revenge because it made Jason feel as if he was no better than anyone else.
Somehow, it was weird because he was always thinking about revenge, but never had he bothered about trying to come up with a solution in which everything ended peacefully.
If he were to go on a killing spree, Jason believed that he would be no better than the mindless creatures that simply killed for their own benefits.
This caused him to think a lot about the changes he had undergone in the past few years, and how he had been unwilling to kill when he first gained eyesight.
'Why does it feel as if only a few days have passed since everything began?' He wondered as they were leaving the city. He was deep in thoughts while they were flying high above the city walls.
Meanwhile, Jennifer looked back at the city one more time before turning away.
A firm resolve could be seen in her eyes, and Jason felt great to see the change.
He was relieved to see that she had overcome the emotional turmoil that was eating at her the previous day.
With her emotions in check, they were finally able to fly towards the borders of the Julandra region which was only a three-week travel away from their current location.
They had to use their highest speed that was comparable to the peak of Initial Ascendion stage cultivators.
But everything was worth it as they reached their destination much faster than initially hoped for.
Having left behind all burdens and responsibilities, Jason and Jennifer were ready to embark on their own journey together…or so they thought.
In the end, it was just Jason's revenge that he would finally enact one step at a time after years of relentless efforts just to become a little bit stronger.
Jennifer was 'just' accompanying him on the path that Jason was walking on.
However, this 'just' was a lot more valuable to Jason than most things he had left behind.
All his life, he had fought alone and never had a companion.
It was only now, in the form of Jennifer, that he saw a worthy ally who he could have by his side without any worries of being betrayed.
This was an important factor and Jason didn't want to disregard the importance of Jennifer.
However, how should he know that Jennifer's presence next to him would make his journey both more pleasant and easy to walk on, but at the same time, become something horrifying enough to be imprinted into the depths of his heart?
Yet, right now, both didn't know anything about the fateful encounters they were bound to make.
For now, The only thing they could see were the armies of the Aeus and Devir race fighting against the Shadow walker alliance at the borders of the Julandra region!

chapters.title: Chapter 844 - Open Kidnapping
chapters.content:
Jason wasted no time and jumped right into the fray on the battlefield.
He targeted the Initial phase Ascendion stage beings and was quickly able to kill many beings belonging to the Shadow walker alliance.
It hadn't been his plan in the beginning, but somehow they had been pulled into the fight.
As such, Jason had decided to make use of the chaos to his benefit.
Thus, he had picked out the strongest prodigies at the Initial Ascendion stage before fighting them.
This was not only to allow himself to fight without holding back but also to knock these particular prodigies out and question them about the location of Lux later.
If that was something the prodigies didn't know, he could interrogate them about many other things that could lead towards the same end result.
His ultimate aim was to find out the rough location of Lux and the other humans who betrayed mankind on Argos.
Fortunately, it was not necessary for him to make a big detour.
After Jason revealed his ability to manifest body parts of his soulbonds and that he could do much more than that, many younger Shadow walkers stared at him in confusion.
Owing to the fusion he completed with Artemis, it was even possible for him to hear two prodigies of the Shadow walker race talking to each other.
"Isn't he one of the humans from this little planet? I already forgot its name… either way, I didn't know that the Aeus and Devir race had a world bridge to that planet too!"
Meanwhile, the other Shadow walker stared at Jason from faraway with conflicted emotions that were hidden under the cover of darkness he had created.
"It almost looks like his body part manifestation is stronger than that of our people. Maybe even stronger than that of the Lord of Death?
And I thought that the Lord of Death was a prodigy from Argos… but this human looks even more frightening!"
It was astonishing to hear someone talk about his home planet. But even more so was the fact that he felt as if he had already found what he had been looking for before truly entering the battlefield.
That was because the Lord of Death was most likely Lux, which caused Jason to almost laugh out loud.
However, instead of making fun of the ridiculous situation after finally connecting the dots, Jason decided that he should imprison the two prodigies of the Shadow walkers before leaving.
With that in mind, he told Jennifer that she should stay out of the fight because he would return in a moment.
That being said, he made use of the fusion with Artemis and manifested her wings.
Only a moment later, Jason released the two Stigmas, his Arctic aura, the Hermes Celeration movement technique, the moonlight affinity, and his divine energy, at once.
Through this, he was able to shoot towards the two prodigies of the Shadow walker race with a speed that crossed the threshold of their limits.
Yet, despite seeing Jason shooting towards them like a bullet, they had enough time to react…or so they thought.
As they had been busy talking to each other, they took a second to sense that someone had attacked them.
Just a second should have been more than enough for them to react, but Jason didn't even need a second. I
It was a fraction of a second later that both felt incapable of moving, their bodies rigid as stone.
Jason's sky blue eyes were gleaming brightly as he forcefully restricted the movements of one Shadow walker prodigy.
The other one's knees gave in as he collapsed on the ground just a moment later.
His eyes were pitch-black which was odd owing to the fact that their eyes were normally….red like a ruby in color.
Thus, the paralyzed Shadow walker stared at his friend in shock, believing that his friend had died just like that, only to perceive that the darkness around him was still moving.
Yet, before he was even able to do anything, Jason had already appeared behind the Shadow walker as he whispered an order.
"Now…go to sleep!"
Saying so, he used his hand to attack the Shadow walker, hitting the side of his neck in order to knock out the prodigy.
If that wouldn't have worked, Jason was ready to use his divine energy to combine his petrification curse, the race specific weakening curse, and the abyssal effect of his Emperor Eyes.
He had done the same with the first Shadow walker prodigy, who had collapsed on the ground already, so he wouldn't shy away from using it a second time.
However, that was not necessary, and both were knocked out.
This allowed Jason to pick them up before he shot high in the air, leaving as quickly as possible.
This was seen by the majority of other Shadow walkers on the battlefield at the Initial phase Ascendion stage, but considering that Jason had just defeated their two strongest two combatants, they didn't dare make a move against him.
Meanwhile, the other battlefields were relatively oblivious to Jason's appearance, and even less so when he disappeared with two unconscious Shadow walkers in his arms.
When he had left the battlefield, Jason couldn't help but feel that it had been way too easy.
But that was not something he should be complaining about.
Instead, he should be glad that it went much easier than he had planned.
In the end, he had killed a few Shadow walkers on the battlefield, but the number was not much in comparison to what he would have done if the other Initial Ascendion stage cultivators attacked him.
As such, the chaotic situation ended before it truly began.
BothJason and Jennifer disappeared, leaving everyone behind without attracting any attention from the stronger beings.
This allowed Jason to feel reassured as he and Jennifer had stopped flying almost half a day after they had departed.
The distance was more than enough to know if someone was following them or not.
Both of them and their imprisoners were hidden by the dense canopy of the treetops of large trees.
Additionally, the strong energy currents of other beasts that had been resting at their current location before they arrived, would serve as an additional camouflage to throw their pursuers, if any, off guard.
While waiting for another half a day, Jason read a book, while Jennifer was cultivating.
It was only when one of the Shadow walker prodigies began to move that they finished everything they had been doing.
As he stared at the Shadow walker, who was slowly regaining his consciousness, Jason couldn't help but feel satisfied.
The once 'mighty' and 'powerful' Shadow walkers that had terrorized Argos, were now lying in front of them, helpless and tied up.
"Who…are you guys?!?!" The Shadow walker that had just regained his consciousness asked in an angry voice as he stared at Jason.
His voice was filled with a sense of superiority and entitlement which was perfectly normal for a prodigy.
But Jason couldn't help but feel that his smile was widening as he countered,
"Do you really think we would tell you our real names? If that's the case, do you expect to survive if we tell you our real name?"
The moment Jason and Jennifer revealed their real names, they would have to kill the Shadow walker prodigy.
It would be stupid to give someone important information only to leave them alive.
After realizing this, the Shadow walker fell silent for a moment.
He looked into Jason's eyes that were clearly telling him that he was not someone to be taken lightly.
Jason had overcome more than enough hurdles to kill without feeling any remorse, and his eyes were the mirrored image of his soul, clearly showing this.
As such, the Shadow walker couldn't help but quietly ask.
"What…do you want from us?"

chapters.title: Chapter 845 - Betrayal
chapters.content:
"What…do you want from us?"
Jason tried to keep a poker face when he heard this question, and it worked to some extent.
Yet, when Jennifer saw how hard he was trying, she couldn't help but lightly push him as she mumbled,
"What are you doing?"
Apparently, Jennifer found the situation funnier than it was the case for Jason, which caused him to look at her in confusion.
"What? Can't I find it funny that the so-called prodigies of the Shadow walkers are being entitled in front of us? Their talent is trash in comparison to yours, after all!"
It was not like Jennifer was lying, but Jason noticed only now that her sense of humor was…unique, to put it plainly.
As such, he shook his head before averting his attention back to the awake Shadow walker.
"Just tell me where can I find the Lord of Death, and I might consider allowing you to leave safely."
Jason asked the question as if he was discussing whether with one of the most talented Ultimate soldiers the Shadow walkers were nurturing.
This caused the prodigious Shadow walker to stop trying to free himself for a moment.
It was as if his mind turned blank, only for him to ask.
"You…come from Argos too, right?"
There was no need for Jason to answer this question, but he simply nodded his head, not denying the obvious fact. His fusion with Artemis was enough to show that he had a soulbond with which he could combine his strength, after all.
After he nodded his head, Jason hoped to receive an answer to his earlier question.
But the Shadow walker prodigy was still quiet, thinking a lot about what he should do.
His life was on the line, but even if he were to tell everything he knew about the Lord of Death, it didn't mean that he would necessarily stay alive.
"Will you set me free if I tell you his location?" the Shadow walker asked reluctantly.
Jason felt that it was obvious that the Shadow walker was afraid of dying.
But it was already astonishing enough that he didn't betray his race to buy his freedom or his life in exchange.
That meant the Shadow walker prodigy would most likely return to his people the moment this was possible.
Despite that, Jason nodded his head as he answered.
"If you want to stay alive, I will set you free.
But after that, you should stay here for an entire week. There is no need for me to kill you but the moment I find you annoying, you'll die, alright?
By the way, if I get to know that you returned to your race before a week passed, I'll torture you in the worst possible way!"
Jason hoped that this was enough to prevent the Shadow walker from doing anything, but he knew that this was not the case.
The moment he and Jennifer would leave, they would probably leave straight to alert the others.
In no time they would report everything he had said, and where he and Jennifer were heading.
Despite that, Jason didn't want to kill the Shadow walker prodigies.
It might only be his opinion, but he had no problem killing anyone on the battlefield.
However, he was against killing someone who was tied-up, and unarmed.
"Why don't you just use mana sealing handcuffs? With our energy supplying the runes, they should stay active for two weeks…I guess. So one week for each of them!
Well, that is if you really don't want to kill them. The handcuffs are quite expensive after all."
Jason raised his right eyebrow upon hearing Jennifer's idea which she simply stated without giving it another thought.
Yet, instead of commenting on the fact that Jennifer gave living beings a price tag, he just nodded his head.
"If you are fine with giving me the handcuffs, I would be grateful to you!"
Jennifer was already moving, but when she heard how polite Jason sounded she stopped in her tracks.
"I will make you pay back ten times the price of the handcuffs, so be prepared to slave away for me! And I don't like that you're being formal with me…"
Frowning at her line, Jason was not sure if Jennifer was teasing him or if she was dead serious.
As such, he couldn't help but nod his head before ruffling her hair.
However, only a moment later he turned around, looking at the Shadow walker with a serious expression.
"I guess you listened. To put it simply, you won't be killed as long as you tell me all the information I need to know!
In the end, Jason knew that he could have used the foretelling ability to figure out Lux's location. But there were too many downsides that came forth with the use of the blessing.
First, it looked like he could only use the foretelling blessing once in a few months, which was perfectly fine.
Other than that, even if he were to use the blessing right now, it would only show him images.
He would be clueless about where he had to go, how far was it from his current location or the name of the place.
This was quite disadvantageous, which was why Jason chose the easier way to figure out the information he wanted to get to know!
That way was to use the Shadow walker prodigies who had already exposed the fact that they knew more about the humans on Argos.
Their race had been taking humans with them for quite some time already.
As such, there shouldn't be a problem getting to know the information he wanted.
At the same time, Jason was extremely good at figuring out if someone was lying.
His Emperor Eyes allowed him to perceive everything down to the finest detail after all.
Other than that, he was able to perceive energy fluctuations that were the most distinct indicator if someone was lying or not.
With that in mind, Jason asked,
"Now tell me. Where are the humans on Argos situated, and where can I find the 'Lord of Death'?"
The other Shadow walker prodigy had yet to wake up, but Jason didn't think that he needed any information from him.
After all, the Shadow Walker, who was awake, seemed to be willing to provide every single piece of information he required.
Hearing the Shadow walker share everything he could think of to save his life made Jason nod his head.
He was quite intrigued about what he had heard him blabber.
If his words were true, there seemed to be many more humans that had been taken away by the Shadow walker race than he initially expected.
To be precise, the Shadow walker prodigy told him about the combined work of dozens of races that were connected to Argos.
These races had worked together in order to kidnap as many talented humans as possible.
Under normal circumstances, this would enrage Jason, but he was eerily calm and was patiently listening to everything.
When the Shadow walker was almost nearing the end of his explanation, Jason noticed that the other prodigy was stirring.
Yet, instead of averting his attention to the other prodigy, he kept asking all kinds of things to the one who was already awake.
As such, the prodigy who had just woken up could only hear his friend willingly exposing all kinds of secrets, shocking him to the core.
Because of that, Jason assumed that a huge fight would break out at any moment, which would be quite interesting to see because the two Shadow walker prodigies were tied up.
However, oddly enough, the Shadow walker prodigy who had just awoken remained quiet as if he was okay with whatever his friend was doing.
Yet, it was just a moment later that Jason's foresight blessing noticed something.
It caused him to react instinctively as he turned around, before fusing with Petri.
Only a fraction of a second later, he grasped Jennifer as he released his entire mana and divine energy.
He used these two simultaneously to give his speed a major boost to an extent he had never reached before.
With Jennifer in his arms, Jason was quickly transported several hundred meters away from the Shadow walker who had only sensed the wind pressure.
He had barely blinked before he noticed that his kidnappers were not in front of him anymore.
A moment later, he sensed faint mana fluctuation from his friend, indicating that he had finally awoken.
Unfortunately, his joy didn't stay long as his friend shouted.
"TRAITOR, DIE!"
The moment he shouted this word, he released his entire energy at once, utilized in the red Miasma that was suddenly released from his body.
Just a fraction of a second later, his body exploded like a volcano.
It filled the red Miasma with the necessary energy to reach the surroundings in a range of several hundred meters only a second later.
The Shadow walker prodigy who had exposed all secrets about the humans on Argos felt incapable of moving.
He was paralyzed and his energy was drained, while he was clueless as to what had happened just now.
He could only stare at the spot his friend had been only a moment ago where a red crystal lay instead. Looking at the ground with disbelieving eyes, he blurted out,
"Shit…", before he died. His body began to wither as the energy that had once invigorated him was rapidly draining off his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 846 - To The Death Lord
chapters.content:
Jason had expected a fight to break out between the two Shadow walker prodigies.
But, he could have never expected that the second prodigy would sacrifice himself just to prevent his own kind from exposing even more information.
That was a drastic measure considering that he didn't know the situation or why the Shadow walker prodigy who had woken up first, revealed all kinds of secrets.
However, fortunately enough, Jason had noticed what would happen early enough.
If not for his sharp senses,? he and Jennifer would have died too.
In fact, it was scary enough to just look at the red Miasma.
Yet, after seeing the energy streams through his Emperor Eyes, Jason felt goosebumps spreading over his entire body.
He couldn't even explain what exactly he was seeing, but if he were to describe it, the whole red Miasma felt like a sentient and living being!
The moving energy currents were intertwined with some sort of mixture of lifeforce and an unknown type of energy.
This made them unique, and oddly intriguing to Jason.
Nevertheless, it felt much more dangerous than it was interesting.
Trusting his gut feeling, Jason continued to retreat the more the red Miasma expanded.
In the end, it dispersed into nothingness.
But before that, it drained the life and energy out of everything it touched.
Thus, the small area of the forest had withered which the Miasma had touched.
It had sucked the vitality and life out of everything, leaving nothing but death behind.
Lifeless trees crumbled before they fell over, while the lush grass was now pale yellow in color, dry and perished.
Even the soil below had changed in color, causing Jason to be a little bit flabbergasted.
However, he quickly got a hold of himself and by taking a look at Jennifer, he saw that she was fine too.
He was still holding her in a tight grasp, but when he noticed this, Jason let go of her.
While continuing to stare at the once green field that looked no better than a desolate piece of land right now, it was impossible not to be impressed by the ability of the now deceased Shadow walker prodigy.
After all, the red Miasma could be turned into a means of mass destruction if used properly.
It was almost as if some Shadow walkers were trained to sacrifice themselves if the situation on the battlefield or in some other incident were to become too dangerous.
This was most likely exactly what had just happened, and Jason predicted that all Shadow walkers had learned this technique.
He had no idea if that was truly the case, but thinking that every single one of them could sacrifice their life force and energy to activate some sort of racial ability, was the best he could come up with.
After all, this thought could save him from being overconfident.
The belief that the Shadow walker weaker than him would be unable to even hurt him would be his doom.
With the red Miasma even the weakest of them could certainly injure and even kill him.
As such, Jason had to be careful of advancing further while fighting Shadow walkers.
He hadn't done it earlier owing to the fact that he was alone in the middle of their rows but now he couldn't risk it.
In the end, nobody would intentionally kill their comrades as long as the situation was not against their odds, and impossible to win anymore.
Averting his attention from the gloomy field, he looked at Jennifer before he smiled lightly and asked,
"How about we go and take a look at the Shiman camp? I heard that there are a few people I know…and someone I want to show how it feels to be betrayed by their own people!"
When Jason began to speak, it sounded like he was joking, considering the situation to be quite easy.
However, when he ended his sentence, Jennifer couldn't help but feel a little bit confused.
"Is..it about the Lord of Death, again?"
Until now, Jason had never said much about his past, even less about the things that had happened on Argos.
Because of that, Jennifer had always believed that Jason loathed the time he had spent on his home planet.
Yet, the more time she spent with him, the less likely it seemed.
She had paid attention to his words and could recall that there were quite a few people Jason had mentioned once or twice already.
However, knowing that Jason's only family, that is his mother, was dead, and the fact that his masters on Argos had also died, it was not difficult to imagine what he felt about the place.
It was complex and far from easy, just like her emotions concerning her parents and master.
Thus, she didn't want to ask Jason something he didn't want to answer.
But seeing him nodding his head nonchalantly in response emboldened her.
Wanting to know more about him, Jennifer couldn't help but continue asking,
"Can you tell me more about your past, and what happened with the Lord of Death, that you are so eager to kill him?"
By turning his head a little, he looked directly into the depth of Jennifer's eyes.
She was looking at him with confidence, her interest in his past apparent by the glint in her eyes.
Jennifer desperately wanted to know more about him and his life before she had met him.
Seeing this, Jason, who hadn't planned to tell her the boring story of his life, which was filled with more petty emotions and useless grudges than one could think, decided to open up a little.
After all, Lux had only shot him in his shoulder, yet, he wanted to kill Lux!
Yet, after thinking about it a third time, killing Lux might be the nicer option.
Jason had once even considered damaging Lux's soul world to the extent that he would never be able to use it again.
However, that would be worse than killing Lux, which was not exactly what Jason had wanted to do.
In fact, Lux had killed and tortured many more people other than him in order to make use of their corpses.
As such, Jason wouldn't feel bad about anything he did to Lux, and it was not like he was a saint, to begin with, either!
With that in mind, he would await the moment of his re-encounter with Lux.
But for now, it was time for him to tell Jennifer his story!
This didn't take long because he cut to the chase, and told Jennifer only about the important things.
Unfortunately, this made his story less interesting than it truly was, but Jennifer realized that Jason left out a lot. He had wrapped the painful experience of the death of his soulbond and masters in a single sentence after all.
Owing to this, Jennifer clearly knew that the memories still hurt him like a long-forgotten wound that would hurt when you touched it.
Even if did not actively dwell on those memories on a daily basis, the loved ones he had lost held a special place in his heart.
His mind was still tormented with guilt, even though he could have done nothing to change their fate.
He was young and thus, obviously also weak at that time.
Because of that, she didn't say anything after Jason ended his story but tightly hugged him.
This was unexpected, and Jason stiffened for a moment, only to return the hug.
Afterward, they decided that it was best to leave the Julandra region for the time being.
They wished to take a look at the Shiman camp that was, in fact, a place at which the humans with a soul world were being trained.
There was much more information one had to know, but the most important fact for Jason was that they would most likely encounter Lux there!
If he was not there, he was probably nearby.
He could most likely be in a certain area the Shadow walker prodigy had been unable to mention or hint at because he had never entered it.
With that in mind, Jason stated in a confident voice,
"Let's go…to the Lord of Death!"
